glossary.ἐρητύσειέ: ἐρητύω — restrain, hold back; aor. opt. 3 sg. (accent thrown back before the enclitic τε): ’he should restrain’
glossary.ἐριβώλακι: ἐριβώλαξ — with rich soil, clod-rich; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having drawn (a sword)’
glossary.ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’
glossary.ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’
glossary.ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐτέλεσσας: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. 2 sg., epic -σσ-: ’you fulfilled’
glossary.ἐτράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐτράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned, changed’
glossary.ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
glossary.ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
glossary.ἑθέν: οὗ (ἕθεν) — of him, of her; epic 3rd-person reflexive/pron. gen. sg.: ’than her’ (gen. of comparison)
glossary.ἑκάεργον: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooting (epithet of Apollo); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’taking’
glossary.ἑσπόμεθ: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἑσπόμεθ’ = ἑσπόμεθα; Attic ἐσπόμεθα)
glossary.ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἑτοιμάσατ: ἑτοιμάζω — prepare, make ready; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἑτοιμάσατ’ = ἑτοιμάσατε)
glossary.ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
glossary.ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
glossary.ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
glossary.ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
glossary.ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
glossary.ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔμοιγε: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’to me, for my part’
glossary.ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ (+ dat.: βασιλῆϊ … ἔοικε ’is like a king’)
glossary.ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
glossary.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’)
glossary.ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
glossary.ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρχομ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 sg., elided (ἔρχομ’ = ἔρχομαι)
glossary.ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be, let him be’
glossary.ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf.
glossary.ἔχθιστος: ἔχθιστος — most hateful; superl. of ἐχθρός, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔχῃς: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’you may have’
glossary.ἔω: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ὦ), in a purpose clause: ’I may be’
glossary.ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
glossary.ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
glossary.ἕλωμαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I shall take’
glossary.ἕνεκά: ἕνεκα — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., accented ἕνεκά after its noun or pronoun
glossary.ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
glossary.ἠχήεσσα: ἠχήεις — echoing, resounding; fem. nom. sg., epic -ήεσσα
glossary.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
glossary.ἤλασαν: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. 3 pl., epic
glossary.ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they came, advanced’
glossary.ἥμιν: ἐγώ — I; epic dat. pl. ἥμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to/for us’
glossary.ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
glossary.ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε)
glossary.ἧος: ἧος — while, until; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως)
glossary.ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’
glossary.ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
glossary.ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. as noun: ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adj., agreeing with τείχεα: ’sacred (walls)’
glossary.ἱλάσσεαι: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἱλάσῃ), after ὄφρα: ’you may appease’
glossary.ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
glossary.ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also after ὄφρα: ’that you may see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after αἴ κεν: ’if he should see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’
glossary.ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
glossary.ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
glossary.ἵκωμαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I come to’
glossary.ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
glossary.ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’)
glossary.ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
glossary.ὀλέσσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσῃ): ’he may lose’
glossary.ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’)
glossary.ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
glossary.ὀσσόμενος: ὄσσομαι — see before one, foresee, forebode; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁμοιωθήμεναι: ὁμοιόω — make like, make equal; aor. pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ὁμοιωθῆναι): ’to be made equal’
glossary.ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
glossary.ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
glossary.ὄθομαι: ὄθομαι — care for, heed (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg., epic, used with a negative
glossary.ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
glossary.ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
glossary.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’)
glossary.ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
glossary.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’)
glossary.ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’
glossary.ὑπεροπλίῃσι: ὑπεροπλίη — arrogance, overbearing violence; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
glossary.ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
glossary.ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
glossary.ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
glossary.ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
glossary.ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
glossary.ᾗς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὑπεροπλίῃσι · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗς (= ᾗσι, Attic αἷς): ’in which’ (ᾗς ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
glossary.ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’
glossary.αἰγεΐδην: Αἰγεΐδης — son of Aegeus (patronymic of Theseus); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰχμητὴν: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative (’made him a spearman’) · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a name: ’Trechus the spearman’ · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a noun with epithets: ’wild spearman’ (ἄγριον αἰχμητήν)
glossary.αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, at once; adv., accented before the enclitic τοι
glossary.αὐδή: αὐδή — voice, speech; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves, of their own accord’
glossary.αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
glossary.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’)
glossary.αὖτέ: αὖτε — again, now in turn; adv., accented αὖτέ before the enclitic μιν
glossary.βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’threw, dashed’ · also ’hit, struck’ a target (κατ’ ἀσπίδα … βάλε ’hit the shield’) · also ’put on, fitted’ in tmesis (ἀμφ’ ὀχέεσσι … βάλε ’fitted to the chariot’)
glossary.βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
glossary.βασιλεύς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, was gone’
glossary.βουλέων: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.βουλὴν: βουλή — counsel, plan, advice; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in counsel’
glossary.βροτοί: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc. nom. pl.: ’mortals’
glossary.βῆσε: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 sg. causative, unaugmented (= ἔβησε): ’made go aboard, embarked’
glossary.γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γαίας)
glossary.γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
glossary.γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο) · also of a father: ’begot, fathered’
glossary.γενεαὶ: γενεά — generation, race of men; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γηθήσαι: γηθέω — rejoice; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic -σαι (= Attic γηθήσειε): ’would rejoice’
glossary.γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γλυκίων: γλυκύς — sweet; comparative γλυκίων, masc. nom. sg. + gen.: ’sweeter than’
glossary.γλώσσης: γλῶσσα — tongue; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γλώσσης/γλώττης)
glossary.γνώωσι: γιγνώσκω — know, come to know; aor. subj. 3 pl., epic lengthened (= Attic γνῶσι)
glossary.δαίμονας: δαίμων — god, divine power; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δειλός: δειλός — cowardly, wretched; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δημοβόρος: δημοβόρος — devouring the people (δῆμος ’people’ + βορά ’food’); masc. nom. sg., used in address
glossary.δικασπόλοι: δικασπόλος — dispenser of justice, judge; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δουρί: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δόρατι)
glossary.δρύαντά: Δρύας — Dryas, a Lapith hero; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.δυνήσεαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic δυνήσῃ)
glossary.δόντες: δίδωμι — give; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having given’
glossary.δῶρ: δῶρον — gift; neut. acc. pl., elided (δῶρ’ = δῶρα) · also neut. nom. pl., elided: ’gifts’ (δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’the gifts of Aphrodite’)
glossary.εἰρύαται: ἐρύομαι (εἰρύομαι) — guard, protect; perf. mid. 3 pl. with pres. sense, epic -αται (for -νται): ’they guard’
glossary.εἰρύσσασθαι: ἐρύομαι (εἰρύομαι) — guard, keep, observe; aor. inf. mid., doubled σ (= Attic ἐρύσασθαι)
glossary.εἴδεται: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (with inf.); pres. mid. 3 sg.: ’seems’
glossary.εἴπῃ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whoever may speak’
glossary.εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., often after its noun; epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
glossary.εἷσεν: ἵζω — seat, set; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’seated, set’
glossary.εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj. (with ἄν + subj.) · also with an aor. indic. in a simile: ’when’ (εὖτ’ … κατέχευεν ’when he has poured’)
glossary.θέμιστας: θέμις — custom, established right, ordinance; fem. acc. pl.: ’ordinances, customary rights’
glossary.θησέα: Θησεύς — Theseus, hero of Athens; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θνήσκοντες: θνῄσκω — die; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’dying’
glossary.θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.θωρηχθῆναι: θωρήσσω (mid. θωρήσσομαι) — arm, put on armour; aor. pass. inf. with middle sense: ’to arm oneself’
glossary.κάρτιστοι: κάρτιστος — strongest, mightiest (superl. of κρατερός); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.καινέα: Καινεύς — Caeneus, a Lapith hero; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κακοῖο: κακός — bad, evil; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.καλέσαντο: καλέω — call, summon; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they summoned (me)’
glossary.καλεοίμην: καλέω — call; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid./pass., uncontracted (= Attic καλοίμην): ’I would be called’
glossary.καρτίστοις: κάρτιστος — strongest, mightiest (superl. of κρατερός); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.κείνοισι: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐκείνοις)
glossary.κελαινὸν: κελαινός — dark, black; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.κεχαροίατο: χαίρω — rejoice; reduplicated aor. opt. mid. 3 pl., epic -οίατο (= -οιντο): ’would rejoice’
glossary.κεχολωμένον: χολόω — make angry; pass. be angry; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the unexpressed subject of an infinitive
glossary.κεῖνοι: ἐκεῖνος — that, he; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl., epic κεῖνος (= Attic ἐκεῖνος): ’those men’
glossary.κλισίας: κλισίη — hut, shelter (of soldiers); fem. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic κλισίας from κλισία)
glossary.κουλεὸν: κουλεός — sheath, scabbard; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
glossary.κρατέειν: κρατέω — be strong, rule, prevail over (+ gen.); pres. inf., uncontracted (= Attic κρατεῖν)
glossary.κώπῃ: κώπη — handle, hilt (of a sword); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ
glossary.κὴρ: κήρ — death-spirit, power of death, doom; fem. nom. sg., personified (distinct from κῆρ ’heart’)
glossary.κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’glory’
glossary.λέλοιπεν: λείπω — leave, forsake; perf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’has left’
glossary.λίσσομ: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. 1 sg., elided (λίσσομ’ = λίσσομαι)
glossary.λαῷ: λαός — people, host, army; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λιγὺς: λιγύς — clear-toned, clear-voiced; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λωβήσαιο: λωβάομαι — outrage, insult, act with outrage; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., with ἄν: ’you would commit outrage’
glossary.λόχον: λόχος — ambush, band lying in wait; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion: ’to an ambush’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of εἷσαν: ’set an ambush’
glossary.λώϊόν: λώϊον — better, more desirable (comparative of ἀγαθός); neut. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστί
glossary.λῆγ: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (λῆγ’ = λῆγε) · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔληγε): ’did cease’ (οὐδ’ Ἀγαμέμνων λῆγ’ ἔριδος ’nor did Agamemnon cease from strife’)
glossary.λῆγε: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.: ’ceased’
glossary.λῦσαν: λύω — loose, release, break up; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔλυσαν)
glossary.μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μέλιτος: μέλι — honey; neut. gen. sg., gen. of comparison with γλυκίων
glossary.μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
glossary.μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; negative conj. with imperatives, correlative: ’neither … nor’
glossary.μαρναμένοιϊν: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. part. mid. dual masc. gen./dat., epic -οιϊν: ’you two fighting’
glossary.μαχέοιτο: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. opt. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μάχοιτο): ’would fight’
glossary.μαχήσομαι: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall fight’
glossary.μαχεσσαμένω: μάχομαι — fight; aor. part. mid. dual masc. nom., doubled σ (= μαχεσαμένω): ’the two having fought’
glossary.μαχόμην: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμαχόμην): ’I fought’
glossary.μεθέμεν: μεθίημι — let go, give up; aor. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic μεθεῖναι)
glossary.μεθομίλεον: μεθομιλέω — consort with (+ dat.); impf. 1 sg., uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic μεθωμίλουν)
glossary.μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black, dark; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα, standing epithet of ships · also fem. dat. sg., epithet of κήρ ’death, doom’: ’black’
glossary.μενοιτιάδῃ: Μενοιτιάδης — son of Menoetius, i.e. Patroclus (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μερόπων: μέροψ — epithet of men, ’mortal’ or ’speech-dividing’ (meaning uncertain); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν)
glossary.μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
glossary.μὴν: μήν — truly, indeed; affirmative particle, in εἰ δ’ ἄγε μὴν ’come now’
glossary.νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ναὶ: ναί — yes, verily; affirmative particle (ναὶ μὰ + acc. in oaths; ναὶ δή ’yes indeed’)
glossary.νεωτέρω: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, dual masc. nom.: ’both younger’
glossary.νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
glossary.νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
glossary.ξύνιεν: ξυνίημι — understand, heed (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic συνίεσαν): ’they understood’
glossary.οἰνοβαρές: οἰνοβαρής — heavy with wine, drunkard; masc. voc. sg., used as a noun in address
glossary.οἵδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’these here’
glossary.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’)
glossary.οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl.: ’to whom’ (οἷς … μέλει ’to whom … is a care’)
glossary.οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’
glossary.οὐτιδανοῖσιν: οὐτιδανός — worthless, of no account; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.οὐτιδανὸς: οὐτιδανός — worthless, of no account; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὔλυμπον: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion with the -δε ’to’ that follows
glossary.οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
glossary.πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’)
glossary.πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.πίθεσθ: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (πίθεσθ’ = πίθεσθε)
glossary.πίθεσθε: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’obey’
glossary.πίθηαι: πείθομαι — be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πίθῃ)
glossary.πίπτωσι: πίπτω — fall; pres. subj. 3 pl. (with εὖτ’ ἂν): ’fall’
glossary.παλάμῃς: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic παλάμαις)
glossary.παρέσσεται: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic παρέσται): ’will be at hand’
glossary.παύσουσα: παύω — stop, make cease; fut. part. act. fem. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to stop’
glossary.παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παῦε: παύω — stop, make cease; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.
glossary.πείθεο: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic πείθου)
glossary.πείθεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey, comply with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.πείθοντό: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπείθοντο), acute before the enclitic τε: ’they obeyed’
glossary.πείρησαι: πειράομαι — try, make trial (of); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’try’
glossary.πείσεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to obey, to be going to obey’
glossary.πειρίθοόν: Πειρίθοος — Peirithous, king of the Lapiths; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πεπαρμένον: πείρω — pierce, pin through; perf. pass. part. neut. acc. sg.: ’studded, fastened through’
glossary.περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’)
glossary.πηλεΐδης: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πηλείδη: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πλεόνεσσιν: πλείων — more, greater in number (comparative of πολύς); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic πλείοσιν)
glossary.ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ποθ’); οὔ ποθ’ ’never’
glossary.ποθὴ: ποθή — longing, want, need (+ gen.); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
glossary.πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many counsels, very wily, epithet of Odysseus (μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολύφημον: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, a Lapith hero (not the Cyclops); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’)
glossary.πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πριάμοιό: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.προέρυσσεν: προερύω — drag forward, launch; aor. 3 sg., doubled σ, ν-movable (= Attic προήρυσε)
glossary.προθέουσιν: προθέω — run forward, rush ahead; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic προθέουσι)
glossary.πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
glossary.πυθοίατο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= -οιντο): ’would learn’
glossary.πυλίων: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Pylians’
glossary.πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
glossary.πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πύλῳ: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’
glossary.πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
glossary.σήμαιν: σημαίνω — give orders, command; pres. imper. act. 2 sg., elided (σήμαιν’ = σήμαινε)
glossary.σημαίνειν: σημαίνω — give orders, command (+ dat.); pres. inf. act.
glossary.σκηπτοῦχος: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-holding, sceptred; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σφωΐτερόν: σφωΐτερος — of you two, your (dual possessive); neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’of you two’
glossary.σχέθε: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., thematic aorist with epic -θ- (σχεθ-), unaugmented (= ἔσχε)
glossary.σύμπαντας: σύμπας — all together, all; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε that follows · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σύν ῥ’ ἔβαλον = συνέβαλον ’dashed together’)
glossary.σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
glossary.τέτληκας: τλάω — endure, dare, have the heart; perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense (+ inf.): ’you have the heart’
glossary.ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic · also elided ταῦτ’
glossary.τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’
glossary.τηλόθεν: τηλόθεν — from afar; adv., ablatival suffix -θεν
glossary.τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg., partitive after ἔμμορε
glossary.τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
glossary.τοίους: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τομὴν: τομή — cutting, stump (where a tree was cut); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic οἱ · also accented before the enclitic μιν (τοὔνεκά μιν κάλεον ’for that reason they called him’)
glossary.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’)
glossary.τράφεν: τρέφω — nourish, rear, bring up; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτράφησαν): ’were reared, grew up’
glossary.τριτάτοισιν: τρίτατος — third (epic by-form of τρίτος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
glossary.τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
glossary.τόνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg., elided (τόνδ’ = τόνδε): ’this man’
glossary.τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’)
glossary.τῆσδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τῳ: τις, τι — someone, anyone; masc./neut. dat. sg. (= τινί), enclitic: ’to anyone’
glossary.υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
glossary.φέροις: φέρω — carry, bear off; pres. opt. 2 sg. act. (with ἄν, potential): ’you could carry off’
glossary.φηρσὶν: φήρ — wild beast (Aeolic form of θήρ); in Homer used of the Centaurs; masc. dat. pl., epic -σιν
glossary.φορέουσι: φορέω — carry, bear (habitually); pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φοροῦσι)
glossary.φύλλά: φύλλον — leaf; neut. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.φύσει: φύω — bring forth, put forth (shoots); fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will put forth’
glossary.χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
glossary.χραισμεῖν: χραισμέω — ward off, avail, help (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.: ’to help, to avail’
glossary.χρυσείοις: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
glossary.χόλοιο: χόλος — anger, bile; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after λῆγε (ceasing from)
glossary.ἀέκοντος: ἀέκων — unwilling (= Attic ἄκων); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ἐμεῖο: ’against my will’
glossary.ἀγορητής: ἀγορητής — speaker, orator; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθέριζον: ἀθερίζω — slight, make light of, scorn; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἠθέριζον)
glossary.ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθηναίης: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic form (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
glossary.ἀμύξεις: ἀμύσσω — tear, scratch, rend; fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will tear’
glossary.ἀνάσσει: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνάσσειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. inf.: ’to rule over’
glossary.ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
glossary.ἀναθηλήσει: ἀναθηλέω (ἀναθάλλω) — bloom again, sprout afresh; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνδροφόνοιο: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνελὼν: ἀναιρέω — take up, take away; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken away’
glossary.ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀνστήτην: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 dual, root aorist, unaugmented (= ἀνεστήτην): ’the two stood up’
glossary.ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
glossary.ἀντιβίην: ἀντίβιος — opposing, hostile; fem. acc. sg. used as an adv.: ’in open opposition, against’
glossary.ἀντιβίοισι: ἀντίβιος — opposing, hostile; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
glossary.ἀπίης: ἄπιος — far-off, distant (ancient explanation; sense uncertain, ’Apian’ is another view); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
glossary.ἀποαίρεο: ἀφαιρέομαι (ἀποαιρέομαι) — take away from (someone); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted -εο (= Attic ἀφαιροῦ)
glossary.ἀποαιρεῖσθαι: ἀφαιρέομαι (ἀποαιρέομαι) — take away, seize; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀπόλεσσαν: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, doubled σ (= ἀπώλεσαν)
glossary.ἀργυρέῃ: ἀργύρεος — of silver, silvery; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀρείοσιν: ἀρείων — better, braver (comparative of ἀγαθός); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀριστήεσσιν: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. dat. pl., epic -ήεσσιν (= Attic -εῦσιν)
glossary.ἀταρτηροῖς: ἀταρτηρός — harsh, harmful, mischievous (ancient gloss; meaning uncertain, origin unknown); neut. dat. pl. (= -οῖς)
glossary.ἀφέλεσθέ: ἀφαιρέω — take away; mid. take away for oneself; aor. 2 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἀφείλεσθε), accented before γε
glossary.ἀχαιΐδα: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean; adj. of land, fem. acc. sg. · also used as a noun: ’Achaea’, the Achaean land (Ἀχαιΐδα καλλιγύναικα ’Achaea of the fair women’)
glossary.ἀχαιοῖσιν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἀχιλλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἀχιλλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.ἀχνύμενός: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accented before περ: ’grieving’
glossary.ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
glossary.ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’
glossary.ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄνασσεν: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤνασσεν): ’ruled’
glossary.ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
glossary.ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’)
glossary.ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’
glossary.ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
glossary.ἐΐσας: ἐΐσος (ἔΐσος) — equal, even, balanced (of ships, sense uncertain); fem. acc. pl., epic · also of mares, ’balanced, level’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ἐΐσας ’balanced along the back’)
glossary.ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’)
glossary.ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐκπάγλως: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, vehement; adv. ἐκπάγλως: ’terribly, mightily’
glossary.ἐλάφοιο: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐμήνιε: μηνίω — be wrathful, rage; impf. 3 sg.: ’was angry’
glossary.ἐξάδιόν: Ἐξάδιος — Exadius, a Lapith hero; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
glossary.ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
glossary.ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἐπιείκελον: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic
glossary.ἐπιπείθηται: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey (+ dat.); pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause: ’whoever obeys’
glossary.ἐπιτέλλεο: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, lay a command on; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἐπιτέλλου)
glossary.ἐπιχθονίων: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπιχθόνιοι: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐριζέμεναι: ἐρίζω — strive, contend (with + dat.); pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐρίζειν)
glossary.ἐρωήσει: ἐρωέω — rush, gush forth; fut. 3 sg.: ’will gush’
glossary.ἐστὸν: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 dual (3 dual is the same): ’you two are’
glossary.ἐφθίαθ: φθίνω — perish, die; plpf. mid. 3 pl., elided (ἐφθίαθ’ = ἐφθίατο, -ατο for -ντο): ’had passed away’
glossary.ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
glossary.ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
glossary.ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
glossary.ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
glossary.ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
glossary.ἔγωγ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε, elided (ἔγωγ’ = ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
glossary.ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
glossary.ἔθελ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔθελ’ = ἔθελε)
glossary.ἔθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they made’
glossary.ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hearken to (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), in a general statement: ’they hear’
glossary.ἔκρινεν: κρίνω — separate, choose out; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’picked out’
glossary.ἔλεψε: λέπω — peel, strip; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’stripped’
glossary.ἔμμορε: μείρομαι — receive a share; perf. 3 sg. ἔμμορε, + gen.: ’has a share of’
glossary.ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
glossary.ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
glossary.ἔσεταί: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἔσεται (= Attic ἔσται), accented before the enclitic περ: ’it will be’
glossary.ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἔτισας: τίω — honour, value; aor. 2 sg. act.: ’you honoured’
glossary.ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἕλκεο: ἕλκω — draw, drag, pull; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἕλκου)
glossary.ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ
glossary.ἠγαθέῃ: ἠγάθεος — very holy, sacred (intensive formation); adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἠμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’answered’
glossary.ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
glossary.ἥλοισι: ἧλος — nail, stud; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
glossary.ἱκάνει: ἱκάνω — come, arrive, reach; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
glossary.ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with future force: ’shall I see’
glossary.ἴσχεο: ἴσχω — hold, restrain; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἴσχου): ’restrain yourself, hold back’
glossary.ἵξεται: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will reach’
glossary.ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀμοῦμαι: ὄμνυμι — swear; fut. 1 sg. mid. (contracted from ὀμόσσομαι): ’I shall swear’
glossary.ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’reproaches’ (λέγ’ ὀνείδεα ’spoke reproaches’)
glossary.ὀνείδισον: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’revile’
glossary.ὀρεσκῴοισι: ὀρεσκῷος — lying on the mountains, of the mountains (traditional explanation; meaning uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ὁμοίης: ὅμοιος — like, equal; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὄζους: ὄζος — branch, twig; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὄμματ: ὄμμα — eye; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὄμματ’ = ὄμματα)
glossary.ὄρεσσι: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
glossary.ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
glossary.ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν
glossary.ὑπείξομαι: ὑπείκω — yield, give way to (+ dat.); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall yield’
glossary.ὑποβλήδην: ὑποβλήδην — taking up another’s speech, in retort; adv.
glossary.ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’)
glossary.ὔμμες: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; nom. pl., epic ὔμμες (= Attic ὑμεῖς)
glossary.ὕβριος: ὕβρις — insolence, outrage, arrogance; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὕστατα: ὕστατος — last; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’for the last time’
glossary.ὡμίλησα: ὁμιλέω — consort with (+ dat.); aor. 1 sg. act., augment ὡ- (= ὁ + ἠ): ’I kept company with’
glossary.ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
glossary.ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
glossary.ῥέεν: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἔρρει): ’flowed’
glossary.αἰγαίων: Αἰγαίων — Aegaeon, men’s name for the hundred-handed Briareus; masc. acc. sg., elided (Αἰγαίων’ = Αἰγαίωνα)
glossary.αἰδομένω: αἰδέομαι — feel awe or shame before, respect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. dual (= Attic αἰδουμένω)
glossary.αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.
glossary.αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic αὐτοῦ): ’him’, after πάροιθε ’before him’
glossary.αὐτὼ: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. dual: ’the two themselves’
glossary.αὖθ: αὖθις (elided αὖθ’) — again, in turn, next; adv., epic by-form αὖθι (cf. αὖτε)
glossary.βάλλον: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλλον): ’were throwing’
glossary.βάτην: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐβήτην): ’the two went’
glossary.βένθεσσιν: βένθος — depth (of the sea); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic βένθεσι)
glossary.βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in might’ · also periphrasis for a person, direct object: ’the might of Priam’ (= Priam himself) · also periphrasis for a person, acc. subject of an infinitive: ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself) · also periphrasis for a person, governed by ἀμφί: ’around the might of Diomedes’ (= around Diomedes himself)
glossary.βαρὺ: βαρύς — heavy, deep; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’heavily’
glossary.βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
glossary.βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic βασιλέως)
glossary.βριάρεων: Βριάρεως — Briareus, the hundred-handed giant; masc. acc. sg., epic -εων (= Attic Βριάρεων)
glossary.βρισηΐδος: Βρισηΐς — Briseis, the captive woman of Achilles; fem. gen. sg. (-ηΐδος)
glossary.βρισῆος: Βρισεύς — Briseus, father of Briseis; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’) · also after ὅπως in an indirect question: ’how … may come about, turn out’ · also in a prohibition or negative wish after μή: ’let it not become’
glossary.γέροντι: γέρων — old man; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε)
glossary.γαίων: γαίω — exult, glory (in); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. of the thing gloried in
glossary.γνῷ: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’may know’
glossary.γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων); gen. of the part grasped, after λαβέ
glossary.δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a tear’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀπομόρξατο ’wiped away’
glossary.δάσσαντο: δατέομαι — divide, share out among themselves; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάσαντο)
glossary.δία: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Δία
glossary.δακρύσας: δακρύω — weep, shed tears; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεσμῶν: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. gen. pl., gen. of separation after ὑπελύσαο: ’from his bonds’
glossary.διεπράθομέν: διαπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. 1 pl. (aor. stem -πραθ-), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.διογενὲς: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.δύνασαί: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid. (= δύνασαι), accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.δώῃσιν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic δῷ); with κε in a condition: ’gives up’
glossary.δὸς: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.
glossary.δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
glossary.εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing, who knew’
glossary.εἴδομεν: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 1 pl., epic short-vowel subj. (= Attic εἰδῶμεν), in a purpose clause after ἵνα
glossary.εὐξαμένου: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with τοῖο, the genitive of the person heard: ’as he prayed’
glossary.εὐρυβάτην: Εὐρυβάτης — Eurybates, herald of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐχομένης: εὔχομαι — pray, boast, claim; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. sg., agreeing with σεο
glossary.εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl. act. (augmented εὗρον = Attic ηὗρον)
glossary.θήβην: Θήβη — Thebe, city of Eëtion in the Troad; fem. acc. sg., goal of motion with ἐς
glossary.θεράποντε: θεράπων — attendant, squire; masc. nom. dual
glossary.θεὸν: θεός — god; masc. acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg. of a goddess (θεός is common gender): ’goddess’ (δεινὴν … θεόν ’a fearsome goddess’)
glossary.θνητῶν: θνητός — mortal; masc. gen. pl.: ’of mortal (men)’
glossary.θνῇσκον: θνῄσκω — die; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθνῃσκον): ’were dying’
glossary.θύει: θύω — rush, rage, storm; pres. 3 sg., of a furious spirit
glossary.θῖν: θίς — shore, beach; masc. acc. sg., elided (θῖν’ = θῖνα)
glossary.κέλευθα: κέλευθος — path, way; neut. acc. pl. κέλευθα (Homeric neuter plural of a masc. noun)
glossary.κίεν: κίω — go; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (κίε(ν) = Attic ᾔει)
glossary.καθέζετο: καθέζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκαθέζετο)
glossary.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’
glossary.καλέουσι: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι)
glossary.καλέσασ: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (καλέσασ’ = καλέσασα)
glossary.κατέρεξεν: καταρρέζω — stroke, caress; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, epic κατέρεξε(ν) (= Attic κατέρρεξε)
glossary.κελαινεφέϊ: κελαινεφής — dark-clouded, of the dark clouds; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ), epithet of Zeus
glossary.κελόμην: κέλομαι — urge, bid, call on; impf. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκελόμην)
glossary.κεῦθε: κεύθω — hide, conceal; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: μὴ κεῦθε ’do not hide it’
glossary.κλισίηθεν: κλισίη — hut; with the suffix -θεν of place from which: adv., ’from the hut’ (= Attic ἐκ κλισίας)
glossary.κλισίης: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic κλισίας), with ἐκ: ’out of the hut’
glossary.κλισίῃ: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic κλισίᾳ)
glossary.κνίση: κνίση — savour of burnt fat, of a sacrifice; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κρονίωνι: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, i.e. Zeus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κτεινομένους: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’being killed’
glossary.κύδεϊ: κῦδος — glory, majesty; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει), dat. of cause after γαίων
glossary.λάβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔλαβεν)
glossary.λίσαι: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’beg’
glossary.λαβὲ: λαμβάνω — take, take hold of; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., + gen. of the part gripped
glossary.λαοὶ: λαός — people, host; masc. nom. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς, pl. λεῴ)
glossary.λιασθείς: λιάζομαι — withdraw, give way; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg. (λιασθείς)
glossary.λύματα: λῦμα — filth, refuse washed off (in purification); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. nom. pl., epithet of the gods
glossary.μάρτυροι: μάρτυς (epic μάρτυρος) — witness; masc. nom. pl. μάρτυροι (= Attic μάρτυρες)
glossary.μακάρων: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. gen. pl., epithet of the gods
glossary.μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long (spear)’
glossary.μαχέοιντο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μαχοῖντο), in an indirect question: ’how they might fight’
glossary.μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μινυνθάδιόν: μινυνθάδιος — short-lived, lasting a little while; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic περ
glossary.μνήσασα: μιμνήσκω — remind; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., + acc. of the person and gen. of the matter
glossary.μυρμιδόνων: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ people; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’
glossary.νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, think, consider; aor. inf. act.: οἶδε νοῆσαι ’knows how to consider’
glossary.νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
glossary.νόσφι: νόσφι — apart, aside; adv., also prep. + gen. ’apart from’ (νόσφι λιασθείς ’withdrawn apart’)
glossary.ξυνδῆσαι: συνδέω (Ionic/epic ξυνδέω) — bind together, bind; aor. inf. act.
glossary.οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg., epic οἴη (= Attic μόνη): ’you alone’
glossary.οἶδε: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. with present force: ’knows’
glossary.οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
glossary.πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
glossary.πάροιθ: πάροιθε(ν) (elided πάροιθ’) — before, in front of; prep. + gen., or adv.
glossary.πάτροκλος: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πένοντο: πένομαι — toil, be busy at; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπένοντο)
glossary.πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’ · also intensive after a relative pronoun, accented before the enclitic φασι: ’whom indeed’
glossary.παιδὸς: παῖς — child, son; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.παρά: παρά — beside, by; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε · also adv./preverb in tmesis with ἵσταμαι: ’stand by’
glossary.παρέζεο: παρέζομαι — sit beside; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic παρέζου)
glossary.πατρόκλεες: Πατροκλῆς, Πάτροκλος — Patroclus; masc. voc. sg., epic voc. Πατρόκλεες
glossary.περίσχεο: περιέχω — hold around; mid. + gen. protect, shield; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic περίσχου)
glossary.πλεόνεσσι: πλείων — more, more numerous; masc. dat. pl., epic πλεόνεσσι (= Attic πλείοσι)
glossary.πολιῆς: πολιός — grey (of the sea); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
glossary.ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)
glossary.προΐει: προΐημι — send forth, send off; impf. 3 sg. (προΐει, diaeresis marking the separate syllable)
glossary.προσεφώνεον: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (-εον = Attic -ουν)
glossary.πρός: πρός — to, towards; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’before, in the sight of’ (of witnesses); accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πρύμνας: πρύμνη (Attic πρύμνα) — stern of a ship; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
glossary.πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen
glossary.σεο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέο (= Attic σοῦ), enclitic
glossary.στήτην: ἵστημι — set; intrans. stand; aor. 3 dual (strong aor. ἔστην), unaugmented (= Attic ἐστήτην): ’the two stood’
glossary.στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στρατόν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σφίσιν: σφεῖς (σφέ) — they, themselves; dat. pl. σφίσιν: μετὰ σφίσιν ’among themselves’
glossary.σφωϊν: σφώ — you two; dual pron., gen./dat. σφῶϊν, also of the third person: ’to the two of them’
glossary.σφῶϊ: σφώ — you two; dual pron., epic σφῶϊ, acc.: ’you two’ · also nom. dual: ’you two’ (σφῶϊ μέν ’as for you two’)
glossary.σόοι: σόος (contracted σῶς) — safe, unharmed; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted
glossary.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’
glossary.ταλθύβιόν: Ταλθύβιος — Talthybius, herald of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ταρβήσαντε: ταρβέω — be afraid, fear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two frightened’
glossary.τεληέσσας: τελήεις (fem. τελήεσσα) — perfect, complete, unblemished; fem. acc. pl., epithet of hecatombs
glossary.τετελεσμένος: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.; with ἐστί, periphrastic perfect: ’has been fulfilled’
glossary.τιμήν: τιμή — honour, esteem; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic τιμήν)
glossary.τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’
glossary.τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
glossary.τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
glossary.τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’)
glossary.τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
glossary.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
glossary.φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
glossary.φίλῃ: φίλος — dear, beloved; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.χέοντος: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., uncontracted: ’as he shed (tears)’
glossary.χέων: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’shedding (tears)’
glossary.χαίρετε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’greetings! welcome!’
glossary.χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ)
glossary.χρειὼ: χρειώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (= Attic χρεία)
glossary.χρύσης: Χρύσης — Chryses, priest of Apollo; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀέκοντε: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. nom. dual, uncontracted (= Attic ἄκοντε)
glossary.ἀέκουσ: ἀέκων — unwilling; fem. nom. sg. ἀέκουσα, elided (ἀέκουσ’ = ἀέκουσα)
glossary.ἀγέμεν: ἄγω — lead, take; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἄγειν)
glossary.ἀγορεύω: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell, declare; pres. 1 sg., in a question: ’why do I tell?’
glossary.ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’speak’ (μὴ … ἀγόρευε ’do not speak’)
glossary.ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός
glossary.ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
glossary.ἀνέδυ: ἀναδύομαι — rise up, emerge; aor. 3 sg. (strong aor. ἀνέδυ), + gen. of the place left
glossary.ἀναβάντες: ἀναβαίνω — go up, embark; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀναστὰς: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. part. act. (intrans.) masc. nom. sg.: ’standing up’
glossary.ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; masc. acc. sg., epithet of the sea
glossary.ἀπελυμαίνοντο: ἀπολυμαίνομαι — cleanse oneself, wash off a defilement; impf. 3 pl. mid. (ἀπελυμαίνοντο)
glossary.ἀπηνέος: ἀπηνής — unkind, harsh (origin not known); masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἀπολυμαίνεσθαι: ἀπολυμαίνομαι — cleanse oneself, wash off a defilement; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀπούρας: ἀπαυράω — take away from, rob of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀπούρας (a defective verb)
glossary.ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖοι — Argives, Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀρῆξαι: ἀρήγω — help, aid; aor. inf. act. (+ dat.)
glossary.ἀτρεΐωνα: Ἀτρεΐων — son of Atreus; masc. acc. sg., by-form of Ἀτρεΐδης
glossary.ἀτρυγέτοιο: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, barren (epithet of the sea; meaning uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
glossary.ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγαγε)
glossary.ἄγοντες: ἄγω — lead, take away; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγουσι: ἄγω — lead, take, bring; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἄκουσα: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσα), + gen. of the person heard
glossary.ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. pl.: ’(to) the others’
glossary.ἄμμι: ἐγώ — I; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us’
glossary.ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα — order, bid; perf. with present force, 3 sg. ἄνωγεν also in past sense (= ἠνώγει): ’ordered’
glossary.ἄτην: ἄτη — blindness, bewilderment, folly; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
glossary.ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
glossary.ἐγγυαλίξαι: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into one’s hands, grant; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἐθέλῃσιν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κεν
glossary.ἐλθοῦσ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἐλθοῦσ’ = ἐλθοῦσα)
glossary.ἐλθοῦσα: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having come, going’
glossary.ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
glossary.ἐξαύδα: ἐξαυδάω — speak out, utter; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἐπέπλεον: ἐπιπλέω — sail over, sail upon (+ acc.); impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
glossary.ἐπαίτιοι: ἐπαίτιος — to blame, culpable; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπασσύτεροι: ἐπασσύτερος — one upon another, in close succession (traditional sense; formation unclear); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπαύρωνται: ἐπαυρίσκω — get the result of, enjoy or suffer (+ gen.); aor. subj. 3 pl. mid. (ἐπαύρωμαι), in a purpose clause
glossary.ἐπεπείθεθ: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., elided (ἐπεπείθεθ’ = ἐπεπείθετο; Attic ἐπείθετο)
glossary.ἐπηπείλησ: ἐπαπειλέω — threaten, make a threat against; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐπηπείλησ’ = ἐπηπείλησε)
glossary.ἐρέοντο: ἐρέομαι — ask, enquire; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἠρέοντο)
glossary.ἐστί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg.; with a perf. part., periphrastic perfect: ’has been, is done’
glossary.ἑκάτοιο: ἕκατος — far-darter (epithet of Apollo, probably a short form of ἑκατηβόλος; sense not certain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑκατηβόλου: ἑκατηβόλος — far-shooting; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Apollo
glossary.ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑλίκωπες: ἑλίκωψ — quick-eyed (or with rolling eyes; meaning uncertain), epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑλισσομένη: ἑλίσσω — turn, roll, curl; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’curling’
glossary.ἑλόντ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual, elided (ἑλόντ’ = ἑλόντε): ’the two taking’
glossary.ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
glossary.ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἑταίρῳ: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑῆος: ἑός — one’s own (possessive of any person); masc. gen. sg., epic ἑῆος; sometimes taken as gen. of ἐύς ’good’
glossary.ἔβαν: βαίνω — go; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔβαν (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.ἔδησαν: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἔλσαι: εἴλω — shut in, pen, hem in; aor. inf. act. ἔλσαι (epic ἕλσαι)
glossary.ἔξαγε: ἐξάγω — lead out, bring out; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἔπει: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by word’
glossary.ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, action; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by deed’ · also after ἐπί: ’task, undertaking’
glossary.ἔρχεσθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 dual: ’go, you two’
glossary.ἔστων: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 dual: ’let the two be’
glossary.ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
glossary.ἔτεκές: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. 2 sg., accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.ἔτισεν: τίω — honour, value; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἔτισε(ν))
glossary.ἔφ: ἐπί — on, along; prep. + acc., elided and aspirated (ἐφ’), written ἔφ’ after its noun (anastrophe)
glossary.ἔφησθα: φημί — say, speak; impf. 2 sg., epic -σθα ending (= Attic ἔφης): ’you said, boasted’
glossary.ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’
glossary.ἕρδον: ἔρδω (ῥέζω) — do, perform; offer (a sacrifice); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἠΰτ: ἠΰτε — like, as, as when; particle, elided (ἠΰτ’)
glossary.ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
glossary.ἠετίωνος: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠτίμησεν: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἠτίμησε(ν))
glossary.ἡμένη: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
glossary.ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl. (ἤθελον)
glossary.ἤκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of the person heard); aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἤκουσε(ν))
glossary.ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἰδυίῃ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. sg., epic ἰδυίῃ (= Attic εἰδυίᾳ): ’to you who know’
glossary.ἱκέσθην: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 3 dual (strong aor., ἱκέσθην), + acc. of goal: ’the two came to’
glossary.ἱλάσκεσθαι: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἴτ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἴτ’ = ἴτε)
glossary.ἴτην: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 dual (ἴτην = Attic ᾔτην): ’the two went’
glossary.ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
glossary.ἷκεν: ἵκω — come to, reach; impf./aor. 3 sg. active ἷκεν, ν-movable, unaugmented
glossary.ὀλοιῇσι: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ὀλύμπιοι: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, dwelling on Olympus; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὀμίχλη: ὀμίχλη — mist, fog; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
glossary.ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
glossary.ὀρεγνύς: ὀρέγνυμι — stretch out, reach out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀτρηρὼ: ὀτρηρός — brisk, active, ready; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
glossary.ὁρόων: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶν)
glossary.ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄφελλεν: ὀφείλω (epic ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; impf. 3 sg. (= ὤφελλεν), + inf., of what should have happened: ’ought to have’ · also ὀφέλλω — increase, enlarge; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤφελλεν): ’was increasing’
glossary.ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
glossary.ὑγρὰ: ὑγρός — wet, watery; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπέδεισαν: ὑποδείδω — fear, be afraid of; aor. 3 pl. (ὑπέδεισαν), + acc.
glossary.ὑπελύσαο: ὑπολύω — loose from under, set free; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic ὑπελύσω), + gen. of what one is freed from
glossary.ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — thundering on high; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὤνησας: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; aor. 2 sg. act. (ὤνησας)
glossary.ὦχ: ὦκα — swiftly, quickly; adv., elided and aspirated (ὦχ’ before a rough breathing)
glossary.ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
glossary.ᾠχόμεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (ᾠχόμεθ’ = ᾠχόμεθα)
glossary.ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — worse, more grievous; comparative adj. (cf. ῥῖγος ’shudder’), neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.αἰθιοπῆας: Αἰθίοψ — Ethiopian, one of the Aethiopians; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -ας)
glossary.αἰνὰ: αἰνός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’in dread, grievously’
glossary.αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle, elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ), with ὄφελες + inf. · also with an optative: ’would that he might fulfil’
glossary.αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fiery, flashing (of wine; αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’look’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg.: ’by an evil lot’ (κακῇ αἴσῃ)
glossary.αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. nom. sg., subject: ’your lot’ (τοι αἶσα)
glossary.αὐέρυσαν: αὐερύω (= ἀνερύω) — draw back (a victim’s head before the throat is cut); aor. 3 pl. (= Attic ἀνείρυσαν)
glossary.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’
glossary.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’)
glossary.αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
glossary.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. in a periphrasis: βίῃ Ἡρακληείῃ ’by the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles) · also dat. sg. of means: ’by (your) strength’
glossary.βαῖνον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαινον)
glossary.βῆσαν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, causative with an object: ’made go, led out’ (not the intransitive ἔβησαν ’went’)
glossary.γουνάσομαι: γουνάζομαι — entreat, beg (clasping the knees; γόνυ ’knee’); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will entreat’
glossary.γυναικὸς: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg., with ἐϋζώνοιο: ’of the well-girdled woman’, after χωόμενον
glossary.δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδέξατο)
glossary.δήν: δήν — for a long time; adv., epic (cf. δηρόν)
glossary.δίπτυχα: δίπτυχος — twofold, double-folded; neut. acc. pl., predicative with ποιέω: ’making (it) double’
glossary.δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
glossary.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀκουάζεσθον: ’hear of the feast’
glossary.δαῖτα: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. sg.: ’for the feast’ (after κατά), ’a meal’ (object of τετύκοντο)
glossary.δεξιτερῇ: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιᾷ), with χειρί understood: ’with the right hand’
glossary.δεπάεσσιν: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic δέπασι)
glossary.διαπρήσσουσα: διαπρήσσω (= διαπράσσω) — accomplish, make one’s way through; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ησσ-
glossary.διογενὴς: διογενής — sprung from Zeus, Zeus-born; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes
glossary.διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
glossary.δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἠώς: ’the twelfth dawn’
glossary.δωδεκάτῃ: δωδέκατος — twelfth; fem. dat. sg., dat. of time with ἡμέρᾳ understood: ’on the twelfth (day)’
glossary.δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί
glossary.εἶμ: εἶμι — go, shall go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense, elided (εἶμ’ = εἶμι)
glossary.εὐνὰς: εὐνή — bed; pl. εὐναί, anchor-stones (the ship’s ’bed’ on the seabed); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εὐξαμένοιο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic εὐξαμένου), after ἔκλυες: ’when I prayed’
glossary.εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — far-thundering, wide-sounding (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., epic short -α · also masc. nom. sg., epic short -α (εὐρύοπα Ζεύς ’far-thundering Zeus’)
glossary.εὔξαντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they prayed’
glossary.εὔχετο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg.: ’was praying’ (no augment written; εὐ- not lengthened to ηὐ-)
glossary.εὗρεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 sg., epic εὗρεν (= Attic ηὗρεν), ν-movable
glossary.θέσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’they laid, stowed’
glossary.θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάη): ’was burned up’
glossary.κέλευθον: κέλευθος — way, path, course; fem. acc. sg. (pl. also neut. κέλευθα)
glossary.κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη)
glossary.κακῇ: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’fair (skin)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος: ’fair (plot)’
glossary.κατά: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc./gen. · also preverb in tmesis (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’); acute kept before an enclitic
glossary.κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented (κατά … ἔδυ): of the sun ’set, went down’
glossary.καῖε: καίω — burn; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαιε): ’burned’
glossary.κνέφας: κνέφας — dusk, darkness, nightfall; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’darkness’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ἐπί: ’to darkness, to nightfall’
glossary.κνίσῃ: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — fat that wraps the entrails, savour of burning fat; fem. dat. sg., of what covers: ’with fat’
glossary.κοιμήσαντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they lay down to sleep’
glossary.κορυφῇ: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’youths!’ (κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν ’youths of the Achaeans’)
glossary.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. acc. sg. (object of τίθει) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’power, might’ (τοῦ κράτος ἐστὶ μέγιστον)
glossary.κρητῆρας: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κρονίδην: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κρονίωνα: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κυδιάνειραν: κυδιάνειρα — bringing glory to men (κῦδος + ἀνήρ); fem. acc. sg., epithet of ἀγορή ’assembly’ · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of μάχη ’battle’
glossary.λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε); λαβεῖν + gen. ’take hold of’
glossary.λήθετ: λήθομαι — forget; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λήθετ’ = λήθετο), + gen.: ’did forget’
glossary.λίπ: λείπω — leave; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λίπ’ = λίπε = ἔλιπε): ’left’
glossary.λευκὰ: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λεῖβε: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλειβε): ’poured’
glossary.λισσομένη: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’begging’
glossary.μέλποντες: μέλπω — celebrate with song and dance; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μένων: μένω — remain, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
glossary.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’the middle, the space between’ (ἐς μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ’into the space between the two’)
glossary.μήνι: μηνίω — be wrathful, nurse one’s wrath (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μήνι’ = μήνιε)
glossary.μήνιε: μηνίω — be wrathful, nurse one’s wrath; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμήνιε): ’sat in wrath’
glossary.μίνυνθά: μίνυνθα — for a little while, briefly; adv., epic, accented before the enclitic περ
glossary.μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμίστυλλον), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βοάω: ’loudly’ (μακρὰ βοῶν) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βιβάντα: ’with long (strides)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔγχεα: ’long (spears)’
glossary.μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’
glossary.μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’
glossary.μολπῇ: μολπή — song with dance, play; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with song and dance’
glossary.μῆρε: μηρός — thigh; μῆρα, thigh-pieces burned for the god; neut. nom. pl., spelled as if a dual (μῆρε, = μῆρ’)
glossary.νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. as a noun: ’young men’
glossary.νηός: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νώμησαν: νωμάω — deal out, distribute, wield; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐνώμησαν)
glossary.οὐλοχύτας: οὐλοχύται — barley scattered on a sacrificial victim (οὐλαί + χέω ’pour’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.οὔλυμπόν: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., accented before τε
glossary.οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’)
glossary.πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπάσαντο): ’they tasted’
glossary.πέλασαν: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπέλασαν)
glossary.πέτασσαν: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, doubled σσ (= Attic ἐπέτασαν)
glossary.πίθηται: πείθω — persuade; mid. be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (αἴ κε πίθηται ’if he may be persuaded’)
glossary.παιήονα: παιήων — paean, hymn of thanks or praise to Apollo; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πανημέριοι: πανημέριος — all day long; masc. nom. pl., used adjectivally where English has an adverb
glossary.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’)
glossary.παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παύσαντο: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσαντο)
glossary.παῖδά: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’
glossary.πεμπώβολα: πεμπώβολον — five-pronged fork (Aeolic πέμπε ’five’ + ὀβελός ’spit’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.περιφραδέως: περιφραδέως — very thoughtfully, carefully (adv. of περιφραδής)
glossary.πηλῆος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ποθέεσκε: ποθέω — long for, miss; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’kept longing for’
glossary.ποιήσαντες: ποιέω — make, do; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made’
