glossary.τέκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔτεκεν)
glossary.τίρυνθά: Τίρυνς — Tiryns, a city of the Argolid; acc. sg. Τίρυνθα
glossary.ταλαϊονίδαο: Ταλαϊονίδης — son of Talaïon (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ταύροισι: ταῦρος — bull; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ταύροις)
glossary.τειχιόεσσαν: τειχιόεις — walled, with strong walls; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα
glossary.τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τεσσαράκοντα: τεσσαράκοντα — forty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic τετταράκοντα)
glossary.τινες: τις, τι — someone, anyone; indefinite pron., masc. nom. pl.; after the relative οἵ: οἵ τινες = ὅστινες, ’whoever, those who’
glossary.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
glossary.τρίτατος: τρίτατος — third; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic τρίτος)
glossary.τριήκοντα: τριήκοντα — thirty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic τριάκοντα)
glossary.τροιζῆν: Τροιζήν — Troezen, a city of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg., elided (Τροιζῆν’ = Τροιζῆνα)
glossary.τόσος: τόσος — so great, so big; masc. nom. sg., correlative with ὅσος
glossary.τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; masc. nom. pl., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτοι)
glossary.φάλαγγες: φάλαγξ — battle-line, line of battle; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.φωκήων: Φωκεῖς — the Phocians; masc. gen. pl., epic Φωκήων (= Attic Φωκέων)
glossary.φωνὴ: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φὼς: φώς — man; masc. nom. sg. (epic, φωτός in the gen.)
glossary.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’
glossary.χαλκίδα: Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg. · also Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a town of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χαλκωδοντιάδης: Χαλκωδοντιάδης — son of Chalcodon (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀβάντων: Ἄβαντες — the Abantes, a tribe of Euboea; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀγέληφι: ἀγέλη — herd; fem. dat. sg., epic -φι (= Attic ἀγέλῃ): ’in the herd’
glossary.ἀγακλειτοῦ: ἀγακλειτός — renowned, glorious; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀγρομένῃσι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. part. mid. fem. dat. pl., syncopated (ἀγρομένῃσι = Attic ἀγειραμέναις): ’assembling’
glossary.ἀζεΐδαο: Ἀζεΐδης — son of Azeus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀθήνῃς: Ἀθῆναι — Athens; fem. dat. pl. (locative), Ionic -ῃς (= Attic Ἀθήναις)
glossary.ἀθηναίων: Ἀθηναῖοι — the Athenians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀμπελόεντ: ἀμπελόεις — vine-clad, rich in vines; adj., fem. acc. sg., elided (ἀμπελόεντ’ = ἀμπελόεντα)
glossary.ἀμφενέμοντο: ἀμφινέμομαι — dwell around, live round about; impf. 3 pl. mid. (augment in ἀμφ-ε-)
glossary.ἀμφιέποντες: ἀμφιέπω — be busy about, attend to, ply; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’busying themselves about’
glossary.ἀνεμώρειαν: Ἀνεμώρεια — Anemoreia, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνθηδόνα: Ἀνθηδών — Anthedon, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
glossary.ἀρκεσίλαός: Ἀρκεσίλαος — Arcesilaus, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ἀρχοὺς: ἀρχός — leader, commander; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀσίνην: Ἀσίνη — Asine, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀσκάλαφος: Ἀσκάλαφος — Ascalaphus, son of Ares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσπιδιώτας: ἀσπιδιώτης — shield-bearing, armed with a shield; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀσπληδόνα: Ἀσπληδών — Aspledon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀστυόχη: Ἀστυόχη — Astyoche, mother of Ascalaphus and Ialmenus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁλίαρτον: Ἁλίαρτος — Haliartus, a Boeotian town; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄβαντες: Ἄβαντες — the Abantes, a tribe of Euboea; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγγεα: ἄγγος — vessel, pail; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄγγη)
glossary.ἄγεν: ἄγω — lead, take, bring; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἦγεν) · also ἄγνυμι — break; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐάγησαν): ’were bent, broken back’ (of arrow-barbs)
glossary.ἄκτορος: Ἄκτωρ — Actor, father of Astyoche; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄλσος: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄργός: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun in the nominative (Ἄργός τε Σπάρτη τε ’Argos and Sparta’)
glossary.ἄρεϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
glossary.ἄρνην: Ἄρνη — Arne, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρρηκτος: ἄρρηκτος — unbroken, unbreakable; adj. (2 endings), fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅρμ: Ἅρμα — Harma, a Boeotian town (also ἅρμα ’chariot’); neut. acc. sg., elided (Ἅρμ’ = Ἅρμα)
glossary.ἐγχείῃ: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. dat. sg., epic by-form of ἔγχος, dat. of means: ’with the spear’
glossary.ἐκέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; plpf. 3 sg. mid. (of κέκασμαι), with impf. sense, + acc.: ’excelled’
glossary.ἐκπρεπέ: ἐκπρεπής — distinguished, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐκπρεπέ’ = ἐκπρεπέα, Attic ἐκπρεπῆ)
glossary.ἐλεφήνωρ: Ἐλεφήνωρ — Elephenor, leader of the Abantes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλεῶν: Ἐλεών — Eleon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg., elided (Ἐλεῶν’ = Ἐλεῶνα)
glossary.ἐνέμοντ: νέμομαι — dwell in, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἐνέμοντ’ = ἐνέμοντο), + acc.
glossary.ἐνέμοντο: νέμομαι — dwell in, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. mid., + acc.
glossary.ἐνείη: ἔνειμι — be in, be within; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition: ’were within’
glossary.ἐνιαυτῶν: ἐνιαυτός — year, cycle of the seasons; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπίδαυρον: Ἐπίδαυρος — Epidaurus, a city of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπίστροφος: Ἐπίστροφος — Epistrophus, a Phocian leader (also adj. ’much-visiting’); masc. nom. sg. · also Ἐπίστροφος — Epistrophus, a leader of the Halizones; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιχθόνιος: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth, earthly; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρατεινὰς: ἐρατεινός — lovely, delightful; adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρεχθῆος: Ἐρεχθεύς — Erechtheus, early king of Athens; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἐρυθράς: Ἐρυθραί — Erythrae, a Boeotian town (also ἐρυθρός ’red’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐσχατόωσαν: ἐσχατάω — lie at the edge, be outlying; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic ἐσχατόωσα (= Attic ἐσχατῶσα)
glossary.ἐτεωνόν: Ἐτεωνός — Eteonus, a Boeotian town; masc. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic)
glossary.ἐχούσας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. acc. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ), agreeing with πτολίεθρον
glossary.ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑρμιόνην: Ἑρμιόνη — Hermione, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc. dat. sg.: ’her own’
glossary.ἔμπλην: ἔμπλην — hard by, next to; adv. or prep. + gen.
glossary.ἔναιον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.): ’they dwelt’
glossary.ἔξοχος: ἔξοχος — standing out, pre-eminent (+ partitive gen.); adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
glossary.ἔριζεν: ἐρίζω — contend, vie, rival; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔσπετε: ἐννέπω — tell, say; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic ἔσπετε (= Attic εἴπατε): ’tell!’
glossary.ἔφαλον: ἔφαλος — by the sea, sea-girt; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἠλάσκουσιν: ἠλάσκω — wander, roam about (by-form of ἀλάομαι); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἠϊόνας: Ἠϊόνες — Eïones, a town of the Argolid (also ἠϊών ’shore’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἡγεμόνες: ἡγεμών — leader, commander; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἡγεμόνευ: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, lead; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεμόνευ’ = ἡγεμόνευε)
glossary.ἡγεμόνευε: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be leader (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. (augment not visible on ἡ-)
glossary.ἡγεμόνευεν: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be leader (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., movable ν
glossary.ἡγεῖτο: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was leading’
glossary.ἡρώεσσιν: ἥρως — hero; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἥρωσιν)
glossary.ἰάλμενος: Ἰάλμενος — Ialmenus, a Boeotian leader, son of Ares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰδ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj., elided (ἰδ’ = ἰδέ)
glossary.ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰφίτου: Ἴφιτος — Iphitus, father of Schedius and Epistrophus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. acc. sg. (the neut. has the same spelling)
glossary.ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
glossary.ἱλάονται: ἱλάομαι — propitiate, appease; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἱλῶνται)
glossary.ἱστίαιαν: Ἱστίαια — Histiaea, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴστέ: οἶδα — know; pres. 2 pl. ἴστε (accent from enclitic τε): ’you know’
glossary.ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
glossary.ἵσταντο: ἵστημι — set, place; mid. impf. 3 pl., intransitive: ’took their stand, were standing’
glossary.ἵστασαν: ἵστημι — set up, station; impf. act. 3 pl., transitive: ’were drawing up’ (contrast intransitive mid. ἵσταντο)
glossary.ὀγδώκοντα: ὀγδώκοντα — eighty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic ὀγδοήκοντα)
glossary.ὀγχηστόν: Ὀγχηστός — Onchestus, a Boeotian town with a grove of Poseidon; acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλυμπιάδες: Ὀλυμπιάς — Olympian, of Olympus; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀνομήνω: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. subj. 1 sg. (fut. has the same form), potential with ἂν: ’I could name’
glossary.ὀπόεντά: Ὀπόεις — Opoeis, a Locrian town; acc. sg. Ὀπόεντα (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ὀρεκτῇσιν: ὀρεκτός — stretched out, outstretched; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ὀρχομενὸν: Ὀρχομενός — Orchomenus, a Boeotian city; acc. sg. · also the Arcadian Orchomenus, acc. sg.

glossary.ἑλίκην: Ἑλίκη — Helice, a town of Achaea; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.κῶν: Κῶς — Cos, an island of the Aegean; fem. acc. sg. (Κῶν)

glossary.μάχοντο: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμάχοντο): ’were fighting’
glossary.μέδων: Μέδων — Medon, bastard son of Oïleus, a leader of Philoctetes’ men; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.: ’of flocks’

glossary.μενεπτόλεμος: μενεπτόλεμος — steadfast in battle (μένω + πόλεμος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μηθώνην: Μηθώνη — Methone, a town among Philoctetes’ places; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μητέρα: μήτηρ — mother; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to Ἴτωνα
glossary.μνήσεσθαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to be mindful’
glossary.μογήσας: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having toiled’
glossary.μοχθίζοντα: μοχθίζω — toil, suffer hardship; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’toiling, suffering’
glossary.μοῦσα: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of poetic inspiration; fem. voc. sg. (same form as the nom.): ’O Muse’
glossary.μυρμιδόνες: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, the people of Achilles; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μύνητ: Μύνης — Mynes, son of Euenus, struck down by Achilles; masc. acc. sg., elided (Μύνητ’ = Μύνητα)
glossary.νέμοντο: νέμω — distribute; mid. dwell in, inhabit, hold (+ acc.); impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’inhabited’

glossary.νῶτον: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. sg. (usually pl. νῶτα)

glossary.οἰκί: οἰκίον — dwelling, home; neut. pl. οἰκία (acc. pl.), elided (οἰκί’ = οἰκία)

glossary.πήλιον: Πήλιον — Pelion, mountain in Thessaly; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + acc.: ’beside’
glossary.παῖδε: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’

glossary.πελίαο: Πελίας — Pelias, father of Alcestis; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)

glossary.πηλίου: Πήλιον — Pelion, mountain in Thessaly; neut. gen. sg., after ἐκ
glossary.πηνειὸν: Πηνειός — the Peneius, river of Thessaly; masc. acc. sg.

glossary.ποδαλείριος: Ποδαλείριος — Podaleirius, a healer, son of Asclepius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ποδώκεας: ποδώκης — fleet-footed; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl., epic -εας (= Attic -εις), agreeing with the mares
glossary.ποθέοντες: ποθέω — long for, miss; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦντες)
glossary.πολυμήλου: πολύμηλος — rich in flocks; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἰφίκλου
glossary.πολυποίτης: Πολυποίτης — Polypoetes, son of Peirithous and joint leader with Leonteus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ποντοπόροισι: ποντοπόρος — sea-crossing, sea-faring; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πρωτεσίλαος: Πρωτεσίλαος — Protesilaus, a leader of the men of Phylace and its neighbours, killed as he leapt from his ship; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρωτεσιλάου: Πρωτεσίλαος — Protesilaus, a leader of the men of Phylace and its neighbours; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πρόθοος: Πρόθοος — Prothous, leader of the Magnetes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρώτιστον: πρῶτος — first; the strengthened superlative πρώτιστος: ’very first’; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the participle ἀποθρῴσκοντα (πολύ ’by far’ before it)
glossary.πτολιπόρθῳ: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities; masc. dat. sg., epic πτολι- (= πολι-)
glossary.πόθεόν: ποθέω — long for, miss; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.), epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐπόθουν): ’longed for’
glossary.πύρασον: Πύρασος — Pyrasus, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg. (Πύρασον)
glossary.σέλινον: σέλινον — celery or parsley (or a plant like them); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σεληπιάδαο: Σεληπιάδης — son of Selepus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Εὐηνοῖο
glossary.σταφύλῇ: σταφυλή — plumb-line, builder’s level; fem. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by the plumb-line’
glossary.στυγὸς: Στύξ — the Styx, the underworld river by which the gods swear their most binding oath; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.συμμίσγεται: συμμίσγω — mix together; mid. mingle with (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’mingles with’
glossary.τέκετο: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέκετο): ’begot’, said of a father · also ’bore’, said of a mother
glossary.τέμενος: τέμενος — sacred precinct, plot of land set apart; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to Πύρασον · also neut. acc. sg., object of τάμον: ’a plot’
glossary.τέρποντο: τέρπω — delight; mid. take pleasure, amuse oneself; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’amused themselves’
glossary.τείχεα: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τείχη)
glossary.τενθρηδόνος: Τενθρηδών — Tenthredon, father of Prothous; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τιτάνοιό: Τίτανος — Titanus, taken as a place-name (τίτανος is also ‘chalk, gypsum’; sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τιταρησσὸν: Τιταρησσός — the Titaressus, a river of Thessaly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τρίκκην: Τρίκκη — Tricca, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρηχῖνα: Τρηχίς — Trachis, a town of Achilles’ realm; acc. sg. Τρηχῖνα (stem Τρηχῖν-)
glossary.τόξοισίν: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), accented before the enclitic θ’: ’with bows’
glossary.τόξων: τόξον — bow; neut. gen. pl. (τόξα), gen. of respect after εἰδώς: ’skilled in bows’
glossary.τὰρ: ἄρα — then, so; τὰρ is taken as τε + ἄρα run together (compare τίς τ’ ἄρ), after interrogative τίς: ’who then?’
glossary.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
glossary.υἱέας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἱέας (= Attic υἱούς/υἱεῖς)
glossary.υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’
glossary.φέρτατος: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of φέρτερος, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φείδιππός: Φείδιππος — Pheidippus, son of Thessalus, a leader from Cos; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.φερὰς: Φεραί — Pherae, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φηρητιάδαο: Φηρητιάδης — son of Pheres (patronymic; usually taken to be Admetus); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φιλοκτήταο: Φιλοκτήτης — Philoctetes, the Greek archer at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φιλοκτήτης: Φιλοκτήτης — Philoctetes, the Greek archer at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φοίτων: φοιτάω — go to and fro, roam; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφοίτων): ’were roaming’
glossary.φορέεσκον: φορέω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ- (epic), uncontracted, unaugmented: ’used to carry’
glossary.φορεούσας: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φοροῦσας): ’bearing’
glossary.φυλάκην: Φυλάκη — Phylace, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φυλάκῃ: Φυλάκη — Phylace, a town of Thessaly; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Phylace’
glossary.φυλακίδαο: Φυλακίδης — son of Phylacus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Ἰφίκλου
glossary.φόβον: φόβος — fear, flight, panic; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆρας: φήρ — wild beast (Aeolic = Attic θήρ), used of the beasts Peirithous fought, traditionally the Centaurs; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγαθὼ: ἀγαθός — good, brave, able; masc. nom. dual, agreeing with ἰητῆρε
glossary.ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγχίαλόν: ἀγχίαλος — near the sea, by the sea; adj. of two endings, acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀντρῶνα · also Ἀγχίαλος — Anchialus, a Greek warrior killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., accented ἀγχίαλόν before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀδμήτοιο: Ἄδμητος — Admetus, king of Pherae; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀδμήτῳ: Ἄδμητος — Admetus, king of Pherae; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό of the father: ’to Admetus’
glossary.ἀθάνατος: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλόπην: Ἀλόπη — Alope, a town of Achilles’ realm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιδρυφὴς: ἀμφιδρυφής — torn on both sides, i.e. with cheeks scratched in grief (traditional sense); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλοχος
glossary.ἀνάκτων: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the lords’
glossary.ἀνθεμόεντα: ἀνθεμόεις — flowery, rich in blossoms; acc. sg. masc., agreeing with Πύρασον
glossary.ἀνστήσεσθαι: ἀνίστημι — raise up; mid. rise, get up; fut. inf. mid., syncopated ἀν- for ἀνα- (= Attic ἀναστήσεσθαι): ’to rise up’
glossary.ἀντρῶνα: Ἀντρών — Antron, a town; acc. sg. (Ἀντρῶνα)
glossary.ἀποθρῴσκοντα: ἀποθρῴσκω — leap off, spring down from (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’leaping from’
glossary.ἀπομηνίσας: ἀπομηνίω — be wrathful, with ἀπο- of uncertain force (‘away’, ‘utterly’); aor. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. ’at’: ’having withdrawn in wrath’
glossary.ἀπορρώξ: ἀπορρώξ — broken-off piece, hence an offshoot; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρήϊος: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργυροδίνῃ: ἀργυροδίνης — with silver eddies; adj. of two endings, masc. dat. sg., agreeing with Πηνειῷ
glossary.ἀργυρότοξος: ἀργυρότοξος — of the silver bow; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Apollo
glossary.ἀρείων: ἀρείων — better, braver; comparative of ἀγαθός (cf. ἄριστος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρηΐφιλον: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀρχόν · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menelaus
glossary.ἀρχόν: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀσκληπιοῦ: Ἀσκληπιός — Asclepius, the healer; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀστέριον: Ἀστέριον — Asterium, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃσιν: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon, Menelaus); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀχέων: ἀχέω — grieve, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. ἄχνυμαι): ’grieving’
glossary.ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
glossary.ἄλκηστις: Ἄλκηστις — Alcestis, daughter of Pelias, wife of Admetus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλον: Ἄλος — Alus, a town of Achilles’ realm; acc. sg. (Ἄλον)
glossary.ἄναρχοι: ἄναρχος — without a leader; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄντιφος: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, son of Thessalus, a leader from Cos; masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a Maeonian leader, son of Talaemenes; masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄργισσαν: Ἄργισσα — Argissa, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρισται: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; fem. nom. pl. ἄρισται, predicate (of mares): ’best, foremost’
glossary.ἐγχεσιμώρους: ἐγχεσίμωρος — spear-fighting, spear-wielding (second element of uncertain origin); adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐλέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. 3 sg. pass.: ’had been left (behind)’
glossary.ἐλεόθρεπτόν: ἐλεόθρεπτος — marsh-bred, grown in the marsh (ἕλος + τρέφω); epic ἐλεο-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σέλινον
glossary.ἐμβέβασαν: ἐμβαίνω — step in, embark; plpf. 3 pl. (= Attic ἐνεβεβήκεσαν), with the sense ‘stood in’: ’had embarked, were aboard’
glossary.ἐμνώοντο: μνάομαι — be mindful of, give thought to (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis (= Attic ἐμνῶντο)
glossary.ἐνιῆνες: Ἐνιῆνες — the Enienes, a people of northern Greece; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξείλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take out for oneself, pick out; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took out for himself’
glossary.ἐπίστροφον: Ἐπίστροφος — Epistrophus, a son of Euenus, brother of Mynes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιρρέει: ἐπιρρέω — flow over, flow upon; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπιρρεῖ), + acc.: ’flows over’
glossary.ἐρεπτόμενοι: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, munch; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + acc.
glossary.ἐτίσατο: τίνω (mid. τίνυμαι) — pay, requite; mid. exact vengeance, take vengeance on; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took vengeance (on)’
glossary.ἐϋκτιμένην: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; fem. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ); said of a town
glossary.ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’
glossary.ἑλλάδα: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, a district beside Phthia in Achilles’ realm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔβαλεν: βάλλω — throw, hurl, strike; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’threw’ (κὰδ … ἔβαλεν = κατέβαλεν ’laid low’)
glossary.ἔθεντο: τίθημι — put, set; mid. make for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’made for themselves’ (οἰκία ἔθεντο ’made their homes’)
glossary.ἔκτανε: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist ἔκτανον: ’killed’
glossary.ἔλαιον: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. nom. sg., after ἠΰτε: ’like oil’
glossary.ἔλαυνε: ἐλαύνω — drive; impf. 3 sg., without the lengthened augment (= Attic ἤλαυνε): ’drove’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drive’
glossary.ἔννεπε: ἐννέπω — tell of, relate, speak; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔτεκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’bore’
glossary.ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
glossary.ἕλκεϊ: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκει)
glossary.ἕλληνες: Ἕλληνες — the Hellenes, a people of Achilles’ realm; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; plpf. 3 pl., intransitive (= Attic εἱστήκεσαν): ’stood, were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
glossary.ἠλώνην: Ἠλώνη — Elone, a town of Perrhaebia in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠϋκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος (= ἐΰκομος) — fair-haired; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Βρισηΐδος · also agreeing with Ἑλένης: ’fair-haired (Helen)’ · also agreeing with Θέτιδος: ’fair-haired (Thetis)’ · also agreeing with Ἀθηναίης: ’fair-haired (Athena)’
glossary.ἡγήσαιτο: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, guide (+ dat.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a relative clause of characteristic after a negative: ’who might lead’
glossary.ἡγείσθην: ἡγέομαι — lead, go before (+ gen.); impf. 3 dual: ’the two led’
glossary.ἡγεμόνος: ἡγεμών — guide, leader; masc. gen. sg., after a verb of lacking (+ gen.)
glossary.ἡμιτελής: ἡμιτελής — half-finished, half-complete; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δόμος
glossary.ἡρακλεΐδαο: Ἡρακλεΐδης — son of Heracles (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), in apposition to Θεσσαλοῦ
glossary.ἦρχεν: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable, + gen.: ’was leading’
glossary.ἰαωλκόν: Ἰαωλκός — Iolcus, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg. (Ἰαωλκόν)
glossary.ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
glossary.ἰητῆρ: ἰητήρ — healer, physician; masc. nom. dual, elided (ἰητῆρ’ = ἰητῆρε)
glossary.ἰθώμην: Ἰθώμη — Ithome, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰφίκλου: Ἴφικλος — Iphiclus, father of Podarces; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱέντες: ἵημι — throw, hurl, let fly; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’throwing’
glossary.ἱμερτὸν: ἱμερτός — lovely, desirable; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Τιταρησσόν
glossary.ἱπποδάμεια: Ἱπποδάμεια — Hippodameia, wife of Peirithous; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴτωνά: Ἴτων — Iton, a town; acc. sg. (Ἴτωνα), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὀλιζῶνα: Ὀλιζών — Olizon, a town among Philoctetes’ places; fem. acc. sg. (Ὀλιζῶνα)
glossary.ὀλοοσσόνα: Ὀλοοσσών — Oloosson, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg. (Ὀλοοσσόνα), in apposition to πόλιν
glossary.ὀλοόφρονος: ὀλοόφρων — baleful-minded (sense of the epithet debated); adj. of two endings, masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ὕδρου
glossary.ὀρμένιον: Ὀρμένιον — Ormenium, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg.
glossary.ὀϊλῆϊ: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, father of the lesser Ajax; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.ὁπλότερος: ὁπλότερος — younger; comparative adj. (superl. ὁπλότατος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄρθην: Ὄρθη — Orthe, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄτριχας: ὄθριξ (lemma uncertain) — alike in hair, of one coat (traditional sense; the word is not secure); adj., acc. pl. ὄτριχας
glossary.ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ὑπέρειαν: Ὑπέρεια — Hypereia, a spring of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to κρήνην
glossary.ὑπερθύμοιο: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὕδατός: ὕδωρ — water; neut. gen. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ῥήνη: Ῥήνη — Rhene, mother of Medon; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰακίδαο: Αἰακίδης — son or descendant of Aeacus, used of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰνείας: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader, son of Anchises; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰπεινὰ: αἰπεινός — steep, sheer, lofty; neut. acc. pl., with κάρηνα
glossary.αἰπεῖα: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, high; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with κολώνη
glossary.αἰπύ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, high; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος
glossary.αἰσήποιο: Αἴσηπος — the Aesepus, a river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰσυήταο: Αἰσυήτης — Aesyetes, an old Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἴθωνες: αἴθων — blazing, fiery, tawny; masc. nom. pl., of horses: ’fire-bright, tawny’
glossary.αἶαν: αἶα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic γῆ), object of ἐπικίδναται
glossary.βαρβαροφώνων: βαρβαρόφωνος — of strange, non-Greek speech; masc. gen. pl., with Καρῶν
glossary.βατίειαν: Βατίεια — Batieia, a hillock before Troy; fem. acc. sg., second object of κικλήσκουσιν
glossary.βροτῷ: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. sg., used as a noun: ’to a mortal (man)’
glossary.γένος: γένος — stock, race, breed; neut. nom. sg. (ἡμιόνων γένος ’the breed of mules’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of αἰσχυνέμεν: ’the stock (of the fathers)’
glossary.γέροντες: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γεγαῶτας: γίγνομαι — be born, become; perf. part. masc. acc. pl., epic γεγαῶτ- (= Attic γεγονότας): ’born’
glossary.γενέθλη: γενέθλη — birth, source, place of origin; fem. nom. sg. (ἀργύρου γενέθλη ’the source of silver’) · also offspring, brood; fem. nom. sg. in apposition: ’as offspring’
glossary.γλαῦκος: Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, a Lycian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γλῶσσα: γλῶσσα — tongue, language; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γυγαίη: Γυγαῖος — of Gyges, Gygaean; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α), with λίμνη
glossary.δέγμενος: δέχομαι — receive; wait for, await; syncopated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. with present sense, epic (= Attic δεξάμενος)
glossary.δαΐφρων: δαΐφρων — of uncertain sense, either ’warlike’ or ’wise-minded’; masc. nom. sg., epithet in apposition to a name
glossary.δαρδανίων: Δαρδάνιοι — the Dardanians, a people allied to Troy; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.διέκριθεν: διακρίνω — separate, sort apart; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic διεκρίθησαν): ’were divided’
glossary.διέπρησσον: διαπράσσω — pass through, traverse; impf. 3 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic διέπραττον), with gen. of the space crossed
glossary.δινήεντος: δινήεις — eddying, whirling; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ξάνθου
glossary.διοτρεφέος: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.δῖ: δῖος — heavenly, divine; fem. nom. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖα), epithet of Aphrodite · also fem. nom. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖα), epithet of Anteia
glossary.εἰδότε: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. dual nom. (= Attic εἰδότε), + gen.: ’skilled in’ · also masc. dual acc., agreeing with a dual noun: ’knowing’ (δύο φῶτε … εἰδότε χάρμης ’two men knowing the joy of battle’)
glossary.εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
glossary.εἰρήνης: εἰρήνη — peace; fem. gen. sg. (ἐπ’ εἰρήνης ’in time of peace’)
glossary.εἰσήλυθον: εἰσέρχομαι — go into, enter; aor. 1 sg., epic stem -ήλυθον (= Attic εἰσῆλθον), + acc.
glossary.εἴσατο: εἴδομαι — liken oneself to, take the likeness of; aor. 3 sg. mid., with acc. of respect and dat. of the person · also ἵεμαι — rush, speed; aor. 3 sg. mid., of a missile: ’darted’
glossary.εὐνάς: εὐνή — bed, resting place, lair; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εὐνηθεῖσα: εὐνάζω — put to bed; pass. lie with, sleep with (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’having lain with’
glossary.εὔφημος: Εὔφημος — Euphemus, leader of the Cicones; masc. nom. sg. (also adj. ’of good omen’)
glossary.ζέλειαν: Ζέλεια — Zeleia, a town below Mt Ida; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θρήϊκας: Θρῇξ — a Thracian; masc. acc. pl., epic Θρήϊκας (= Attic Θρᾷκας)
glossary.θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)
glossary.κάλλιστον: καλός — beautiful, fine; superl. κάλλιστος, neut. nom. sg.: ’fairest, finest’
glossary.καρῶν: Κᾶρες — the Carians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κεάδαο: Κεάδης — Ceades, a name or patronymic (’son of Ceas’) of Troezenus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κεράϊζε: κεραΐζω — ravage, slay, plunder; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκεράϊζε)
glossary.κικλήσκουσιν: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl., epic reduplicated κικλήσκω (= Attic καλοῦσιν)
glossary.κικόνων: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Cicones’
glossary.κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., with δώματ’
glossary.κνημοῖσι: κνημός — mountain spur, foothill; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κολώνη: κολώνη — hill, mound; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
glossary.κοσμησάμενος: κοσμέω — arrange, marshal; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having marshalled’
glossary.κούρη: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. nom. sg. (ἠΰτε κούρη ’like a girl’) · also ’daughter’ (κούρη Διός ’daughter of Zeus’)
glossary.κρῶμνάν: Κρῶμνα — Cromna, a Paphlagonian place; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κύτωρον: Κύτωρος — Cytorus, a Paphlagonian place; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λάρισαν: Λάρισα — Larisa, a Pelasgian city; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λάσιον: λάσιος — shaggy, hairy; neut. acc. sg., with κῆρ: ’shaggy heart’
glossary.λήθοιο: Λῆθος — Lethus, father of Hippothous; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λίμνη: λίμνη — lake, pool; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λαὸς: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λυγρὸν: λυγρός — baneful, grievous; masc. acc. sg., with ὄλεθρον
glossary.λυκάονος: Λυκάων — Lycaon, father of Pandarus; masc. gen. sg. · also Lycaon, a son of Priam and brother of Paris; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.λυκίης: Λυκίη — Lycia; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Λυκίας)
glossary.λυκίων: Λύκιοι — the Lycians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μάχας: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl., after εἰσήλυθον
glossary.μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. acc. sg., with ὕδωρ · also with αἷμα: ’black (blood)’
glossary.μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc. gen. sg., with θανάτοιο
glossary.μέμασαν: μέμονα — be eager, be set on; 3 pl., perfect stem with past sense, epic, + inf.: ’were eager’
glossary.μέροπος: Μέροψ — Merops of Percote, a seer; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μέσθλης: Μέσθλης — Mesthles, a Maeonian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μίλητον: Μίλητος — Miletus, a Carian city; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαιάνδρου: Μαίανδρος — the Maeander, a river; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μαντοσύνας: μαντοσύνη — seer’s craft, prophecy; fem. acc. pl., Ionic -ας, object of ᾔδεε
glossary.μαχησόμενοι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); fut. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’about to fight, to fight’ (of purpose)
glossary.μεγάλοι: μέγας — great, large; masc. nom. pl., with ἵπποι
glossary.μεμαότες: μέμονα — be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic -αότες (= Attic -ότες): ’eager’
glossary.μυκάλης: Μυκάλη — Mycale, a mountain; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ης)
glossary.μυρίνης: Μυρίνη — Myrine, a woman of legend; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ης)
glossary.μυσῶν: Μυσοί — the Mysians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μῄονας: Μῄονες — the Maeonians; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μῄοσιν: Μῄονες — the Maeonians; masc. dat. pl., contracted form (= Μῄοσι from Μῄονεσσι)
glossary.μῦθοι: μῦθος — word, speech, talk; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νάστης: Νάστης — Nastes, a Carian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νέμοιτο: νέμω — distribute; mid. spread over, feed on (of fire); pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., after ὡς εἴ τε: ’as if … were consumed’ · also νέμω, mid. have as one’s share, hold, enjoy; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he might enjoy’
glossary.ναῦφιν: ναῦς — ship; pl. with epic suffix -φιν, ablatival (’from the ships’; = Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νείατον: νείατος — lowest, last; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic νέατος)
glossary.νομίονος: Νομίων — Nomion, father of Nastes and Amphimachus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ξάνθου: Ξάνθος — the Xanthus, a river of Lycia; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οἰωνιστής: οἰωνιστής — augur, reader of birds; masc. nom. sg., in apposition to Ἔννομος
glossary.οἰωνοῖσιν: οἰωνός — bird, bird of omen; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), instrumental: ’by bird-omens’

glossary.πάνδαρος: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, son of Lycaon, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg., with μάχης · also fem. gen. sg., with ὁμηλικίης: ’all’ (περὶ πάσης ὁμηλικίης ’above all his age-mates’)
glossary.πίνοντες: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παίονας: Παίονες — the Paeonians; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.παρθένιον: Παρθένιος — the Parthenius, a river; masc. acc. sg., with ποταμόν
glossary.παφλαγόνων: Παφλαγόνες — the Paphlagonians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πείροος: Πείροος — Peiroos, a Thracian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’
glossary.πεζοί: πεζός — on foot; masc. nom. pl.: ’foot-soldiers’
glossary.πειθέσθην: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); impf. 3 dual mid., unaugmented (= ἐπειθέσθην): ’the two obeyed’
glossary.πελασγοῦ: Πελασγός — a Pelasgian; masc. gen. sg., with Λήθοιο
glossary.πελασγῶν: Πελασγοί — the Pelasgians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.περίδρομος: περίδρομος — running round, open all round; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), with κολώνη
glossary.περκωσίου: Περκώσιος — of Percote; masc. gen. sg., with Μέροπος
glossary.περκώτην: Περκώτη — Percote, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πιτύειαν: Πιτύεια — Pityeia, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ποδήνεμος: ποδήνεμος — wind-footed (πούς + ἄνεμος); fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), epithet of Iris
glossary.ποδωκείῃσι: ποδωκείη — swiftness of foot; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’trusting in his swift feet’
glossary.ποδώκεος: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.πολίτῃ: Πολίτης — Polites, a son of Priam; masc. dat. sg. (common noun πολίτης ’citizen’)
glossary.πολιήτας: πολιήτης — citizen, townsman; masc. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic πολίτης, acc. πολίτας)
glossary.πολυσκάρθμοιο: πολύσκαρθμος — much-bounding, nimble; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with Μυρίνης
glossary.πολυσπερέων: πολυσπερής — widely scattered, from many lands; masc. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.πολὺς: πολύς — much, many, great; masc. nom. sg., grave accent mid-clause (πολὺς ὀρυμαγδός ’a great din’)
glossary.πράκτιον: Πράκτιον — Practius, a place on the Hellespont; acc. sg.
glossary.πριαμίδης: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. nom. sg., patronymic, of Hector · also of another son of Priam (Antiphus) · also of Helenus
glossary.προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
glossary.πυλαιμένεος: Πυλαιμένης — Pylaemenes, a Paphlagonian leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.πυραίχμης: Πυραίχμης — Pyraechmes, a Paeonian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
glossary.πύλαι: πύλη — gate; fem. nom. pl. (the plural is the usual form)
glossary.πύλαιός: Πύλαιος — Pylaeus, son of Lethus; masc. nom. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών
glossary.πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι · also fem. nom. pl. with another fem. noun: ’all’ (πᾶσαι χολάδες ’all the bowels’) · also fem. nom. pl., in apposition to a pronoun: ’all (of them)’ (αἳ … πᾶσαι ’they all’)
glossary.σήσαμον: Σήσαμος — Sesamus, a Paphlagonian place; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σαρπηδὼν: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σημαινέτω: σημαίνω — give a sign, give orders; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him command’
glossary.σηστὸν: Σηστός — Sestus, a town on the Hellespont; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σκοπὸς: σκοπός — watcher, look-out, scout; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στείχειν: στείχω — go, march; pres. inf., after ἔασκε: ’to go’
glossary.ταλαιμένεος: Ταλαιμένης — Talaemenes, father of Mesthles and Antiphus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.τευταμίδαο: Τευταμίδης — son of Teutamus; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
glossary.τηρείης: Τηρεία — Tereia, a mountain region; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.τμώλῳ: Τμῶλος — Tmolus, a mountain; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τοσόνδέ: τοσόσδε — so great, so large; masc. acc. sg., with λαόν; accent from enclitic τε
glossary.τροιζήνοιο: Τροιζῆνος — Troezenus, a Cicone; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τυφωέος: Τυφωεύς — Typhoeus, a monster; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.τυφωέϊ: Τυφωεύς — Typhoeus, a monster; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.τύμβῳ: τύμβος — burial mound, tomb; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τῆλ: τῆλε (elided τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
glossary.υἷϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
glossary.φασὶ: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl.: ’they say’
glossary.φθιρῶν: Φθῖρες — the Phthires, a name attached to a Carian mountain; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.φθισήνορα: φθισήνωρ — man-destroying (φθίνω + ἀνήρ); masc. acc. sg., with πόλεμον
glossary.φθογγὴν: φθογγή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φρύγας: Φρύγες — the Phrygians; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.φόρκυς: Φόρκυς — Phorcys, a Phrygian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φύλλοισιν: φύλλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), with ἐοικότες
glossary.χρόμις: Χρόμις — Chromis, a Mysian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χωομένῳ: χώομαι — be angry; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with Διί: ’angry’
glossary.ψαμάθοισιν: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀγάρροος: ἀγάρροος — strong-flowing; masc. nom. sg., epithet of the Hellespont
glossary.ἀγγελίῃ: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.ἀγκυλοτόξους: ἀγκυλότοξος — with curved bow; masc. acc. pl., with Παίονας
glossary.ἀγορὰς: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἀγοράς), internal object of ἀγόρευον
glossary.ἀγροτεράων: ἀγρότερος — wild; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with ἡμιόνων
glossary.ἀγχίσαο: Ἀγχίσης — Anchises; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, address an assembly; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀδρήστειάν: Ἀδρήστεια — Adresteia, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκάμας: Ἀκάμας — Acamas, name of a son of Antenor and of a Thracian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκριτόφυλλον: ἀκριτόφυλλος — thick with leaves (ἄκριτος ’countless’ + φύλλον); neut. acc. sg., with ὄρος
glossary.ἀλίαστος: ἀλίαστος — unceasing, relentless; masc. nom. sg., with πόλεμος
glossary.ἀλεγεινῇ: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; fem. dat. sg., with ἀγγελίῃ
glossary.ἀλύβης: Ἀλύβη — Alybe, a distant land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ης)
glossary.ἀμυδῶνος: Ἀμυδών — Amydon, a Paeonian town; gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., with τε following it
glossary.ἀμφίμαχός: Ἀμφίμαχος — Amphimachus, a Carian leader, son of Nomion; masc. nom. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἀντήνορος: Ἀντήνωρ — Antenor, a Trojan elder; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀξιοῦ: Ἀξιός — the Axius, a river of Paeonia; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀπαισοῦ: Ἄπαισος — Apaesus, a town; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀρίμοις: Ἄριμοι — the Arimi, a people or place of unknown site; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀρίσβηθεν: Ἀρίσβηθεν — from Arisbe; place name + ablatival suffix -θεν; adv.
glossary.ἀρίσβην: Ἀρίσβη — Arisbe, a town; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην (= Attic -ην)
glossary.ἀρχέλοχός: Ἀρχέλοχος — Archelochus, son of Antenor; masc. nom. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἀσκάνιος: Ἀσκάνιος — Ascanius, a Phrygian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσκανίης: Ἀσκανίη — Ascania, a Phrygian region; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.ἀφνειοὶ: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀφορμηθεῖεν: ἀφορμάω — set out from; pass. start off; aor. opt. pass. 3 pl. (= ἀφορμηθείησαν), after ὁππότε: ’set out’
glossary.ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁλιζώνων: Ἁλιζῶνες — the Halizones, a people; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἄβυδον: Ἄβυδος — Abydos, a city on the Hellespont; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἦγον): ’were leading’
glossary.ἄδρηστός: Ἄδρηστος — Adrastus, son of Merops; masc. nom. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἄκριτοί: ἄκριτος — unsifted, without end (ἀ- + κρίνω); masc. nom. pl., predicate with μῦθοι
glossary.ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., distributive: ἄλλη δ’ ἄλλων γλῶσσα ’each tongue differing from the others’
glossary.ἄμφιος: Ἄμφιος — Amphius, a leader, son of Merops; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρχει: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; pres. 3 sg.: ’commands, rules’
glossary.ἄσιος: Ἄσιος — Asius, son of Hyrtacus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐγχείῃσι: ἐγχείη — spear (= ἔγχος); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), instrumental
glossary.ἐγχεσιμώρων: ἐγχεσίμωρος — spear-fighting (second part -μωρος of uncertain sense); masc. gen. pl., with Πελασγῶν
glossary.ἐδάμη: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower, slay; aor. 3 sg. pass., epic ἐδάμη (= Attic ἐδαμάσθη): ’was overcome’

glossary.ἐκόμισσε: κομίζω — carry off, take; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐκόμισε)
glossary.ἐνετῶν: Ἐνετοί — the Eneti, a people; masc. gen. pl.

glossary.ἐπήρκεσε: ἐπαρκέω — ward off from, help (+ dat. of the person helped); aor. 3 sg.: ’warded off’
glossary.ἐπικίδναται: ἐπικίδναμαι — spread over, flow over; pres. 3 sg. mid., + acc.

glossary.ἐριβώλακα: ἐρίβωλαξ — of rich soil, with large clods; fem. acc. sg., with Λάρισαν · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of Troy (Τροίην ἐριβώλακα)
glossary.ἐρυθίνους: Ἐρυθῖνοι — the Erythini, a place with cliffs; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — ward off, save, rescue; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’warded off’
glossary.ἐῢς: ἐΰς — good, brave; masc. nom. sg., epic form (= Attic ἀγαθός), with πάϊς
glossary.ἑλλήσποντος: Ἑλλήσποντος — the Hellespont; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.ἔλυσ: λύω — loose, break up; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔλυσ’ = ἔλυσε): ’broke up, dissolved’
glossary.ἔννομος: Ἔννομος — Ennomus, a Mysian seer; masc. nom. sg. (also adj. ’lawful’)
glossary.ἔρχονται: ἔρχομαι — come, go, march; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔσσυτο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, dash; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἔσσυτο (= Attic ἐσύθη): ’rushed out’
glossary.ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’
glossary.ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)

glossary.ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
glossary.ἡγήσατο: ἡγέομαι — lead, be leader (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’led’
glossary.ἡμιόνων: ἡμίονος — mule; gen. pl., construed as fem. with ἀγροτεράων
glossary.ἦγ: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦγ’ = ἦγε): ’led’
glossary.ἦγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl.: ’were leading’
glossary.ἱμάσσῃ: ἱμάσσω — lash, scourge; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἱμάττῃ), after ὅτε τε without κε
glossary.ἱππόθοος: Ἱππόθοος — Hippothous, a Pelasgian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱππόθοός: Ἱππόθοος — Hippothous, a Pelasgian leader; masc. nom. sg., accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἱππῆές: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic ἱππεῖς); accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
glossary.ἴεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει)
glossary.ἶρις: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδίος: Ὀδίος — Odius, a leader of the Halizones; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρυμαγδὸς: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, clamour; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
glossary.ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε
glossary.ὄπωπα: ὁράω — see; perf. 1 sg., epic stem ὀπ- (= Attic ἑόρακα): ’I have seen’
glossary.ὄρχαμος: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader; masc. nom. sg. (ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ’chief of men’)
glossary.ὄρωρεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; perf. 3 sg. with ν-movable: ’has arisen’
glossary.ὅσσους: ὅσος — as many as, as great as; masc. acc. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσους), relative of quantity
glossary.ὑπαὶ: ὑπαί — under; epic lengthened form of ὑπό; prep. + acc. · also adverb, ’underneath, from below’ (ὑπαὶ δὲ ἴδεσκε ’and he would look from under (his brows), downward’)
glossary.ὑπεστενάχιζε: ὑποστεναχίζω — groan beneath; impf. 3 sg. (ὑπο- + στεναχίζω)
glossary.ὑρτακίδης: Ὑρτακίδης — son of Hyrtacus; masc. nom. sg., patronymic, of Asius
glossary.ὑσμῖνι: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg., epic ὑσμῖνι (= ὑσμίνῃ)
glossary.ὑψηλοὺς: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. acc. pl., with Ἐρυθίνους
glossary.ὠΐγνυντο: οἴγνυμι — open; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic (= Attic ἀνεῴγοντο): ’were opened’
glossary.ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα), epithet of Iris
glossary.ῥέοντος: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., with Ἀξιοῦ: ’flowing’
glossary.ῥοὰς: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰζηοί: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. nom. pl., with θαλεροί
glossary.αἰνῇ: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with δηϊοτῆτι
glossary.αἰσχροῖς: αἰσχρός — shameful, disgraceful, abusive; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
glossary.αἶσαν: αἶσα — due measure, portion, lot; fem. acc. sg. (κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure’; ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’)
glossary.βάλλετε: βάλλω — throw, strike, hit; pres. imper. 2 pl.: μὴ βάλλετε ’do not strike’
glossary.βήσσῃς: βῆσσα — glen, wooded mountain valley; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic βήσσαις)
glossary.βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βιβάντα: βίβημι (βιβάω) — stride, step; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., with μακρά: ’striding with long steps’
glossary.βουλοίμην: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. opt. 1 sg., potential: ’I would wish’
glossary.γνοίης: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential after κε: ’you would come to know’
glossary.γυναιμανὲς: γυναιμανής — woman-mad (γυνή + μαίνομαι); adj., masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.γυναῖκ: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg., elided (γυναῖκ’ = γυναῖκα)
glossary.γυναῖκά: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. acc. pl., goal of motion with δέδυκεν: ’has sunk into the limbs’
glossary.δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δείσας: δείδω — fear, be afraid of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with acc. object: ’having feared’ · also with μή: ’fearing lest’
glossary.δειδήμονες: δειδήμων — timid, fearful (δείδω; the sense is a traditional guess); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δηϊοτῆτι: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, battle (δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. dat. sg., epic
glossary.δουρὸς: δόρυ — spear, wood, timber; neut. gen. sg., epic stem δουρ- (= Attic δόρατος)
glossary.δοῦρε: δόρυ — spear; neut. acc. dual, epic stem δουρ-: ’two spears’
glossary.δράκοντα: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δυσμενέσιν: δυσμενής — ill-disposed, hostile; masc. dat. pl., used as a noun: ’to enemies’
glossary.δύσπαρι: Δύσπαρις — ’Ill-Paris’, a reproachful name for Paris (δυσ- + Πάρις); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.δῶσιν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 pl., epic -σιν, after κεν: ’may give’
glossary.εἶσιν: εἶμι — go; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable (= Attic εἶσι(ν)): ’goes’
glossary.εἷλε: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’took, seized’
glossary.εὐειδέ: εὐειδής — fair-formed, comely; fem. acc. sg., elided and uncontracted (εὐειδέ’ = εὐειδέα, Attic εὐειδῆ)
glossary.εὑρὼν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having found’
glossary.θαλεροί: θαλερός — blooming, lusty, vigorous; masc. nom. pl., with αἰζηοί
glossary.θαλερὴν: θαλερός — blooming, lusty, vigorous; fem. acc. sg., with παράκοιτιν
glossary.θεοειδέα: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic θεοειδῆ)
glossary.θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάθισον: καθίζω — make sit, seat; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., transitive: ’make sit’
glossary.κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative (κέρδος), predicate
glossary.κίθαρις: κίθαρις — lyre, cithara (later κιθάρα); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καγχαλόωσι: καγχαλάω — laugh aloud, exult; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καγχαλῶσι)
glossary.καμπύλα: καμπύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl., with τόξα · also agreeing with κύκλα: ’bent (wheels)’
glossary.κατέχευεν: καταχέω — pour down over; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable
glossary.κατεπλήγη: καταπλήσσω — strike down, stun, dismay; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was struck, was stunned’
glossary.κατεσθίει: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κατηφείην: κατηφείη — dejection, downcast shame; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κεκορυθμένα: κορύσσω — arm, equip with a helmet or point; perf. mid./pass. part. neut. acc. pl.: ’armed’, with δοῦρε
glossary.κεραὸν: κεραός — horned; masc. acc. sg., with ἔλαφον
glossary.κλαγγῇ: κλαγγή — clamour, shrill cry, din; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner
glossary.κονίσαλος: κονίσαλος — cloud of dust; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
glossary.κορυφῇσι: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κορυφαῖς)
glossary.κραδίη: κραδίη — heart; fem. nom. sg. (= Attic καρδία)
glossary.κτήμαθ: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (κτήμαθ’ = κτήματα)
glossary.κτήμασι: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κόμη: κόμη — hair, locks; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κόσμηθεν: κοσμέω — arrange, marshal; aor. 3 pl. pass., unaugmented, epic -θεν (= Attic ἐκοσμήθησαν)
glossary.κύρσας: κύρω — meet with, light upon (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having chanced upon’
glossary.λάεσσί: λᾶας — stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic λίθοις), instrumental
glossary.λάϊνον: λάϊνος — of stone; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic λίθινος)
glossary.λώβην: λώβη — outrage, insult, object of reproach; fem. acc. sg., predicate with ἔμεναι
glossary.μέσσον: μέσος — middle, in the middle; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσον), used as a noun: ’the middle’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with αὐχένα: ’(the neck) in the middle’
glossary.μέσσου: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc. gen. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσου), agreeing with δουρός: ’by the middle’
glossary.μέσσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσῳ), used as a noun: ’in the midst’ · also masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with a place-name: ’in mid-’ (Ἄργεϊ μέσσῳ ’in the midst of Argos’)
glossary.μαχέσασθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); aor. inf. mid., epic: ’to fight’
glossary.μείνειας: μένω — stay, wait for, await; aor. opt. 2 sg. (-ειας for -αις), in a question: ’would you await?’ + acc.
glossary.μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μιγείης: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. opt. pass. 2 sg. (ἐμίγην), in a temporal clause: ’you were mingled’
glossary.μιχθεὶς: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having mingled with’
glossary.νέεσσι: νηῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νέεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νήϊον: νήϊος — of a ship, for ships; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’ship-timber’
glossary.ναίοιτε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. opt. 2 pl., of a wish: ’may you dwell’
glossary.νεέσθων: νέομαι — go, go back, return; pres. imper. 3 pl. mid., epic: ’let them go back’
glossary.νείκεσσεν: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, ν-movable
glossary.νικήσῃ: νικάω — win, conquer; aor. subj. 3 sg., after κε: ’shall win’
glossary.νυκτὸς: νύξ — night; fem. gen. sg., gen. of comparison (after ἀμείνω)
glossary.νυὸν: νυός — daughter-in-law, bride; fem. acc. sg., epic (Attic νύμφη), in apposition
glossary.οἵου: οἷος — of what sort; masc. gen. sg., in an indirect question: ’of what kind of (man)’, with φωτός
glossary.οὐρανόθι: οὐρανόθι — in heaven, in the sky; adv., -θι locative suffix
glossary.πάλλων: πάλλω — brandish, shake; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’brandishing’
glossary.πέλει: πέλω — be, come to be; pres. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐστί): ’is, exists’
glossary.παλίνορσος: παλίνορσος — starting back, springing back; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παντί: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. sg., with δήμῳ
glossary.παράκοιτιν: παράκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παρδαλέην: παρδαλέη — leopard-skin (fem. of παρδάλεος ’of a leopard’); fem. acc. sg., used as a noun
glossary.πεινάων: πεινάω — be hungry; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεινῶν): ’hungry’
glossary.προκαλίζετο: προκαλίζομαι — challenge, call out (+ acc. of those challenged, + inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.προμάχιζεν: προμαχίζω — fight in the front rank; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable
glossary.προμάχοισι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front of; prep. + gen. (also adv.)
glossary.προφέρονται: προφέρω — bring forward, put forward, offer; pres. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.πρόμον: πρόμος — foremost fighter, champion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πρόφερε: προφέρω — bring forward, offer; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: μή … πρόφερε ’do not bring forward’
glossary.πυγμαίοισι: Πυγμαῖος — Pygmy, of the dwarf folk; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), with ἀνδράσι
glossary.πόληΐ: πόλις — city; fem. dat. sg., epic πόληϊ (= Attic πόλει)
glossary.πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, bane; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to the whole action · also neut. nom. sg., subject of λίποιτο: ’a woe (be left)’
glossary.σεύωνται: σεύω — drive, hunt; mid. rush at, set upon; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid., after εἴ περ ἂν
glossary.σιγῇ: σιγή — silence; fem. dat. sg., used adverbially: ’in silence’
glossary.στεῦται: στεῦμαι — stand forth as promising, declare, claim (defective); 3 sg. στεῦται, + inf.: ’he declares’
glossary.συμβάλετ: συμβάλλω — throw together, bring together, set against each other; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (συμβάλετ’ = συμβάλετε)
glossary.σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
glossary.σώματι: σῶμα — body, carcass (in Homer, of a dead body); neut. dat. sg.
glossary.σῷ: σός — your (sg.); masc. dat. sg., with πατρί · also with υἱέϊ: ’your (son)’ · also neut. dat. sg., with βέλεϊ: ’your (shaft)’
glossary.τέχνῃ: τέχνη — skill, craft, art; fem. dat. sg., dative of means
glossary.τίσεσθαι: τίνω — pay; mid. τίνομαι, τίνυμαι take vengeance on, exact payment from; fut. inf. mid., in indirect speech after φάτο: ’to take vengeance on’
glossary.ταί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they, those’
glossary.ταχέες: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ταχεῖς)
glossary.τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.τιτυσκόμενοι: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, take aim; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’taking aim’
glossary.τοιόσδε: τοιόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε — such (as this); masc. nom. sg., in agreement with the subject
glossary.τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τόξα: τόξον — bow; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single bow)
glossary.τόσσόν: τόσσος — so much, so far; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic τόσον), adverbial; correlative with ὅσον
glossary.φάλαγγας: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line, phalanx; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φάντες: φημί — say, think; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’saying, declaring’
glossary.φανέντα: φαίνω — bring to light; pass. appear; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’having appeared’
glossary.φιλότητα: φιλότης — friendship, love, kindness; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φωτὸς: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φύγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔφυγον)
glossary.χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing; with the opt., potential: ’would’ · also with the subj. after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ χ’ … πύθηαι ’if you ever hear’)
glossary.χάρμα: χάρμα — joy, delight, source of joy; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition · also neut. acc. sg., predicate after γενέσθαι: ’a joy’
glossary.χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
glossary.χειμῶνα: χειμών — winter, wintry storm; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χρυσέης: χρύσεος — golden; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῆς)
glossary.ἀγέσθω: ἄγω — lead; mid. lead for oneself, take home; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him lead (home)’
glossary.ἀελλὴς: ἀελλής — stormy, tempestuous (ἄελλα ’storm’); adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., with κονίσαλος
glossary.ἀθέσφατον: ἀθέσφατος — immense, prodigious (sense of the word debated); adj., masc. acc. sg., with ὄμβρον
glossary.ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard, + acc. of what is said); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard’
glossary.ἀλέξανδρον: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλείτην: ἀλείτης — offender, wrongdoer, sinner; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλεείνων: ἀλεείνω — shun, avoid; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
glossary.ἀλεξέμεν: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend (+ dat. of those defended); pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀλέξειν)
glossary.ἀλκή: ἀλκή — defence, strength to resist, might; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλοδαποῖσι: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), used as a noun: ’to foreigners’
glossary.ἀμείνω: ἀμείνων — better (comparative of ἀγαθός); fem. acc. sg., contracted from ἀμείνονα, with ὀμίχλην · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’better’
glossary.ἀνέεργε: ἀνέργω — hold back, check, restrain (epic ἐέργω = Attic εἴργω); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
glossary.ἀνεχώρησεν: ἀναχωρέω — go back, withdraw, retire; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀντίβιον: ἀντίβιος — opposed, face to face; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially: ’in open opposition’
glossary.ἀνῆγες: ἀνάγω — lead up, lead away, carry off (by sea); impf. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἀπέστη: ἀφίσταμαι — stand away, withdraw, retire; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἀπέστη, intransitive)
glossary.ἀπόβλητ: ἀπόβλητος — to be thrown away, to be rejected; adj., neut. nom. pl., elided (ἀπόβλητ’ = ἀπόβλητα)
glossary.ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
glossary.ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
glossary.ἀριστῆα: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, noble; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἀτάρβητος: ἀτάρβητος — unafraid, fearless; adj., masc. nom. sg., with νόος
glossary.ἀτειρὴς: ἀτειρής — unwearied, unyielding; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., with κραδίη
glossary.ἄγαμός: ἄγαμος — unmarried, unwed; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate, with ἀπολέσθαι: ’perish unwed’
glossary.ἄγονός: ἄγονος — not begotten, unborn (or childless; sense debated); adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate with ἔμεναι
glossary.ἄγριον: ἄγριος — wild, savage; adj., acc. sg., with αἶγα · also masc. acc. sg., with αἰχμητήν: ’wild (spearman)’
glossary.ἄριστε: ἄριστος — best (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.ἄϋσεν: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. 3 sg. (epic ἄϋσε), ν-movable
glossary.ἐκτάμνῃσιν: ἐκτάμνω (= ἐκτέμνω) — cut out, hew out; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -σιν, in a general relative clause with τε: ’hews out’
glossary.ἐνείκεσας: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; aor. 2 sg., augmented (cf. unaugmented νείκεσσεν)
glossary.ἐνοπῇ: ἐνοπή — shout, cry, battle-cry; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner
glossary.ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice, think of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπετοξάζοντο: ἐπιτοξάζομαι — shoot arrows at, aim a bow at (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl. mid., augment after the preverb
glossary.ἐπιλεύσσει: ἐπιλεύσσω — look upon, catch sight of; pres. 3 sg.: ’sees’
glossary.ἐπιπλώσας: ἐπιπλώω (= ἐπιπλέω) — sail over, sail upon; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with acc.: ’having sailed over’
glossary.ἐρέειν: ἐρέω (= εἴρω/λέγω) — say, tell, speak; fut. inf., epic uncontracted -έειν (= Attic ἐρεῖν) · also ἐρεείνω — ask, question; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἐρέειν’ = ἐρέεινε): ’asked’
glossary.ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρατὰ: ἐρατός — lovely, desirable; neut. acc. pl., with δῶρ’
glossary.ἐρικυδέα: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, splendid; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρικυδῆ), with δῶρα
glossary.ἐρχόμενον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’coming’
glossary.ἐρωήν: ἐρωή — rush, onset, force of a blow; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐχάζετο: χάζομαι — draw back, give way, retire; impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐχάρη: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., passive form with active sense: ’rejoiced’
glossary.ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’willingly’
glossary.ἑλένῃ: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔβαλλον: βάλλω — throw, pelt, hit; impf. 3 pl. (1 sg. identical): ’kept pelting’
glossary.ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
glossary.ἔθνος: ἔθνος — company, band, throng; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔλαφον: ἔλαφος — deer, stag; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
glossary.ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔοργας: ἔρδω (= ῥέζω) — do, perform; perf. 2 sg. act. (ἔοργα): ’you have done’
glossary.ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλοιτο: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would take, would choose’ · also aor. opt. mid. 3 sg. after μή, of fear: ’lest (he) take’ (μή τις … ἕλοιτο ’lest any take’) · also aor. opt. mid. 3 sg. in an indirect deliberation or purpose clause: ’should take, might take’ (ἦ … ἕλοιτο ’or whether he should take’)
glossary.ἕνεχ: ἕνεκα — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., following its noun, elided and aspirated (ἕνεχ’ before a rough breathing)
glossary.ἕσσο: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. be clothed in, wear; aor. mid. 2 sg., epic (ἕσσο = ἕσσαο), with κεν: ’you would have put on’
glossary.ἠέριαι: ἠέριος — early, at dawn (the sense is debated; also ’in the mist’); adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἠπεροπευτὰ: ἠπεροπευτής — deceiver, seducer; masc. voc. sg., epic -ά, in address
glossary.ἡγεμόνεσσιν: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -όσι)
glossary.ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
glossary.ἰοῖσίν: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), instrumental; accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
glossary.ἱδρύνθησαν: ἱδρύω — make sit, seat, settle; aor. 3 pl. pass.: ’were seated, sat down’
glossary.ἱππόβοτον: ἱππόβοτος — horse-feeding, horse-pasturing; neut. acc. sg., with Ἄργος
glossary.ἴσχεσθ: ἴσχω — hold; mid. hold oneself back, stop; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (ἴσχεσθ’ = ἴσχεσθε)
glossary.ἵησιν: ἵημι — send, throw, hurl; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable (= Attic ἵησι)
glossary.ὀμίχλην: ὀμίχλη — mist, fog; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀφέλλει: ὀφέλλω — increase, strengthen, add to; pres. 3 sg. (distinct from ὀφείλω ’owe’)
glossary.ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁππότερος: ὁππότερος — whichever of the two; masc. nom. sg., indefinite relative (= Attic ὁπότερος)
glossary.ὄμβρον: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ὄρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
glossary.ὄρνυτ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; mid. rise, start up; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented and elided (ὄρνυτ’ = ὄρνυτο)
glossary.ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’
glossary.ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. acc. pl.: ’all that’
glossary.ὑπό: ὑπό — under, beneath; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑπό … ἔλλαβε ’seized from beneath’); accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὑπόψιον: ὑπόψιος — looked at askance, regarded with suspicion; adj., masc. acc. sg., predicate with ἔμεναι (+ gen. of those who look)
glossary.ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὦχρός: ὦχρος — paleness, pallor; masc. nom. sg., subject (cf. adj. ὠχρός ’pale’)
glossary.ῥοάων: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.αἰτίη: αἰτίη (Attic αἰτία) — cause, blame, fault; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η, predicate: οὔ τί μοι αἰτίη ἐσσί ’you are in no way to blame to me’
glossary.αἴθρη: Αἴθρη — Aethra, daughter of Pittheus, one of Helen’s two handmaids; fem. nom. sg. · also αἴθρη — clear bright sky, cloudless air; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ), dative of cause: ’by old age’
glossary.γαλόῳ: γάλως — husband’s sister, sister-in-law; fem. dat. sg., epic γαλόῳ
glossary.γεραρόν: γεραρός — stately, venerable, majestic; neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person (the form is also masc. acc.): ’a stately (one)’
glossary.γλαφυρὰς: γλαφυρός — hollow, well-hollowed; fem. acc. pl., standing epithet of ships (νῆας γλαφυράς)
glossary.γλυκὺν: γλυκύς — sweet; masc. acc. sg.: γλυκὺν ἵμερον ’sweet longing’
glossary.γυναικὶ: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg., after ἀμφί: ’about a woman’
glossary.γῇ: γαῖα (Attic γῆ) — earth, land; the goddess Earth; fem. dat. sg., Attic-type contracted form: ’(for) Earth’
glossary.δάμαρτι: δάμαρ — wife, spouse; fem. dat. sg. (stem δαμαρτ-)
glossary.δίπλακα: δίπλαξ — double cloth, a mantle woven to be folded double; fem. acc. sg. (gen. δίπλακος)
glossary.δενδρέῳ: δένδρεον (Attic δένδρον) — tree; neut. dat. sg., epic δενδρέῳ (= Attic δένδρῳ)
glossary.δηλήσηται: δηλέομαι — harm, damage, violate; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after μή τις: ’lest anyone harm’
glossary.δημογέροντες: δημογέρων — elder of the people, councillor; masc. nom. pl., in apposition to the men seated
glossary.διακρινθήμεναι: διακρίνω — separate, part; aor. pass. inf. in -ήμεναι with epic ν (-κρινθ-) (= Attic διακριθῆναι): ’to be parted’
glossary.διακρινθεῖτε: διακρίνω — separate, part; aor. pass. opt. 2 pl., epic ν-form (-κρινθ-) of Attic διακριθεῖτε, in a wish: ’may you be parted’
glossary.εἰποῦσα: λέγω, aor. εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having said’
glossary.εἴδονθ: ὁράω, aor. εἶδον — see; aor. 3 pl. mid. εἴδοντο, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (εἴδονθ’ = εἴδοντο); epic mid. in the sense of the active: ’saw’
glossary.εἶχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contracted from ἔ-εχε): ’had, held (as wife)’
glossary.εὗρ: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 sg., elided (εὗρ’ = εὗρε): ’found’
glossary.θέσκελα: θέσκελος — marvellous, wondrous (the meaning is not known; this is the traditional sense); neut. acc. pl., with ἔργα
glossary.θαλάμοιο: θάλαμος — chamber, inner room; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεῇς: θεά — goddess; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic θεαῖς), after ἔοικεν: ’to goddesses’
glossary.θυμοίτην: Θυμοίτης — Thymoetes, one of the Trojan elders; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάλ: καλός — fair, fine, goodly; neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with τεύχεα: ’fine (armour)’ · also agreeing with σφυρά: ’fair (ankles)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’fine (works)’ · also agreeing with λέπαδνα: ’fine (yoke-straps)’
glossary.κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen., accented before the enclitic μευ: ’hear (me)’
glossary.κέκλυτε: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
glossary.κέλεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 3 sg. (+ acc. and inf.): ’he bids’
glossary.καλέσσαι: καλέω — call, summon; aor. inf. act., epic doubled σσ (= Attic καλέσαι): ’to call’
glossary.καλυψαμένη: καλύπτω — cover, veil; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’having veiled herself (in)’
glossary.κατέθεντ: κατατίθημι — put down, lay down; aor. 3 pl. mid., elided (κατέθεντ’ = κατέθεντο): ’laid down (their own)’
glossary.κεκλήσῃ: καλέω — call, name; fut. perf. pass. 2 sg. (= κεκλήσεαι): ’you will be called’
glossary.κεκλιμένοι: κλίνω — lean, recline; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’leaning (on)’
glossary.κλυμένη: Κλυμένη — Clymene, one of Helen’s two handmaids; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κλυτίον: Κλυτίος — Clytius, one of the Trojan elders; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λάμπόν: Λάμπος — Lampus, one of the Trojan elders; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λίποιτο: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a wish, passive in sense: ’may … be left’
glossary.λαοδίκην: Λαοδίκη — Laodice, daughter of Priam, wife of Helicaon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λειριόεσσαν: λειριόεις — lily-like (what the likeness is, is uncertain), of a voice; fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα (= Attic -όεισα)
glossary.λευκόν: λευκός — white, bright; masc. acc. sg., in apposition to the dual ἄρνε: ’(one) white’
glossary.λεύσσει: λεύσσω — look, see, gaze; pres. 3 sg.: ’he looks’
glossary.λιλαιόμενοι: λιλαίομαι — long for, desire (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing for’
glossary.μακρῇς: μακρός — long, tall; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic μακραῖς)
glossary.μαχήσονται: μάχομαι (epic μαχέομαι) — fight; fut. 3 pl. in -ήσ- (= Attic μαχοῦνται): ’will fight’
glossary.μείζονες: μέγας — great, big; comparative μείζων; masc. nom. pl.: ’taller, bigger’
glossary.μετέῃσιν: μέτειμι — be among, be present; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic μετῇ), in an indefinite relative clause: ’is among’
glossary.μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νέμεσις: νέμεσις — righteous indignation, resentment, blame; fem. nom. sg., predicate with ἐστί understood: ’(it is) a cause for indignation’
glossary.νεέσθω: νέομαι — go, go back, return; pres. imper. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείσθω): ’let her go back’
glossary.νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (has arisen)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἔμβαλε: ’threw a quarrel’
glossary.νικήσαντι: νικάω — win, conquer; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’to the one who has won’
glossary.νύμφα: νύμφη — young wife, bride; an affectionate title of address; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.οἰσέμεναι: φέρω (fut. οἴσω) — bring, carry; fut. inf. act. in -έμεναι (= Attic οἴσειν): ’to bring’
glossary.οἴους: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. pl., predicative: ’alone, only’
glossary.οἴσετε: φέρω (fut. οἴσω) — bring, carry; fut. 2 pl. used as a command: ’bring!’
glossary.οἴσομεν: φέρω (fut. οἴσω) — bring, carry; fut. 1 pl.: ’we will bring’
glossary.οὐκαλέγων: Οὐκαλέγων — Ucalegon, one of the Trojan elders; masc. nom. sg. (a speaking name: οὐκ + ἀλέγω, ’one who does not care’)
glossary.οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’ · also relative of persons, object of γνοίην: ’whom’ (οὕς κεν ἐῢ γνοίην ’whom I could recognise’)
glossary.πάνθοον: Πάνθοος — Panthous, one of the Trojan elders; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάσχειν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. inf.: ’to suffer’
glossary.πέπασθε: πάσχω — suffer, experience; perf. 2 pl., epic syncopated form (= Attic πεπόνθατε): ’you have suffered’
glossary.πέπαυται: παύω — stop; mid./pass. cease, be at rest; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’has ceased’
glossary.πέπηγεν: πήγνυμι — fix, fasten; intrans. perf. πέπηγα, stand fixed; perf. 3 sg. with ν-movable, singular verb after a neuter plural subject: ’is fixed’
glossary.παλαμάων: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.παύσασθαι: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to cease from’
glossary.πελώριον: πελώριος — huge, monstrous; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα: ’huge’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’huge’
glossary.πεπαυμένοι: παύω — stop; mid. cease, have rest from (+ gen.); perf. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having ceased from’
glossary.πεπνυμένω: πέπνυμαι (πινύσκω) — be wise, prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. dual: ’(both) prudent’
glossary.πηούς: πηός — relative by marriage, in-law, kinsman; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πιτθῆος: Πιτθεύς — Pittheus, king of Troezen, father of Aethra; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.πολύδακρυν: πολύδακρυς — tearful, bringing many tears; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἄρηα or πόλεμον
glossary.πορφυρέην: πορφύρεος — purple, dark-gleaming; adj., fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic πορφυρᾶν)
glossary.πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
glossary.πρίαμον: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πρίαμόν: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.προτέρου: πρότερος — former, earlier; masc. gen. sg.: ’former (husband)’
glossary.πρότερόν: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόσιν: ’former (husband)’ (accented before the enclitic τε)
glossary.πτερόεντ: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πτερόεντ’ = πτερόεντα): ἔπεα πτερόεντα ’winged words’
glossary.πόσιν: πόσις — husband; masc. acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.
glossary.πύλῃσι: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic πύλαις)
glossary.πύργον: πύργος — tower, bastion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πύργῳ: πύργος — tower, bastion; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’)
glossary.σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
glossary.σκαιαὶ: σκαιός — left, left-hand; fem. nom. pl.: Σκαιαὶ πύλαι ’the Scaean Gates’ (the sense of the name is uncertain; ‘left-hand’ is a guess)
glossary.σκαιῇσι: σκαιός — left, left-hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic σκαιαῖς): Σκαιῇσι πύλῃσι ’at the Scaean Gates’ (the sense of the name is uncertain)
glossary.τάμνῃ: τάμνω (Attic τέμνω) — cut; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ὅρκια τάμνῃ ’he may cut (swear) a pact’
glossary.τάμωμεν: τάμνω (Attic τέμνω) — cut; aor. subj. 1 pl. (aor. ἔταμον), hortatory: ’let us cut’ (ὅρκια τάμωμεν ’let us swear a pact’)
glossary.τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
glossary.τέρεν: τέρην — tender, delicate; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυ: ’(a) tender (tear)’
glossary.τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made ready, has come to pass’ · also with a predicate noun: ’has been made, has become’ (ταμίης τέτυκται ’has been made steward’)
glossary.ταλθύβιον: Ταλθύβιος — Talthybius, Agamemnon’s herald; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τεθναίη: θνῄσκω — die; perf. opt. 3 sg. (perf. τέθνηκα), in a wish: ’let him be dead’
glossary.τεκέεσσί: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τέκεσι), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τεττίγεσσιν: τέττιξ — cicada; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τέττιξι), with ἐοικότες
glossary.τεύχεά: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τοίη: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.: ’such a one’
glossary.τοιῇδ: τοιόσδε — such, of such a kind; fem. dat. sg., elided (τοιῇδ’ = τοιῇδε)
glossary.τοκήων: τοκεύς — parent, begetter; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic τοκέων)
glossary.τοῖοι: τοῖος — such, of such a sort; masc. nom. pl.: ’of such a kind’
glossary.φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, friends’
glossary.φρονέω: φρονέω — think, have in mind, be minded; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I am minded’
glossary.φωνῇ: φωνή — voice; fem. dat. sg., dative of means: ’with the voice’
glossary.ἀέθλους: ἄεθλος (Attic ἆθλος) — contest, struggle, ordeal; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted ἄεθλος
glossary.ἀγορηταὶ: ἀγορητής — speaker, orator; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀθανάτῃσι: ἀθάνατος — immortal; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀθανάταις)
glossary.ἀκὴν: ἀκήν — silent, in silence; adv. (frozen acc. of ἀκή), predicative: ’still, silent’
glossary.ἀλεξάνδροιο: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀλεξάνδρου: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
glossary.ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’) · also gen. pl. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἰθυνομένων ’as they aimed at one another’)
glossary.ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’
glossary.ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’
