glossary.ἀνδρός: ἀνήρ — man, husband; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀντήνωρ: Ἀντήνωρ — Antenor, one of the Trojan elders; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντηνορίδαο: Ἀντηνορίδης — son of Antenor (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀντηνορίδης: Ἀντηνορίδης — son of Antenor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπίθησ: ἀπειθέω (epic ἀπιθέω) — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., elided (ἀπίθησ’ = ἀπίθησε): ’disobeyed’
glossary.ἀποθέσθαι: ἀποτίθημι — put away, lay down; aor. inf. mid.: ’to lay down (one’s own)’
glossary.ἀρίστην: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, fem. acc. sg.: ’the best’
glossary.ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀργεννῇσι: ἀργεννός — white, bright; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic ἀργεναῖς), with ὀθόνῃσιν
glossary.ἀρχῆς: ἀρχή — beginning, origin; fem. gen. sg., after ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of the beginning (of the trouble)’
glossary.ἀσπίσι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. pl. (stem ἀσπιδ-): ’on shields’
glossary.ἀχαιὸς: Ἀχαιός — Achaean, Greek; masc. nom. sg., in apposition to ἀνήρ: ’an Achaean (man)’
glossary.ἄκοιτις: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄνεῴ: ἀνεώς — speechless, silent; masc. nom. pl. (Attic-type declension)
glossary.ἄξετε: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. 2 pl. used as a command: ’bring!’
glossary.ἄπιστοι: ἄπιστος — faithless, untrustworthy; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄριστα: ἀγαθός (superl. ἄριστος) — best; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’best’
glossary.ἄρν: ἀρήν — lamb, sheep; acc. sg. ἄρνα, elided (ἄρν’ = ἄρνα): ’a lamb’ · also acc. dual, elided (ἄρν’ = ἄρνε): ’two lambs’
glossary.ἄρνάς: ἀρήν — lamb, sheep; masc./fem. acc. pl. ἄρνας: ’lambs’
glossary.ἄστεος: ἄστυ — city, town; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic ἄστεως)
glossary.ἐκέλευεν: κελεύω — bid, order, urge; impf. 3 sg., movable ν (= Attic ἐκέλευε(ν)): ’ordered’
glossary.ἐκαλέσσατο: καλέω — call, summon; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic doubled σσ (= Attic ἐκαλέσατο): ’called to himself’
glossary.ἐλπόμενοι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + inf.: ’hoping’
glossary.ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐνέπασσεν: ἐμπάσσω (ἐν-πάσσω) — work in, weave in a pattern; impf. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’was working in’
glossary.ἐξεδύοντο: ἐκδύω — take off, strip off; mid. strip oneself of; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’were taking off (their own)’
glossary.ἐξονομήνῃς: ἐξονομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. subj. 2 sg., after ὥς: ’you may name’
glossary.ἐοῦσ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἐοῦσ’ = ἐοῦσα), epic (= Attic οὖσα): ’being, though she is’
glossary.ἐσθλοί: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐσσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
glossary.ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
glossary.ἐφεζόμενοι: ἐφέζομαι — sit upon, settle on; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’sitting on’
glossary.ἐφώρμησαν: ἐφορμάω — set upon, stir up against (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. act., transitive: ’stirred up’
glossary.ἐχάρησαν: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 pl. (aor. pass. ἐχάρην): ’rejoiced’
glossary.ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
glossary.ἑθεν: οὗ (ἕ) — of him, her, itself; 3rd-person pron., gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ): ’her’, after εἵνεκα: ’for her sake’
glossary.ἑλικάων: Ἑλικάων — Helicaon, son of Antenor, husband of Laodice; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑτέρην: ἕτερος — other, second (of two); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἑτέραν)
glossary.ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
glossary.ἔγχεα: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἔγχη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’spears’ (ἔγχεα ὀξυόεντα ’sharp spears’)
glossary.ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, put into; aor. 3 sg., + dat.: ’cast into’
glossary.ἔπασχον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; impf. 3 pl.: ’were suffering’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I was suffering’ (with κε: ’I would have suffered’)
glossary.ἔρυξαν: ἐρύκω — hold back, check, restrain; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’held back’
glossary.ἔσχοντο: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. aor. ἐσχόμην, intransitive: hold oneself back (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’held back (from)’
glossary.ἔφαν: φημί — say; impf./aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
glossary.ἕαται: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. 3 pl., epic ἕαται (= Attic κάθηνται): ’sit’
glossary.ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)
glossary.ἥατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἧντο): ’were sitting’
glossary.ἧντ: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl., elided (ἧντ’ = ἧντο): ’were sitting’
glossary.ἰοῦσαν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. act. fem. acc. sg.: ’going, coming’
glossary.ἱεῖσι: ἵημι — send forth, let go, emit; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic ἱᾶσι): ’send out, utter’
glossary.ἱκετάονά: Ἱκετάων — Hicetaon, one of the Trojan elders; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἴδηαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἴδῃ), after ἵνα: ’you may see’
glossary.ἵζευ: ἵζω — sit down, seat oneself; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ἵζευ (= ἵζου): ’sit down’
glossary.ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
glossary.ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀθόνῃσιν: ὀθόνη — fine linen cloth; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ὀθόναις)
glossary.ὀλίγη: ὀλίγος — little, small; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλοοῖο: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὀϊζυροῦ: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable, woeful; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁπλοτέρων: ὁπλότερος — younger; comparative adj., masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὁπποτέρῳ: ὁππότερος — whichever of the two; masc. dat. sg., indefinite relative (= Attic ὁπότερος)
glossary.ὁρμᾶτ: ὁρμάω — set in motion; mid. set out, hasten; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented and elided (ὁρμᾶτ’ = ὁρμᾶτο, Attic ὡρμᾶτο): ’set out’
glossary.ὑπερβασίῃ: ὑπερβασίη — overstepping, transgression; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ίῃ (= Attic ὑπερβασίᾳ), dative of cause
glossary.ὑπερφίαλοι: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὕφαινε: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. (an augment on initial υ- does not show in writing): ’was weaving’
glossary.ὦπα: ὤψ — face, countenance; acc. sg. ὦπα, after εἰς: accusative of respect, ’in face’
glossary.αἰγείῳ: αἴγειος — of a goat; masc. dat. sg.: ἀσκῷ ἐν αἰγείῳ ’in a goatskin’
glossary.αἰδοῖός: αἰδοῖος — worthy of respect, revered, august; masc. nom. sg., predicate adj.: ’revered’
glossary.αἰολοπώλους: αἰολοπῶλος — with swift or gleaming colts (αἰόλος ’quick, flashing’ + πῶλος ’foal’); masc. acc. pl., epithet of the Phrygians
glossary.αἰχμητής: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴαντα: Αἴας — Ajax, the great Telamonian hero; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσχεα: αἶσχος — disgrace, shame; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic αἴσχη)
glossary.αἶα: αἶα — earth, land (poetic, = γαῖα); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτοκασιγνήτω: αὐτοκασίγνητος — own brother (αὐτός + κασίγνητος); masc. dual acc. (same form as nom.): ’own brothers’
glossary.βήσετο: βαίνω — go, step, mount; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic mixed aor. (stem βησ- with thematic endings), unaugmented (= Attic ἐβήσατο): ’stepped onto’
glossary.βροτὸς: βροτός — mortal; masc. nom. sg.: ’mortal man’
glossary.γένει: γένος — birth, descent, race; neut. dat. sg., dative of respect: ’in birth’
glossary.γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γεραιός: γεραιός — old; masc. nom. sg., substantival: ’the old man’
glossary.γεραρώτερος: γεραρός — stately, venerable; comparative γεραρώτερος, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’more stately’
glossary.γνοίην: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κεν: ’I could recognise’
glossary.γνωτούς: γνωτός — kinsman, relative (cf. γιγνώσκω); masc. acc. pl.: ’kinsfolk’
glossary.γυναικί: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg., after ἀμφί: ’about a woman’
glossary.γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg., in address: ’woman!’
glossary.δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also a seat, stool: ’stool’ (δίφρον … κατέθηκε ’set down a stool’)
glossary.δαὴρ: δαήρ — husband’s brother, brother-in-law; masc. nom. sg., predicate (stem δαερ-)
glossary.δεδμήατο: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, overpower; plupf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ήατο (= Attic ἐδέδμηντο): ’had been subdued’
glossary.δειδιότες: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic δειδιότες (= Attic δεδιότες): ’dreading’, + acc.
glossary.δεινός: δεινός — fearful, dread, awesome; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’awesome’
glossary.δεύρω: δεῦρο — hither, to this place; adv., epic form δεύρω (= δεῦρο)
glossary.δεῦρό: δεῦρο — hither, to this place; adv., accented before the enclitic ποτε
glossary.διέρχεται: διέρχομαι — go through, pass through; pres. 3 sg., + acc.
glossary.δοιὼ: δοιώ, δοιαί — two; masc. dual acc., epic (= Attic δύο): ’the two’
glossary.δόλους: δόλος — trick, wile, cunning; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. dep., + inf.: ’I am able’
glossary.εἴπ: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., elided (εἴπ’ = εἰπέ): ’tell!’
glossary.εἵη: ἵημι — send, let go, utter; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., the Attic form too, in a general clause: ’(whenever) he sent forth’
glossary.εὐρέας: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖς)
glossary.εὐρύτερος: εὐρύς — broad; comparative εὐρύτερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’broader’
glossary.ζάκοτόν: ζάκοτος — very wrathful, full of resentment (ζα- intensive + κότος ’grudge’); masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ζευγνύμεναι: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; pres. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic ζευγνύναι): ’to yoke’
glossary.θάλαμον: θάλαμος — inner chamber, bedroom; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θάνατός: θάνατος — death; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic μοι
glossary.κάστορά: Κάστωρ — Castor, brother of Polydeuces and Helen; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic θ’
glossary.κάτεχεν: κατέχω — hold fast, hold down, cover; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= κατεῖχεν), accent thrown back from the preverb
glossary.καλέουσιν: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι(ν))
glossary.καταβῆναι: καταβαίνω — go down, come down; aor. inf. act.: ’to go down’
glossary.καταδύμεναι: καταδύω — go down into, enter; aor. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic καταδῦναι), + acc.: ’to enter’
glossary.κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. 3 sg.: ’lies’
glossary.κλαίουσα: κλαίω — weep, cry; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’weeping’
glossary.κρήτεσσι: Κρής — a Cretan; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Κρησί): ’among the Cretans’
glossary.κρήτηθεν: Κρήτη — Crete; adv. with suffix -θεν: ’from Crete’
glossary.κραναῆς: κραναός — rocky, rugged; fem. gen. sg., Attic form identical
glossary.κρατερός: κρατερός — strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κτίλος: κτίλος — tame, gentle (of animals); masc. nom. sg., used as a noun: ’a tame (ram)’
glossary.κυνώπιδος: κυνῶπις — dog-eyed, shameless; adj., fem. gen. sg., agreeing with the speaker herself: ’shameless (me)’
glossary.κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λαερτιάδης: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes (patronymic of Odysseus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λακεδαίμονι: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the Spartan land; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Lacedaemon’
glossary.λακεδαίμονος: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the Spartan land; fem. gen. sg., after ἐξ: ’from Lacedaemon’
glossary.λαομεδοντιάδη: Λαομεδοντιάδης — son of Laomedon (patronymic of Priam); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.λιγέως: λιγύς — clear-toned, shrill; adv. λιγέως: ’clearly, in a ringing voice’
glossary.λιποῦσα: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’leaving’
glossary.μάκαρ: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; adj. (2 endings), masc. voc. sg.
glossary.μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά (ἄν τε μάχην): ’through the fighting’
glossary.μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (pl. μήδεα)
glossary.μία: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg.: ’one (mother)’
glossary.μαχήσοντ: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 3 pl., elided (μαχήσοντ’ = μαχήσονται): ’they will fight’
glossary.μεγάλην: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. sg.: ’great (voice)’
glossary.μεταλλᾷς: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 2 sg., + acc.
glossary.μοιρηγενὲς: μοιρηγενής — born to one’s fate, fate-born (μοῖρα + γένος); adj., masc. voc. sg.
glossary.μυγδόνος: Μύγδων — Mygdon, a Phrygian leader; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μυθησαίμην: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, recount; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I could tell’
glossary.μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.νέεσσ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νέεσσι (= Attic ναυσί), elided
glossary.νέονται: νέομαι — go, come, return; pres. 3 pl., with future sense: ’will go back’
glossary.ναίοιμεν: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. opt. 1 pl., wish: ’may we live in’, + acc.
glossary.νιφάδεσσιν: νιφάς — snowflake; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic νιφάσι), dative after ἐοικότα: ’(like) snowflakes’
glossary.ξείνισσεν: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, epic double σ (= Attic ἐξένισεν)
glossary.οἰῶν: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; fem. gen. pl., contracted (= epic ὀΐων): ’of sheep’
glossary.οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
glossary.οὔνομα: ὄνομα — name; neut. acc. sg., epic οὔνομα (= Attic ὄνομα)
glossary.οὗτός: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: ’this man’
glossary.πήξας: πήγνυμι — fix, plant, make fast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fixed’
glossary.παντοίους: παντοῖος — of every kind; masc. acc. pl.: ’all sorts of’
glossary.παριστάμενος: παρίστημι — set beside; mid. stand beside; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’standing beside’
glossary.πατρίδι: πατρίς — of one’s fathers, native; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γαίῃ: ’native (land)’
glossary.παῦρα: παῦρος — few, little; neut. acc. pl.: ’few things’
glossary.πελώριος: πελώριος — monstrous, huge; masc. nom. sg., predicate · also masc. nom. sg., in apposition to a name: ’huge’ (Ἀΐδης … πελώριος ’huge Hades’)
glossary.πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., stock epithet: ’prudent’
glossary.περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ), agreeing with δίφρον · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with δειρήν: ’very beautiful’
glossary.πηγεσιμάλλῳ: πηγεσίμαλλος — thick-fleeced (πηγός ’stout, thick’ + μαλλός ’fleece’); masc. dat. sg., with ἀρνειῷ
glossary.πολυδεύκεα: Πολυδεύκης — Polydeuces, brother of Castor and Helen; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.πολύμυθος: πολύμυθος — much-talking, talkative; masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.προπρηνὲς: προπρηνής — bending forward, leaning forward; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’forward’
glossary.πυκνά: πυκνός — thick, close-set, solid, shrewd; neut. acc. pl., with μήδεα: ’solid (counsels)’
glossary.πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’
glossary.πὺξ: πύξ — with the fist, in boxing; adv.
glossary.πῶϋ: πῶϋ — flock (of sheep); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σαγγαρίοιο: Σαγγάριος — the Sangarius, a river of Phrygia; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σκαιῶν: Σκαιαί (πύλαι) — the Scaean Gates of Troy (σκαιός ’left’); fem. gen. pl., Σκαιῶν (πυλῶν), after διά
glossary.στάντων: ἵστημι — set; intrans. aor. stand; aor. part. act. masc. gen. pl.: ’(of them) standing’
glossary.στάσκεν: ἵστημι — stand; iterative aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, -σκ- suffix: ’he would stand’
glossary.στέρνοισιν: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.στήθεος: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.τάμητε: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; aor. subj. 2 pl. act., epic τάμνω; ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
glossary.τέτηκα: τήκω — melt, make waste; perf. 1 sg. intrans.: ’I have melted, I waste away’
glossary.τανύπεπλος: τανύπεπλος — long-robed, with trailing robe (τανύ- ’long’ + πέπλος ’robe’); fem. nom. sg., epithet of Helen
glossary.τεῖνεν: τείνω — stretch, draw tight; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτεινεν), with κατά in tmesis: ’drew tight’
glossary.τηλυγέτην: τηλύγετος — late-born, dearly loved (meaning traditional, not certain); fem. acc. sg., with παῖδα
glossary.τράφη: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐτράφη): ’was reared’
glossary.τρίτον: τρίτος — third; neut. acc. sg., adverbial with the article (τὸ τρίτον): ’the third time’
glossary.τόσοι: τόσος — so great, so many; masc. nom. pl., correlative with ὅσοι: ’so many’
glossary.υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε)
glossary.φίλησα: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; aor. 1 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐφίλησα)
glossary.φαίης: φημί — say; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you would say’
glossary.φαεινὸν: φαεινός — shining, bright (cf. φαίνω ’show, shine’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρητῆρα
glossary.φρυγίην: Φρυγίη — Phrygia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic Φρυγία)
glossary.φυσίζοος: φυσίζοος — life-giving, grain-giving; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of the earth
glossary.φυὴν: φυή — stature, growth, form; fem. acc. sg.: ’stature’
glossary.φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg., after ἐοικώς: ’(like) a man’
glossary.χειμερίῃσιν: χειμέριος — wintry; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), with νιφάδεσσιν
glossary.χθονὸς: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.: κατὰ χθονὸς ’down upon the ground’
glossary.χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
glossary.ἀΐδρεϊ: ἄϊδρις — ignorant, knowing nothing; adj., masc. dat. sg. (stem ἀϊδρι-), with φωτί
glossary.ἀγασσάμεθ: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be amazed at; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἀγασσάμεθ’ = ἀγασσάμεθα), doubled σ
glossary.ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, embassy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἕνεκα
glossary.ἀγοὶ: ἀγός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγρομένοισιν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. mid. part., syncopated (ἀγρόμενος), masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’gathered’
glossary.ἀμαζόνες: Ἀμαζών — an Amazon, warrior woman; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἠμείβετο)
glossary.ἀμπελόεσσαν: ἀμπελόεις — rich in vines, vine-clad; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Φρυγίην
glossary.ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both respects’ (ἀμφότερον … τε … τε ’both … and’)
glossary.ἀναΐξειεν: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, leap up; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a general clause with ὅτε: ’(whenever) he sprang up’
glossary.ἀνείρεαι: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνείρῃ)
glossary.ἀντιάνειραι: ἀντιάνειρα — man-matching, a match for men; adj., fem. nom. pl., epithet of the Amazons
glossary.ἀντιθέοιο: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀργεννάων: ἀργεννός — white, bright; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with οἰῶν
glossary.ἀρηϊφίλῳ: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2 endings), masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀρνειῷ: ἀρνειός — ram; masc. dat. sg., after ἐΐσκω: ’to a ram’
glossary.ἀρούρης: ἄρουρα — ploughed land, field; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.ἀσκῷ: ἀσκός — skin, wineskin; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀστεμφὲς: ἀστεμφής — firm, unshaken, stiff; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’stiffly’
glossary.ἀφαμαρτοεπής: ἀφαμαρτοεπής — missing the mark in speech, speaking wide of the point; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁδεῖν: ἁνδάνω (ἀνδάνω) — please, be pleasing to; aor. inf. act. (ἁδεῖν), + dat.: ’to please’
glossary.ἄρνε: ἀρήν (gen. ἀρνός) — lamb, sheep; masc. dual acc.: ’two lambs’
glossary.ἄφρονά: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἐΐσκω: ἐΐσκω — liken, compare; pres. 1 sg. act., + dat. of what it is likened to
glossary.ἐΰφρονα: ἐΰφρων — kindly, cheering the heart (ἐΰ- ’well’ + φρήν); adj., masc. acc. sg.: ’heart-cheering’
glossary.ἐδάην: δάω — learn, get to know; aor. pass. dep. 1 sg., root δα- with augment: ’I came to know’
glossary.ἐθέλουσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., + inf.
glossary.ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + acc. + inf.
glossary.ἐκγεγαυῖα: ἐκγίγνομαι — be born from; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (ἐκγεγαώς), + gen.: ’born of’
glossary.ἐλέχθην: λέγω — count, number among, reckon; aor. pass. 1 sg. (ἐλέχθην): ’I was counted’
glossary.ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ
glossary.ἐνώμα: νωμάω — handle, wield, ply; impf. 3 sg.: ’was handling’
glossary.ἐξείνισσα: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented, epic double σ (= Attic ἐξένισα)
glossary.ἐοικότα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. neut. acc. pl., + dat.: ’like’
glossary.ἐούσης: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic οὔσης), concessive with περ: ’though it is’
glossary.ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they obeyed’
glossary.ἐπίκουρος: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιπωλεῖται: ἐπιπωλέομαι — go about, range over, move along; pres. 3 sg. dep., + acc.
glossary.ἐπιτροχάδην: ἐπιτροχάδην — glibly, fluently, ’at a run’; adv.
glossary.ἐρίσσειε: ἐρίζω — vie, contend; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐρίσειε), + dat., potential with ἄν: ’could rival’
glossary.ἐρατεινήν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, charming; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρατεινῆς: ἐρατεινός — lovely, charming; fem. gen. sg., Attic form identical
glossary.ἐστρατόωντο: στρατάομαι — be encamped, encamp; impf. 3 pl. dep., epic -όωντο (= Attic ἐστρατῶντο)
glossary.ἑζομένω: ἕζομαι — sit down, be seated; pres. part. dual masc. nom.: ’both seated’
glossary.ἑλένη: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑλίκωπας: ἑλίκωψ — quick-eyed or with rolling eyes (meaning uncertain), epithet of the Achaeans; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑπόμην: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 sg. mid. dep. (= Attic εἱπόμην): ’I followed’
glossary.ἑσπέσθην: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 dual mid. dep. (= Attic ἐσπέσθην): ’the two followed’
glossary.ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔμιχθεν: μείγνυμι (Attic μίγνυμι) — mix; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -θεν (= Attic ἐμίχθησαν), intrans.: ’they mingled’
glossary.ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
glossary.ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative -σκ- form: ’was, used to be’
glossary.ἔχεσκεν: ἔχω — have, hold; iterative impf. 3 sg., -σκ- suffix: ’he would hold’
glossary.ἕποιτο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. dep., potential with κε: ’would follow’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it followed’
glossary.ἕστηκ: ἵστημι — set; perf. stand; perf. 3 sg., elided (ἕστηκ’ = ἕστηκε): ’stands’
glossary.ἠγάσσατο: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be amazed; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented, epic doubled σ
glossary.ἠγερέθονται: ἠγερέθομαι — gather, assemble; pres. 3 pl. dep., epic by-form of ἀγείρομαι: ’are gathered’
glossary.ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ’he came’
glossary.ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν): ’to see’
glossary.ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’
glossary.ἰδαῖος: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. nom. sg. · also Idaeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰδόντες: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., unaugmented: ’having seen’
glossary.ἰθάκης: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ης)
glossary.ἱππόδαμον: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. acc. sg., with Κάστορα
glossary.ἴδεσκε: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see, look; iterative aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, -σκ- suffix: ’he would look’
glossary.ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a general clause: ’(whenever) he came’
glossary.ὀδυσῆΐ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., single-σ metrical variant (= Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ), after ἐρίσσειε: ’with Odysseus’
glossary.ὀλβιόδαιμον: ὀλβιοδαίμων — blessed in fortune, prosperous (ὄλβιος + δαίμων); adj., masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὀτρῆος: Ὀτρεύς — Otreus, a Phrygian king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ὁμηλικίην: ὁμηλικίη — age-mates, company of the same age; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general clause
glossary.ὁρῶ: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., contracted: ’I see’
glossary.ὄρσεο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid. (ὄρσεο = ὄρσο): ’rise!’
glossary.ὄτρυνεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνεν)
glossary.ὄφελεν: ὀφείλω (ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤφελε(ν)); with ὡς + inf., an unfulfilled wish: ’would that’
glossary.ὄχθας: ὄχθη — bank (of a river); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπείρεχεν: ὑπερέχω — rise above, overtop; impf. 3 sg., epic ὑπείρεχεν (= Attic ὑπερεῖχεν), + acc.: ’stood out above’
glossary.ὕστερος: ὕστερος — later, younger; comparative, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’younger’ · also predicative, ’later, afterward’ (ὕστερος ὄρνυτο ’rushed on later’)
glossary.ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
glossary.ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
glossary.ῥίγησεν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’shuddered’
glossary.αἰειγενέτῃσιν: αἰειγενέτης — everlasting, ever-living (αἰεί + γίγνομαι); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις); epithet of the gods
glossary.αἰχμὴ: αἰχμή — spear-point, spear; fem. nom. sg.: ’the point’
glossary.βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλε): ’hit, struck’
glossary.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. inf. mid.: ’to come about, be made’ · also with περί + gen.: ’to be superior to’ · also aor. inf. mid. after φημί, predicate: ’to be, to have become’
glossary.δάμασσον: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower, kill; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic δάμασον): ’subdue’
glossary.δαμεῖεν: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. opt. 3 pl. pass. (= Attic δαμείησαν), wish: ’may they be subdued’
glossary.δαρδανίδης: Δαρδανίδης — descendant of Dardanus, ancestor of the Trojan royal house (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully, fearsomely’
glossary.δερκόμενοι: δέρκομαι — look; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. pl.: ’looking’
glossary.δευομένους: δεύομαι — lack, be without, + gen. (= Attic δέομαι); pres. part. mid., masc. acc. pl.: ’lacking’
glossary.διάμησε: διαμάω — cut through; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic διήμησε): ’cut through’
glossary.διαμετρητῷ: διαμετρητός — measured out, marked off; masc. dat. sg.: ’measured’
glossary.διατρυφὲν: διαθρύπτω — break in pieces, shatter; aor. 2 pass. part., neut. nom. sg.: ’shattered’
glossary.διεμέτρεον: διαμετρέω — measure out; impf. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted -εον (= Attic διεμέτρουν): ’they measured’
glossary.δολιχόσκιον: δολιχόσκιος — long-shadowed; neut. acc. sg., epithet of a spear (ἔγχος)
glossary.δόμον: δόμος — house, home; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰσορόωντας: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze on; pres. part. act., masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντας): ’looking on’
glossary.εὐρύν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν, set after its noun
glossary.εὔτυκτον: εὔτυκτος — well-made, well-wrought; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔχοντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 pl. mid., augment εὐ- unchanged: ’they prayed’
glossary.θάμβος: θάμβος — amazement, astonishment; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.θέτο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put (for himself)’
glossary.θωρήχθησαν: θωρήσσω — arm, put on armour; aor. pass. 3 pl. with middle sense: ’they armed themselves’
glossary.θώρηκα: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. acc. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακα)
glossary.θώρηκος: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. gen. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακος)
glossary.κακότητος: κακότης — wickedness, evil; fem. gen. sg., gen. of the wrong avenged: ’for the wickedness’
glossary.καλάς: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with κνημῖδας
glossary.καμόντας: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; aor. part. act., masc. acc. pl.: ’those who have toiled’, i.e. the dead
glossary.κασιγνήτοιο: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with οἷο agreeing: ’of his own brother’
glossary.κατέθηκεν: κατατίθημι — put down, lay down; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’laid down’
glossary.καταπέφνῃ: καταπέφνω (φένω) — slay, kill; reduplicated aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κεν after εἰ: ’should kill’ (= Attic κατακτείνῃ)
glossary.κεφαλέων: κεφαλή — head; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic κεφαλῶν)
glossary.κλήρους: κλῆρος — lot (a marked token drawn or shaken to decide); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κλῆρος: κλῆρος — lot (a marked token drawn or shaken to decide); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κνήμῃσιν: κνήμη — shin, lower leg; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κνημῖδας: κνημίς — greave, leg-guard; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κοτέοντε: κοτέω — be angry, bear a grudge; pres. part. act., masc. dual nom., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοτοῦντε): ’the two angered’
glossary.κουλεόν: κολεόν — scabbard, sheath; neut. acc. sg., epic κουλεόν (= Attic κολεόν), after παρά
glossary.κρατερῇ: κρατερός — strong, mighty, fierce; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.κρατὶ: κάρη (κράς) — head; neut. dat. sg. (stem κρατ-): ’on the head’
glossary.κρητῆρι: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κρατῆρι)
glossary.κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κτείνῃ: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., with κε in a condition: ’should kill’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. after μή: ’lest he kill’
glossary.κυνέην: κυνέη — helmet, cap; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic κυνῆν)
glossary.κυνέῃ: κυνέη — helmet, cap (properly of dog-skin); fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κυνῇ)
glossary.λαπάρην: λαπάρη — flank, the soft part of the side; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λόφος: λόφος — crest, plume of a helmet (also ridge, hill); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάχαιραν: μάχαιρα — knife, dagger; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μίσγον: μίσγω (= μίγνυμι) — mix; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔμισγον): ’they mixed’
glossary.μαρνάμενον: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. sg.: ’fighting’
glossary.μεδέων: μέδω — rule, be lord over; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μεδῶν), in address: ’ruling, lord’
glossary.νεῖμαν: νέμω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -αν (= Attic ἔνειμαν), unaugmented: ’they dealt out’
glossary.νηλέϊ: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic νηλεεῖ), agreeing with χαλκῷ
glossary.ξίφεος: ξίφος — sword; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ξίφους)
glossary.ξεινοδόκον: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests (ξεῖνος + δέχομαι); masc. acc. sg., epic ξειν- (= Attic ξενοδόκος)
glossary.οἷο: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic οὗ): ’his own’
glossary.πάλλεν: πάλλω — shake, brandish; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπαλλε): ’shook’
glossary.πάλλον: πάλλω — shake, brandish; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπαλλον): ’they shook’
glossary.πάντοσε: πάντοσε — in every direction, all round; adv.
glossary.πάριος: Πάριος — of Paris (adj. from Πάρις); masc. nom. sg., agreeing with κλῆρος: ’Paris’s’
glossary.πέληται: πέλομαι — be, come to be, remain; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic γένηται): ’may be, shall be’
glossary.παλάμηφιν: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. sg. with epic suffix -φιν, dative or ablative (= Attic παλάμῃ, or ἐκ παλάμης): ’in or by the hand’; ’from the palm’
glossary.παράσχῃ: παρέχω — offer, show, provide; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative with κεν: ’offers’
glossary.πεπρωμένον: πόρω — grant, allot; perf. pass. part., neut. nom. sg.: ’fated, destined’
glossary.πεσόντος: πίπτω — fall, drop; aor. part. act., masc. gen. sg.: ’having fallen’, i.e. slain
glossary.πημήνειαν: πημαίνω — harm, wrong; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., epic -ειαν (= Attic πημήναιεν): ’should do harm’
glossary.πιστά: πιστός — trusty, faithful; neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’faithful (oaths)’
glossary.ποικίλα: ποικίλος — many-coloured, intricately wrought; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἅρματα: ’intricate (chariot)’
glossary.ποινῆς: ποινή — requital, payment exacted for a killing or wrong; fem. gen. sg., after εἵνεκα: ’for the requital’
glossary.πολυδαιδάλου: πολυδαίδαλος — much-wrought, intricately made; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θώρηκος
glossary.ποντοπόροισιν: ποντοπόρος — sea-crossing; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πουλυβότειραν: πουλυβότειρα — much-nourishing, bounteous; fem. acc. sg., epic (= πολυβότειρα), epithet of the earth
glossary.πριαμίδαο: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
glossary.πρότεροι: πρότερος — earlier, first (comparative of πρό); masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’first (to do it)’ · also with the article as a noun: ’the men of earlier days’ (οἱ πρότεροι)
glossary.πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
glossary.σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
glossary.σείοντ: σείω — shake, brandish; pres. part. act., masc. dual nom., elided σείοντ’ (= σείοντε): ’the two brandishing’
glossary.στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.στομάχους: στόμαχος — throat, gullet; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them, their’ or acc. σφε ’them’
glossary.σύναγον: συνάγω — bring together, gather; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic συνῆγον): ’they brought together’
glossary.τάμε: τέμνω — cut; aor. 3 sg. act., epic stem ταμ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἔτεμε): ’cut’
glossary.τάμνε: τέμνω — cut; impf. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔτεμνε): ’was cutting’
glossary.τίνειν: τίνω — pay, pay as a penalty; pres. inf. act.: ’to pay’
glossary.τίνυσθον: τίνυμαι (τίνω) — take vengeance on, punish; pres. dual mid. (2nd and 3rd person share the ending): ’the two punish’
glossary.τεκέων: τέκος — child (Attic τέκνον); neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted -έων: ’of the children’
glossary.τετραχθὰ: τετραχθά — in four pieces; adv. (correlative with τριχθά)
glossary.τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα)
glossary.τλήσομ: τλάω — endure, bear, dare; fut. 1 sg. mid., elided τλήσομ’ (= τλήσομαι): ’I shall bear’
glossary.τρῶάς: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl., accent shifted before the enclitic τε (Τρῶας θ’)
glossary.φάλον: φάλος — part of a helmet, usually taken as the ridge that carried the plume; the sense is not certain; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φαεινῆς: φαεινός — shining, bright; adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φυλάσσετε: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic φυλάττετε): ’guard’
glossary.φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλκήρεϊ: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze (χαλκός + ἀραρίσκω); adj. of two endings, dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.χαλκός: χαλκός — bronze; masc. nom. sg., also the bronze blade or spear-head
glossary.χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
glossary.χείρεσσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic χερσί), instrumental: ’with the hands’
glossary.χείρεσσιν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic χερσίν): ’in the hands’
glossary.χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg.: ’onto the earth’
glossary.χώρῳ: χῶρος — place, spot, space; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.χῶρον: χῶρος — place, spot, space; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγαυοὶ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀερσίποδες: ἀερσίπους — lifting the feet high (ἀείρω + πούς), the usual explanation, sense not quite certain; masc. nom. pl., epithet of horses
glossary.ἀλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἠλεύατο): ’avoided’
glossary.ἀμπεπαλὼν: ἀναπάλλω — swing up, brandish; aor. 2 part. act., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, ἀμ- by assimilation of ἀνά
glossary.ἀνέσχον: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. 3 pl. act. (also 1 sg.): ’they held up’
glossary.ἀνασχόμενος: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. raise oneself, lift up one’s arm; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
glossary.ἀνεγνάμφθη: ἀναγνάμπτω — bend back; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was bent back’
glossary.ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
glossary.ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς) · also of fighting, ’head-on, face to face’ (ἀντικρὺ μάχεσθαι ’to fight head-on’)
glossary.ἀποβάντες: ἀποβαίνω — step off, disembark; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπονέοντο: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they went back’
glossary.ἀποτινέμεν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, pay in full; pres. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic ἀποτίνειν): ’to pay back’
glossary.ἀποφθίμενον: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. part. mid., masc. acc. sg.: ’having perished’
glossary.ἀρήρει: ἀραρίσκω — fit, fit together; plpf. 3 sg. with intransitive impf. sense, epic: ’was fitted’
glossary.ἀρίστοις: ἄριστος — best, noblest; masc. dat. pl., substantival: ’to the best men’
glossary.ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic reduplicated -υῖα, no Attic prose equivalent: ’fitted’
glossary.ἀργείοις: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Achaeans/Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀργυρέοισιν: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἀργυροῖς), agreeing with ἐπισφυρίοις · also agreeing with ἱμᾶσιν: ’(straps) of silver’
glossary.ἀσπίδ: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. acc. sg., elided ἀσπίδ’
glossary.ἀσπαίροντας: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. act., masc. acc. pl.: ’gasping’
glossary.ἀφείη: ἀφίημι — let go, let fly; aor. opt. 3 sg. act.: ’should let fly’
glossary.ἀφυσσόμενοι: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀφύττω): ’drawing’
glossary.ἄγη: ἄγνυμι — break, shatter; aor. 2 pass. 3 sg., epic ἄγη (= Attic ἐάγη): ’was broken’
glossary.ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄνα: ἄναξ — lord, master; voc. sg., shortened epic form: ’lord!’ · also ἀνά (ἄνα) — up!; adv. used as an imperative
glossary.ἄρνας: ἀρήν — lamb; acc. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
glossary.ἄψορροι: ἄψορρος — going back, back again; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’returning’
glossary.ἄωρτο: ἀείρω — lift, hang up; plpf. pass. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἤορτο): ’hung’
glossary.ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
glossary.ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
glossary.ἐθέλωσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl. act., ν-movable, in a condition: ’should be willing’
glossary.ἐκλίνθη: κλίνω — bend, lean; aor. pass. 3 sg. with middle sense: ’leaned aside’
glossary.ἐμῇς: ἐμός — my, mine; possessive adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic ἐμαῖς), agreeing with χερσί
glossary.ἐπίορκον: ἐπίορκος — false to one’s oath; adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg., as cognate object of ὄμνυμι: ’a false (oath)’
glossary.ἐπακούεις: ἐπακούω — hear, listen to; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you hear’
glossary.ἐπευξάμενος: ἐπεύχομαι — pray (to), make a vow; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπισφυρίοις: ἐπισφύριον — ankle-piece, ankle-clasp (of a greave); neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἐρρίγῃσι: ῥιγέω — shudder (with dread); perf. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ): ’may shudder’
glossary.ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
glossary.ἐτώσιον: ἐτώσιος — vain, fruitless; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’
glossary.ἐφάμην: φημί — say, think; impf. mid. 1 sg. (= Attic ἔφην): ’I said, I thought’
glossary.ἐφορᾷς: ἐφοράω — look upon, oversee; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you watch over’
glossary.ἐχέτω: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. imper. 3 sg. act.: ’let him keep’
glossary.ἑκάτερθεν: ἑκάτερθε(ν) — on each side, from each side; adv.
glossary.ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
glossary.ἔβαιν: βαίνω — go, step, mount; impf. 3 sg. act., elided ἔβαιν’ (= ἔβαινε): ’mounted’
glossary.ἔβαλόν: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 1 sg. act. (same form as 3 pl.): ’I hit’
glossary.ἔδυνεν: δύνω (= δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’put on (armour)’
glossary.ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
glossary.ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔκχεον: ἐκχέω — pour out; impf. 3 pl. act. (= Attic ἐξέχεον): ’they poured out’
glossary.ἔνευεν: νεύω — nod; impf. 3 sg. with ν-movable (= Attic ἔνευε): ’nodded’
glossary.ἔντε: ἔντεα — gear, armour, equipment (neut. pl.); neut. acc. pl., elided (ἔντε’ = ἔντεα)
glossary.ἔρρηξεν: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’broke’
glossary.ἔστε: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 pl. (indic. or imper.): ’you are, be’
glossary.ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν) · also with σύν in tmesis: σὺν … ἔχευαν ’poured together, confounded’ (of oaths)
glossary.ἠΐχθη: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, hurl; aor. pass. 3 sg. with active sense: ’darted’
glossary.ἠέλιός: Ἠέλιος — the Sun; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic Ἥλιος), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἠρήρειστο: ἐρείδω — press, fix, lodge; plpf. pass. 3 sg., epic reduplicated: ’was driven home’
glossary.ἠρήσαντο: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they prayed’
glossary.ἥρμοσε: ἁρμόζω — fit, join; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’fitted’
glossary.ἧός: ἧος — until, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως), accented before the enclitic κε
glossary.ἰφθίμῳ: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; adj. of two endings, neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἱπποδάμους: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; masc. acc. pl., epithet of the Trojans
glossary.ἴδηθεν: Ἴδη — Mount Ida near Troy; Ἴδηθεν with suffix -θεν: ’from Ida’
glossary.ἴσην: ἴσος — equal, even; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἵζοντο: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they sat down’
glossary.ἵππουριν: ἵππουρις — with a horsehair plume; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
glossary.ὀλοώτερος: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. nom. sg., comparative ὀλοώτερος: ’deadlier’
glossary.ὀμόσσῃ: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀμόσῃ), with κε in a general clause: ’swears’
glossary.ὀψιγόνων: ὀψίγονος — late-born, born in later generations; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὁππότεροι: ὁππότερος — whichever of the two; masc. nom. pl., indefinite relative (= Attic ὁπότεροι)
glossary.ὁρᾶσθαι: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. inf. mid., epic contracted ὁρᾶσθαι: ’to look at, behold’
glossary.ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρνυτο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, rush; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυτο): ’rose, rushed’
glossary.ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this’
glossary.ὅτις: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. nom. sg., epic (ὅτις = Attic ὅστις)
glossary.ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
glossary.ᾤμωξεν: οἰμώζω — cry out in pain, wail; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ῥέοι: ῥέω — flow; pres. opt. 3 sg. act.: ’may it flow’
glossary.αἱρεῖ: αἱρέω — take, seize, take hold of; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’seizes’
glossary.αὐτόθ: αὐτόθι — right there, on the spot; adv., elided (αὐτόθ’ = αὐτόθι)
glossary.βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow; gen. sg.: ’of an ox’
glossary.γρηῒ: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic γραΐ, from γραῦς)
glossary.δάρδανοι: Δάρδανοι — the Dardanians, a people of the Troad (descendants of Dardanus); masc. nom. pl., also voc. in address: ’Dardanians!’
glossary.δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, a divine power (often unnamed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δαμήῃς: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower, kill; aor. subj. 2 sg. pass., epic -ήῃς (= Attic δαμῇς), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest you be overcome’
glossary.δαμεὶς: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower (epic δάμνημι); aor. part. pass., masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome, subdued’
glossary.δειρήν: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. sg., epic -ήν (= Attic δέρην)
glossary.δειρὴν: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. sg., epic -ὴν (= Attic δέρην)
glossary.δεῖξαι: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. inf. act.: ’to show’
glossary.δινωτοῖσι: δινωτός — turned, rounded (from δινέω ’whirl’; exact sense uncertain); masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.δολοφρονέουσα: δολοφρονέω — plot craftily, think guile; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονοῦσα)
glossary.δούλην: δούλη — slave-woman; fem. acc. sg., predicate: ’as a slave’
glossary.δύνατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδύνατο): ’was able’
glossary.εἰροκόμῳ: εἰροκόμος — wool-dresser, one who tends wool (εἶρος ’wool’ + κομέω ’tend’); fem. dat. sg. (adj. of two endings)
glossary.εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’
glossary.εἴρια: εἴριον (εἶρος) — wool, fleece; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’wool, woollen things’
glossary.εἴρυσσέν: ἐρύω — drag, haul; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ-, augmented (= Attic εἴρυσε), ν-movable; with κεν, contrary to fact: ’would have dragged’
glossary.εἵμασιν: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable (= Attic ἱματίοις)
glossary.εἵπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (εἵπετ’ = εἵπετο), augment εἱ- from ἐ- + σεπ-: ’followed’
glossary.εἷσ: ἵζω — seat, set, place; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (εἷσ’ = εἷσε): ’set, seated’
glossary.εὐνηθέντε: εὐνάω — put to bed; pass. lie down, go to bed; aor. part. pass., masc. nom. dual: ’the two of us having gone to bed’
glossary.εὐνῇ: εὐνή — bed, bed of love; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.εὐώδεϊ: εὐώδης — sweet-smelling, fragrant (εὖ + ὄζω); masc. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.εὔχε: εὔχομαι — boast, claim, pray; impf. 2 sg. mid., unaugmented, uncontracted and elided (εὔχε’ = εὔχεο; Attic ηὔχου): ’you used to claim’
glossary.θάμβησέν: θαμβέω — be amazed, be struck with wonder; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐθάμβησε), ν-movable
glossary.θαλάμῳ: θάλαμος — inner room, bedchamber; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θηρὶ: θήρ — wild beast; masc. dat. sg., after ἐοικώς: ’to a beast’
glossary.κάθιζ: καθίζω — sit down; impf. 3 sg. act., elided (κάθιζ’ = κάθιζε): ’sat down’
glossary.κάλλεΐ: κάλλος — beauty; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic κάλλει)
glossary.κέλομαι: κέλομαι — bid, urge; pres. 1 sg. mid., + acc. and inf.: ’I bid’
glossary.κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (Attic ᾔει from εἶμι): ’went’
glossary.κίχανε: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, come upon; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκίχανε): ’found, came upon’
glossary.καθίζειν: καθίζω — sit down; pres. inf. act.: ’to sit down’
glossary.καλά: καλός — beautiful, fine, good; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.καλέουσ: καλέω — call, summon; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted, elided (καλέουσ’ = καλέουσα; Attic καλοῦσα): ’calling’
glossary.καλεῖ: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.κατέθηκε: κατατίθημι — put down, set down; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’set down’
glossary.κατακτάμεναι: κατακτείνω — kill; root aor. inf. (κατακτάμεναι, epic -μεναι; Attic κατακτεῖναι): ’to kill’
glossary.κατασχομένη: κατέχω — hold down, cover, hold back; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’having covered herself’
glossary.κατεύνασθεν: κατευνάζω — lay to sleep; mid./pass. lie down; aor. pass. 3 dual (or 3 pl.) in -θεν: ’the two lay down’
glossary.κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κεινὴ: κενεός (κεινός) — empty, hollow; fem. nom. sg., epic κεινή (= Attic κενή)
glossary.κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, path; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation after ἀπόεικε: ’from the road’
glossary.κεῖθι: κεῖθι — there; adv., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
glossary.κεῖνον: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνον); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεῖσε: κεῖσε — to that place, thither; adv.
glossary.κηρὶ: κήρ — death, doom; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κηώεντι: κηώεις — fragrant, scented; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic adjective with no Attic equivalent
glossary.κιών: κίω — go; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. Attic ἰών): ’going’
glossary.κλίνασα: κλίνω — bend, turn aside; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having turned (away)’
glossary.κλειτῶν: κλειτός — famous, renowned (= Attic κλυτός); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κραναῇ: κραναός — rugged, rocky; as a name, Cranae; fem. dat. sg., epic -ῇ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.κταμένοιο: κτείνω — kill; root aor. part. (κτάμενος), pass. sense, masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’slain’
glossary.κόμισαν: κομίζω — take care of, carry off, fetch; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐκόμισαν): ’took care of’
glossary.λάθεν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαθεν)
glossary.λέχεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.λήγοντα: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); pres. part. act., masc. acc. sg.: ’ceasing’
glossary.λαβοῦσα: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (+ gen., of the part taken): ’having taken hold’
glossary.λεχέεσσιν: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν, uncontracted ending
glossary.λιλαίεαι: λιλαίομαι — long for, desire eagerly; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic λιλαίῃ): ’you long’
glossary.λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl.: ’grievous things’
glossary.μαρμαίροντα: μαρμαίρω — flash, sparkle; pres. part. act., neut. acc. pl.: ’flashing’
glossary.μαχεσσάμενον: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); aor. part. mid., masc. acc. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having fought’
glossary.μεθείω: μεθίημι — let go, give up; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., epic -είω (= Attic μεθῶ), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest I abandon’
glossary.μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be eager, rage; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, furious’
glossary.μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μητίσομαι: μητίομαι — devise, contrive; fut. 1 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’I will contrive’
glossary.μωμήσονται: μωμάομαι — blame, find fault with; fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’will blame’
glossary.μῃονίης: Μῃονίη — Maeonia, a region of Asia Minor; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.ναιετοώσῃ: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. act., fem. dat. sg., epic -όωσα (= Attic ναιετώσῃ): ’dwelling’
glossary.ναιομενάων: ναίω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. mid./pass., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν): ’inhabited’
glossary.νεκταρέου: νεκτάρεος — nectar-sweet, fragrant (νέκταρ); masc. gen. sg., epic -έου (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νεμεσσητὸν: νεμεσσητός — open to righteous blame, shameful; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a thing to resent’
glossary.νικήσας: νικάω — conquer, win; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having prevailed over’
glossary.νόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
glossary.ξανθῷ: ξανθός — yellow, fair-haired, tawny; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.οἶτον: οἶτος — fate, doom (usually evil); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’) · also prep. + gen., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’from beside, from’ (γαμβροῖο πάρα ’from his son-in-law’)
glossary.πάρις: Πάρις — Paris, son of Priam, also called Alexander; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.παλαιγενέϊ: παλαιγενής — born long ago, aged; fem. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.παρέστης: παρίστημι — stand beside, come up to; aor. 2 sg. act. (root aorist): ’you have come to stand by’
glossary.παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
glossary.παύεσθαι: παύω — stop; mid. cease, leave off; pres. inf. mid.: ’to stop’
glossary.περικαλλέ: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέα; Attic περικαλλῆ)
glossary.ποιήσεται: ποιέω — make, do; mid. make for oneself, take as; fut. 3 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.) with κε: ’will make’, with a double acc.
glossary.πολλῇ: πολύς — much, many, great; fem. dat. sg.: ’thick, great’
glossary.πολύκεστος: πολύκεστος — much-stitched, richly embroidered (πολύς + κεστός ’stitched’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πορσανέουσα: πορσαίνω (πορσύνω) — prepare, make ready, tend; fut. part. act., fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πορσυνοῦσα), of purpose: ’to tend’
glossary.προκάλεσσαι: προκαλέω — call forth, challenge; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -σσαι (= προκάλεσαι): ’challenge!’
glossary.προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; comp. adv. προτέρω: ’farther on’
glossary.πόδεσσιν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.πῄ: πῃ — somewhere, in some direction; indef. enclitic adv., accented πῄ before a following enclitic
glossary.στήθεά: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic στήθη)
glossary.στίλβων: στίλβω — gleam, glisten; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’glistening’
glossary.στυγερὴν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σχετλίη: σχέτλιος — hard-hearted, headstrong, wretched; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), in address
glossary.σῇ: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.τέτατο: τείνω — stretch, extend; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stretched out’
glossary.τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
glossary.τράποντο: τρέπω — turn; mid. turn oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐτράποντο): ’turned, set about’
glossary.τραπείομεν: τρέπω — turn; aor. pass. subj. 1 pl., epic lengthened (= Attic τραπῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us turn’
glossary.τρητοῖσι: τρητός — bored, pierced (of a bedstead strung through drilled holes); masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.τρυφάλεια: τρυφάλεια — helmet (origin of the word not known); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τρυφαλείης: τρυφάλεια — helmet (origin of the word not known); fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.τρῳαὶ: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. nom. pl., Ionic Τρῳαί
glossary.τρῳὰς: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. act., fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
glossary.φέρτερος: φέρτερος — stronger, better; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’
glossary.φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.φιλέεσκε: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ- (unaugmented): ’used to be fond of’
glossary.φιλομειδὴς: φιλομειδής (φιλομμειδής) — smile-loving, epithet of Aphrodite; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φιλότητί: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; fem. dat. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.φρυγίης: Φρυγίη — Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.φύλασσε: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’guard!’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύλασσε): ’was keeping watch’
glossary.χαλεποῖσιν: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.χαλκείῳ: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze-tipped; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.χολωσαμένη: χολόω — anger; mid. grow angry; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’having grown angry’
glossary.χοροῖο: χορός — dance; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of separation: ’from the dance’
glossary.χορὸν: χορός — dance; dancing-place; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χωσαμένη: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic: ’incensed’
glossary.ἀθήνῃ: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Ἀθηνᾷ)
glossary.ἀλέξανδρός: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’answering’
glossary.ἀμφεκάλυψεν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round about, envelop; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (= ἀμφεκάλυψε), ν-movable: ’enveloped’
glossary.ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along, through; prep. + acc.: ’up through, throughout’
glossary.ἀντί: ἀντίος — facing, opposite; neut. acc. pl. ἀντία used as adv. + gen., elided (ἀντί’ = ἀντία): ’opposite, facing’
glossary.ἀπήχθετο: ἀπεχθάνομαι (ἀπέχθομαι) — be hateful (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: ’was hateful, became hated’
glossary.ἀπεχθήρω: ἀπεχθαίρω — hate, come to hate; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest I come to hate’
glossary.ἀπόεικε: ἀπείκω (ἀπό + εἴκω) — give way, withdraw from (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’give way, withdraw!’
glossary.ἀργῆτι: ἀργής — bright, gleaming white; masc./neut. dat. sg. (stem ἀργητ-)
glossary.ἀρηϊφίλου: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares; adj. (2 endings), masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀφραδέως: ἀφραδέως — senselessly, thoughtlessly; adv. (ἀ- privative + φράζομαι ’consider’)
glossary.ἁπαλὴν: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁρπάξας: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize, carry off; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having seized’
glossary.ἄγεσθαι: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry off for oneself’
glossary.ἄγχε: ἄγχω — squeeze, throttle, choke; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἦγχε): ’was choking’
glossary.ἄκριτα: ἄκριτος — unsorted, undistinguished, without end; neut. acc. pl.: ’unsorted, endless’
glossary.ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄξεις: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will lead’
glossary.ἄρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead the way; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἦρχε): ’led the way’
glossary.ἄχε: ἄχος — pain, grief, distress; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted and elided (ἄχε’ = ἄχεα; Attic ἄχη): ’griefs’
glossary.ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
glossary.ἐκεύθανον: κεύθω (κευθάνω) — hide, conceal; impf. 3 pl. act. (ἐκεύθανον, = Attic ἔκευθον): ’they hid’
glossary.ἐμίγην: μίγνυμι — mix; aor. pass. 1 sg. (ἐμίγην), + dat.: ’I mingled with, lay with’
glossary.ἐνίκησεν: νικάω — conquer, win; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, ν-movable: ’won’
glossary.ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
glossary.ἐξήρπαξ: ἐξαρπάζω — snatch away; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented and elided (ἐξήρπαξ’ = ἐξήρπαξε): ’snatched away’
glossary.ἐοικὼς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’like’
glossary.ἐπιδινήσας: ἐπιδινέω — whirl round; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having whirled round’
glossary.ἐπικούρων: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπιστρέψας: ἐπιστρέφω — turn round, turn about; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned round’
glossary.ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)
glossary.ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐσαθρήσειεν: εἰσαθρέω (epic ἐσαθρέω) — look at, spy out; aor. opt. 3 sg. act.: ’might catch sight of’
glossary.ἐτίναξε: τινάσσω — shake, brandish, pluck; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’shook, tugged’
glossary.ἐφίλησα: φιλέω — love, be fond of; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented: ’I loved’
glossary.ἐφοίτα: φοιτάω — go to and fro, range about; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’was ranging’
glossary.ἐϊκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐϊκυῖα (= Attic ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
glossary.ἑανοῦ: ἑανός — fine, soft; as noun, a fine robe; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑανῷ: ἑανός — fine, soft; as noun, a fine robe; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἔκδοτε: ἐκδίδωμι — give up, hand over; aor. imper. 2 pl. act.: ’hand over!’
glossary.ἔκπαγλ: ἔκπαγλος — terrifying, violent; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (ἔκπαγλ’ = ἔκπαγλα): ’terribly, exceedingly’
glossary.ἔνιπτε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, scold; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., after μή: ’do not scold’
glossary.ἔπλεον: πλέω — sail; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἔπλεον): ’I sailed, they sailed’
glossary.ἔραμαι: ἔραμαι — love, desire (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.ἔρεθε: ἐρέθω (ἐρεθίζω) — provoke, irritate; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., after μή: ’do not provoke’
glossary.ἔρως: ἔρως — love, desire; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔχθεα: ἔχθος — hatred, enmity; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἔχθη): ’hatreds’
glossary.ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’
glossary.ἕσπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐ-σπ-ετο, root σεπ-), the augment absorbed: ’followed’
glossary.ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’
glossary.ἠπεροπεύειν: ἠπεροπεύω — deceive, cheat; pres. inf. act.: ’to deceive’
glossary.ἤλυθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., epic ἤλυθες (= Attic ἦλθες): ’you came’
glossary.ἤρατο: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (α lengthens to η): ’won’
glossary.ἤσκειν: ἀσκέω — work, fashion, prepare with art; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented, ν-movable: ’was working, worked’
glossary.ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἱμάντα: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — full of longing, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἱμὰς: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱπποδασείης: ἱπποδασύς — horse-haired, thick with horsehair; fem. ἱπποδασεῖα, gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.ἴδοιτο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a conditional clause: ’should see’
glossary.ἴε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἴε (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ἴθ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἴθ’ = ἴθι): ’go! come!’
glossary.ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀΐζυε: ὀϊζύω — suffer, toil, be in distress; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’suffer, toil’
glossary.ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. inf. mid.: ’to perish’
glossary.ὀνείδεσι: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ὀχεὺς: ὀχεύς — that which holds fast, a fastening; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄληαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic ὄλῃ), with κεν: ’you shall perish’
glossary.ὑποστρέψειας: ὑποστρέφω — turn back, return; aor. opt. 2 sg. act., in a wish after μηδ’: ’may you not return’
glossary.ὑψηλῷ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑψόροφον: ὑψόροφος — high-roofed; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὤφελες: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; aor. 2 sg. ὤφελες + inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that you had …’
glossary.ᾔνεον: αἰνέω — praise, approve; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾔνουν); with ἐπί (ἐπαινέω): ’approved’
glossary.ῥῆξεν: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
glossary.ῥῖψ: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; aor. 3 sg. act., elided and unaugmented (ῥῖψ’ = ῥῖψε, Attic ἔρριψε): ’threw’
glossary.αἰνήν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome; fem. acc. sg., with φύλοπιν
glossary.αἰνὴ: αἰνός — dread, fearsome; fem. nom. sg., with φύλοπις
glossary.αἰνὴν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome; fem. acc. sg., with φύλοπιν
glossary.βάλωμεν: βάλλω — throw, put, set; aor. subj. 1 pl., in an indirect question: ’we shall put (friendship)’
glossary.βεβρώθοις: βιβρώσκω — eat, devour; perf. opt. 2 sg. act., epic -θ- form with aorist sense, in a condition after εἰ: ’you were to eat’
glossary.γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’should become’ · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’would that it might come to be’ · also in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might become’
glossary.δαπέδῳ: δάπεδον — floor, level ground; neut. dat. sg., after ἐν
glossary.δειδέχατ: δέχομαι (reduplicated δειδέχ-) — greet, pledge with a cup; 3 pl. mid. past, epic -ατο (= Attic -ντο), elided (δειδέχατ’ = δειδέχατο), + acc.: ’were pledging’
glossary.δεπάεσσι: δέπας — cup, goblet; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δέπασι)
glossary.δηλήσασθαι: δηλέομαι — harm, do injury; aor. inf. mid.: ’to do harm’, epic (Attic βλάψαι)
glossary.διαπέρσαι: διαπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. inf. act., epic: ’to sack’; used also as a command (Attic διαπορθῆσαι)
glossary.διατρίβειν: διατρίβω — delay, put off, wear away; pres. inf. act., standing for a prohibition after μή: ’not to delay’
glossary.δοιαὶ: δοιός — two, twofold; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic δύο)
glossary.δῶκα: δίδωμι — give; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκα)
glossary.εἰσελθοῦσα: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’going in’
glossary.εἰσορόωντες: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze on; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντες)
glossary.εἰσορόωσαι: εἰσοράω — look at, look on; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶσαι)
glossary.εἰῶ: ἐάω — allow, permit; pres. 1 sg., epic form with εἰ- (= Attic ἐῶ), + acc. and inf.: ’I allow (you to)’
glossary.εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
glossary.εὐρέϊ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
glossary.εὐρυάγυια: εὐρυάγυιος — with broad streets (ἀγυιά ’street’); fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with a city’s name
glossary.θανέεσθαι: θνῄσκω — die; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖσθαι): ’to die’
glossary.θεάων: θεά — goddess; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θεῶν), partitive: ’of the goddesses’
glossary.θεῖναι: τίθημι — put, set, make; aor. inf. act., with two accusatives: ’to make (toil) vain’ · also aor. inf. act. with a place-phrase: ’to lay (a robe) upon’
glossary.κέκλημαι: καλέω — call, name; perf. pass. 1 sg.: ’I am called’, with a predicate noun
glossary.καθήμεναι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
glossary.καθήμενοι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
glossary.καμέτην: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= ἐκαμέτην), of a pair of horses: ’grew weary’
glossary.κερτομίοις: κερτόμιος — taunting, cutting, mocking; masc./neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
glossary.κρόνος: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus and Hera; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κῆρας: κήρ — doom, fate of death, death-spirit; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κῆρι: κῆρ — heart; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic καρδίᾳ), in the idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περί an adverb)
glossary.λάχομεν: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, receive as one’s portion; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐλάχομεν)
glossary.λαμπρόν: λαμπρός — bright, shining; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέρας
glossary.λοιβῆς: λοιβή — libation, drink-offering; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο
glossary.μεγαίρω: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge, be unwilling to allow; pres. 1 sg., without an expressed object: ’I do not begrudge (it)’
glossary.μεδέσθην: μέδομαι — plan, devise, contrive; impf. 3 dual mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμήδεσθην), + acc.: ’the two were contriving’
glossary.μεμαυῖαν: μάω (perf. μέμαα) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. acc. sg., present sense: ’eager’ (no Attic equivalent)
glossary.μεμαὼς: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic, present sense (no Attic equivalent): ’eager’
glossary.μενεαίνεις: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on (doing); pres. 2 sg., epic, + inf.: ’you are eager’
glossary.μυκήνη: Μυκήνη — Mycenae, city of Argolis; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μόγῳ: μόγος — toil, hardship; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with toil’
glossary.ναιετάουσι: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι); of cities, ’are inhabited’
glossary.ναύτῃσι: ναύτης — sailor; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ναύταις)
glossary.οἰκέοιτο: οἰκέω — dwell in, inhabit; pres. opt. 3 sg. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic οἰκοῖτο), in a wish: ’may it be inhabited’
glossary.οὐρανῷ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παισίν: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl. (= Attic παισί, with movable ν)
glossary.παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.παραβλήδην: παραβλήδην — sidelong, with a glancing taunt (παραβάλλω ’throw beside’); adv.
glossary.παρμέμβλωκε: παραβλώσκω — go beside, stay close to; perf. 3 sg., elided παρ- (παρμέμβλωκε = παραμέμβλωκε), present sense: ’keeps close’
glossary.πειρᾶν: πειράω — try, test; pres. inf. act., used as a command: ’try!’
glossary.πλησίαι: πλήσιος — near, close; fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’close together’
glossary.πρεσβυτάτην: πρέσβυς — old; superl. πρεσβύτατος ’eldest’; fem. acc. sg., predicative with με
glossary.πόληες: πόλις — city; fem. nom. pl., epic -ηες (= Attic -εις)
glossary.σκυζομένη: σκύζομαι — be sullen, be angry; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’sullen at’
glossary.σπάρτη: Σπάρτη — Sparta, city of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.στρατῷ: στρατός — army, host; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σὴ: σός — your, yours; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with παράκοιτις
glossary.τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): partitive, ’of these’ · also governed by πρόσθ’: ’before these’ · also fem. gen. pl., antecedent of a relative: ’of those’ (τάων ἃς … ’of those which …’)
glossary.τέρπεσθον: τέρπω — delight; mid. take pleasure, enjoy oneself; pres. 3 dual mid.: ’the two take pleasure’
glossary.τίθησι: τίθημι — put, set, establish; pres. 3 sg.: ’sets, puts’
glossary.ταμίης: ταμίας — steward, dispenser; masc. nom. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic ταμίας)
glossary.ταὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they, those two’
glossary.τιέσκετο: τίω — honour, esteem; iterative impf. 3 sg. pass. in -σκε-: ’was honoured’
glossary.τοῖό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ), accented before the enclitic τε: ’his’
glossary.τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’this’
glossary.φίλταταί: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος ’dearest’; fem. nom. pl., predicate, accented before the enclitic εἰσι
glossary.φθονέουσ: φθονέω — begrudge, grudge; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φθονοῦσα), elided: ’begrudging’
glossary.φθονέω: φθονέω — begrudge, grudge; pres. 1 sg., without an expressed object
glossary.φραζώμεθ: φράζομαι — consider, think out, plan; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortative, elided (φραζώμεθ’ = φραζώμεθα): ’let us consider’
glossary.φύλοπιν: φύλοπις — battle-din, battle; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φύλοπις: φύλοπις — battle-din, battle; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χρυσέοις: χρύσεος — golden; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῖς), with δεπάεσσι
glossary.ἀέκοντί: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἄκων), with θυμῷ
glossary.ἀγειρούσῃ: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. part. act. fem. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’as I gathered’
glossary.ἀγκυλομήτης: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Cronus
glossary.ἀγορεύων: ἀγορεύω — speak, address, say; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’speaking’
glossary.ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναίῃ: Ἀθηναίη — Athena, epic full form (= Ἀθήνη); fem. dat. sg. (= Attic Ἀθηνᾷ)
glossary.ἀλαλκομενηῒς: Ἀλαλκομενηΐς — of Alalcomenae (a Boeotian town), epithet of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμύνει: ἀμύνω — ward off, keep away; pres. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’wards off’
glossary.ἀνύω: ἀνύω — accomplish, achieve; pres. 1 sg.: ’I accomplish’
glossary.ἀπέχθωνται: ἀπεχθάνομαι — become hateful, be hated; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., with ὅτ’ ἄν, + dat.: ’become hateful to’
glossary.ἀργείη: Ἀργεῖος — Argive; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -είη (= Attic Ἀργεία)
glossary.ἀρηγόνες: ἀρηγών — helper, helping (ἀρήγω ’help’); masc./fem. nom. pl., + dat.: ’helpers of’
glossary.ἀσπερχὲς: ἀσπερχής — without pause, vehement; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly’
glossary.ἀστερόεντι: ἀστερόεις — starry; masc. dat. sg., with οὐρανῷ
glossary.ἀτέλεστον: ἀτέλεστος — unaccomplished, unfulfilled; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόνον
glossary.ἄγοιτο: ἄγω — lead; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a wish: ’may he lead (home)’
glossary.ἄγριος: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with χόλος
glossary.ἄρξωσι: ἄρχω — begin, make a start; aor. subj. 3 pl., in an indirect question, + inf.: ’might begin (to)’
glossary.ἅλιον: ἅλιος — vain, to no purpose; masc. acc. sg., predicative with πόνον: ’vain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’vain’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ · also neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (ἅλιον βέλος ’a vain shaft’) · also neut. nom. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (οὐχ ἅλιον βέλος ’not a vain shaft’)
glossary.ἐγγεγάασι: ἐγγίγνομαι — be born in, grow up in; perf. 3 pl. (ἐγγεγάασι = Attic ἐγγεγόνασι), epic: ’are born (there)’
glossary.ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
glossary.ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., stressed (non-enclitic): ’to me’
glossary.ἐξακέσαιο: ἐξακέομαι — heal, cure, make good; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’you might heal’
glossary.ἐξεσάωσεν: ἐκσαόω — save, rescue; aor. 3 sg. act., epic (= Attic ἐξέσωσεν): ’rescued’
glossary.ἐοινοχόει: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, serve wine; impf. 3 sg., epic augment ἐο- (= Attic ᾠνοχόει): ’was pouring wine’
glossary.ἐπέμυξαν: ἐπιμύζω — mutter at, murmur at; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’muttered’
glossary.ἐπαινέομεν: ἐπαινέω — approve, agree to; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπαινοῦμεν)
glossary.ἐπειρᾶτο: πειράω — try, attempt; mid. impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’tried (to)’
glossary.ἐπιτεῖλαι: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge; aor. inf. act., used as a command, + dat. and inf.: ’give charge (to)’
glossary.ἐρεθιζέμεν: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, rouse; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν): ’to provoke’
glossary.ἐϊκυῖ: ἔοικα (perf. of εἴκω) — be like, resemble; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. ἐϊκυῖα, elided (= Attic ἐοικυῖα), + dat.: ’like’
glossary.ἐϋμμελίω: ἐϋμμελίης — with good ash-spear; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -ω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐᾶσαι: ἐάω — allow, let; aor. inf. act., used as a command: ’let (me)’
glossary.ἔθορ: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔθορ’ = ἔθορε): ’leapt’
glossary.ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
glossary.ἔρισμα: ἔρισμα — cause of strife, bone of contention; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔχαδε: χανδάνω — hold, contain, have room for; aor. 3 sg. (χαδ-), + acc.: ’held’
glossary.ἕρδ: ἔρδω — do, perform (= Attic ῥέζω, δράω); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἕρδ’ = ἕρδε): ’do!’
glossary.ἕρξον: ἔρδω — do, perform (= Attic ῥέζω, δράω); aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’do!’
glossary.ἕψονται: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’will follow’
glossary.ἠγορόωντο: ἀγοράομαι — hold assembly, speak in assembly; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἠγορῶντο)
glossary.ἤϊξεν: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’darted’
glossary.ἥβη: Ἥβη — Hebe, cupbearer of the gods, daughter of Zeus and Hera; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥρην: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
glossary.ἥσθην: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 dual: ’the two sat’
glossary.ἱδρῶ: ἱδρώς — sweat; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἱδρῶτα)
glossary.ἱρὴ: ἱρός — holy, sacred; fem. nom. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic ἱερά)
glossary.ἴλιος: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἵδρωσα: ἱδρόω — sweat, toil in sweat; aor. 1 sg. act., with ἱδρῶ as cognate object: ’I sweated’
glossary.ἵενται: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. rush, dart; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’fly, dart’
glossary.ἵσταμαι: ἵστημι — set up; mid. stand; pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I stand (before)’
glossary.ὀϊόμενον: ὀΐομαι — expect, suppose; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οἰόμενον): ’supposing’
glossary.ὄρσομεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; fut. (or short-vowel aor. subj.) 1 pl. act., in an indirect question: ’we shall rouse’
glossary.ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
glossary.ὑπερκύδαντας: ὑπερκύδας — exulting, over-proud; masc. acc. pl. (adj. in -ας, -αντος)
glossary.ὑποείξομεν: ὑπείκω — yield, give way; fut. 1 pl. act., epic ὑποείκω, + dat.: ’we shall yield’
glossary.ὠμὸν: ὠμός — raw, uncooked; masc. acc. sg., predicative with Πρίαμον
glossary.ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized, held’
glossary.ῥέζουσιν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; pres. 3 pl., + two accusatives: ’are doing (evils to you)’
glossary.αἰγίδα: αἰγίς — aegis, Zeus’s tasselled storm-shield; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰνὸν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome, grim; neut. nom./acc. sg. (αἰνὸν ἄχος ’fearsome grief’)
glossary.αἰχμητῇ: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to a name
glossary.αἵματι: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg.: ’with blood’, instrumental
glossary.αἷμά: αἷμα — blood; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.βέλεϊ: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic βέλει): ’by a shaft’
glossary.βεβλήκει: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; plpf. act. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβεβλήκει): ’had struck’
glossary.βιός: βιός — bow; masc. nom. sg. (accent distinct from βίος ’life’)
glossary.βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.βλῆσθαι: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. inf. pass., epic root aorist (= Attic βληθῆναι): ’to be struck’
glossary.βόεια: βόειος — of an ox, ox-hide; adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νεῦρα: ’ox-(sinews)’
glossary.γλυφίδας: γλυφίς — notch of an arrow, where the string is set; fem. acc. pl.: ’the notches’
glossary.γυναιξί: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.δαΐφρον: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, prudent (sense disputed; sometimes ’warlike’); adj., masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.δαιδαλέοιο: δαιδάλεος — cunningly wrought, skilfully made; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δεδεγμένος: δέχομαι — receive; await, wait for; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’waiting for’
glossary.δεξιαὶ: δεξιός — right (hand), on the right; fem. nom. pl.: ’right hands’
glossary.διζημένη: δίζημαι — seek, look for; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ζητοῦσα): ’seeking’
glossary.διπλόος: διπλόος — double, of two layers; adj., masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic διπλοῦς)
glossary.δμηθέντα: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — subdue, overpower; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’subdued, laid low’
glossary.εὐρεῖα: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐφυέες: εὐφυής — well-grown, shapely; adj., masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic εὐφυεῖς)
glossary.εὔχεο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὔχου)
glossary.ζελείης: Ζέλεια — Zeleia, a town of the Troad below Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.ζωστῆρι: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ζωστῆρος: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θάνῃς: θνῄσκω — die; aor. subj. 2 sg. (stem θαν-), after αἴ κε: ’if you die’
glossary.θώρηξ: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. nom. sg., epic θώρηξ (= Attic θώραξ)
glossary.κάειρα: Κάειρα — Carian woman, from Caria; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κέρα: κέρας — horn; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic κέρα (beside Attic κέρατα): ’horns’
glossary.καταρρέον: καταρρέω (κατά + ῥέω) — flow down; pres. part. act. neut. acc. sg., agreeing with αἷμα: ’flowing down’
glossary.κατεδύσεθ: καταδύω — go down into, sink down; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (= Attic κατέδυ), elided (κατεδύσεθ’ = κατεδύσετο): ’went down into’ + acc.
glossary.κατεκόσμει: κατακοσμέω — set in order, arrange; impf. 3 sg.: ’was setting in order’
glossary.κειμένου: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with σέο: ’lying’
glossary.κεινῇσιν: κενός — empty; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic κεινός with -ῇσιν (= Attic κεναῖς)
