glossary.κεραοξόος: κεραοξόος — horn-polishing, working horn (κέρας + ξέω); adj., masc. nom. sg., with τέκτων
glossary.κεφαλῇσι: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.κλειτὴν: κλειτός — famous, renowned; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic κλυτήν)
glossary.κλυτοτόξῳ: κλυτότοξος — famed for the bow; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Apollo
glossary.κνῆμαί: κνήμη — shin, lower leg; fem. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.κορώνην: κορώνη — curved tip, the hooked end of a bow; fem. acc. sg. (the same word as ’crow’)
glossary.κοτέων: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + gen. of cause: ’bearing a grudge over’
glossary.κρατεραὶ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κρατερόν: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κυδαλίμοιο: κυδάλιμος — glorious, famous; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κυκλοτερὲς: κυκλοτερής — round, circular; adj., neut. acc. sg., used adverbially: ’into a circle’
glossary.κόσμός: κόσμος — ornament, adornment; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.λέξεται: λέχομαι (root λεχ-, distinct from λέγω ’say, gather’) — lie down to rest; fut. mid. 3 sg., or short-vowel subj. in a general clause: ’will lie down’
glossary.λίγξε: λίγξε — twang, ring sharply (present stem not found in our texts); aor. 3 sg., of a bowstring: ’twanged’
glossary.λίποιμεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 1 pl., potential with κεν: ’we should leave’
glossary.λαοδόκῳ: Λαοδόκος — Laodocus, a son of Antenor; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λειήνας: λειαίνω — make smooth, polish; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having smoothed’
glossary.λελάθοντο: λανθάνομαι (λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., epic reduplicated (= Attic ἐπελάθοντο): ’they forgot’
glossary.λιπὼν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having left’
glossary.λυκηγενέϊ: Λυκηγενής — Lycia-born, epithet of Apollo (sense disputed); masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.μίτρης: μίτρη — belly-guard, metal plate worn below the breastplate; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μελαινέων: μέλας — black, dark; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν), with ὀδυνάων
glossary.μενέλαε: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.μιάνθην: μιαίνω — stain, defile; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θην (= -θησαν): ’were stained’
glossary.μιήνῃ: μιαίνω — stain, dye; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a simile after ὡς ὅτε: ’stains’
glossary.μνήσονται: μιμνῄσκομαι — remember (+ gen.); fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’will remember’
glossary.μῃονὶς: Μῃονίς — Maeonian woman, from Maeonia in Lydia; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νευρὴ: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νευρὴν: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νευρῇ: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. dat. sg., after ἐπί: ’on the string’
glossary.νεῦρα: νεῦρον — sinew, cord made of sinew; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νεῦρόν: νεῦρον — sinew, cord made of sinew; neut. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.νοστήσας: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having returned’
glossary.οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
glossary.πάμπρωτα: πάμπρωτος — first of all; adj., neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’before all others’
glossary.πάνδαρον: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, Lycian archer, son of Lycaon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάτησαν: πατέω — tread, trample; aor. 3 pl. act., with κατά in tmesis: ’trampled down’
glossary.πέλασεν: πελάζω — bring near, drive to (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπέλασεν): ’brought near’
glossary.πέτρῃ: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.πίθοιο: πείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., in a polite request: ’you might obey’
glossary.παρήϊον: παρήϊον — cheek-piece of a horse’s bridle (παρειά ’cheek’); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πεφύκει: φύω — grow, come to be, be by nature; plpf. 3 sg. act. with impf. force: ’had grown, was growing’
glossary.πεῖθεν: πείθω — persuade, win over; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπειθε): ’was persuading’
glossary.πικρὸν: πικρός — bitter, sharp; adj., masc. acc. sg., with ὀϊστόν
glossary.πικρὸς: πικρός — bitter, sharp; adj., masc. nom. sg., with ὀϊστός
glossary.πλεῖστον: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’most, above all’
glossary.πολυδίψιον: πολυδίψιος — very thirsty, parched; adj., neut. acc. sg., with Ἄργος
glossary.προδοκῇσι: προδοκή — ambush, lurking-place; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς): ’in ambush’
glossary.προστήσας: προΐστημι (πρό + ἵστημι) — set forward, put in front; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having set forward’
glossary.πρωτογόνων: πρωτόγονος — first-born, first-yeaned; adj., gen. pl., with ἀρνῶν
glossary.πρώτη: πρῶτος — first; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πυρῆς: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς), after ἐπιβάντ’: ’gone up on the pyre’
glossary.πύσει: πύθω — make rot, cause to decay; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will rot’
glossary.πῶμα: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. acc. sg. (distinct from πόμα ’drink’)
glossary.σάκεα: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic σάκη)
glossary.σίδηρον: σίδηρος — iron; an iron tool or weapon, an arrow-head; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στέρνοιο: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.στίχες: στίξ — rank, line of men; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.στᾶσα: ἵστημι — stand, set; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (root aor. ἔστην): ’having stood, standing’
glossary.σφῇσιν: σφός — their own; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.σχέθον: ἔχω — hold, keep; aor. 3 pl., epic σχέθον (= ἔσχον): ’they held’
glossary.σύλα: συλάω — strip off, take away; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐσύλα): ’took off’
glossary.σύνεχον: συνέχω — hold together; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic συνεῖχον): ’held together’
glossary.τέκτων: τέκτων — craftsman, worker in wood, horn or metal; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τανυσσάμενος: τανύω — stretch, bend (a bow); mid. stretch for oneself; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having stretched’
glossary.ταχὺν: ταχύς — swift, quick; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τεκέεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τέκνοις)
glossary.τελέσει: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (τελέσει’ = τελέσειε), in a wish after αἴθ’: ’might fulfil’
glossary.τελεῖ: τελέω — fulfil, bring about; 3 sg. contracted from τελέει, pres. or fut.; with ἔκ in tmesis: ’fulfils, brings to fulfilment’
glossary.τλαίης: τλῆναι (defective, root τλα-) — endure, dare; aor. opt. 2 sg., with κεν + inf.: ’you would dare (to)’
glossary.τοῖοί: τοῖος — of such sort, such; masc. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.τυχήσας: τυγχάνω — hit (+ gen.), hit upon, meet with; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., aor. in -ησα: ’having hit’
glossary.τόξῳ: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. sg., after πέλασεν: ’to the bow’
glossary.τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’
glossary.τῆσδ: ὅδε — this; demonstrative pron., fem. gen. sg., elided (τῆσδ’ = τῆσδε), with ἀπάτης
glossary.φάτ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (φάτ’ = ἔφατο): ’said’
glossary.φέροιο: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’you would carry off’
glossary.φαρέτρης: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic φαρέτρας)
glossary.φοίνικι: φοῖνιξ — crimson, purple-red (the dye); masc. dat. sg., instrumental
glossary.φορέειν: φορέω — carry, wear; pres. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φορεῖν)
glossary.φωτός: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.χάνοι: χάσκω — gape, yawn open; aor. opt. 3 sg. (stem χαν-), in a wish: ’may (the earth) gape’
glossary.χάριν: χάρις — grace, favour, thanks; fem. acc. sg.: ’thanks’
glossary.χθών: χθών — earth, land, ground; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χροὸς: χρώς — skin, flesh; masc. gen. sg., epic χροός (= Attic χρωτός)
glossary.χρυσέην: χρύσεος — golden; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῆν)
glossary.χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; masc. acc. sg. χρόα
glossary.χρύσειοι: χρύσεος — golden; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic χρυσοῖ)
glossary.ἀβλῆτα: ἀβλής — unshot, not yet hit (ἀ- + βάλλω); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἰόν
glossary.ἀγέρθη: ἀγείρω — gather; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἠγέρθη): ’was gathered’
glossary.ἀγελείη: ἀγελείη — epithet of Athena, traditionally ’driver of spoil’ (ἄγω + λεία); fem. nom. sg., sense not certain
glossary.ἀγκλίνας: ἀνακλίνω — lean, lean against; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with apocope (ἀγκλίνας = ἀνακλίνας): ’having leaned (it)’
glossary.ἀγρίου: ἄγριος — wild, savage; adj., masc./fem. gen. sg. (two-ending), agreeing with αἰγός
glossary.ἀκρότατον: ἀκρότατος — topmost, outermost (superl. of ἄκρος); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα
glossary.ἀκόντων: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀλεγεινῆς: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλεξάνδρῳ: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, another name of Paris; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμύμονά: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent; adj., masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀναΐξειαν: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, leap up; aor. opt. 3 pl., after μή in a fear or purpose clause: ’lest they spring up’
glossary.ἀναπλήσῃς: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fulfil; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after αἴ κε: ’if you fill up’
glossary.ἀντηνορίδῃ: Ἀντηνορίδης — son of Antenor; masc. dat. sg., patronymic, Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.ἀπάτης: ἀπάτη — deceit, trick, treachery; fem. gen. sg., gen. of cause with κοτέων
glossary.ἀπέτισαν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, pay a penalty; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they paid back’
glossary.ἀρήϊοι: ἀρήϊος — warlike (of Ares); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρήϊον: ἀρήϊος — warlike (of Ares); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρηρότι: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. act. masc. dat. sg., with ζωστῆρι: ’fitted, close-fitting’
glossary.ἀσκήσας: ἀσκέω — work skilfully, fashion with art; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having worked with skill’
glossary.ἀσπιστάων: ἀσπιστής — shield-bearer; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀτέλεστα: ἀτέλεστος — unfulfilled, unaccomplished; adj., neut. nom. pl. (οὐκ ἀτέλεστα ’not unfulfilled’, i.e. fulfilled)
glossary.ἀτελευτήτῳ: ἀτελεύτητος — unfinished, unfulfilled; adj., neut. dat. sg., with ἔργῳ
glossary.ἄγ: ἄγε (elided ἄγ’) — come!, come now; interjection, originally 2 sg. imper. of ἄγω ’lead’, used before another imperative
glossary.ἄγαλμα: ἄγαλμα — a thing that delights, ornament, treasure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμυνεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, keep off (+ acc.); impf. or aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἤμυνε, the same form in both tenses): ’warded off’
glossary.ἄροιο: ἄρνυμαι (αἴρομαι) — win, gain; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’you would win’
glossary.ἄφρονι: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄψορρόν: ἄψορρος — backward, back again; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’back again’
glossary.ἐέργῃ: ἔργω (ἐέργω) — keep off, shut out; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a simile after ὡς ὅτε: ’keeps off’
glossary.ἐκβαίνοντα: ἐκβαίνω — step out, come out; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object: ’coming out’
glossary.ἐλέγχιστος: ἐλέγχιστος — most shameful, most disgraceful (superl., from ἐλεγχής); adj., masc. nom. sg., predicative with the subject
glossary.ἐλήλατο: ἐλαύνω — drive, push through; plpf. pass. 3 sg., reduplicated (= Attic ἐλήλατο): ’had been driven’
glossary.ἐλατῆρί: ἐλατήρ — driver (of horses or a chariot); masc. dat. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἐπέγραψε: ἐπιγράφω — scratch the surface of, graze; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’grazed’
glossary.ἐπέθηκε: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, set upon; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist)
glossary.ἐπεστενάχοντο: ἐπιστενάχομαι — groan in addition, groan along with; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’groaned along’
glossary.ἐπιβάντ: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐπιβάντ’ = ἐπιβάντα), root aor. ἐπέβην: ’having gone up on’
glossary.ἐπιθρῴσκων: ἐπιθρῴσκω — leap upon; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’leaping upon’
glossary.ἐπιπροέμεν: ἐπιπροΐημι — send forth at, let fly at (+ dat.); aor. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -εῖναι): ’to send forth’
glossary.ἐπιπτέσθαι: ἐπιπέτομαι — fly at, fly onward; aor. inf. mid. (root aor. πτέσθαι): ’to fly onward’
glossary.ἐπισσείῃσιν: ἐπισείω — shake at, brandish over; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσιν (= Attic -ῃ), with σσ and a future sense: ’shall shake’
glossary.ἐρέει: ἐρέω (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ) — say, tell; fut. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐρεῖ)
glossary.ἐρεμνὴν: ἐρεμνός — dusky (not μέλας ’black’); adj., fem. acc. sg., epic (cf. Attic ἐρεβεννός)
glossary.ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐσύλα: συλάω — strip off, take away; impf. 3 sg.: ’stripped off’
glossary.ἐτέλεσσεν: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἐτέλεσεν): ’fulfilled’
glossary.ἐφόρει: φορέω — carry, wear; impf. 3 sg.: ’was wearing’
glossary.ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
glossary.ἑκκαιδεκάδωρα: ἑκκαιδεκάδωρος — sixteen palms long (δῶρον ’palm’); adj., neut. nom. pl., with κέρα
glossary.ἔεργεν: ἔργω (ἐέργω) — keep off, shut out; impf. 3 sg., epic ἔεργεν: ’kept off’
glossary.ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνέπεσε): ’fell on’
glossary.ἔπεσε: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg. (ἔπεσον); with ἐν in tmesis: ’fell into’
glossary.ἔρρεεν: ῥέω — flow, run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρρει)
glossary.ἔρυμα: ἔρυμα — protection, defence; neut. nom./acc. sg. (ἐρύομαι ’protect’)
glossary.ἔρυτο: ἐρύομαι (ῥύομαι) — protect, ward off; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐρρύετο); an aorist sense (= ἐρρύσατο) is possible
glossary.ἔταμνον: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; impf. 1 sg.: ὅρκια ἔταμνον ’I was cutting (swearing) oaths’
glossary.ἔτεινε: τείνω — stretch, draw tight; aor. 3 sg. (formally the same as the impf.): ’stretched’
glossary.ἕλετ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἕλετ’ = ἕλετο = εἵλετο)
glossary.ἕρμ: ἕρμα — prop, support, that which holds up; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (ἕρμ’ = ἕρμα), in apposition
glossary.ἡδέϊ: ἡδύς — sweet; adj., masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -έϊ (= Attic ἡδεῖ)
glossary.ἤντετο: ἄντομαι (ἀντάω) — meet, encounter (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., epic: ’met’
glossary.ἤραρε: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aor.): ’fitted together’
glossary.ἰκέλη: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὁμοία, ἐοικυῖα)
glossary.ἰξάλου: ἴξαλος — bounding, leaping (of a goat; sense uncertain); adj., masc. gen. sg., with αἰγός
glossary.ἰόν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’)
glossary.ἱκοίμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential with κεν: ’I should come to’
glossary.ἱππῆες: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἴαχεν: ἰάχω — cry out, shout, ring; aor. 3 sg.: ’cried out’
glossary.ἴθυνεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide, direct; aor. 3 sg.: ’guided’
glossary.ὀΐστευσον: ὀϊστεύω — shoot an arrow (at, + gen.); aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’shoot at’
glossary.ὀδυνάων: ὀδύνη — pain, ache, anguish; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὀλώλῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; perf. subj. 3 sg. (ὄλωλα), after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’shall have perished’
glossary.ὀξυβελὴς: ὀξυβελής — sharp-pointed; adj., masc. nom. sg., with ὀϊστός
glossary.ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
glossary.ὀχῆες: ὀχεύς — clasp, fastening, bar; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ὄγκους: ὄγκος — barb (of an arrow); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὅρκι: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅρκι’ = ὅρκια): ’oaths’
glossary.ὅρκιον: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, agreeing with a noun: ’over-bold’
glossary.ὑψίζυγος: ὑψίζυγος — sitting on high (ὑψι- + ζυγόν, bench); adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠτειλῆς: ὠτειλή — wound; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ῆς)
glossary.ῥέξειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; fut. inf. act., in a vow after εὔχεο or εὔχετο: ’(vow) to sacrifice’
glossary.αἷμ: αἷμα — blood; neut. acc. sg., elided (αἷμ’ = αἷμα)
glossary.βλήμενος: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. mid. in form with passive sense, masc. nom. sg., epic syncopated (= Attic βληθείς): ’struck’
glossary.βρίζοντα: βρίζω — nod off, be drowsy, sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βὰν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.γερούσιον: γερούσιος — of the elders (γέρων), of the council; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δαΐφρονα: δαΐφρων — wise-minded or war-minded (root disputed: δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. acc. sg., standing epithet
glossary.δαίθ: δαίς — feast, meal; dat. sg., elided (δαίθ’ = δαιτί), τ>θ before a rough breathing
glossary.δαιτρὸν: δαιτρόν — portion, allotted share (δαίομαι ’divide’); neut. acc. sg. used as a noun
glossary.δειδίσσεο: δειδίσσομαι — frighten, scare; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic -εο and -σσ- (= Attic δειδίττου)
glossary.δηλήσαντο: δηλέομαι — harm, injure, wrong; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐδηλήσαντο)
glossary.εἰρύατ: ἐρύω — draw, haul; perf. 3 pl. mid./pass., epic -αται (Attic -νται), elided (εἰρύατ’ = εἰρύαται): ’are drawn up’
glossary.εἰρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — protect, guard, rescue; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic εἰρύσατο (= Attic ἐρύσατο)
glossary.εἴκελος: εἴκελος (ἴκελος) — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐοικώς)
glossary.εὐρυμέδων: Εὐρυμέδων — Eurymedon, Agamemnon’s attendant (εὐρύς ’wide’ + μέδων ’ruler’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔπρυμνοι: εὔπρυμνος — with fine sterns, well-sterned; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
glossary.εὔχεαι: εὔχομαι — claim, profess, boast; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὔχῃ)
glossary.ζωστήρ: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ζωστῆρα: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ζῶμά: ζῶμα — waistcloth, loincloth worn under the belt; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented ζῶμά before the enclitic τε
glossary.θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg. (= Attic θάρρει) · also θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic θάρσει), dat. of cause: ’in your boldness’
glossary.θέουσαι: θέω — run; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.θαρσύνεσκε: θαρσύνω — encourage, cheer on; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), unaugmented: ’used to cheer’
glossary.θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θινὶ: θίς (θίν-) — shore, beach, strand; dat. sg.
glossary.θούριδος: θοῦρις — impetuous, rushing, furious; adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κάλεσσον: καλέω — call, summon; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic κάλεσον)
glossary.κάματος: κάματος — weariness, toil, fatigue; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάμον: κάμνω — toil, labour, make with toil; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), unaugmented (= ἔκαμον)
glossary.κέρωνται: κεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); pres. subj. 3 pl. mid., contracted from epic κεράωνται (Attic subj. κεραννύωνται)
glossary.καιρίῳ: καίριος — vital, deadly (of a spot on the body); dat. sg., masc./neut.: ἐν καιρίῳ ’in a vital spot’
glossary.καλέει: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλεῖ)
glossary.κατένευσα: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise; aor. 1 sg., augmented
glossary.καταπτώσσοντ: καταπτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (καταπτώσσοντ’ = καταπτώσσοντα)
glossary.κοιρανέοντα: κοιρανέω — rule, be lord, command; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανοῦντα)
glossary.κυκλόσ: κυκλόσε — in a ring, in a circle, all around (κύκλος + -σε); adv., elided (κυκλόσ’ = κυκλόσε)
glossary.λάβῃ: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg. act.
glossary.λῦσε: λύω — loose, undo; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλυσε)
glossary.μάχεσθε: μάχομαι (epic μαχέομαι) — fight; pres. 2 pl. (indic.; the imper. has the same form)
glossary.μένετε: μένω — wait, wait for, remain; pres. 2 pl. (indic.; the imper. has the same form)
glossary.μέσσοισι: μέσος — middle, mid; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι with double σ (= Attic μέσοις); ἐν μέσσοισι ’in the midst’
glossary.μίτρη: μίτρη — belt-guard, metal waist-band worn under the belt; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μίτρην: μίτρη — belt-guard, metal waist-band worn under the belt; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχάονα: Μαχάων — Machaon, the healer, son of Asclepius; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχώμεθ: μάχομαι (epic μαχέομαι) — fight; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., elided (μαχώμεθ’ = μαχώμεθα)
glossary.μεθίετε: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, give up (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.μεθιέντας: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, give up (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μειλιχίοισιν: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μελαινάων: μέλας — black, dark; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic μελαινῶν)
glossary.μνήσαντο: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, think of (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμνήσαντο)
glossary.νήεσσιν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσιν (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νεβροί: νεβρός — fawn, young deer; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.νόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησεν)
glossary.οὐλαμὸν: οὐλαμός — crowd, throng (of men); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάγη: πήγνυμι — fix, make fast; aor. 2 pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπάγη): ’was fixed, stuck’
glossary.πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. · also + gen.: ’in front of’
glossary.πάσσε: πάσσω — sprinkle; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπασσε): ’sprinkled’
glossary.πίνωσιν: πίνω — drink; pres. subj. 3 pl., after εἴ περ without ἄν/κε (epic)
glossary.παναίολον: παναίολος — all-glancing, all-gleaming (πᾶν + αἰόλος ’flashing, quick’); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.παναίολος: παναίολος — all-glancing, all-gleaming (πᾶν + αἰόλος ’flashing, quick’); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παπταίνων: παπταίνω — look about, peer around; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρισχέμεν: παρίσχω (= παρέχω) — hold ready, furnish; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic παρέχειν)
glossary.παύσῃσι: παύω — stop, make cease; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic παύσῃ)
glossary.πεζὸς: πεζός — on foot; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πειραΐδαο: Πειραΐδης — son of Peiraeus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πιέειν: πίνω — drink; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic πιεῖν)
glossary.πολέος: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πολλοῦ)
glossary.προμάχοις: πρόμαχος — front fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.πτολέμῳ: πτόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic πολέμῳ)
glossary.πτολεμαίου: Πτολεμαῖος — Ptolemaeus (father of Eurymedon); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πυμάτας: πύματος — last, hindmost, rearmost; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σέβεσθε: σέβομαι — feel awe or shame before, revere; pres. 2 pl. mid. (indic.; the imper. has the same form)
glossary.σπεύδοντα: σπεύδω — hasten, press on; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σπεύδοντας: σπεύδω — hasten, press on; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.στυγεροῦ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.συῒ: σῦς — boar, pig (Attic ὗς); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τέρενα: τέρην, τέρεινα, τέρεν — tender, soft; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl. (same form)
glossary.τίφθ: τίπτε (τί ποτε) — why, what then?; interrog. adv., elided τίπτ’, and τίφθ’ before a rough breathing
glossary.τίω: τίω — honour, value, hold in esteem; pres. 1 sg. (= Attic τιμῶ)
glossary.ταλθύβι: Ταλθύβιος — Talthybius, Agamemnon’s herald; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ταλθύβι’ = Ταλθύβιε)
glossary.ταχυπώλων: ταχύπωλος — with swift colts, with swift horses (ταχύς + πῶλος); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.τεθηπότες: τέθηπα — be astonished, amazed, stunned; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., with present sense (no present in use)
glossary.τινας: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. acc. pl.: ’some, certain’ · also after a relative: οὕς τινας ’whichever’
glossary.τρίκης: Τρίκη — Tricca, a town of Thessaly; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φάρμακα: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or harmful); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.φάρμαχ: φάρμακον — drug, potion; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (φάρμαχ’ = φάρμακα), κ>χ before a rough breathing
glossary.φίλας: φίλος — dear, own; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φυσιόωντας: φυσιάω — snort, blow hard (of horses); pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic φυσιῶντας)
glossary.φῶτ: φώς — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (φῶτ’ = φῶτα)
glossary.χάρμης: χάρμη — joy of battle, eagerness to fight; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.χαλκῆες: χαλκεύς — smith, bronze-worker; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic χαλκεῖς)
glossary.χείρων: Χείρων — Chiron, the wise centaur, healer and teacher; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χολωτοῖσιν: χολωτός — angry, wrathful; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ψευδέσσι: ψευδής — false, lying; masc. dat. pl. used as a noun, ’liars’, epic -εσσι (= Attic ψευδέσι)
glossary.ἀγηγέραθ: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; plpf. 3 pl. mid./pass., epic -ατο (Attic -ντο), elided (ἀγηγέραθ’ = ἀγηγέρατο), τ>θ before a rough breathing: ’were gathered’
glossary.ἀγὸς: ἀγός — leader, commander; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, might, valour; fem. acc. sg., also of respect: ’in might’
glossary.ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλλοίῳ: ἀλλοῖος — of another kind, different, other; dat. sg., masc./neut.
glossary.ἀλόχους: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμφεπένοντο: ἀμφιπένομαι — busy oneself about, attend to; impf. mid. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνώγοι: ἄνωγα — bid, command, urge; perf. with present sense, opt. 3 sg., epic
glossary.ἀπάνευθ: ἀπάνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv., elided (ἀπάνευθ’ = ἀπάνευθε)
glossary.ἀρηρότος: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fasten; perf. part. masc. gen. sg. (ἀρηρώς), with present sense: ’close-fitting’
glossary.ἀρωγός: ἀρωγός — helper, ally; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσκληπιάδη: Ἀσκληπιάδης — son of Asclepius (patronymic); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἄξομεν: ἄγω — lead, carry off; fut. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐκμυζήσας: ἐκμυζάω — suck out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλεγχέες: ἐλεγχής — shameful, disgraced, base (ἔλεγχος ’disgrace’); masc. nom./voc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐλεγχεῖς)
glossary.ἐλθέμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. inf., epic ἐλθέμεν (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come’
glossary.ἐξελκομένοιο: ἐξέλκω — drag out, pull out; pres. pass. part. masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
glossary.ἐπεπωλεῖτο: ἐπιπωλέομαι — go over, range along, review; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented and contracted
glossary.ἐπιθήσει: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, apply; fut. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐπιθαρσύνων: ἐπιθαρσύνω — cheer on, encourage (θάρσος ’courage’); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιμάσσεται: ἐπιμαίομαι — touch, feel over, handle; fut. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπιμάσεται)
glossary.ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj.
glossary.ἐρίηρος: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (ἐρι- intensive; the rest of the word is of disputed sense); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑστᾶσ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. 3 pl., elided (ἑστᾶσ’ = ἑστᾶσι, for ἑστάασι; Attic ἑστήκασι): ’they stand’
glossary.ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔασε: ἐάω — let be, leave alone, allow; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴασε)
glossary.ἔδονται: ἐσθίω — eat; fut. 3 pl., mid. in form (epic future)
glossary.ἔδυν: δύω — enter, put on (armour); aor. 3 pl., intransitive, epic (= Attic ἔδυσαν)
glossary.ἔκαμον: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.); with a participle, ’tire of doing’
glossary.ἔσσετ: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἔσσεται (= Attic ἔσται), elided (ἔσσετ’): ’will be’
glossary.ἔσσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσομαι): ’I shall be’
glossary.ἔστητε: ἵστημι — set; intrans. aor. stand; aor. 2 pl.: ’you stood’
glossary.ἕλκεν: ἕλκω — draw, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic εἷλκε): ’drew’
glossary.ἕλκος: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἕστηχ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. 3 sg., elided (ἕστηχ’ = ἕστηκε), κ>χ before a rough breathing: ’stands’
glossary.ἤπια: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly, soothing; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἰδομενεῦ: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἰητὴρ: ἰητήρ — healer, physician; masc. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἰατρός)
glossary.ἰητῆρος: ἰητήρ — healer, physician; masc. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἰατροῦ)
glossary.ἰόμωροι: ἰόμωρος — abusive epithet of disputed sense, perhaps ’arrow-dull’ (ἰός ’arrow’ + μῶρος ’dull’); masc. voc./nom. pl.
glossary.ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
glossary.ἴδητ: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 2 pl. act., elided (ἴδητ’ = ἴδητε), after ὄφρα: ’you may see’
glossary.ἴδοις: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with ἂν/κε: ’you would see’
glossary.ἴδῃς: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after ὄφρα, ἵνα: ’you may see’
glossary.ὀξέες: ὀξύς — sharp; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀξεῖς)
glossary.ὀϊστεύσας: ὀϊστεύω — shoot an arrow; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄγκοι: ὄγκος — barb (of an arrow); in general, bulk, mass; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄρσ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., elided (ὄρσ’ = ὄρσο): ’rise up’
glossary.ὄρσευ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ὄρσευ (= ὄρσεο): ’rouse yourself’
glossary.ὑπέρσχῃ: ὑπερέχω — hold over, hold above (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κε: ’may hold over’ (as protection)
glossary.ὑπέστην: ὑφίστημι — place under; mid. and intrans. aor. undertake, promise; aor. 1 sg. (aor. 2 of ὑφίστημι): ’I undertook’
glossary.ὔμμιν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic dat. pl. ὔμμιν (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to you’
glossary.αἰάντεσσι: Αἴας — Ajax (the two heroes of that name, together ’the Ajaxes’); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Αἴασι)
glossary.αἰχμάσσουσι: αἰχμάζω — wield the spear, fight with the spear (αἰχμή); fut. 3 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic αἰχμάσουσι): ’will wield’
glossary.αἰχμὰς: αἰχμή — spear, spear-point; fem. acc. pl.: ’spears’
glossary.αἴαντ: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. voc. dual, elided (Αἴαντ’ = Αἴαντε): ’you two Ajaxes’
glossary.αἵμονά: Αἵμων — Haemon, a Pylian companion of Nestor; masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.βάζεις: βάζω — speak, chatter, talk; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.βίαντά: Βίας — Bias, a Pylian captain; masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.βίηφιν: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι(ν) (= dat. βίῃ): ’by force, in might’
glossary.γέρουσιν: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. dat. pl. (= γέρουσι): ’for the elders’
glossary.γεγάασι: γίγνομαι — be born, be; perf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic γεγόνασι): ’are born, are’
glossary.γηθόσυνος: γηθόσυνος — glad, joyful; masc. nom. sg., from γηθέω ’rejoice’
glossary.γνῶ: γιγνώσκω — recognise, perceive, know; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔγνω): ’recognised, perceived’
glossary.γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα)
glossary.δήνεα: δῆνος — plan, wile, counsel (used only in the plural, epic and poetic); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δήϊον: δήϊος — hostile, destructive (of war or a foe); masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δήιος)
glossary.δόλοισι: δόλος — trick, stratagem, cunning device; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.εἰδώς: οἶδα — know, know how; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen. ’versed in’: ’knowing’
glossary.εἴθ: εἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (εἴθ’ = εἴθε)
glossary.εἴρηται: ἐρῶ (aor. εἶπον) — say, speak; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been said’
glossary.ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεῖεν: τίθημι — put, make; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., of wish: ’may they make’
glossary.κίνυντο: κίνυμαι — move, stir; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -υντο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκινοῦντο): ’moved, stirred’
glossary.κακοὺς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. acc. pl., used as a noun: ’the base, cowards’
glossary.κακοῖσι: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’evil’
glossary.κατέκταν: κατακτείνω — kill; aor. 1 sg. (also 3 pl.), epic root aorist (= Attic κατέκτεινα/κατέκτανον): ’I killed’
glossary.καταπτώσσοντες: καταπτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.καυστείρης: καυστειρός — burning, fiery (of battle); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κεκασμένε: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass (+ dat.); perf. part. mid. masc. voc. sg.: ’excelling’
glossary.κελεύω: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.κεφαλλήνων: Κεφαλλῆνες — the Cephallenians, Odysseus’ island people; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κλονέεσθαι: κλονέω — drive in confusion, throw into disorder; pres. inf. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic κλονεῖσθαι): ’be thrown into confusion’
glossary.κορυσσέσθην: κορύσσω — arm, equip with a helmet; impf. 3 dual mid., unaugmented, epic -σσ-: ’were arming themselves’
glossary.κουροτέροισι: κουρότερος — younger (comparative of κοῦρος ’youth’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κοῦρος: κοῦρος — boy, young man; masc. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic κόρος)
glossary.κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’pieces of meat’
glossary.κρείοντα: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. acc. sg., epithet of kings
glossary.κυάνεαι: κυάνεος — dark, dark-blue; fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυαναῖ)
glossary.λάζετο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize, take; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλάζετο)
glossary.λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
glossary.λαίλαπα: λαῖλαψ — squall, storm-blast; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λιγὺν: λιγύς — clear-voiced, shrill; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
glossary.μήστωρες: μήστωρ — deviser, master, adviser (μήδομαι ’plan’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μαχοίατο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 pl., epic -οίατο (= Attic μάχοιντο), in a condition after εἰ: ’(if) they were fighting’
glossary.μεθιέμεν: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, be slack; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic μεθιέναι)
glossary.μελάντερον: μέλας — black, dark; comparative μελάντερος, neut. nom. sg.: ’blacker’
glossary.μελιηδέος: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελιηδοῦς)
glossary.μεμάτω: μέμονα (perf., present sense) — be eager, strive; perf. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him be eager’
glossary.μεμήλῃ: μέλω — be a care to, concern (+ dat.); perf. subj. 3 sg. (perf. μέμηλα), after αἴ κεν: ’should concern’
glossary.μενεσθῆα: Μενεσθεύς — Menestheus, leader of the Athenians; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.μετέσσομαι: μέτειμι — be among (+ dat.); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic μετέσσομαι (stem ἐσσ-, = Attic μετέσομαι)
glossary.μεταμώνια: μεταμώνιος — wasted, vain, gone to the winds; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.μετεῖναι: μέτειμι — be among, be present among (+ dat.); pres. inf. (μετ-εῖναι)
glossary.μιγέντα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. (= μιγείς), + dat.: ’having mingled among’
glossary.μύθοισι: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’flocks’
glossary.νέστορ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. acc. sg., elided (Νέστορ’ = Νέστορα) · also masc. voc. sg.
glossary.νέφος: νέφος — cloud; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀνακλῖναι and ἐπιθεῖναι: ’cloud’
glossary.νεικείω: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile, rebuke; pres. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικῶ)
glossary.νεώτεροι: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’younger’
glossary.νόον: νόος — mind, understanding; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦν)
glossary.πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
glossary.παρῴχετο: παροίχομαι — go past, pass by; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’passed on’
glossary.πεζοὺς: πεζός — on foot; used as a noun: ’foot-soldiers’; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πεζῶν: πεζός — on foot; used as a noun: ’foot-soldiers’; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.πελάγοντα: Πελάγων — Pelagon, a Pylian captain; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πεποίθασίν: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα: trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. 3 pl. act. (= πεποίθασι), accent shifted before the enclitic τε: ’they trust’
glossary.περιώσιον: περιώσιος — beyond measure, excessive; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’exceedingly, unduly’
glossary.πεφρικυῖαι: φρίσσω — bristle, shudder; perf. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’bristling’
glossary.πινέμεναι: πίνω — drink; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic πίνειν): ’to drink’
glossary.πλήξιππον: πληξίππος — horse-lashing, driving horses with the whip; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menestheus · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of Orestes
glossary.πολέμων: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.πολεμίζοι: πολεμίζω — fight, make war; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’might fight’
glossary.πολλήν: πολύς — much, many, great; fem. acc. sg.: ’much, great’
glossary.ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. nom./acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a ...’
glossary.πρώτοισιν: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πρώτω: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. dual, predicate: ’the first (two)’
glossary.πυκιναὶ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πόλεας: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl., epic -εας (= Attic πόλεις)
glossary.πύργοι: πύργος — tower, bastion (of men); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πύργος: πύργος — tower, bastion (of men), city wall; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σάκεσίν: σάκος — shield; neut. dat. pl. (= σάκεσι), accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.σκοπιῆς: σκοπιή — watch-post, lookout point, height; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
glossary.στέλλοντα: στέλλω — set in order, marshal, send; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’marshalling’
glossary.στῆσεν: ἵστημι — set, make stand; aor. 3 sg., transitive, unaugmented (= ἔστησε): ’set, posted’
glossary.συνορινόμεναι: συνορίνω — stir up together; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.: ’stirring together’
glossary.σφοὺς: σφός — his own, their own (possessive); masc. acc. pl., referring to the subject: ’his own’
glossary.τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
glossary.τείρει: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.τείχε: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. pl., elided and uncontracted (τείχε’ = τείχεα, Attic τείχη)
glossary.τοῖαι: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. pl.: ’such’
glossary.τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
glossary.φέρτερον: φέρτερος — better, stronger (comparative); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’better’
glossary.φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (φίλ’ = φίλα) · also masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε): ’dear’
glossary.φίλοισιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις); also as a noun: ’friends’
glossary.φίλως: φίλως — in a friendly way, gladly; adv. (from φίλος)
glossary.φρονέεις: φρονέω — think, have in mind, intend; pres. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονεῖς)
glossary.φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
glossary.φῂς: φημί — say, speak; pres. 2 sg. (= φῄς)
glossary.χρομίον: Χρόμιος — Chromius, a Pylian captain; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγορητὴν: ἀγορητής — speaker, orator; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναῖοι: Ἀθηναῖος — Athenian; masc. nom. pl.: ’the Athenians’
glossary.ἀκουάζεσθον: ἀκουάζομαι — hear, listen to (+ gen.); pres. 2 dual mid. dep.: ’you two hear’
glossary.ἀκούετο: ἀκούω — hear; impf. 3 sg. mid. (= Attic ἤκουε), + gen. of what is heard: ’was hearing’
glossary.ἀλάστορά: Ἀλάστωρ — Alastor, a Pylian companion of Nestor; masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀλαπαδναὶ: ἀλαπαδνός — weak, feeble; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀλαπαδνότεροι: ἀλαπαδνός — weak, feeble; comparative ἀλαπαδνότερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’feebler’
glossary.ἀναγκαίῃ: ἀναγκαίη — necessity, compulsion (= ἀνάγκη); fem. dat. sg.: ’by compulsion, under constraint’
glossary.ἀναχωρείτω: ἀναχωρέω — withdraw, step back; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him step back’
glossary.ἀνεμώλια: ἀνεμώλιος — windy, idle, vain (of words); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀντιβολῆσαι: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ gen.); aor. inf. act.: ’to meet’
glossary.ἀνώγετον: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — bid, command; 2 dual, ’you two bid’
glossary.ἀρεσσόμεθ: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends, put right; fut. 1 pl. mid., epic -σσ-, elided (ἀρεσσόμεθ’ = ἀρεσσόμεθα): ’we shall put right’
glossary.ἀφέστατε: ἀφίστημι — stand away, hold aloof; perf. 2 pl. intrans., present sense, epic (= Attic ἀφεστήκατε): ’you stand aloof’
glossary.ἄρξειαν: ἄρχω — begin, rule (+ gen.); aor. opt. 3 pl., Aeolic -ειαν, in a clause after ὁππότε: ’(when) they should begin’
glossary.ἅρμαθ: ἅρμα — chariot; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ἅρμαθ’ = ἅρματα)
glossary.ἐθέλητον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 2 dual, after ὄφρα: ’you two wish’ · also pres. subj. 3 dual, after μή: ’lest they two be willing’
glossary.ἐθέλοιμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 sg. (hypothetical wish)
glossary.ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’willing’
glossary.ἐξόπιθε: ἐξόπιθε(ν) — behind, in the rear; adv.
glossary.ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon, advance against; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’advancing’
glossary.ἐπετέλλετο: ἐπιτέλλομαι — charge, give orders to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’gave his charge’
glossary.ἐπιμειδήσας: ἐπιμειδάω — smile at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’smiling’
glossary.ἐπόρθεον: πορθέω — sack, ravage; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπόρθουν)
glossary.ἐρευθαλίωνα: Ἐρευθαλίων — Ereuthalion, an Arcadian champion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλοὺς: ἐσθλός — good, brave; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐφοπλίζωμεν: ἐφοπλίζω — make ready, prepare; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., after ὁππότε: ’we prepare’
glossary.ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep in check; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν): ’to hold’
glossary.ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
glossary.ἑστάμεν: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. perf. stand; perf. inf. act., epic (= Attic ἑστάναι): ’to stand’
glossary.ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
glossary.ἔγχεσι: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl. (epic also ἔγχεσσι)
glossary.ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
glossary.ἔλασσεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἤλασε)
glossary.ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
glossary.ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἔοικ: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting; perf. 3 sg. with present sense, elided (ἔοικ’ = ἔοικε), impersonal: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἔσεσθε: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 pl. (mid. in form): ’you will be’
glossary.ἔτετμε: τέτμον (defective) — come upon, overtake; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came upon, found’
glossary.ἕτερ: ἕτερος — other; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἕτερ’ = ἕτερα): ’other (chariots)’
glossary.ἠνορέηφι: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage; instrumental case in -φι (= dat. ἠνορέῃ): ’in manliness’
glossary.ἡγήτορε: ἡγήτωρ — leader, commander; masc. voc. dual: ’you two leaders’
glossary.ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
glossary.ἰωῆς: ἰωή — blast, cry (of the wind); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱππεῦσι: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. dat. pl. (= ἱππεῦσιν)
glossary.ἱππεῦσιν: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable (= ἱππεῦσι)
glossary.ἱπποδάμοισιν: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἱπποσύνῃ: ἱπποσύνη — horsemanship, skill with horses; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἱππῆας: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic ἱππέας)
glossary.ὀπάζει: ὀπάζω — make follow, bestow, grant, attach as an attendant; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀρεξάσθω: ὀρέγω — reach out, stretch; mid. reach for, thrust; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him thrust’
glossary.ὀτρυνέμεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send forth; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ὀτρύνειν)
glossary.ὀτρύνοντα: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’urging on’
glossary.ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὁμοίϊον: ὁμοίϊος — alike, common to all, the same for all (sense not certain); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γῆρας; related to ὅμοιος · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νεῖκος: ’the same for all’
glossary.ὁρμήσειε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, stir up (trans.); rush, charge (intrans.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after ὁππότε: ’(when) he should rush’
glossary.ὁρόῳτε: ὁράω — see, look on; pres. opt. 2 pl., epic ὁρόῳτε (= Attic ὁρῷτε), potential with κε: ’you would look on’
glossary.ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
glossary.ὄφελέν: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; ὄφελεν (aor. 3 sg., unaugmented) + inf. marks an unfulfilled wish: ’would that’; accent shifted before the enclitic τις
glossary.ὄχεσφι: ὄχος — chariot, car; neut. instrumental case in -φι (= dat. pl. ὄχεσι): ’with chariots’ · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the chariot’ (παρ’ ὄχεσφι)
glossary.ὄψεαι: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὄψει)
glossary.ὑμείων: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; gen. pl., epic ὑμείων (= Attic ὑμῶν): ’of you’
glossary.ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive, not the possessive
glossary.ῥίγησέν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable, accent shifted before the enclitic τε: ’shuddered’
glossary.αἰδεσθεὶς: αἰδέομαι — respect, feel shame before; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg. (deponent), + acc.: ’respecting’
glossary.αἰδοίοιο: αἰδοῖος — revered, worthy of respect; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰτώλιος: Αἰτώλιος — Aetolian, of Aetolia; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἱμονίδης: Αἱμονίδης — son of Haemon; patronymic, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐδήν: αὐδή — voice, human speech; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αὐλῇ: αὐλή — courtyard, farmyard; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αὐτοφόνοιο: Αὐτοφόνος — Autophonus, father of Polyphontes; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.βαίνει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.βαθύσχοινον: βαθύσχοινος — deep in rushes, rush-grown (βαθύς + σχοῖνος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γένετο: γίγνομαι — become, be born, arise; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγένετο)
glossary.γεφύρας: γέφυρα — bridge; fem. acc. pl.; πολέμοιο γέφυραι is the open ground between armies (sense debated)
glossary.γῆρυς: γῆρυς — voice, speech; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δαινυμένους: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι, feast, banquet; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’feasting’
glossary.δεῖμός: Δεῖμος — Dread, Fear personified (cf. δεῖμος ’fear’); masc. nom. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.δηΐοισι: δήϊος — hostile; as noun, enemy; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the enemy’
glossary.διομήδεα: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.δοῦπον: δοῦπος — thud, booming sound; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic δοῦναι)
glossary.δῃωθέντων: δηϊόω (δῃόω) — cut down, slay; aor. pass. part. masc. gen. pl., in a genitive absolute: ’having been cut down’
glossary.δῃώσωσιν: δηϊόω (δῃόω) — cut down, slay; aor. subj. 3 pl., ν-movable, after εἴ κεν
glossary.εἰσῆλθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.εἱμένοι: ἕννυμι — clothe; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. pl., + acc.: ’clothed in’
glossary.εἵλομεν: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. 1 pl.: ’we took’
glossary.εἷλεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= εἷλε): ’seized’ · also ’killed’, of a warrior who takes a man’s life (Κοίρανον εἷλεν ’killed Coeranus’)
glossary.εἷο: ἕ, οὗ — him, himself; 3rd-person pron. gen. sg., epic εἷο (= Attic οὗ); after a comparative: ’than himself’
glossary.εἷσαν: ἵζω — make sit, set, place; aor. 3 pl., causative: ’set’ (λόχον εἷσαν ’set an ambush’)
glossary.εὐχωλὴ: εὐχωλή — boast, vaunt (also prayer, vow); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐχόμεθ: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, claim, boast; pres. 1 pl., elided (εὐχόμεθ’ = εὐχόμεθα)
glossary.ζεφύρου: Ζέφυρος — Zephyrus, the West Wind; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
glossary.θρόος: θρόος — noise, murmur of voices; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κέντορες: κέντωρ — goader, driver (from κεντέω ’prick’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.καδμεΐωνας: Καδμεΐων — Cadmean, a man of Cadmus’ Thebes; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.καδμείοισιν: Καδμεῖος — Cadmean, Theban; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), as noun
glossary.καδμεῖοι: Καδμεῖος — Cadmean, Theban; masc. nom. pl., as noun: ’the Cadmeans’
glossary.καπανήϊος: Καπανήϊος — of Capaneus; adj. from Καπανεύς, masc. nom. sg.: ’son of Capaneus’ when with υἱός
glossary.κινήσαντος: κινέω — set in motion, stir; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute with Ζεφύρου
glossary.κιχήσατο: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented
glossary.κλειτοὺς: κλειτός — famous, renowned (= κλυτός); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κολλητοῖσι: κολλητός — well-joined, fitted together; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.κορυφοῦται: κορυφόομαι — rise to a peak, crest; pres. 3 sg. mid., of a wave
glossary.κορύσσεται: κορύσσω — arm with a helmet; mid. arm oneself, rear up; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-
glossary.κούρους: κοῦρος — youth, young man; masc. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic κόρους)
glossary.κρουνῶν: κρουνός — spring, fountain; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κυρτὸν: κυρτός — curved, arched; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῦμα
glossary.λίσσοντο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; impf. 3 pl. mid. deponent: ’begged’
glossary.λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μέμικτο: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg., epic: ’was mixed’
glossary.μένε: μένος — might, vigour, strength; neut. acc. pl. μένεα, elided μένε’ before a vowel
glossary.μαίον: Μαίων — Maeon, a Theban captain; masc. acc. sg., elided (Μαίον’ = Μαίονα)
glossary.μαίων: Μαίων — Maeon, a Theban captain, son of Haemon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγάλα: μέγας — great, big; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with a verb of sound: ’loudly’
glossary.μεγάλων: μέγας — big, great; gen. pl. (all genders)
glossary.μεδώμεθα: μέδομαι — think of, take thought of, be mindful of (+ gen.); pres. subj. 1 pl.
glossary.μεμακυῖαι: μηκάομαι — bleat; perf. part. fem. nom. pl., epic μεμακυῖαι (masc. μεμηκώς): ’bleating’
glossary.μεμαυῖα: μέμονα (perf. of μάω) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. μεμαώς), ’eager’
glossary.μισγάγκειαν: μισγάγκεια — meeting-place of glens, where valleys join; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μισγομένων: μίσγω — mix, mingle; pres. part. mid./pass. gen. pl.: ’mingling’
glossary.μυρίαι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.νεμεσῶ: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation at, blame; pres. 1 sg., + dat.
glossary.νωλεμέως: νωλεμέως — without a break, relentlessly, unyieldingly; adv.
glossary.νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom., epic νῶϊ (= Attic νώ): ’we two’ · also dual acc.: ’us two’
glossary.ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
glossary.ξεῖνός: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ξυνιόντες: σύνειμι (εἶμι) — come together, meet; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic ξυν- (= Attic συνιόντες)
glossary.οἰμωγή: οἰμωγή — wailing, lamentation; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.οὔρεσιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic οὖρος, οὔρεσιν (= Attic ὄρεσιν)
glossary.πέλεν: πέλω — be, become; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was’
glossary.παραίσια: παραίσιος — unfitting, ominous, contrary to what is right; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.παυρότερον: παῦρος — few, small; comparative παυρότερος, fewer; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun
glossary.πειθόμενοι: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’obeying’
glossary.πιθήσας: πιθέω (epic aor. ἐπίθησα; cf. πείθομαι) — trust, obey (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’obeying’
glossary.ποικίλ: ποικίλος — inlaid, intricately worked; neut. acc. pl., elided (ποικίλ’ = ποικίλα)
glossary.πολέσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολυηχέϊ: πολυηχής — loud-sounding, resounding (πολύς + ἦχος); masc. dat. sg., uncontracted -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.πολυνείκεϊ: Πολυνείκης — Polynices, son of Oedipus; masc. dat. sg., uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.πολυπάμονος: πολυπάμων — owning much, rich in possessions (πολύς + πάομαι); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πολυφόντης: Πολυφόντης — Polyphontes, a Theban captain; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολύκλητοι: πολύκλητος — summoned from many places (πολύς + καλέω); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πονεύμενον: πονέομαι — toil, labour; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg., epic -εύ- (= Attic πονούμενον): ’toiling’
glossary.πτωσκαζέμεν: πτωσκάζω — cower, skulk (frequentative of πτώσσω); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πτωσκάζειν)
glossary.πτώσσεις: πτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’)
glossary.πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
glossary.σημάντορας: σημάντωρ — one who gives the orders, commander; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.στήθεσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable (= στήθεσι)
glossary.στεῖλαν: στέλλω — send, dispatch; make ready, equip; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστειλαν)
glossary.στόνον: στόνος — groan, groaning; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.συμβάλλετον: συμβάλλω — throw together; of rivers, flow together, join; pres. 3 dual
glossary.σφετέρῃσιν: σφέτερος — their own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τάρβει: ταρβέω — fear, be afraid; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτάρβει): ’was afraid’
glossary.τέττα: τέττα — a familiar, friendly address: ’friend, good fellow’; voc. sg.
glossary.ταλασίφρονά: ταλασίφρων — steadfast, enduring of heart (τλῆναι + φρήν); masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic περ
glossary.τεράεσσι: τέρας — portent, sign; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τέρασι)
glossary.τηλόσε: τηλόσε — to a distance, afar, far off; adv. of place
glossary.τούτῳ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τυδέϊ: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. dat. sg., uncontracted -έϊ
glossary.τυδεὺς: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τυδῆ: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. acc. sg., contracted Τυδῆ (= Τυδέα)
glossary.φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’
glossary.φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χέρεια: χερείων (χέρης) — worse, inferior; comparative of κακός; masc. acc. sg., epic χέρεια (= χερείονα, Attic χείρονα) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.χέρσῳ: χέρσος — dry land (fem. adj. as noun); fem. dat. sg.: ’on dry land’
glossary.χαλκεοθωρήκων: χαλκεοθώρηξ — bronze-breasted, wearing a bronze breastplate; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.χαράδρης: χαράδρα — ravine, gully; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic χαράδρας)
glossary.χείμαρροι: χείμαρρος (Attic χειμάρρους) — winter torrent, flowing in winter; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χολωσάμενοι: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ψεύδε: ψεύδομαι — lie, speak falsely; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ψεύδεο elided (ψεύδε’; Attic ψεύδου)
glossary.ἀγαγόνθ: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual or pl., elided and aspirated before ὑπό (ἀγαγόνθ’ = ἀγαγόντε ’we two’, or ἀγαγόντες): ’leading’
glossary.ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγείρων: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gathering’
glossary.ἀεθλεύειν: ἀεθλεύω — contend in a contest, compete (= Attic ἀθλεύω); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀζηχὲς: ἀζηχής — unceasing, incessant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly’
glossary.ἀκούουσαι: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl., + acc.: ’hearing’
glossary.ἀλαλητὸς: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shouting; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλῃσι: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀλλήλαις)
glossary.ἀμείνονες: ἀμείνων — better, braver (comparative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμείψατο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; aor. 3 sg. mid. deponent: ’answered’
glossary.ἀμελγόμεναι: ἀμέλγω — milk; mid. be milked; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.: ’being milked’
glossary.ἀνερχομένῳ: ἀνέρχομαι — come back, return; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. dat. sg.: ’as he comes back’
glossary.ἀντιθέῳ: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀποπτύει: ἀποπτύω — spit out, spew forth; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀρωγῇ: ἀρωγή — help, aid; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀσωπὸν: Ἀσωπός — the Asopus, a river of Boeotia; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτασθαλίῃσιν: ἀτασθαλίη — wanton folly, reckless wrongdoing; fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἄκρας: ἄκρα — headland, cape (cf. ἄκρος ’topmost’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄμοτον: ἄμοτον — insatiably, unceasingly, eagerly; adv. (neut. acc. of ἄμοτος)
glossary.ἄρειον: ἀρείων — better, stronger; comparative; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τεῖχος: ’stronger’
glossary.ἄρεος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρεος (= Attic Ἄρεως)
glossary.ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄχνην: ἄχνη — foam, spray; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, bid, order; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐνίκα: νικάω — conquer, surpass, prevail; impf. 3 sg.: ’won, prevailed’
glossary.ἐνιπὴν: ἐνιπή — rebuke, reproach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπίρροθος: ἐπίρροθος — helper, ally; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπασσύτεραι: ἐπασσύτερος — one close upon another, in close succession; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπασσύτερον: ἐπασσύτερος — one close upon another, in close succession; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’close upon another’
glossary.ἐπιείκελος: ἐπιείκελος — resembling, like; masc. nom. sg., epic, + dat.
glossary.ἐπικούρους: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper, auxiliary; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπιστάμενος: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, know how to; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg., + inf.: ’knowing how (to speak)’
glossary.ἐπῄνεον: ἐπαινέω — praise, approve, applaud; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπῄνουν)
glossary.ἐρχομένη: ἔρχομαι — come, go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐστήριξε: στηρίζω — set firmly, plant, fix; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐστρατόωνθ: στρατάομαι — be encamped, be arrayed in camp; impf. 3 pl. mid. deponent, uncontracted and elided (ἐστρατόωνθ’ = ἐστρατόωντο; Attic ἐστρατῶντο)
glossary.ἐτεοκληείης: Ἐτεοκληεῖος — of Eteocles, Eteoclean; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -ηείης (= Attic -είας); βίη Ἐτεοκληείη ’the might of Eteocles’ (= Eteocles himself)
glossary.ἐφῆκε: ἐφίημι — send upon, lay upon; aor. 3 sg.: ’sent upon’
glossary.ἐὸν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. neut. nom. sg., epic ἐόν (= Attic ὄν): ’being’
glossary.ἑπταπύλοιο: ἑπτάπυλος — seven-gated; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with Θήβης
glossary.ἑστήκασιν: ἵστημι — set; perf. stand; perf. 3 pl. (ἕστηκα): ’stand’
glossary.ἑτάρη: ἑταίρη (epic ἑτάρη) — companion (fem.); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔβραχε: βράχω — crash, clang, roar; aor. 3 sg. act., strong aorist
glossary.ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’)
glossary.ἔνθεο: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἔνθου)
glossary.ἔπεφν: φένω — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated, elided (ἔπεφν’ = ἔπεφνε)
glossary.ἔπληντ: πελάζω — bring near; mid. draw near, come close; aor. mid./pass. 3 pl. ἔπληντο (root aorist ἐπλήμην), elided: ’came together’
glossary.ἔχοντ: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἔχοντ’ = ἔχοντα)
glossary.ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλωσί: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. subj. 3 pl. (= ἕλωσι), accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
glossary.ἤντησ: ἀντάω (ἀντιάω) — meet, encounter (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., elided (ἤντησ’ = ἤντησα): ’I met’
glossary.ἰαχή: ἰαχή — cry, shout, war-cry; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱππηλάτα: ἱππηλάτης — horse-driver, charioteer; masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α, epithet of heroes
glossary.ἱρήν: ἱρός — holy, sacred; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρός (= Attic ἱερός)
glossary.ἴα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg., epic ἴα (= Attic μία)
glossary.ἴδοντο: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= augmented εἴδοντο): ’they saw’
glossary.ἵπποισι: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὀλλυμένων: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’perishing’
glossary.ὀλλύντων: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl.: ’killing’
glossary.ὀμφαλόεσσαι: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (ὀμφαλός); fem. nom. pl., epic -σσ-
glossary.ὀπιπεύεις: ὀπιπεύω — look about at, peer at; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ὀρνυμένου: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. spring up, rush; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg.: ’as he sprang up’
glossary.ὀτρύνοντι: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’urging’
glossary.ὀφέλλουσα: ὀφέλλω — increase, swell; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁδοῦ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁμοίῃ: ὅμοιος (epic ὁμοῖος) — like, the same; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὁμὸς: ὁμός — one and the same, common; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
glossary.ὄρεσφι: ὄρος — mountain (epic οὖρος); neut. pl. in -φι(ν), ablatival/locatival (= Attic gen. ὀρῶν or dat. ὄρεσι): ’down the mountains’
glossary.ὄϊες: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic οἶες)
glossary.ὑπέρθυμον: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, proud (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ᾤχοντο: οἴχομαι — go, be gone, set out; impf. 3 pl. mid. deponent
glossary.ῥέε: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented and uncontracted (= ἔρρει)
glossary.ῥέοντες: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’flowing’
glossary.ῥηγνύμενον: ῥήγνυμι — break; mid. break (of a wave); pres. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. sg.: ’breaking’
glossary.ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
glossary.ῥινούς: ῥινός — hide, skin; pl. hides, hide shields; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰνόθεν: Αἶνος — Aenus, a town on the Thracian coast; Αἰνόθεν with the suffix -θεν: ’from Aenus’
glossary.αἰολοθώρηξ: αἰολοθώρηξ — with a flashing corslet, mail-clad (αἰόλος ’flashing’ + θώρηξ ’corslet’); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰτωλὸς: Αἰτωλός — Aetolian, of Aetolia in central Greece; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰὼν: αἰών — life, lifetime, span of life; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴγειρος: αἴγειρος — black poplar; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴθοπι: αἴθοψ — fiery, flashing, gleaming; adj. of two endings, masc. dat. sg., agreeing with χαλκῷ: ’gleaming (bronze)’
glossary.αἴθωνι: αἴθων — blazing, gleaming (of metal); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with σιδήρῳ: ’gleaming (iron)’
glossary.αἴνυτο: αἴνυμαι — take, take away; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (cf. Attic ἐλάμβανε): ’took away’
glossary.βαλλομένοισιν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; pres. part. pass. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to those being struck’
glossary.βελέων: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βελῶν)
glossary.βλῆτο: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg. mid. with passive sense, root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἐβλήθη): ’was hit’
glossary.γένεθ: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (γένεθ’ = ἐγένετο): ’came to be, was’
glossary.γαστέρα: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γείνατ: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., elided, unaugmented (γείνατ’ = ἐγείνατο): ’bore’
glossary.δίφρῳ: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαμέντι: δάμνημι — tame, overpower, subdue; aor. pass. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’overpowered, brought down’
glossary.δεινὸς: δεινός — terrible, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεξιτερήν: δεξιτερός — on the right, right; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιάν), agreeing with a fem. noun
glossary.δεξιόν: δεξιός — on the right, right; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun
glossary.δημοκόωντα: Δημοκόων — Democoon, a son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δινεύοι: δινεύω — whirl about, wheel round; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a potential relative clause: ’were to wheel about’
glossary.διογενής: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.διώρεα: Διώρης — Diores, an Epeian leader; masc. acc. sg., third declension -εα
glossary.δολίχ: δολιχός — long; neut. acc. pl., elided (δολίχ’ = δολιχά)
glossary.δούπησεν: δουπέω — fall with a thud, thud; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδούπησε): ’thudded down’
glossary.εἰληλούθει: ἔρχομαι — come, go; plpf. 3 sg. (perfect stem εἰληλουθ-, epic for Attic ἐληλύθει): ’had come’
glossary.εἱαμενῇ: εἱαμενή — low-lying meadow, water-meadow; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.εἴκετε: εἴκω — yield, give way; pres. imper. 2 pl., with a gen. of the thing and dat. of the person: ’give way’
glossary.θέτιδος: Θέτις — Thetis, a sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θαλυσιάδην: Θαλυσιάδης — son of Thalysius; patronymic, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θρέπτρα: θρέπτρον — payment for rearing, what is owed for upbringing; neut. acc. pl. θρέπτρα
glossary.θρήϊκες: Θρῄξ — a Thracian; masc. nom. pl., epic Θρήϊκες (= Attic Θρᾷκες)
glossary.θρῃκῶν: Θρῄξ — a Thracian; masc. gen. pl., epic Θρῃκῶν (= Attic Θρᾳκῶν)
glossary.θυμαλγέα: θυμαλγής — heart-grieving, bitter; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with a masc. noun: ’heart-paining’
glossary.θυμός: θυμός — life, the life-breath that leaves the body; also heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάλεον: καλέω — call, name; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάλουν): ’called’
glossary.κάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλυψε)
glossary.κάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἐκάλυψεν)
glossary.κάμψῃ: κάμπτω — bend, curve; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’may bend’
glossary.κάππεσεν: καταπίπτω — fall down; aor. 3 sg., epic κατ- assimilated before π, ν-movable (= Attic κατέπεσε): ’fell down’
glossary.κέκλετ: κέλομαι — urge, call to; aor. 3 sg. mid., reduplicated, epic, unaugmented, elided (κέκλετ’ = ἐκέκλετο): ’called out to’ (+ dat.)
glossary.κατιοῦσα: κάτειμι (κατά + εἶμι) — go down, come down; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming down’
glossary.κεκάδοντο: χάζομαι — give way, draw back; reduplicated aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, unaugmented: ’drew back’
glossary.κεκορυθμένος: κορύσσω — arm, equip with a helmet; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’helmeted, armed’
glossary.κνήμην: κνήμη — shin, lower leg; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κορυστὴν: κορυστής — helmeted warrior, armed man (from κόρυς ’helmet’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κροτάφοιο: κρόταφος — temple of the head (usually pl. κρόταφοι); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κτείνοντο: κτείνω — kill, slay; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’were being killed’
glossary.κυδίστη: κύδιστος — most glorious, most honoured (superl. of κυδρός/κῦδος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κόρσην: κόρση — temple, side of the head; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic κόρρη)
glossary.κύψαντι: κύπτω — stoop, bend forward; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’having stooped’
glossary.λίθος: λίθος — stone, rock; masc. nom. sg., predicate noun · also masc. nom. sg., subject: ’stone’
glossary.λίπε: λείπω — leave, abandon; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε): ’left’
glossary.λείη: λεῖος — smooth; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic λεία)
glossary.λελιημένος: λιλαίομαι — long for, be eager; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’eager’
glossary.λεῦκον: Λεῦκος — Leucus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λᾶας: λᾶας — stone, rock; masc. nom. sg. (Attic λίθος)
glossary.μάρναται: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.μέσην: μέσος — middle, in the middle; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun
glossary.μίνυνθα: μίνυνθα — for a little while, briefly; adv.
glossary.μαζοῖο: μαζός — breast, nipple; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μαζὸν: μαζός — breast, nipple; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μεγάθυμος: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μετελθών: μετέρχομαι — go among, go after, go about; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone among’
glossary.μινυνθάδιος: μινυνθάδιος — short-lived, lasting only a little while; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νέκυν: νέκυς — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νεκρούς: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.νεκρὸν: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νεκρὸς: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεμέσησε: νεμεσάω — feel righteous anger, be indignant; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνεμέσησε): ’was indignant’
glossary.νόθον: νόθος — bastard, born out of wedlock; masc. acc. sg., used of a son
glossary.ξυστῷ: ξυστόν — polished spear, lance; neut. dat. sg., of means: ’with a spear’
glossary.οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
glossary.οὔτησε: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic (cf. Attic οὔτασε): ’stabbed’
glossary.οὖτα: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, without augment: ’stabbed’
glossary.πέδησε: πεδάω — bind, fetter, hold fast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπέδησε): ’bound’
glossary.πέρησε: περάω — pass through, pierce; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic: ’pierced through’
glossary.πέρησεν: περάω — pass through, pierce; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable, epic: ’pierced through’
glossary.πέσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἔπεσεν): ’fell’
glossary.πέσσει: πέσσω — cook, ripen; digest, brood over (anger); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.παπτήνας: παπταίνω — look about, glance around; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having looked about’
glossary.πείρως: Πείρως — Peiros, a Thracian leader (by-form of Πείροος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πελεμίχθη: πελεμίζω — shake, make reel; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπελεμίχθη): ’was shaken, reeled’
glossary.περίστησαν: περιίστημι — stand around; aor. 3 pl. (intransitive root aorist), unaugmented (= περιέστησαν): ’stood around’
glossary.περγάμου: Πέργαμος — Pergamos, the high citadel of Troy; gen. sg., gen. of the place looked down from, with ἐκκατιδών: ’from Pergamos’
glossary.περικαλλέϊ: περικαλλής — very beautiful, exceedingly fair; adj. of two endings, masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ), agreeing with a masc. noun · also fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun: ’very fair (oak)’ (περικαλλέϊ φηγῷ)
glossary.πεσών: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
glossary.πετάσσας: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., double σ metrical: ’having spread out’
glossary.πεφύασι: φύω — grow, come to be; perf. 3 pl. act., epic (= Attic πεφύκασι): ’have grown, grow’
glossary.πλευρά: πλευρόν — side, flank, rib; neut. nom./acc. pl. πλευρά (the sides of the body)
glossary.ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.πρόμαχοι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πτόλιος: πτόλις (epic for πόλις) — city; fem. gen. sg. (= Attic πόλεως)
glossary.πῆξε: πήγνυμι — fix, plant, fasten; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπηξε): ’fixed, drove in’
glossary.σίδηρος: σίδηρος — iron; masc. nom. sg., also an iron weapon or tool
glossary.σιδήρῳ: σίδηρος — iron; masc. dat. sg., also an iron tool or weapon
glossary.σιμοείσιον: Σιμοείσιος — Simoeisios, a young Trojan named for the river Simoeis; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σιμόεντος: Σιμόεις — Simoeis, a river of the Troad; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.σκότος: σκότος — darkness; masc. nom. sg., the dark of death
glossary.συλήσειε: συλάω — strip (a dead man of his arms), despoil; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’might strip’
glossary.σφείων: σφεῖς — they; epic gen. pl. σφείων (= Attic σφῶν, αὐτῶν): ’of them, from them’
glossary.τένοντε: τένων — sinew, tendon; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two tendons’
glossary.τέταντο: τείνω — stretch, stretch out; plpf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐτέταντο): ’lay stretched out’
glossary.ταμεσίχροα: ταμεσίχρως — cutting the flesh, skin-cutting; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τετάσθην: τείνω — stretch, stretch out; plpf. 3 dual mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐτετάσθην): ’the two lay stretched out’
glossary.τοκεῦσι: τοκεύς — parent (usually pl. ’parents’); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τοκεῦσιν: τοκεύς — parent (usually pl. ’parents’); masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.τριτογένεια: Τριτογένεια — Tritogeneia, title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed (linked to a lake/river Triton, to a word for ’head’, or to ’third-born’)
glossary.τύψε: τύπτω — strike, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= ἔτυψε): ’struck’
glossary.φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
glossary.χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
glossary.χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
glossary.χασσάμενος: χάζομαι — draw back, give ground; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having drawn back’
glossary.χερμαδίῳ: χερμάδιον — hand-sized stone, rock used as a missile; neut. dat. sg., of means: ’with a stone’
glossary.χεῖρε: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. dual: ’the two hands’
glossary.χολάδες: χολάς — bowel, entrail (usually pl. χολάδες); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χολώθη: χολόω — anger; mid./pass. grow angry; aor. pass. 3 sg. with middle sense, unaugmented (= ἐχολώθη): ’grew angry’
glossary.χρὼς: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χύντο: χέω — pour, shed; aor. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐχύντο): ’were poured out, spilled’
glossary.χώρησαν: χωρέω — give way, withdraw; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐχώρησαν): ’gave way, fell back’
glossary.ἀΰσας: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’calling out’
glossary.ἀβυδόθεν: Ἄβυδος — Abydos, a town on the Hellespont; Ἀβυδόθεν with the suffix -θεν: ’from Abydos’
glossary.ἀγαυὸν: ἀγαυός — illustrious, noble, proud; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγχίμολον: ἀγχίμολος — coming near, close at hand; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’close by, hard upon’
glossary.ἀζομένη: ἄζομαι — become dry, wither (distinct from ἅζομαι ’dread’); pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’drying out, withering’
glossary.ἀκοντίσσαντος: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, throw a spear; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having hurled’
glossary.ἀκρόκομοι: ἀκρόκομος — with hair on the top of the head, perhaps in a top-knot (ἄκρος + κόμη; the fashion is not known); masc. nom. pl.
