glossary.τυδεΐδην: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. acc. sg. (patronymic)
glossary.τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
glossary.τυδεΐδῃ: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. dat. sg. (patronymic)
glossary.τυχὼν: τυγχάνω — hit upon, obtain, + gen.; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having obtained’ · also aor. part., absolute, of a blow: ’having hit’ (the mark)
glossary.φέρεκλον: Φέρεκλος — Phereclus, a Trojan shipwright, son of Tecton; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin or body parts serves as a possessive); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.φαῖστον: Φαῖστος — Phaestus, a Maeonian, son of Borus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φεύγοντα: φεύγω — flee, run away; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’fleeing’
glossary.φηγεύς: Φηγεύς — Phegeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φηγεὺς: Φηγεύς — Phegeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαζώμεσθα: χάζομαι — draw back, give way, yield; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= -μεθα), deliberative: ’are we to draw back?’
glossary.χαριζομένη: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, gratify, be free with; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’gratifying’
glossary.χειμάρρῳ: χείμαρρος — winter-flowing, swollen by winter rain; masc. dat. sg., of a river, agreeing with ποταμῷ
glossary.χραῖσμ: χραισμέω — help, avail, ward off (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (χραῖσμ’ = ἔχραισμε): ’helped’
glossary.ψυχρὸν: ψυχρός — cold; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χαλκόν
glossary.ἀΐξας: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting’
glossary.ἀδελφειοῦ: ἀδελφειός — brother (by-form of ἀδελφός); masc. gen. sg., epic -οῦ (= Attic ἀδελφοῦ)
glossary.ἀκάματον: ἀκάματος — untiring, unwearied; neut. acc. sg., of fire: ’unflagging’
glossary.ἀκαχήμενος: ἀχέω (ἀκαχίζω) — distress, grieve; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic reduplicated: ’grieved, distressed’
glossary.ἀκωκή: ἀκωκή — point, edge; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκωκὴ: ἀκωκή — point, edge; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλευάμενον: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun, escape; aor. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’having escaped’
glossary.ἀλεώμεθα: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun, flee from; subj. 1 pl. mid., long-vowel (-ω-), pres. or aor. stem not certain, deliberative: ’are we to avoid?’
glossary.ἀλωάων: ἀλωή — orchard, cultivated fenced plot; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀμφεκάλυψε: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round, enfold, enclose, shelter; aor. 3 sg. act. (ἀμφί + καλύπτω)
glossary.ἀναχωρήσας: ἀναχωρέω — go back, draw back, withdraw; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνσχήσεσθαι: ἀνέχομαι — hold out, endure; fut. inf. mid. (ἀνσχ- for ἀνασχ-; Attic ἀνέξεσθαι): ’to endure’
glossary.ἀποκρινθέντε: ἀποκρίνω — separate, set apart; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. dual: ’having been parted, having drawn apart’
glossary.ἀπορνύμενον: ἀπόρνυμαι — rouse oneself and set off, rush away; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg. (ἀπό + ὄρνυμαι): ’setting out’
glossary.ἀπόρουσε: ἀπορούω — spring away, leap off; aor. 3 sg.: ’sprang away’
glossary.ἀρητὴρ: ἀρητήρ — one who prays, priest (Ionic for ἀρατήρ); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀριστερὸν: ἀριστερός — left, on the left hand; masc. acc. sg., with ὦμον
glossary.ἀρχεκάκους: ἀρχέκακος — beginning evil, source of woe; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. pl., agreeing with νῆας
glossary.ἀστέρ: ἀστήρ — star; masc. dat. sg., elided (ἀστέρ’ = ἀστέρι), after ἐναλίγκιον
glossary.ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
glossary.ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁρμονίδεω: Ἁρμονίδης — son of Harmon (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’
glossary.ἄγρια: ἄγριος — wild, savage; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄρες: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. voc. sg. Ἄρες
glossary.ἄροιτο: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain, earn; aor. 2 opt. 3 sg. mid. (ἀρέσθαι) ’might win’
glossary.ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄϋσε: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤϋσε): ’shouted’
glossary.ἆρες: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. voc. sg. Ἄρες (the doubled address Ἆρες Ἄρες)
glossary.ἐάσαιμεν: ἐάω — let, allow; aor. opt. 1 pl. act., potential with ἄν in an urgent question: ’should we not let?’
glossary.ἐεργμέναι: εἴργω (ἐέργω) — shut in, hem in, confine; perf. pass. part. fem. nom. pl., epic ἐεργμέναι (= Attic εἰργμέναι)
glossary.ἐκέδασσε: κεδάννυμι — scatter, disperse; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐσκέδασε, from σκεδάννυμι)
glossary.ἐλθόντ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’coming’
glossary.ἐνήρατο: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg. mid., with active sense
glossary.ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πῦρ
glossary.ἐναντίω: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. dual: ’facing’
glossary.ἐξήγαγε: ἐξάγω — lead out; aor. 3 sg. act. (ἐκ + ἄγω): ’led out’
glossary.ἐξαπίνης: ἐξαπίνης — suddenly; adv., epic (= Attic ἐξαίφνης)
glossary.ἐξελάσας: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having driven out’
glossary.ἐπίστατο: ἐπίσταμαι — know, know how to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἠπίστατο)
glossary.ἐπαΐσσοντα: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’springing on’
glossary.ἐπιβησόμενον: ἐπιβαίνω — mount, step upon (+ gen.); fut. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’about to mount’
glossary.ἐπιβρίσῃ: ἐπιβρίθω — press upon, weigh down, come down heavily; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after ὅτε in a general clause
glossary.ἐριβώλακος: ἐριβώλαξ — rich-soiled, with big clods; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., with Τάρνης
glossary.ἐριθηλέων: ἐριθηλής — very flourishing, luxuriant; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἐριθηλῶν)
glossary.ἐρύσσῃς: ἐρύω (ἐρύσσω) — draw, pull out; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ-, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that you may draw’
glossary.ἐσύλευον: συλεύω — strip (armour), despoil; impf. 3 pl. act. (Attic συλάω)
glossary.ἐτέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, contrive, bring about; pass. come to pass, happen; plup. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been made, had come about’
glossary.ἐτεόν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, really’ (εἰ ἐτεόν ’if truly’)
glossary.ἐτιταίνετο: τιταίνω — stretch, draw tight (Attic τείνω); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’stretched (his own)’
glossary.ἐφίλατο: φιλέω — love, hold dear; aor. 3 sg. mid. with active sense, epic (= Attic ἐφίλησε)
glossary.ἑκηβολίαι: ἑκηβολία — skill in shooting from afar, far-shooting; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑταίροισιν: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= -οις)
glossary.ἔγχεος: ἔγχος — spear; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔγχους)
glossary.ἔκβαλε: ἐκβάλλω — cast out, throw out, hurl from; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέβαλε)
glossary.ἔκδηλος: ἔκδηλος — plain to see, conspicuous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔκλιναν: κλίνω — lean, prop; turn back, rout (a force); aor. 3 pl. act., augmented
glossary.ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
glossary.ἔλασ: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg. act., elided epic (ἔλασ’ = ἔλασσε): ’struck’
glossary.ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε): ’drove’
glossary.ἔξεσε: ξέω — scrape, hew, carve; aor. 3 sg. act.; ἀπὸ … ἔξεσε (tmesis) ’hewed off’
glossary.ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
glossary.ἔπεφνε: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
glossary.ἔπτατο: πέτομαι — fly; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (Attic ἐπτόμην): ’flew’
glossary.ἔριπ: ἐρείπω — throw down; intrans. aor., fall, crash down; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔριπ’ = ἔριπε), unaugmented (cf. augmented ἤριπε)
glossary.ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἕ: οὗ, οἷ, ἕ — he, she, it (3rd-person pron.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’him’
glossary.ἕθεν: ἕ, οὗ — of himself, him, her; 3 sg. pron., gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ); with πρόσθεν, πρό: ’in front of him’, reflexive ’in front of himself’ · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from himself’ (ἀπὸ ἕθεν … ὤσατο ’pushed away from himself’)
glossary.ἕλ: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἕλ’ = ἕλε), unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
glossary.ἕρκεα: ἕρκος — fence, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἕρκη)
glossary.ἠϊόεντι: ἠϊόεις — with high banks, steep-banked (sense of the epithet debated); masc. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with Σκαμάνδρῳ
glossary.ἤλυθ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλυθ’ = ἤλυθε), epic (= Attic ἦλθε)
glossary.ἤστην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 dual: ’the two were’
glossary.ἰδαῖός: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg. (accent shifted before the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἰνίον: ἴνιον — nape, the back of the head; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰοχέαιρα: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-pourer, shooter of arrows (epithet of Artemis); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰσχανόωσιν: ἰσχανάω — hold back, check, restrain; pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰσχανῶσι)
glossary.ἱρεὺς: ἱερεύς — priest; masc. nom. sg., epic ἱρεύς (= Attic ἱερεύς)
glossary.ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἵπποιιν: ἵππος — horse; masc. gen./dat. dual, epic -οιιν (= Attic -οιν): ’of the two horses’
glossary.ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
glossary.ὀδίον: Ὀδίος — Odius, leader of the Halizones; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀδοῦσιν: ὀδούς — tooth; masc. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with the teeth’
glossary.ὀξυόεντι: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with ἔγχεϊ
glossary.ὀπωρινῷ: ὀπωρινός — of late summer, of the season of ripening fruit (ὀπώρη); masc. dat. sg., with ἀστέρι
glossary.ὀρέξῃ: ὀρέγω — reach out, hold out, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in an indefinite relative clause: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a condition, with ἄν or κε: ’should grant’
glossary.ὀρίνθη: ὀρίνω — stir, rouse, agitate; aor. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= Attic ὠρίνθη): ’was stirred’
glossary.ὁμιλέοι: ὁμιλέω — mingle with, consort with, be among; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic ὁμιλοίη)
glossary.ὁπποτέροισι: ὁπότερος — whichever of two; indefinite relative, masc. dat. pl., epic ὁππότερος (= Attic ὁπότερος)
glossary.ὁρμηθήτην: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush forward, set out; aor. 3 dual pass. with middle sense: ’the two set out’
glossary.ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄρνυσθε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rouse oneself, hasten; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’rouse yourselves!’
glossary.ὄρσο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= ὄρσεο): ’rise up!’
glossary.ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat./gen. pl., old case-suffix -φιν (= Attic ὄχοις, ὀχέων)
glossary.ὑπέκφυγε: ὑπεκφεύγω — flee out from under, escape; 2nd aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ὑπερθύμου: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, overbold; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὑψήνορα: Ὑψήνωρ — Hypsenor, son of Dolopion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὤμοιο: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ῥέων: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’flowing’
glossary.αἰνεία: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader, son of Anchises; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.αἰχμητὰ: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. nom. sg., epic -ά (= Attic αἰχμητής)
glossary.αὐλώπιδί: αὐλῶπις — (of a helmet) tube-fitted, with a socket for the plume; fem. dat. sg.; exact sense uncertain
glossary.αὐλῆς: αὐλή — courtyard, fold; fem. gen. sg., with compounds of leaping: ’over, out of the fold’
glossary.αὐχένα: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐξ … ἄξῃ (tmesis): ’breaks the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of βάλλω: ’hit the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of τύπτε: ’struck the neck’
glossary.αὐχένος: αὐχήν — neck, nape; masc. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the neck’
glossary.βάλον: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλον): ’I hit’ · also aor. 3 pl. (same ending): ’they hit’
glossary.βαθέης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -έης (= Attic βαθείας), agreeing with αὐλῆς
glossary.βαλών: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having hit, by hitting’
glossary.βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
glossary.βοσκομενάων: βόσκω — feed, graze (mid. intrans.); pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic βοσκομένων): ’grazing’
glossary.βουληφόρε: βουληφόρος — counselling, a counsellor; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.βουσὶ: βοῦς — ox, cow; dat. pl.: ’among cattle’ (after ἐν)
glossary.γιγνώσκων: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’recognising’
glossary.γιγνώσκῃς: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; pres. subj. act. 2 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that you may know’
glossary.γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’
glossary.γυάλοιο: γύαλος — hollow, curved (adj., from the noun γύαλον ’hollow plate’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with θώρηκος
glossary.γόον: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δίδου: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδίδου): ’he gave’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’
glossary.δίζυγες: δίζυξ — yoked in a pair, paired; masc. nom. pl., with ἵπποι: ’a yoked pair of horses’
glossary.δίφροι: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαμάσσῃ: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic δαμάσῃ), in a general relative clause: ’he does not subdue’
glossary.δαρδανίδαο: Δαρδανίδης — descendant of Dardanus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), with Πριάμοιο
glossary.δατέοντο: δατέομαι — divide among themselves, share out; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἐδατοῦντο)
glossary.δηΐῳ: δήϊος — hostile, fierce; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δῄῳ), with πολέμῳ
glossary.διακλάσσας: διακλάω — break in two; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic διακλάσας): ’having snapped’
glossary.διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’looking for’
glossary.διόμηδες: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.δοιοῖσιν: δοιοί (= δύο) — two; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), with ἀριστήεσσιν
glossary.δόμοις: δόμος — house; masc. dat. pl., plural for one dwelling, after postponed ἔνι (= ἐν): ’in the house’
glossary.δύεται: δύομαι — go into, enter, sink into; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’slips into’
glossary.εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
glossary.εἰλομένων: εἴλομαι (εἰλέω) — be crowded, pressed together; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. pl., gen. absolute with ἀνδρῶν: ’with men thronged’
glossary.εἰλυμένος: εἰλύω — wrap, cover; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg., with acc. of the part covered: ’wrapped (in cloud)’
glossary.εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
glossary.εἰροπόκοις: εἰροπόκος — wool-bearing, fleecy; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὀΐεσσι
glossary.εἰσορόων: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶν)
glossary.εἰωθότες: ἔθω (perf. εἴωθα) — be accustomed; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl. + inf.: ’accustomed to’
glossary.εὐρυδάμαντος: Εὐρυδάμας — Eurydamas, the dream-reader, father of Abas and Polyidus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ζώοντε: ζώω (ζάω) — live; pres. part. masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντε): ’alive’
glossary.θαρσῶν: θαρσέω (Attic θαρρέω) — be bold, take heart; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’boldly, with good heart’
glossary.θείην: τίθημι — put, set; aor. opt. act. 1 sg., in a condition after εἰ μή: ’if I do not put’
glossary.θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., possessive with μῆνις: ’a god’s (wrath)’ · also gen. governed by ἄνευθε(ν): ’without a god’
glossary.θορὼν: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (θορ-): ’having sprung’
glossary.θόωνά: Θόων — Thoon, a Trojan, son of Phaenops; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.κέχυνται: χέω — pour; pass. be poured out, lie scattered; perf. mid./pass. 3 pl.: ’lie heaped, lie scattered’
glossary.κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
glossary.καλοὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κιχήμενον: κιχάνω — reach, overtake; aor. part. mid. neut. nom./acc. sg., epic athematic (= Attic κιχόμενον), with βέλος: ’reaching’
glossary.κληῗδα: κληΐς — collar-bone; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κλείς)
glossary.κλόνον: κλόνος — turmoil, press of battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κοτήεις: κοτήεις — wrathful, bearing a grudge; masc. nom. sg., epic (from κότος ’grudge’); predicate with θεός
glossary.κοτεσσάμενος: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having grown angry at’
glossary.κρῖ: κρῖ — barley (indeclinable epic form of κριθή); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.κτεάτεσσι: κτέαρ — possession, property (mostly pl.); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κτήμασι)
glossary.κτῆσιν: κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. acc. sg., after διά: ’over the property’
glossary.λέοντα: λέων — lion; masc. acc. sg., in a comparison after ὥς τε: ’like a lion’
glossary.λεῖπ: λείπω — leave; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λεῖπ’ = λεῖπε, Attic ἔλειπε): ’left behind’
glossary.λιπέσθαι: λείπω — leave; aor. mid. inf. λιπέσθαι: ’to be left behind’
glossary.λυγρῷ: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg., with γήραϊ: ’grievous (old age)’
glossary.λυκάων: Λυκάων — Lycaon, Pandarus’ father; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λυκίῃ: Λυκία — Lycia; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ), after ἐν: ’in Lycia’
glossary.μίγη: μίγνυμι — mix, join (+ dat.); aor. pass. (sense mid.) 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμίγη): ’mingled with’
glossary.μαίνεται: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.μετῴχετο: μετοίχομαι — go after, go about among; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (μετ-ῴχετο)
glossary.μηνίσας: μηνίω — be wrathful, rage at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. + gen.: ’having been angered over’
glossary.μῆνις: μῆνις — wrath, rage (esp. a god’s); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νεοτευχέες: νεοτευχής — newly made; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεοτευχεῖς)
glossary.νεφέλῃ: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’in cloud’
glossary.νοστήσω: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, with κε (= Attic ἐὰν νοστήσω): ’if I get home’
glossary.νώτου: νῶτον — back; neut. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the back’
glossary.ξάνθόν: Ξάνθος — Xanthus, a Trojan, son of Phaenops; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ξίφεϊ: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ξίφει): ’with a sword’
glossary.ξύλοχον: ξύλοχος — thicket, brush (a lair); masc. acc. sg., after κάτα (= κατά): ’through the thicket’
glossary.οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’
glossary.οὐτάμεν: οὐτάζω — wound, stab; aor. inf. act., epic athematic -μεν (= Attic οὐτάσαι): ’to wound’
glossary.πάνδαρε: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, a Lycian archer; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πέπλοι: πέπλος — cloth, coverlet, robe; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πέπτανται: πετάννυμι — spread out; perf. pass. 3 pl., epic (= Attic πεπέτανται): ’lie spread out’
glossary.πίσυνος: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρέασι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic πάρεισι)
glossary.πασσάλου: πάσσαλος — peg; masc. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’from the peg’
glossary.πατέρι: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg.: ’to the father’
glossary.πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
glossary.πειρώμενος: πειράω (mid. πειράομαι) — try, test; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’making trial’
glossary.πιθόμην: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι, obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. 2 mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπιθόμην)
glossary.πλῆξ: πλήσσω — strike; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (πλῆξ’ = πλῆξε, Attic ἔπληξε): ’struck’
glossary.ποιητοῖσιν: ποιητός — well-made, built; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), with δόμοις
glossary.ποιμὴν: ποιμήν — shepherd, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολλῶν: πολύς — much, many; gen. pl., of persons: ’of many (men)’
glossary.πολύειδον: Πολύϊδος — Polyidus, son of Eurydamas; masc. acc. sg. (Πολύειδος, with metrical lengthening)
glossary.ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., in a direct question
glossary.προμάχοισιν: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after ἐμίχθη: ’among the front-fighters’
glossary.προσαμύνει: προσαμύνω — come to the aid of, defend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.προϊάψειν: προϊάπτω — send forth, dispatch (to Hades); fut. inf. act., in indirect speech after ἐφάμην: ’that I would send’
glossary.πρωτοπαγεῖς: πρωτοπαγής — newly fixed together, freshly built; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πτερόεντες: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; masc. nom. pl., epic -όεντες (= Attic πτερωτοί), with ὀϊστοί
glossary.πόρτιος: πόρτις — calf, heifer; fem. gen. sg., paired with βοός: ’of heifer or cow’
glossary.σακέσπαλος: σακέσπαλος — shield-brandishing (σάκος ’shield’ + πάλλω); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Tydeus; exact sense debated
glossary.σταθμοὺς: σταθμός — farmstead, steading; masc. acc. pl., after κατά: ’through the steadings’ · also door-post (same form) · also masc. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’the steadings’ (σταθμοὺς … κεραΐζετον ’ravaged the steadings’)
glossary.στρεπτοῖο: στρεπτός — twisted, pliant; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), with χιτῶνος
glossary.στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
glossary.τάμοι: τέμνω — cut; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic strong aor. (= Attic τέμοι): ’may he cut off’
glossary.τέκετ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 2 mid. 3 sg., elided (τέκετ’ = τέκετο), unaugmented: of a father, ’begot’
glossary.τείρετο: τείρω — wear out, distress; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτείρετο): ’was worn down’
glossary.τηλυγέτω: τηλύγετος — only and dear (late-born?); masc. nom. dual, of the two sons; meaning disputed
glossary.τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’of this man’
glossary.τρυφαλείῃ: τρυφάλεια — helmet; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -εία)
glossary.τυδεύς: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τόξοισιν: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for one bow, with πίσυνος
glossary.τῷδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. sg., elided (τῷδ’ = τῷδε)
glossary.φαίνοπος: Φαίνοψ — Phaenops, father of Xanthus and Thoon; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φειδόμενος: φείδομαι — spare, hold back (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sparing’
glossary.φθάμενος: φθάνω — come first, forestall; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φθάς): ’getting in first’
glossary.φοβεῖται: φοβέομαι — be frightened, flee in fear; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., with a neut. pl. subject: ’are terrified’
glossary.φορβῆς: φορβή — fodder, food; fem. gen. sg., gen. of lack after δεύομαι: ’lack fodder’
glossary.φρονέουσα: φρονέω — think, be minded; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσα)
glossary.φῖλαι: φιλέω — love, befriend; aor. imper. 2 sg., old athematic form (= Attic φίλησον): ’befriend!’
glossary.χαλεπὴ: χαλεπός — hard, grievous; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χηρωσταὶ: χηρωστής — distant kinsman who takes over a childless man’s estate; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χιτῶνος: χιτών — tunic, shirt; masc. gen. sg., after διά: ’through the tunic’
glossary.χραύσῃ: χραύω — graze, scratch; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’grazes’
glossary.ἀέκοντας: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἄκων), agreeing with ἵππους
glossary.ἀγκύλα: ἀγκύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τόξα
glossary.ἀγρῷ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. dat. sg., locative: ’in the country’
glossary.ἀγχιστῖναι: ἀγχιστῖνος — close together, in crowded rows; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
glossary.ἀλαπάζοντα: ἀλαπάζω — lay waste, slaughter; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’laying low (the ranks)’
glossary.ἀλλότριος: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφοτέροιιν: ἀμφότερος — both; gen. dual, epic -οιιν (= Attic -οῖν): ’from both’
glossary.ἀνασχὼν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
glossary.ἀνηκόντιζε: ἀνακοντίζω — spurt up like a javelin; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound: ’spurted up’
glossary.ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
glossary.ἀρχεύειν: ἀρχεύω (= ἄρχω) — lead, command (+ dat.); pres. inf. act.: ’to lead’
glossary.ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’
glossary.ἀστύνοον: Ἀστύνοος — Astynous, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεκὲς: ἀτρεκής — exact, true; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, exactly’
glossary.ἀχλὺν: ἀχλύς — mist, darkness; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀϊδωνῆϊ: Ἀϊδωνεύς — Aidoneus, a poetic name of Hades; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἅιδῃ): ’to Hades’
glossary.ἄβαντα: Ἄβας — Abas, a Trojan, son of Eurydamas; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄδην: ἄδην — to the full, enough; adv.
glossary.ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ)
glossary.ἄξῃ: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a simile without ἄν; with ἐξ (tmesis, ἐξάγνυμι): ’breaks off’
glossary.ἄτρομον: ἄτρομος — untrembling, fearless; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
glossary.ἐέργαθεν: εἴργω (ἐέργω) — shut off, part, sever; aor. 3 sg. act., epic (= Attic εἷρξε): ’cut off, sundered’
glossary.ἐγχειάων: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with κλόνον: ’press of spears’
glossary.ἐδάμασσα: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. 1 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάμασα): ’I brought down’
glossary.ἐκέλευε: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept bidding’
glossary.ἐκνοστήσαντε: ἐκνοστέω — come home from, escape and return (+ gen.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having come back from’
glossary.ἐκρίνατ: κρίνω — judge, interpret, pick out; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ἐκρίνατ’ = ἐκρίνατο): ’interpreted’ · also ’chose, picked out’
glossary.ἐλαφρά: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; neut. acc. pl., predicate with γυῖα: ’light’
glossary.ἐλαύνειν: ἐλαύνω — drive, ride; pres. inf. act.: ’to drive’
glossary.ἐμίχθη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was mingled’
glossary.ἐμβεβαῶτα: ἐμβαίνω — step on, mount; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμβεβηκότα): ’having mounted’
glossary.ἐμμεμαὼς: ἐμμέμαα (μέμονα, with ἐν-) — press on eagerly; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, rushing on’
glossary.ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνάριζε: ἐναρίζω — strip a slain foe of his arms, slay; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept stripping, slaying’
glossary.ἐξάλλεται: ἐξάλλομαι — leap out of (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’leaps out’
glossary.ἐξέρυσ: ἐξερύω — draw out, pull out; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐξέρυσ’ = ἐξέρυσε)
glossary.ἐξαίνυτο: ἐξαίνυμαι — take out, take away; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’took away (his life)’
glossary.ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
glossary.ἐπεύχεται: ἐπεύχομαι — boast over, vaunt; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’exults, boasts’
glossary.ἐπιβαίην: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, mount (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I could mount’
glossary.ἐπῆεν: ἔπειμι (εἰμί) — be upon; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἐπῆν): ’was upon’
glossary.ἐρίζεται: ἐρίζω — contend, vie with (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’vies’
glossary.ἐρχομένοις: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl.: ’(to them) going’
glossary.ἐρχομένῳ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(to him) going’
glossary.ἐρῆμα: ἔρημος — deserted, lonely; neut. nom. pl.: ’the abandoned (ones)’
glossary.ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; gen. pl., as a noun of persons: ’of the brave’
glossary.ἐσόψομαι: εἰσοράω — look at, see; fut. mid. 1 sg., epic shortened ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσόψομαι): ’I shall see’
glossary.ἐφῆκα: ἐφίημι — let fly at, send against; aor. 1 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’I let fly’
glossary.ἐχέμμονά: Ἐχέμμων — Echemmon, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἑλεῖν: αἱρέω — take, seize, kill; aor. inf. act. (stem ἑλ-): ’to take, to slay’
glossary.ἑλόμην: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 1 sg. (stem ἑλ-): ’I took (for myself)’
glossary.ἑνὶ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc./neut. dat. sg. ἑνί
glossary.ἑστᾶσι: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 pl. act., contracted epic (= Attic ἑστήκασι): ’stand’
glossary.ἔασ: ἐάω — let be, leave alone; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔασ’ = ἔασε) · also εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic ἔασι (= Attic εἰσί), elided
glossary.ἔλθῃσ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι ending (ἔλθῃσι), elided: ’should she come’
glossary.ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
glossary.ἔσσευα: σεύω — set in motion, make flow; aor. 1 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔσευα): ’I made flow’
glossary.ἔφες: ἐφίημι — let fly at, send against; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’let fly!’
glossary.ἔχεσκε: ἔχω — have, hold, wield; iterative impf. 3 sg., epic -σκε (= Attic εἶχε): ’used to wield’
glossary.ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
glossary.ἠρᾶτο: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἀ- → ἠ-)
glossary.ἡγεόμην: ἡγέομαι — lead, guide; impf. 1 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡγούμην): ’I led’
glossary.ἤγειρα: ἐγείρω — rouse, stir up; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented (ἐ- → ἠ-): ’I stirred up’ · also ἀγείρω — gather; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἧκα: ἵημι — send, let go, put into; aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I put in’
glossary.ἱρῶν: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. gen. pl. as a noun: ’of the sacred rites’
glossary.ἵπποισίν: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), accented before enclitic μ’
glossary.ὀΐεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
glossary.ὀλύρας: ὀλύρα — emmer, a coarse grain; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀνήσειν: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; fut. inf. act., after ἔμελλον: ’to help’
glossary.ὀνειροπόλοιο: ὀνειροπόλος — dream-reader, interpreter of dreams; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὀφθαλμῶν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the eyes’
glossary.ὁρμὴν: ὁρμή — rush, onset; fem. acc. sg., after ἐς: ’into the onset’
glossary.ὄψεσθαι: ὁράω — see; fut. inf. mid. (ὄψομαι), in indirect speech after φησί: ’that he will see’
glossary.ὑπείρονα: Ὑπείρων — Hyperon, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπεράλμενον: ὑπεράλλομαι — leap over; aor. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic athematic: ’leaping over’
glossary.ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
glossary.αἰνείαο: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου): ’of Aeneas’
glossary.αἰνείᾳ: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader; masc. dat. sg.: ’to Aeneas’
glossary.αἰόλα: αἰόλος — glancing, flashing, quick-moving; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα: ’glancing’
glossary.αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., gen. of what one is glutted with, after ἆσαι: ’with blood’
glossary.αὐτώ: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. dual, in apposition to νῶϊ: ’both of us, the two of us themselves’
glossary.βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, + ἐς and acc.: ’having stepped onto, mounting’
glossary.βέβληαι: βάλλω — throw, hit; perf. pass. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic βέβλησαι): ’you have been hit’
glossary.βαῖνε: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαινε): ’strode’
glossary.βουκολέοντι: βουκολέω — tend cattle; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βουκολοῦντι): ’while tending cattle’
glossary.γανυμήδεος: Γανυμήδης — Ganymede, a Trojan prince carried off to serve the gods; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.γενεῆς: γενεή — race, breed, stock; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic γενεᾶς), partitive after ἔκλεψεν: ’from that breed’; also antecedent of a relative: ’of the breed’ · also fem. gen. sg., of origin, with εἶναι: ’(to be) of this lineage’
glossary.γενναῖον: γενναῖος — noble, befitting one’s birth; neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’fitting, in keeping with noble birth’
glossary.δέδεξο: δέχομαι — receive, await; perf. imper. 2 sg. with present sense, epic (δέδεγμαι): ’take on, meet’
glossary.δέξαι: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid. (δέξαι): ’take’
glossary.δαμάσσατο: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδαμάσατο): ’overcame’
glossary.δείσαντε: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two, having become afraid’
glossary.δεδέξομαι: δέχομαι — receive, await; fut. 1 sg. formed on the perfect stem, epic: ’I shall meet, withstand’
glossary.διαμπερές: διαμπερές — right through, clean through; adv.
glossary.διωκέμεν: διώκω — pursue, chase; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic διώκειν)
glossary.δῶχ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δῶχ’ = δῶκε)
glossary.εἰωθότι: ἔθω — be accustomed; perf. εἴωθα, part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἡνιόχῳ: ’accustomed, used to the horses’
glossary.εὖχος: εὖχος — boast, glory, vaunt of victory; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’cause to boast’
glossary.θήλεας: θῆλυς — female; fem. acc. pl., epic -εας, with ἵππους: ’mares’
glossary.θλάσσε: θλάω — crush, bruise; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔθλασε): ’crushed’
glossary.θώρηκι: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. dat. sg., with πελάσθη: ’against the breastplate’
glossary.καμπύλον: καμπύλος — curved, bent; neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with ἅρμα: ’bent, curved’

glossary.αἰνείαν: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader; masc. acc. sg.: ’Aeneas’
glossary.αἰνῆς: αἰνός — dread, grim, grievous; fem. gen. sg.: ’fearsome’
glossary.αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, high; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσυλα: αἴσυλος — presumptuous, reckless, wicked; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’wicked things’

glossary.γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.

glossary.δεσμῷ: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δηναιὸς: δηναιός — long-lived, lasting long (cf. δήν ’long’); masc. nom. sg.

glossary.δῆσαν: δέω — bind; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔδησαν): ’bound’

glossary.κοιρανέουσιν: κοιρανέω — be lord or ruler, hold sway; pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανοῦσι), ν-movable
glossary.κουρίδιον: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a spouse); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κρατερώνυχας: κρατερώνυξ — strong-hoofed; masc. acc. pl., of horses
glossary.κυανέῃ: κυάνεος — dark, dark-blue; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυανῆ)
glossary.κόμισαί: κομίζω — tend, carry, convey; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., accented before the enclitic τέ: ’convey!’
glossary.κύπριν: Κύπρις — Cypris, ’the Cyprian’, a name of Aphrodite; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κῆδε: κήδω — trouble, distress; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔκηδε): ’distressed’
glossary.λύσασ: λύω — loose, unyoke; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (λύσασ’ = λύσασα): ’having loosed’
glossary.μάστιξεν: μαστίζω — whip; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐμάστιξεν), ν-movable: ’whipped’
glossary.μάχηται: μάχομαι — fight; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: in a general relative clause, ’whoever fights’ · also after μή: ’lest … fight’
glossary.μάχοιτο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., + dat., with ἄν: ’would fight against’
glossary.μάχονται: μάχομαι — fight; pres. 3 pl. mid., + dat.: ’fight against’
glossary.μέθεπε: μεθέπω — go after, pursue (μετά + ἕπω); impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, μετ- aspirated before the rough breathing: ’went after, pursued’
glossary.μαψιδίως: μαψιδίως — idly, heedlessly, to no purpose; adv.: ’without cause’
glossary.μελαίνετο: μελαίνω — grow dark, turn black; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐμελαίνετο): ’grew dark’
glossary.μετάλμενος: μεθάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at (μετά + ἅλλομαι); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (μετάλμενος): ’having leapt upon’
glossary.μητρυιὴ: μητρυιά — stepmother; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ιή (= Attic μητρυιά)
glossary.μῆνας: μείς (Ionic μήν) — month; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.νεκύεσσι: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.οἰκῆας: οἰκεύς — member of the household, servant (οἶκος); masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -έας)
glossary.οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ: ’such as’
glossary.οὐρανιώνων: Οὐρανίων — son of Uranus, god of heaven (Οὐρανίωνες, the heavenly gods); masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the gods of heaven’
glossary.οὔτασεν: οὐτάω — wound by a thrust; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’wounded’
glossary.οὖτά: οὐτάω — wound by a thrust; aor. 3 sg. act., epic οὖτα (= Attic οὔτασε), accented before the enclitic με: ’wounded’
glossary.πάσσων: πάσσω — sprinkle; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= Attic πάττων): ’sprinkling’
glossary.πέπλου: πέπλος — robe, woven robe; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πίνουσ: πίνω — drink; pres. 3 pl. act., elided (πίνουσ’ = πίνουσι): ’they drink’
glossary.παιήων: Παιήων — Paieon, physician of the gods (Attic Παιάν); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παππάζουσιν: παππάζω — call ’papa’, address a father; pres. 3 pl. act., ν-movable: ’call papa’
glossary.πεπαρμένος: πείρω — pierce, run through; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’pierced’
glossary.περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding (περί + φρήν); fem. nom. sg., epithet of a woman
glossary.περικαλλὴς: περικαλλής — very beautiful, very fair (περί + κάλλος); fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.πετέσθην: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented: ’the two flew’
glossary.ποθέουσα: ποθέω — long for, miss (+ acc. or gen.); pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦσα)
glossary.πρυμνὸν: πρυμνός — hindmost, at the end or base; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’at the base’
glossary.πωλήσεαι: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, range about; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic πωλήσῃ): ’you will go back and forth’
glossary.πύθηαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear of, find out; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic πύθῃ), with κεν after εἰ: ’you hear of’
glossary.πῖπτε: πίπτω — fall; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπιπτε)
glossary.στιβαρῷ: στιβαρός — stout, strong, sturdy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.συνθεσιάων: συνθεσίη — arrangement, compact agreed beforehand (σύν + τίθημι); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν; Ionic -ίη for -ία): ’of the arrangements’
glossary.σῖτον: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’ · also plpf. pass. 3 sg. as a copula with a predicate adj.: ’was, had come to be (the best)’
glossary.ταχέ: ταχύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. dual, elided (ταχέ’ = ταχέε): ’two swift’
glossary.τειρόμενον: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’worn down’
glossary.τιθέντες: τίθημι — put, place, lay on; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’laying on’
glossary.τλῆ: τλάω — endure, bear; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= Attic ἔτλη): ’endured’
glossary.τλῆμεν: τλάω — endure, bear; aor. 1 pl., root aorist (= Attic ἔτλημεν): ’we endured’
glossary.τοιάδ: τοιόσδε — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. pl., elided (τοιάδ’ = τοιάδε): ’such things’
glossary.τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
glossary.τριγλώχινι: τρίγλωχις — three-barbed, three-pointed; masc. dat. sg. (stem τριγλωχιν-), of an arrow
glossary.τρισκαίδεκα: τρεισκαίδεκα — thirteen; numeral, indeclinable, epic τρισκαίδεκα (τρεῖς + καὶ + δέκα)
glossary.τῖεν: τίω — honour, prize; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, long ι (= ἔτιεν; Attic uses τιμάω, ἐτίμα): ’honoured’
glossary.φίλοιο: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φίλτατός: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’dearest’
glossary.φιλομμειδὴς: φιλομμειδής — smile-loving (φιλο- + μειδάω ’smile’); fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Aphrodite
glossary.φλοίσβου: φλοῖσβος — roar, din (of battle or sea); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φραζέσθω: φράζομαι — consider, take heed; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him take care’
glossary.χάριτες: χάρις — grace, charm; pl. Χάριτες ’the Graces’, attendants of Aphrodite; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χαλέπ: χαλεπός — hard, grievous; neut. acc. pl., elided (χαλέπ’ = χαλεπά): ’hard’
glossary.χαλεπὸς: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλκέῳ: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκῷ)
glossary.χερσί: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl. (without movable ν)
glossary.χρυσάμπυκας: χρυσάμπυξ — with golden frontlet (χρυσός + ἄμπυξ); masc. acc. pl., of horses
glossary.ωὐτὸς: ὁ αὐτός — the same; masc. nom. sg., by crasis, Ionic ωὐτός (= Attic αὑτός): ’the same’
glossary.ἀΐδης: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god of the dead; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic Ἅιδης)
glossary.ἀβληχρήν: ἀβληχρός — meaning unknown (guessed ’weak’, ’mild’, ’tender’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγκὰς: ἀγκάς — in the arms, in an embrace; adv.
glossary.ἀδρηστίνη: Ἀδρηστίνη — daughter of Adrastus (patronymic), i.e. Aegialeia; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκηχεμένη: ἀκαχίζω — grieve, distress; perf. part. pass. fem. nom. sg., epic ἀκηχεμένη: ’grieved’
glossary.ἀλωῆος: Ἀλωεύς — Aloeus, father of Otus and Ephialtes; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἀλύουσ: ἀλύω — be distraught, be beside oneself; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἀλύουσ’ = ἀλύουσα): ’distraught’
glossary.ἀμβροσίου: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, immortal, divine; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμβρόσιον: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, immortal, divine; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιτρύωνος: Ἀμφιτρύων — Amphitryon, husband of Alcmene; masc. gen. sg.: ’of Amphitryon’
glossary.ἀνάλκιδας: ἄναλκις — without might, feeble (ἀ- + ἀλκή); fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἀνήκεστον: ἀνήκεστος — incurable, past healing (ἀ- + ἀκέομαι ’heal’); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναίμονές: ἀναίμων — bloodless, without blood (ἀ- + αἷμα); masc. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀντετόρησεν: ἀντιτορέω — pierce right through (ἀντί + τορέω); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, ν-movable: ’pierced through’
glossary.ἀνῆκε: ἀνίημι — send up, rouse, set on; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’set on, urged on’
glossary.ἀχθομένην: ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be distressed; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’distressed’
glossary.ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
glossary.ἄκρην: ἄκρος — at the end, topmost, outermost; fem. acc. sg.: ’at its end’
glossary.ἄμβροτον: ἄμβροτος — deathless, immortal (ἀ- + βροτός); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρτια: ἄρτιος — fitting, suitable, well-matched; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’fitting things’
glossary.ἄχθομαι: ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be distressed; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. deponent: ’I am distressed’
glossary.ἆτος: ἄατος — insatiable (the traditional sense; formation uncertain), + gen. of what; masc. nom. sg., contracted epic ἆτος
glossary.ἐγείρῃ: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., after μή: ’lest she rouse’
glossary.ἐδάμνα: δαμνάω (by-form of δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’was overcoming’
glossary.ἐκέκλιτο: κλίνω — lean, prop; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’lay propped’
glossary.ἐκίχανε: κιχάνω — overtake, come upon (poetic; Attic καταλαμβάνω); impf. 3 sg. act.: ’overtook’
glossary.ἐλάαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; epic pres. inf. of the by-form ἐλάω, with diectasis (contracted ἐλᾶν; Attic pres. inf. ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive on’
glossary.ἐλάζετο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took hold of’
glossary.ἐλήθετο: λήθομαι — forget (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐπελάθετο): ’forgot’
glossary.ἐλαυνέμεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive’
glossary.ἐμμεμαώς: μέμαα — be eager, strive; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐμμεμαώς (ἐν + μεμαώς), present sense: ’eager’
glossary.ἐνυώ: Ἐνυώ — Enyo, goddess of war and the sacking of cities; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐνωπῇ: ἐνωπή — the face (ἐν + ὤψ ’look’); dat. sg. as adv.: ’to the face, in plain sight’
glossary.ἐξέκλεψεν: ἐκκλέπτω — steal away, steal out; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’stole out’
glossary.ἐξέλασε: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ἐξέλασε (= Attic ἐξήλασε): ’drove out’
glossary.ἐξήγγειλεν: ἐξαγγέλλω — report, tell out; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’told, reported’
glossary.ἐπιβὰς: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’having mounted’
glossary.ἐπορεξάμενος: ἐπορέγομαι — reach out toward, lunge at (ἐπί + ὀρέγομαι); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having reached out’
glossary.ἐριποῦσα: ἐρείπω — throw down; intrans. aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., contracted (ἐριποῦσα): ’having fallen, having crashed down’
glossary.ἐφιάλτης: Ἐφιάλτης — Ephialtes, one of the two sons of Aloeus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑοὺς: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); masc. acc. pl.; not the relative
glossary.ἑρμέᾳ: Ἑρμέας — Hermes, messenger of the gods (Attic Ἑρμῆς); masc. dat. sg., Ionic -έᾳ: ’to Hermes’
glossary.ἑτάρῳ: ἕταρος — comrade, companion (epic, = Attic ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑτέρωθι: ἑτέρωθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv.
glossary.ἑῆς: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); fem. gen. sg.; not the relative
glossary.ἔβαινε: βαίνω — go, step, get into; impf. 3 sg.: ’was stepping, got in’
glossary.ἔβαινεν: βαίνω — go, step, get into; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was stepping, got in’
glossary.ἔδουσ: ἔδω (= ἐσθίω) — eat; pres. 3 pl., epic, elided (ἔδουσ’ = ἔδουσι; Attic ἐσθίουσι): ’they eat’
glossary.ἔκηδε: κήδω — trouble, distress; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’distressed’
glossary.ἔλαβ: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔλαβ’ = ἔλαβε): ’took’
glossary.ἔξαγ: ἐξάγω — lead out; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ἔξαγ’ = ἔξαγε; Attic ἐξῆγε): ’led out’
glossary.ἔρεξε: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ἔρεξε (= Attic ἔρρεξε): ’did, performed’
glossary.ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, station, halt; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’halted, stood’
glossary.ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
glossary.ἠερίβοια: Ἠερίβοια — Eeriboea, stepmother of Otus and Ephialtes; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠκέσατ: ἀκέομαι — heal, cure; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠκέσατ’ = ἠκέσατο): ’healed’
glossary.ἠλήλατο: ἐλαύνω — drive, hammer, strike; plpf. pass. 3 sg. (ἠλήλατο): ’had been driven’
glossary.ἠπεροπεύεις: ἠπεροπεύω — deceive, beguile; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you deceive’
glossary.ἠρύκακε: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; epic reduplicated aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἤρυξε): ’held back’
glossary.ἰάχουσα: ἰάχω — cry out, shriek; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’crying out’
glossary.ἰφθίμη: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty, stalwart; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰχώρ: ἰχώρ — ichor, the blood-like fluid of the gods; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀβριμοεργὸς: ὀβριμοεργός — doing mighty deeds (ὄβριμος + ἔργον); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυνήφατα: ὀδυνήφατος — pain-killing (usual explanation: ὀδύνη + a root ’kill’, cf. ἔπεφνον; not certain); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀδύνῃσι: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ὀδύναις)
glossary.ὀδύνῃσιν: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ὀδύναις)
glossary.ὀπάζων: ὀπάζω — make follow, drive on, pursue; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’pursuing’
glossary.ὁμηλικίης: ὁμηλικίη — equality of age, one’s age-mates; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ίης (= Attic -ίας): ’of one’s own age’
glossary.ὄθετ: ὄθομαι — care, take heed (only in negative clauses); impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ὄθετ’ = ὄθετο): ’he cared’
glossary.ὑπέρθυμος: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, of overflowing spirit (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπεξέφερεν: ὑπεκφέρω — carry out from under, bear away to safety (+ gen. of separation); impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was carrying out’
glossary.ὑπεξέφερον: ὑπεκφέρω — carry out from under, bear away to safety (+ gen. of separation); impf. 1 sg. act.: ’I was carrying out’
glossary.ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after the word it follows (anastrophe): ’above’
glossary.ὠκὺν: ὠκύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὦτος: Ὦτος — Otus, one of the two sons of Aloeus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ᾔτεεν: αἰτέω — ask, ask for; impf. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted -εεν (= Attic ᾔτει): ’asked for’
glossary.ῥέει: ῥέω — flow; pres. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥεῖ)
glossary.ῥέζουσαν: ῥέζω — do, act; pres. part. act. fem. acc. sg.: ’doing’
glossary.ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’doing’
glossary.ῥιγήσειν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shrink with dread; fut. inf. act., Ionic/epic (= Attic ῥιγώσειν), after ὀΐω: ’that you will shudder’
glossary.βαρεῖαι: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.βοείας: βόειος — of ox-hide; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βροτολοιγὸς: βροτολοιγός — ruinous to mortals, man-destroying (epithet of Ares); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γάμοιο: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γένησθε: γίγνομαι — become; aor. subj. 2 pl. (dep.), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest you become’
glossary.γαμβροῖσι: γαμβρός — son-in-law, brother-in-law, kinsman by marriage; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.δάκε: δάκνω — bite, sting; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔδακε): ’bit’
glossary.δέδοται: δίδωμι — give; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been given’
glossary.δαίμονι: δαίμων — divinity, god, divine power; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δημήτηρ: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain and harvest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δινήεντι: δινήεις — eddying, whirling; masc. dat. sg., epithet of a river
glossary.διοτρεφέεσσι: διοτρεφής — nurtured by Zeus, Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings and princes); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -έσι)
glossary.δυσμενέεσσιν: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσιν (= Attic -έσι)
glossary.δύναμ: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. dep., elided (δύναμ’ = δύναμαι), + inf.: ’I can’
glossary.δῄουν: δηϊόω — cut down, hack; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, with synizesis (= Attic ἐδῄουν): ’were hacking at’
glossary.δῖοι: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δῦσαι: δύω — strip off (trans.), take off; aor. inf. act., with ἀπό in tmesis: ’to strip off’
glossary.εἰδόμενος: εἴδομαι — seem like, make oneself like (+ dat.); mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐοικώς): ’likening himself’
glossary.εἰδώλῳ: εἴδωλον — phantom, image, likeness; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.εἴδωλον: εἴδωλον — phantom, image, likeness; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.εἶδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 pl. (the form is also 1 sg.): ’they saw’
glossary.εὐκύκλους: εὔκυκλος — well-rounded, with a good circle; fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ζωόν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic ζωός (= Attic ζῶν)
glossary.θοῦρος: θοῦρος — rushing, impetuous, furious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.θοῷ: θοός — swift, quick; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κέλευεν: κελεύω — bid, command; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευε), with movable ν: ’bade’
glossary.καλεσσάμενος: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλεσάμενος): ’having called to himself’
glossary.καρπόν: καρπός — fruit, grain, produce; masc. acc. sg.: ’grain’ · also καρπός — wrist; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.καρρέζουσα: καταρρέζω (καρρέζω) — stroke, caress; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., with apocope and assimilation: ’stroking’
glossary.κασιγνήτοισί: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.καταμύξατο: καταμύσσω — scratch, graze; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= κατεμύξατο): ’scratched (her own)’
glossary.καταπτώσσουσι: καταπτώσσω (καταπτήσσω) — crouch down, cower; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.κατηπιόωντο: κατηπιόω — soothe, assuage; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted -όωντο (= Attic -οῦντο): ’were being soothed’
glossary.κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg. act.
glossary.κεχολώσεαι: χολόω — anger; mid. χολόομαι be angry (+ dat.); fut. perf. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ): ’you will be angry’
glossary.κονισάλῳ: κονίσαλος — cloud of dust, dust; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κρίνῃ: κρίνω — separate, sift, decide; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a temporal clause of general truth: ’separates’
glossary.κτείνεσθαι: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. pass. inf.: ’to be killed’
glossary.κύδαινόν: κυδαίνω — make glorious, honour; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, accented before the enclitic τε: ’were making glorious’
glossary.κύπριδα: Κύπρις — Cypris, i.e. Aphrodite; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κύπρις: Κύπρις — Cypris, i.e. Aphrodite; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κύρμα: κύρμα — prey, spoil, booty; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’booty’
glossary.λίνου: λίνον — flax, linen thread, net; neut. gen. sg.: ’of flax’
glossary.λαισήϊά: λαισήϊον — light shield (of wicker or hide); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λαοῖσιν: λαός — people, host, folk; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λικμώντων: λικμάω — winnow; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl.: ’of those winnowing’
glossary.λισσομένῳ: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. dat. sg.: ’entreating’
glossary.λυκίη: Λυκίη — Lycia, a region of south-west Asia Minor; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic Λυκία)
glossary.λυκίους: Λύκιος — Lycian; masc. acc. pl. as a noun: ’the Lycians’
glossary.μάχωνται: μάχομαι — fight; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid. dep., in a temporal clause with κεν: ’until they fight’
glossary.μέλειν: μέλω — be a care to, concern; pres. inf. act., impersonal + dat.: ’to be a care (to)’
glossary.μέμον: μέμονα — be eager, intend, strive; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg., elided (μέμον’ = μέμονα): ’I am eager’
glossary.μαχήσασθαι: μάχομαι — fight; aor. inf. mid. dep., + dat.: ’to fight (against)’
glossary.μαχόμεσθ: μάχομαι — fight; pres. 1 pl. mid. dep., elided (μαχόμεσθ’ = μαχόμεθα): ’we fight’
glossary.μεθίστατο: μεθίστημι — change, shift; mid. take one’s place among; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμεθίστατο)
glossary.μελήσει: μέλω — be a care to; fut. 3 sg. act. (impersonal + dat.): ’will be a care (to)’
glossary.μενέμεν: μένω — stay, remain; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic μένειν)
glossary.μετάλλησάν: μεταλλάω — inquire of, question; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐμετάλλησαν), accented before the enclitic γε: ’questioned’
glossary.μετέρχεο: μετέρχομαι — go after, go among, go over to; pres. imper. mid. dep. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic μετέρχου): ’go after, attend to’
glossary.μετελθὼν: μετέρχομαι — go after, go among, go over to; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (+ acc.): ’having gone after, going among’
glossary.μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νήπιον: νήπιος — infant, childish, young (also witless, foolish); masc. acc. sg.: ’infant’
glossary.ναιομένην: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’inhabited’
glossary.νείκεσεν: νεικέω — quarrel with, taunt, revile; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’reviled’
glossary.νύκτάς: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., accusative of time: ’by night’
glossary.ξάνθῳ: Ξάνθος — Xanthus, a river of Lycia; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ξανθὴ: ξανθός — yellow, fair-haired, golden; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.οἰχομένην: οἴχομαι — be gone, go away, depart; pres. part. mid. dep. fem. acc. sg.: ’going away’
glossary.οἴχεται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. with perf. sense, 3 sg.: ’is gone’
glossary.οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. acc. sg. relative, correlative with τοῖον: ’such (a thing) as’ · also adverbial, + τε: ’such as, like’ · also οἷόν τε + inf.: ’such as to, able to’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τινά: ’such (a man) as’
glossary.οὖλος: οὖλος — baneful, ruinous, deadly (epithet of Ares); masc. nom. sg. · also οὖλος — woolly, thick-curled; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πίονος: πίων — fat, rich, fertile; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’rich’
glossary.πανάγρου: πάναγρος — all-catching, catching all; masc./neut. gen. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.περγάμῳ: Πέργαμος — Pergamus, the citadel of Troy; dat. sg., treated as fem. (with ἱερῇ, ἄκρῃ)
glossary.περόνῃ: περόνη — brooch, pin; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.ποιητῇσι: ποιητός — well made, wrought; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πολύχαλκον: πολύχαλκος — of much bronze, rich in bronze (epithet of the sky); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.προσιόντα: πρόσειμι (εἶμι) — go to, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’approaching’
glossary.πύλῃς: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.σαρπηδών: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σαώσομεν: σαόω — save, rescue (epic σαόω = Attic σῴζω); aor. subj. 1 pl. with short vowel, hortative after ἄγετε: ’let us save’ (the form is also fut. indic.: ’we shall save’)
glossary.σπέσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; aor. inf. mid. dep. (= Attic ἑπέσθαι): ’to follow’
glossary.τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τέταρτον ’the fourth time’ · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
glossary.τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.τεῦξ: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (τεῦξ’ = τεῦξε), unaugmented: ’fashioned’
glossary.τηλεκλειτῶν: τηλεκλειτός — far-famed, renowned afar; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.τηλοῦ: τηλοῦ — far off, at a distance; adv.
glossary.τύνη: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., epic emphatic τύνη (= Attic σύ)
glossary.υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
glossary.υἱεῖς: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’sons!’
glossary.φίλησε: φιλέω — love, treat as dear; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐφίλησε): ’loved’
glossary.φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
glossary.φλοίσβοιο: φλοῖσβος — roar, din (of battle); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φοίβου: Φοῖβος — Phoebus (’bright’), epithet of Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φορέει: φορέω — carry, bear along; pres. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φορεῖ)
glossary.φράζεο: φράζομαι — take note, observe, consider; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic φράζου): ’mark, take note’
glossary.φρονέειν: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονεῖν)
glossary.φόβηθεν: φοβέω — frighten; pass. flee in fear; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic unaugmented -θεν (= Attic ἐφοβήθησαν): ’fled in fear’
glossary.φῦλον: φῦλον — tribe, race, kind; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.χάζεο: χάζομαι — give way, draw back, withdraw; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic χάζου)
glossary.χάρησαν: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 pl. (pass. form, active sense), unaugmented (= ἐχάρησαν): ’were glad’
glossary.χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’)
glossary.χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
glossary.χρυσαόρου: χρυσάωρ — with a golden sword (epithet of Apollo); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.χρυσῆν: χρύσεος — golden; fem. acc. sg., contracted (= Attic χρυσῆν)
glossary.χρυσῇ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., contracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
glossary.ἀδύτοιο: ἄδυτον — innermost sanctuary of a temple; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀδύτῳ: ἄδυτον — innermost sanctuary of a temple; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀκάμαντι: Ἀκάμας — Acamas, a Thracian leader; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀκέοντό: ἀκέομαι — heal, mend; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic uncontracted, unaugmented, accented before the enclitic τε: ’were healing’
glossary.ἀλευάμενος: ἀλέομαι (ἀλεύομαι) — avoid, shun, escape; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (Attic φυγών for the sense): ’avoiding’
glossary.ἀλωὰς: ἀλωή — threshing-floor (also garden, vineyard); fem. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic ἅλως)
glossary.ἀμυνέμεναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
glossary.ἀμφοτέρῃσιν: ἀμφότερος — both; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις): ’with both (hands)’
glossary.ἀνεχάζετο: ἀναχάζομαι — draw back, retreat; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’drew back’
glossary.ἀνιεῖσα: ἀνίημι — send up, urge on, incite; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’urging on’
glossary.ἀολλέες: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀολλεῖς)
glossary.ἀπάτερθεν: ἀπάτερθε(ν) — apart from, away from; prep. + gen. (also adv.), with ν-movable
glossary.ἀρήγων: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’helping’
glossary.ἀραιήν: ἀραιός — thin, slender; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic -άν)
glossary.ἀρηγών: ἀρηγών — helper, one who aids (+ dat.), formed from ἀρήγω; fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’a helper’
glossary.ἀρτεμέα: ἀρτεμής — safe, sound, unharmed; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀρτεμῆ)
glossary.ἀφροδίτην: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀχαιϊάδων: Ἀχαιιάς — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀχυρμιαί: ἀχυρμιά — heap of chaff; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀψῖσι: ἁψίς (ἀψίς) — mesh, loop; pl. the meshes of a net; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.ἁλόντε: ἁλίσκομαι — be caught, be taken; 2nd aor. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having been caught’
glossary.ἄγοιεν: ἄγω — lead, carry off, drive away; pres. opt. 3 pl., potential with κεν: ’might drive off’
glossary.ἄκρῃ: ἄκρος — topmost, high; adj., fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ) · also ἄκρη — headland, height; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄλθετο: ἄλθομαι — be healed, grow well; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented: ’was healed’
glossary.ἅζετο: ἅζομαι — stand in awe of, revere; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented: ’revered’
glossary.ἐάσετε: ἐάω — allow, let; fut. 2 pl. act.: ’you will allow’
glossary.ἐγεῖραι: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake, stir up; aor. inf. act.: ’to rouse’
glossary.ἐκπέρσουσ: ἐκπέρθω — sack, destroy utterly; fut. 3 pl. act., elided (ἐκπέρσουσ’ = ἐκπέρσουσι): ’they will sack’
glossary.ἐκραίαινεν: κραιαίνω — accomplish, fulfil; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented, epic (= Attic κραίνω): ’was fulfilling’
glossary.ἐλελίχθησαν: ἐλελίζω — make whirl, wheel round; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic reduplicated: ’wheeled round’
glossary.ἐναντίοι: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐνιπήν: ἐνιπή — rebuke, reproof, threat; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπέπληγον: ἐπιπλήσσω (πλήσσω) — strike upon, beat; 2nd aor. 3 pl. act., epic reduplicated: ’beat up’
glossary.ἐπέσσυτο: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, hasten at; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic -σσ- (ἐπ-έσσυτο): ’rushed on’
glossary.ἐπειγομένων: ἐπείγω — press, urge; mid. press on, hasten; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’pressing on’
glossary.ἐπιδευής: ἐπιδευής — lacking, in need (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐπιδεής)
glossary.ἐπιμισγομένων: ἐπιμίσγομαι — mingle with, mix; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’mingling’
glossary.ἐποιχόμενος: ἐποίχομαι — go against, assail, come upon; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’assailing, going about’
glossary.ἐρέθιζον: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, goad; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἠρέθιζον): ’were provoking’
glossary.ἐρύσαιο: ἐρύω (mid. ἐρύομαι) — draw, drag, rescue; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with ἄν: ’would you draw (out)’
glossary.ἐστυφέλιξε: στυφελίζω — strike, buffet, thrust back; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’struck, thrust back’
glossary.ἐτίομεν: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 1 pl. act.: ’we were honouring’
glossary.ἐφέζετο: ἐφέζομαι — sit down, take a seat; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., aoristic sense (= Attic ἐκαθέζετο): ’sat down’
glossary.ἐφετμὰς: ἐφετμή — command, behest; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐϋπέπλων: ἐΰπεπλος — well-robed, fair-robed; fem. gen. pl. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑξέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἕξειν): ’to hold’
glossary.ἔγειρε: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; 3 sg. aor. or impf. act., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε): ’roused’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
glossary.ἔγειρεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake, stir up; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγειρεν), with movable ν
glossary.ἔθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. imper. act. 2 sg. (+ inf.): ’wish’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤθελε): ’wished’
glossary.ἔκπαγλα: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, astounding; neut. acc. pl. used as adv.: ’terribly, exceedingly’
glossary.ἔλδεται: ἔλδομαι — long for, desire; pres. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’longs for’
glossary.ἔλιπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 1 sg. act., 2nd aor. (the form is also 3 pl.): ’I left’
glossary.ἔνειμεν: εἰμί (ἔνειμι) — be, be in; pres. 1 pl., ἐν- + epic εἰμέν (= Attic ἔνεσμεν): ’we are’
glossary.ἔστρεφον: στρέφω — turn, wheel; impf. 3 pl. act. (with ὑπό in tmesis = ὑπέστρεφον): ’were wheeling round’
glossary.ἔχεσκες: ἔχω — have, hold; iterative impf. 2 sg. act. in -σκε-, epic: ’you used to have’
glossary.ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
glossary.ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλωρ: ἕλωρ — prey, spoil, plunder; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’prey’
glossary.ἕστηκας: ἵστημι — set; perf. stand; perf. 2 sg. act., intrans.: ’you stand’
glossary.ἡγήτορι: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἡνιοχῆες: ἡνιοχεύς — charioteer, rein-holder; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἥκω: ἥκω — have come, be here; pres. 1 sg. act. with perf. sense: ’I have come’
glossary.ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
glossary.ἰχῶ: ἰχώρ — ichor, the blood of the gods; masc. acc. sg., epic ἰχῶ (= ἰχῶρα)
glossary.ἱερὰς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἱερῇ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἴκελον: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); neut. acc. sg. (epic, = Attic ὅμοιος)
glossary.ἶσ: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (ἶσ’ = ἶσα), + dat.: ’equally with’
glossary.ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
glossary.ὀδύναι: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀμόργνυ: ὀμόργνυμι — wipe off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὠμόργνυ), with ἀπό in tmesis: ’wiped off’
glossary.ὀτρύνω: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir; pres. 1 sg. act. indic. or subj.: ’I urge on’
glossary.ὁμοκλήσας: ὁμοκλέω (ὁμοκλάω) — shout at, rebuke, call out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’shouting’
glossary.ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. nom. sg., predicate (epic ὁμοῖος = Attic ὅμοιος): ’alike’
glossary.ὑμήν: ὑμός — your (pl.), epic (= Attic ὑμέτερος); possessive adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πόλιν
glossary.ὑπέμειναν: ὑπομένω — stay behind, stand firm, await; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’stood their ground’
glossary.ὑπείρεχε: ὑπερέχω — hold over, hold above; impf. 3 sg. act., epic ὑπείρεχε (= Attic ὑπερεῖχε): ’held over’
glossary.ὑπολευκαίνονται: ὑπολευκαίνω — whiten beneath, turn white below; pres. mid./pass. 3 pl.: ’grow white beneath’
glossary.ὤρεσσι: ὄαρ (ὤρ) — wife, spouse; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, contracted ὤρ-: ’for wives’
glossary.αἰδεῖσθε: αἰδέομαι — feel shame before, respect; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid./pass. dep., contracted (= αἰδέεσθε): ’respect’
glossary.αἰδομένων: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, show respect; pres. part. mid./pass. dep. masc. gen. pl., epic stem αἰδόμεν- (= Attic αἰδουμένων): ’who feel respect’
glossary.αἰνείω: Αἰνείας — Aeneas, a Trojan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ω (= Αἰνείαο; Attic Αἰνείου)
glossary.αἰχμητήν: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βίας: βία — force, might, violence; fem. acc. pl., the plural for a people’s might: ’the might (of the Trojans)’
glossary.βαλέτην: βάλλω — throw, put, hit; aor. 3 dual act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐβαλέτην): ’the two put’
glossary.βελέεσσι: βέλος — missile, shaft; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic βέλεσι), of cause or means
glossary.βορέαο: Βορέας (Βορέης) — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Βορέου)
glossary.βρεχμόν: βρεχμός — front of the head, crown; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βόας: βοῦς — ox, cow, head of cattle; acc. pl. βόας (= Attic βοῦς): ’cattle’
glossary.γαστρὶ: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. dat. sg., syncopated stem γαστρ-
glossary.γενέσθην: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 dual (dep.), unaugmented (= Attic ἐγενέσθην): ’the two were born’
glossary.δίε: δείδω (poet. δίω) — fear; past 3 sg. (aor. or impf.), epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔδεισε): ’feared’; with περί ’greatly’ and μή ’lest’
glossary.δαμέντε: δάμνημι (= δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. dual (= Attic δαμασθέντε): ’overcome’
glossary.δαμείη: δάμνημι (= δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg. (= Attic δαμασθείη), in a purpose clause after ἵνα in past sequence: ’should be overcome’
glossary.δαναοὺς: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δειλὼ: δειλός — wretched, miserable, cowardly; masc. acc. dual, used as a noun: ’the two wretched men’
glossary.δεῖσε: δείδω — fear; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδεισε), + acc.: ’feared, was afraid of’
glossary.δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.δηϊκόωντα: Δηϊκόων — Deicoon, a Trojan, comrade of Aeneas; masc. acc. sg. (stem Δηϊκόωντ-)
glossary.διασκιδνᾶσιν: διασκιδνάω (= Attic διασκεδάννυμι) — scatter, disperse; pres. 3 pl. act., epic, contracted -ᾶσιν
glossary.διδυμάονε: διδυμάων — twin; adj. masc. nom. dual, epic (= Attic δίδυμω): ’twin’

glossary.διοκλῆος: Διοκλῆς — Diocles, lord of Pherae, son of Ortilochus; masc. gen. sg., epic -κλῆος (= Attic -κλέους)
glossary.δούρατ: δόρυ — spear; neut. acc. pl., epic δούρατα, elided (δούρατ’ = δούρατα; Attic δόρατα)
glossary.δυνήσατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; aor. 3 sg. (deponent), unaugmented (= ἐδυνήσατο): ’was able’
glossary.εἵποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., with the augment εἱ- (from ἐ-σεπ-): ’followed’
glossary.εἶπέ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., accented εἶπέ before a following enclitic (τε)

glossary.εὔπωλον: εὔπωλος — rich in foals, of fine horses; adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (fem. or neut.), standing epithet of a place
glossary.εὕδῃσι: εὕδω — sleep; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic εὕδῃ), in a temporal clause with ὄφρα
glossary.ζαχρειῶν: ζαχρηής — very violent, raging (a rare epic word of uncertain make-up); adj. in -ής, masc. gen. pl. ζαχρειῶν (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.θαρσαλέον: θαρσαλέος — bold, confident (Attic θαρραλέος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θεράποντα: θεράπων — attendant, squire; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θοός: θοός — swift, quick; masc. nom. sg., accented θοός before the enclitic περ

glossary.καρτεραί: καρτερός — strong, mighty (by-form of κρατερός); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κατέκταθεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. pass. 3 pl., passive-type aorist in -θεν for -θησαν, augmented (κατ’ + ἔκταθεν): ’were slain’

glossary.κελεύων: κελεύω — urge, bid, command; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’giving orders’
glossary.κεραΐζετον: κεραΐζω — ravage, plunder; impf. 3 dual act., epic -ετον for -έτην, unaugmented (= ἐκεραΐζέτην)
glossary.κορυφῇσιν: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.κρήθων: Κρήθων — Crethon, a Greek warrior, son of Diocles; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κρήθωνά: Κρήθων — Crethon, a Greek warrior, son of Diocles; masc. acc. sg., accented κρήθωνά before the enclitic τε
glossary.κυδοιμὸν: κυδοιμός — uproar, din of battle; personified as Κυδοιμός, a figure of the fighting; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κύμβαχος: κύμβαχος — headlong, head first (on the crown of the head); adj. masc. nom. sg., used adverbially
glossary.λέοντε: λέων — lion; masc. nom. dual: ’two lions’
glossary.λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά): ’white’
glossary.λιγυρῇσι: λιγυρός — clear-sounding, shrill; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.λὰξ: λάξ — with the heel, with the foot; adv.
glossary.μένον: μένω — wait for, await; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔμενον), + acc.: ’awaited’
glossary.μένοντε: μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. part. masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’the two standing firm’
glossary.μαχέσθην: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐμαχέσθην): ’the two fought’
glossary.μεγάθυμον: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μενέσθην: Μενέσθης — Menesthes, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg. Μενέσθην
glossary.μενεαινέμεν: μενεαίνω — be eager, rage, be furious; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν), standing for an imperative after μηδέ
glossary.μεῖνε: μένω — remain, stand firm; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμεινε): ’held his ground’
glossary.μορμύροντα: μορμύρω — roar, surge noisily (of water); pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the unspoken object of ἰδών
glossary.μύδωνα: Μύδων — Mydon, a charioteer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νέστορος: Νέστωρ — Nestor, old king of Pylos; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νέφεα: νέφος — cloud; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νέφη)
glossary.ναῖε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔναιε): ’lived’
glossary.νειαίρῃ: νείαιρος — lowest, lower; fem. νείαιρα, dat. sg. νειαίρῃ, of the belly (γαστήρ)
glossary.νεκροὺς: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. pl.: ’the dead’
glossary.νεκροῦ: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.νεφέλῃσιν: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), dative of likeness after ἐοικότες
glossary.νηνεμίης: νηνεμία — windless calm; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), gen. of attendant circumstance: ’in a calm’
glossary.νύξε: νύσσω — pierce, stab; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔνυξε): ’stabbed’
glossary.ξίφει: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. sg., of means: ’with a sword’
glossary.οἵω: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. dual nom., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’): ’such as the two’
glossary.πάθοι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή in past sequence: ’lest he suffer’
glossary.πέσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπεσον): ’they fell’
glossary.παισῷ: Παισός — Paesus, a town of the Troad; dat. sg.
glossary.παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.περγασίδην: Περγασίδης — son of Pergasus (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πεσόντ: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. dual, elided (πεσόντ’ = πεσόντε): ’the two as they fell’
glossary.πλέονες: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. nom. pl. πλέονες (= Attic πλείονες): ’more’
glossary.πλήξαντε: πλήσσω — strike, smite; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having struck’
glossary.πνοιῇσιν: πνοιή — blast, breath; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πνοαῖς), of means
glossary.πολέεσσ: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic πολέεσσι, elided (πολέεσσ’; = Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολεμιζέμεν: πολεμίζω — wage war, fight; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic πολεμίζειν): ’to wage war’
glossary.πολεμιστὴς: πολεμιστής — warrior, fighter; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολλοί: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.: ’many’
glossary.πολυκτήμων: πολυκτήμων — rich in possessions, of many possessions; adj. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολυλήϊος: πολυλήϊος — rich in cornfields, with many crops; adj. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προρέοντι: προρέω — flow forth, flow onward; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg., (Attic προρρέοντι, with ρρ)
glossary.προσβὰς: προσβαίνω — step upon, tread upon; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’having set foot on’
glossary.πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
glossary.πυλαιμένεα: Πυλαιμένης — Pylaemenes, leader of the Paphlagonians; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.πόνοιο: πόνος — toil, labour, work; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of what is lost after ἀποσφήλειε
glossary.πότνι: πότνια — lady, mistress; title of respect for goddesses; fem. nom. sg. (elided πότνι’)
glossary.σείων: σείω — shake, brandish; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’shaking’
glossary.σελάγου: Σέλαγος — Selagus, father of Amphius; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.στήῃ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 2 subj. 3 sg. intrans., epic uncontracted (= Attic στῇ), in a general simile after ὅτε: ’halts’
glossary.στρεφθέντε: στρέφω — turn; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. dual, intrans.: ’the two having turned’
glossary.συλήσων: συλάω — strip, despoil; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to strip’
glossary.σφας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. σφας, enclitic (= Attic σφᾶς, αὐτούς): ’them’
glossary.τάρφεσιν: τάρφος — thicket, dense cover; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.τετραμμένοι: τρέπω — turn; perf. mid./pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’turned, having turned’
glossary.τοίω: τοῖος — of such a kind, such; masc. dual nom., correlative of οἷος: ’such’
glossary.τύχε: τυγχάνω — hit upon, come upon (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., strong aor. unaugmented (= ἔτυχε): ’had come down on’
glossary.τῖον: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔτῑον): ’honoured’
glossary.φέβοντο: φέβομαι — flee, take flight; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., unaugmented (= ἐφέβοντο)
glossary.φευγόντων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl.: ’of men who flee’
glossary.φηρῇ: Φηρή (Φηραί) — Pherae, a town of Messenia; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.φοίτα: φοιτάω — go to and fro, range about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφοίτα)
glossary.φῶτε: φώς — man, fighter; masc. acc. dual: ’two men’
glossary.χεῖράς: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. pl., accented χεῖράς before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀέντες: ἄημι — blow (of wind); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic: ’blowing’
glossary.ἀγκῶνα: ἀγκών — elbow, bend of the arm; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκροπόλοισιν: ἀκρόπολος — high-peaked, lofty; dat. pl. in -οισιν, the same in all genders (= Attic -οις), of mountains
glossary.ἀλφειοῦ: Ἀλφειός — Alpheus, a river of the Peloponnese; masc. gen. sg., contracted -οῦ
glossary.ἀμάθοιο: ἄμαθος — sand (Attic ἄμμος); fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. after τυγχάνω
glossary.ἀμφίβασιν: ἀμφίβασις — a stepping round; a ring of men standing about (a rare word, the sense inferred); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀναιδέα: ἀναιδής — ruthless, shameless; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
glossary.ἀνεδέξατο: ἀναδέχομαι — take up, receive, catch; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (ἀνα- + ἐδέξατο): ’took, received’
glossary.ἀπάλαμνος: ἀπάλαμνος — without resource, helpless (ἀ- privative + παλάμη); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀποσφήλειε: ἀποσφάλλω — cause to fail, cheat (+ gen. of what is lost); aor. opt. 3 sg. act., after μή: ’lest he cheat … of’
glossary.ἀρνυμένω: ἄρνυμαι — win, earn, gain; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. dual: ’the two winning’
glossary.ἀσθμαίνων: ἀσθμαίνω — gasp, pant; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gasping’
glossary.ἀτυμνιάδην: Ἀτυμνιάδης — son of Atymnius (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀφελέσθαι: ἀφαιρέω — take away from; mid. take for oneself; aor. inf. mid. (+ gen. of the source): ’to take from’
glossary.ἀφρῷ: ἀφρός — foam; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’with foam’
glossary.ἁρπάζοντε: ἁρπάζω — seize, snatch, plunder; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two seizing’
glossary.ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl.: ’the other (things)’
glossary.ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
glossary.ἄμφιον: Ἄμφιος — Amphius, a Trojan ally, son of Selagus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄνδρεσσιν: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
glossary.ἐγχείην: ἐγχείη — spear (poetic); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η-, ἐγχείην (= Attic ἐγχείαν)
