glossary.ἐλάτῃσιν: ἐλάτη — fir, fir-tree; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), dative of likeness after ἐοικότες
glossary.ἐλέησε: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’pitied’
glossary.ἐλέησεν: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable), + acc.: ’pitied’
glossary.ἐλέφαντι: ἐλέφας — ivory, elephant; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’with ivory’
glossary.ἐπέδραμε: ἐπιτρέχω — run up, rush at; aor. 3 sg. (ἐπ- + ἔδραμε, strong aor. ἔδραμον): ’ran up’
glossary.ἐπείγετο: ἐπείγω — press, drive on; pass. be hard pressed; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was hard pressed, was driven on’
glossary.ἐπικουρήσοντα: ἐπικουρέω — aid, serve as an ally; fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to be an ally’
glossary.ἐσπάσατ: σπάω — draw, pull out; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐσπάσατ’ = ἐσπάσατο): ’drew out’
glossary.ἐτραφέτην: τρέφω — rear, nourish; pass. grow up; aor. pass. 3 dual (strong aor. ἐτράφην): ’the two were reared’
glossary.ἐφέστασαν: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. stand over, stand about; plpf. 3 pl. with the sense of an imperfect (= Attic ἐφειστήκεσαν): ’stood about’
glossary.ἐχέτην: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 dual act., unaugmented (= Attic εἰχέτην): ’the two held out’
glossary.ἐϋκτιμένῃ: ἐΰκτιμένος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), of a town
glossary.ἐόντε: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom./acc. dual, epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’the two being’
glossary.ἑλέτην: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic εἱλέτην): ’the two killed’
glossary.ἑπέσθην: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 3 dual mid. dep., root aorist (= Attic ἐσπέσθην): ’the two followed’
glossary.ἔγχε: ἔγχος — spear; neut. acc. pl., elided uncontracted (ἔγχε’ = ἔγχεα; Attic ἔγχη)
glossary.ἔδραμ: τρέχω — run; aor. 3 sg. (strong aor. ἔδραμον), elided (ἔδραμ’ = ἔδραμε); ἀνά … ἔδραμ’ ’ran back’
glossary.ἔμενον: μένω — wait, stand firm; impf. 3 pl.: ’stood their ground’
glossary.ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’
glossary.ἔναιεν: ναίω — dwell, live; impf. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’lived’
glossary.ἔρυσαν: ἐρύω (εἰρύω) — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἵλκυσαν): ’dragged’
glossary.ἔστησεν: ἵστημι — set, place, make stand (trans.); aor. 1 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’set, placed’
glossary.ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
glossary.ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕλεσθε: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’take to yourselves’
glossary.ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἡβήσαντε: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth, come to manhood; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having come to manhood’
glossary.ἡνίοχον: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤλασ: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλασ’ = ἤλασε): ’drove’
glossary.ἰωκάς: ἰωκή — onrush, onset of battle (sense uncertain: also taken as din, or rout and pursuit); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα
glossary.ἵμασ: ἱμάσσω — whip, lash; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἵμασ’ = ἵμασε): ’whipped on’
glossary.ὀξυόεντα: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. acc. pl., epic -εντα (ὀξύς ’sharp’)
glossary.ὀρσίλοχόν: Ὀρσίλοχος — Orsilochus, a Greek warrior, son of Diocles; masc. acc. sg., accented ὀρσίλοχόν before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὀρσίλοχός: Ὀρσίλοχος — Orsilochus, a Greek warrior, son of Diocles; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὀρτίλοχον: Ὀρτίλοχος — Ortilochus, son of Alpheus and father of Diocles; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀρτίλοχος: Ὀρτίλοχος — Ortilochus, son of Alpheus and father of Diocles; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
glossary.ὄρεσσιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ὄρεσι)
glossary.ὄρνυται: ὄρνυμι — stir up; mid./pass. rise, be roused; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’rises’
glossary.ὄτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνον): ’urged on’
glossary.ὑπέστρεφε: ὑποστρέφω — turn about, wheel round (trans.); impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was turning about’
glossary.ὑπεδείδισαν: ὑποδείδω — be afraid of, shrink before (δείδω + ὑπό); aor. 3 pl. act., epic reduplicated aor. ἐδείδισα, + acc.: ’were afraid of’
glossary.ὑψηλῇσι: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὠκυρόῳ: ὠκύροος — swift-flowing; adj., masc. dat. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὠκυρῷ)
glossary.ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’
glossary.ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’
glossary.ῥίγησε: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver (with fear or cold); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐρρίγησε): ’shuddered’
glossary.αἰολομίτρην: αἰολομίτρης — with glancing, gleaming belt; masc. acc. sg., epithet agreeing with a name
glossary.αἰτώλιον: Αἰτώλιος — Aetolian, of Aetolia; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun
glossary.βάρυνε: βαρύνω — weigh down, burden; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐβάρυνε): ’weighed on’
glossary.βεβλήκειν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; plpf. act., unaugmented: 3 sg. with ν-movable (= ἐβεβλήκει), or 3 pl. in -ειν (= ἐβεβλήκεσαν): ’had struck’
glossary.βοιωτοὶ: Βοιωτοί — the Boeotians, people of Boeotia; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γόνον: γόνος — offspring, child, stock; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative with an infinitive: ’the offspring (of Zeus)’
glossary.δαμέντα: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — subdue, overpower; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg., epic -ε- aorist (= Attic δαμασθέντα): ’overcome’
glossary.δεῖμα: δεῖμα — terror, fear; neut. acc. sg., object: ’terror’
glossary.διώκοι: διώκω — pursue, chase; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in an indirect deliberative question: ’whether he should pursue’
glossary.δούρατα: δόρυ — spear (also beam, timber); neut. nom./acc. pl. δούρατα, epic stem δουρατ- (= Attic δόρατα): ’spears’
glossary.δώσειν: δίδωμι — give; fut. inf. act., in indirect statement: ’that (you) will give’ · also fut. inf. act. after μέλλω: ’(was about) to give’
glossary.εὐφρανέειν: εὐφραίνω — gladden, cheer; fut. inf. act., epic uncontracted -έειν (= Attic εὐφρανεῖν), after μέλλω: ’to gladden’
glossary.ζώγρει: ζωγρέω — revive, bring back to life (lit. take alive); impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐζώγρει): ’revived’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’take alive!’
glossary.θρασυμέμνονα: θρασυμέμνων — bold of purpose, stout-hearted (second element probably from μέμονα; formation uncertain); masc. acc. sg., epithet of a hero
glossary.θυμολέοντα: θυμολέων — lion-hearted; masc. acc. sg., compound epithet (θυμός + λέων)
glossary.θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
glossary.κέχυτ: χέω — pour, shed; plpf. pass. 3 sg., elided (κέχυτ’ = κέχυτο), unaugmented: ’was poured’
glossary.κείνων: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’of those (men)’
glossary.κεκαφηότα: κεκαφηότα — spent of breath, gasping, exhausted (lemma disputed, perhaps an old verb meaning ’breathe out, gasp’); rare perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg.; formation not fully understood
glossary.κεκλιμένος: κλίνω — lean, recline; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’lying, resting’
glossary.κεῖσθαι: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. inf. mid. dep.: ’to lie’
glossary.κηφισίδι: Κηφισίς — of the Cephisus, Cephisian; fem. adj., dat. sg. Κηφισίδι, agreeing with a fem. noun
glossary.κλυτοπώλῳ: κλυτόπωλος — of famous horses; masc. dat. sg., epithet of a god
glossary.κοίρανον: Κοίρανος — Coeranus, a Lycian warrior (the name also means ’ruler’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κτάνε: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔκτανε): ’killed’
glossary.λίμνῃ: λίμνη — pool, lake; fem. dat. sg., of place: ’by the lake’
glossary.λίποι: λείπω — leave, abandon; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., wish: ’may it leave’
glossary.μαίμησε: μαιμάω — rage, surge, be eager; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐμαίμησε): ’raged’
glossary.μαίνεσθαι: μαίνομαι — rage, be mad; pres. inf. mid./pass. dep.: ’to rage’
glossary.μαιμώωσα: μαιμάω — rage, strain eagerly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., diectasis (= Attic μαιμῶσα): ’raging’
glossary.μείλινον: μείλινος — of ash-wood, ashen; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun
glossary.μεγαλήτορι: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μεμηλώς: μέλω (μέλομαι) — be a care, care for; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg. μεμηλώς + gen.: ’concerned with, taking care of’
glossary.μερμήριξε: μερμηρίζω — ponder, devise, turn over in the mind; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐμερμήριξε)
glossary.μόρσιμον: μόρσιμος — destined, fated, allotted; neut. nom./acc. sg., predicative with εἰμί: ’it is fated’
glossary.ναίεσκε: ναίω — dwell; impf. 3 sg. act., iterative -εσκε, unaugmented (= ἔναιε): ’used to dwell’
glossary.νεφεληγερέταο: νεφεληγερέτης — cloud-gatherer, epithet of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νοήμονά: Νοήμων — Noemon, a Lycian warrior (the name means ’thoughtful’); masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οἰνοπίδην: Οἰνοπίδης — son of Oenops, patronymic; masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a name
glossary.οἰνόμαόν: Οἰνόμαος — Oenomaus, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οἴῃς: οἶος — alone, only; fem. dat. pl., Ionic -ῃς (= Attic -αις), agreeing with a fem. noun: ’only’ (distinct from οἷος ’such as’)
glossary.παρήϊξεν: παραΐσσω — dart past, rush past; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with ν-movable (= Attic παρῇξε)
glossary.παυροτέροισιν: παῦρος — few, little; comp. παυρότερος, masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’fewer’
glossary.πελάγων: Πελάγων — Pelagon, a Lycian companion of Sarpedon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.περήσειν: περάω — pass through, cross; fut. inf. act., uncontracted (= Attic περᾶν), in indirect statement: ’that (you) will pass’
glossary.πλέονας: πλείων (comparative of πολύς) — more, greater in number; masc. acc. pl., epic πλέονας (= Attic πλείονας)
glossary.πλεόνων: πλείων (comparative of πολύς) — more, greater in number; masc. gen. pl., epic πλεόνων (= Attic πλειόνων): ’of more’
glossary.πλούτοιο: πλοῦτος — wealth, riches; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πνοιὴ: πνοιή — blast, breath, gust; fem. nom. sg. (Attic πνοιά)
glossary.πολέων: πολύς — much, many; masc. gen. pl., uncontracted epic πολέων (= Attic πολλῶν): ’of many’
glossary.ποτὲ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; adv. · with a negative (οὔτε ποτὲ), ’never’
glossary.πριαμίδη: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam, patronymic; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.προσιόντι: πρόσειμι (πρός + εἶμι) — go toward, approach; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’as he approached’
glossary.προτέρων: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’of earlier (men)’
glossary.προτρέποντο: προτρέπω (mid. προτρέπομαι) — turn forward, turn toward; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= προὐτρέποντο): ’turned and made for’
glossary.πρύτανίν: Πρύτανις — Prytanis, a Lycian warrior; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πτώσσειν: πτώσσω — cower, shrink in fear (also go cringing); pres. inf. act. (= Attic πτήσσειν)
glossary.σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’
glossary.σαρπηδόνα: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σαρπηδόνι: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.σαρπῆδον: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. voc. sg., accent drawn back in address
glossary.σπευδόντων: σπεύδω — hasten, be eager; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl., in a genitive absolute: ’as (they) hurried’
glossary.τίνα: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. acc. sg.: ’whom?’
glossary.τεύθραντ: Τεύθρας — Teuthras, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg., elided (τεύθραντ’ = Τεύθραντα)
glossary.τεύξεσθαι: τεύχω — make, build, bring about; fut. inf. mid. τεύξεσθαι, passive in sense, in indirect statement: ’will be brought about’ (same form as the fut. of τυγχάνω)
glossary.τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’
glossary.τλήμονα: τλήμων — enduring, steadfast, bold; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τληπόλεμ: Τληπόλεμος — Tlepolemus (’enduring war’), son of Heracles; masc. voc. sg., elided (τληπόλεμ’ = Τληπόλεμε), in address
glossary.τληπόλεμον: Τληπόλεμος — Tlepolemus (’enduring war’), son of Heracles; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τράπε: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτραπε): ’turned’
glossary.τρῆχόν: Τρῆχος — Trechus, an Aetolian warrior; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.φασι: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl. act. (= Attic φασί)
glossary.φηγῷ: φηγός — oak (a tree with edible acorns); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φωτί: φώς — man, mortal (distinct from φῶς ’light’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.χάζονθ: χάζομαι — give ground, draw back; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided and aspirated (χάζονθ’ = χάζοντο): ’gave ground’
glossary.χάλκεος: χάλκεος — of bronze, bronze; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦς)
glossary.χάρη: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg. pass. dep., unaugmented (= ἐχάρη): ’was glad’
glossary.χήρωσε: χηρόω — bereave, leave desolate (make widowed); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐχήρωσε)
glossary.χαλκοκορυστῇ: χαλκοκορυστής — armed in bronze; masc. dat. sg., epithet
glossary.ψευδόμενοι: ψεύδομαι — lie, speak falsely; pres. part. mid./pass. dep. masc. nom. pl.: ’lying’
glossary.ψυχὴν: ψυχή — soul, life-breath; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
glossary.ἀγυιάς: ἀγυιά — street, highway; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀδαήμονι: ἀδαήμων — ignorant, unskilled (+ gen.); adj. of two endings, masc. dat. sg.: ’ignorant of’
glossary.ἀλεγεινή: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνάγκη: ἀνάγκη — necessity, constraint; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνέσχετο: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise (mid. ἀνέχομαι also endure); aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented after the preverb: ’held up, raised’
glossary.ἀντεφέροντο: ἀντιφέρομαι — set oneself against, withstand (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented after the preverb: ’withstood’
glossary.ἀπέδωχ: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, return; aor. 3 sg. act., κ-aorist, elided and aspirated (ἀπέδωχ’ = ἀπέδωκε): ’gave back’
glossary.ἀποκτάμεν: ἀποκτείνω — kill; aor. inf. act., root aorist, epic -μεν (= Attic ἀποκτεῖναι): ’to kill’
glossary.ἀποφθινύθουσι: ἀποφθινύθω — perish, waste away; pres. 3 pl. act. (= Attic ἀποφθίνουσι): ’are dying off’
glossary.ἀπώλεσεν: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented after the preverb, with ν-movable (= ἀπώλεσε): ’destroyed’
glossary.ἀφραδίῃσιν: ἀφραδίη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. dat. pl., Ionic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀφραδίαις): ’through folly’
glossary.ἀχλύς: ἀχλύς — mist, dimness, haze; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁμαρτῇ: ἁμαρτῇ — together, at the same moment; adv., epic (cf. ἅμα)
glossary.ἄλκανδρόν: Ἄλκανδρος — Alcandrus, a Lycian warrior; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic θ’ (= τε)
glossary.ἄλκαρ: ἄλκαρ — defence, protection, ward; neut. nom./acc. sg., predicate: ’a defence’
glossary.ἅλιόν: Ἅλιος — Halius, a Lycian warrior (also the adj. ἅλιος ’vain’); masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; fut. 1 pl. act. + acc. and inf.: ’we will allow (him) to’
glossary.ἐάσῃς: ἐάω — let, allow; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in a prohibition with μή: ’do not let’
glossary.ἐγχριμφθεῖσα: ἐγχρίμπτομαι — graze, press close upon (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. dep. fem. nom. sg.: ’grazing’
glossary.ἐμπνύνθη: ἐμπνύω (ἐμπνύνω) — recover breath, revive; aor. 3 sg. pass. form, intrans. in sense, unaugmented (preverb ἐν-): ’recovered his breath’
glossary.ἐξέφερον: ἐκφέρω — carry out, bear out; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented after the preverb: ’were bearing out’
glossary.ἐξαλάπαξε: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack utterly, plunder; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐξηλάπαξε): ’plundered’
glossary.ἐξεγένοντο: ἐκγίγνομαι — be born from, spring from; aor. 3 pl. dep., augmented after the preverb, + gen.: ’were born of’
glossary.ἐξενάριξαν: ἐξεναρίζω — kill and strip of armour; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented after the preverb: ’killed and stripped’
glossary.ἐξερύσαι: ἐξερύω — draw out, pull out; aor. inf. act.: ’to pull out’
glossary.ἐπάμυνον: ἐπαμύνω — come to the defence of, help; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’defend, help’
glossary.ἐπεφράσατ: ἐπιφράζομαι — notice, take note of, think of; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεφράσατ’ = ἐπεφράσατο)
glossary.ἐπιβαίη: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, mount, tread; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that he might step’
glossary.ἐπιπνείουσα: ἐπιπνέω — blow upon, breathe on; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic πνείω (= Attic ἐπιπνέουσα): ’blowing on’
glossary.ἐπύθοντο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, find out; aor. 3 pl. mid. dep., augmented: ’learned’
glossary.ἐρεβεννὴ: ἐρεβεννός — dark, murky; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐριγδούποιο: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, loud-thundering; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Zeus, epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑλκόμενον: ἕλκω — drag, pull, trail; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. sg.: ’being dragged, trailing’
glossary.ἔλιπε: λείπω — leave, forsake; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
glossary.ἔσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf.: ’to be, will be’
glossary.ἕλενον: Ἕλενος — Helenus, a Greek warrior (not Priam’s son); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕρξαντα: ἔρδω — do, perform; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg. ἕρξαντα: ’having done’ (εὖ ἕρξαντα ’having done well by’)
glossary.ἠΰν: ἠΰς (ἐΰς) — good, noble, brave; masc. acc. sg., epic ἠΰν (= Attic ἀγαθόν)
glossary.ἡρακλεΐδην: Ἡρακλεΐδης — son of Heracles, patronymic; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἡρακληείην: Ἡρακληεῖος (Ἡρακληείη) — of Heracles; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἡρακλεία), with βίην: ’the might of Heracles’
glossary.ἤϊξαν: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (ἤϊξαν = Attic ᾖξαν): ’darted’
glossary.ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’came, went’
glossary.ἱρὴν: ἱερός (epic ἱρός) — holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
glossary.ἴφθιμος: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
glossary.ὀλέκοντας: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl. (= Attic ἀπολλύντας): ’destroying’
glossary.ὀλοφυδνὸν: ὀλοφυδνός — lamenting, mournful; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’a word of lament’
glossary.ὀρέσβιον: Ὀρέσβιος — Oresbius, a Greek warrior of Hyle (the name means ’mountain-living’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀρέστην: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀστέω: ὀστέον — bone; neut. dat. sg., uncontracted epic stem, printed without iota subscript (= ὀστέῳ; Attic ὀστοῦν, dat. ὀστῷ)
glossary.ὑμετέρῃ: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑπέστημεν: ὑφίσταμαι — undertake, promise; 2nd aor. 1 pl. (act. form, intrans.): ’we undertook’
glossary.ὕλῃ: Ὕλη — Hyle, a town in Boeotia (the same word as ὕλη ’woodland’); fem. dat. sg., of place
glossary.ὕστατον: ὕστατος — last; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τίνα, or neut. acc. sg. as adv.: ’last’
glossary.ὤσαιτ: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤσαιτ’ = ὤσαιτο), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’he might thrust back’
glossary.αἰδὼς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. nom. sg., in exclamation: ’shame!’
glossary.αὐδήσασχ: αὐδάω — speak, call aloud; aor. iterative 3 sg. αὐδήσασκε (-σκ-, unaugmented), elided with κ aspirated to χ before the rough breathing of ὅσον: ’used to shout’
glossary.αὐτάων: αὐτός — self, same; in the oblique cases ’him, her, it, them’; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic αὐτῶν): ’them’
glossary.αὐτόμαται: αὐτόματος — self-moved, of its own accord; fem. nom. pl., agreeing with πύλαι
glossary.βάλετ: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (βάλετ’ = ἐβάλετο); in tmesis ἀμφὶ … βάλετ’ ’threw around (oneself)’
glossary.βριθὺ: βριθύς — heavy; neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος
glossary.γοργείη: Γοργεῖος — of the Gorgon; fem. nom. sg., epic -είη (= Attic Γοργεία), agreeing with κεφαλή
glossary.δάμνησι: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, tame (= Attic δαμάζω); pres. indic. 3 sg. act., -μι ending -ησι: ’beats down’
glossary.δέδυκεν: δύω — sink, plunge, enter; perf. 3 sg. intrans., ν-movable (= δέδυκε): ’has sunk (into)’, + acc.
glossary.δίφρος: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δαίνυσθαί: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι, feast, banquet; pres. inf. mid., after ἄνωγον: ’to feast’
glossary.δακρυόεντα: δακρυόεις — tearful, causing tears; masc. acc. sg., epic -όεντα, agreeing with πόλεμον
glossary.δαρδανιάων: Δαρδάνιος — Dardanian, of Dardanus (i.e. Trojan); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with πυλάων
glossary.δεινή: δεινός — dread, terrible; fem. nom. sg., predicate with κεφαλή
glossary.δεινήν: δεινός — dread, terrible; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with αἰγίδα
glossary.δεινοῖο: δεινός — dread, terrible; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with πελώρου
glossary.δῆσε: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔδησε): ’tied’
glossary.εἰλόμενοι: εἴλω (εἰλέω) — press, crowd together; mid./pass. εἴλομαι; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’pressed close together’
glossary.εἰσαμένη: εἴδομαι — seem, appear; aor. εἰσάμην, make oneself like (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’making herself like’
glossary.εἴασκον: ἐάω — allow, let be; impf. iterative 1 sg. (or 3 pl.) act., -σκ- suffix, augmented εἰ-: ’used to allow, would let’
glossary.εἴωθε: ἔωθα (εἴωθα) — be accustomed, be wont; perf. 3 sg. with present sense: ’is accustomed’, + inf.
glossary.εὐκύκλου: εὔκυκλος — well-rounded, with a good circle; gen. sg. of an adj. of two endings, fem., agreeing with ἀσπίδος
glossary.ζυγοῦ: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. gen. sg., object of ἅπτομαι (+ gen.): ’of the yoke’
glossary.ζυγόν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., object of δέω: ’a yoke’
glossary.ζυγὸν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., after ὑπό in tmesis with ἤγαγεν: ’under the yoke’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ὑπέρ: ’over the yoke’ (ὑπὲρ ζυγόν)
glossary.ζῆν: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Ζῆν (elided Ζῆν’ = Ζῆνα), object of ἐξείρετο
glossary.θέμιστα: θέμις — what is right, custom, law; acc. pl. θέμιστα (Attic θέμιστας), or acc. sg. on a stem θεμιστ-; the form is uncertain: ’rules of right’
glossary.θήβας: Θῆβαι — Thebes; fem. acc. pl. (plural place-name), after ἐς: ’to Thebes’
glossary.θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’
glossary.θυσσανόεσσαν: θυσσανόεις — tasselled, fringed; fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσαν (= -όεισαν), agreeing with αἰγίδα
glossary.θωρήσσετο: θωρήσσω — arm; mid. θωρήσσομαι, arm oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐθωρήσσετο): ’armed herself’
glossary.κάμνε: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμνε): ’grew weary’
glossary.κάπροισιν: κάπρος — wild boar; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), in apposition after ἐοικότες
glossary.καδμείων: Καδμεῖοι — Cadmeans, the Thebans; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Cadmeans’
glossary.καδμείωνας: Καδμείων — a Cadmean, a Theban; masc. acc. pl. Καδμείωνας, -ων- stem by-form of Καδμείους, after μετά
glossary.κακῇς: κακός — bad, evil, grievous; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic κακαῖς), agreeing with ὀδύνῃσι
glossary.καρτερὰ: καρτερός — strong, mighty; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.καρτερὸν: καρτερός — strong, mighty, staunch; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν
glossary.κεντρηνεκέας: κεντρηνεκής — goad-driven, urged on by the goad (κέντρον ’goad’ + a root meaning ’carry’; sense debated); masc. acc. pl., epic -έας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.κοτέσσεται: κοτέομαι — bear a grudge, be angry (+ dat.); aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., short vowel, epic -σσ-: ’is angered’, in a general relative clause with τε
glossary.κρυόεσσα: κρυόεις — chilling, icy; fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα (= -όεισα), agreeing with Ἰωκή
glossary.κρόνοιο: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κύκλα: κύκλος — circle, wheel; neut. pl. κύκλα beside masc. κύκλοι; acc. pl.: ’wheels’
glossary.κύπρίς: Κύπρις — Cypris, i.e. Aphrodite; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λέπαδνα: λέπαδνον — yoke-strap, breast-strap (fastening the yoke); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λείουσιν: λέων — lion; masc. dat. pl., epic λείουσιν (= Attic λέουσιν), after ἐοικότες
glossary.λεύσσων: λεύσσω — look, gaze; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gazing’
glossary.λυγρῶς: λυγρῶς — wretchedly, grievously; adv. of λυγρός
glossary.μάν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (Doric form of μήν), ἄγρει μάν ’come now’
glossary.μάστιγι: μάστιξ — whip, lash; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with the whip’
glossary.μαχητής: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’a fighter’
glossary.μεμαυῖ: μέμαα — be eager, strive (perf. with present sense); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (μεμαυῖ’ = μεμαυῖα), + gen.: ’eager for’
glossary.μεμαυῖαι: μέμαα — be eager, strive (perf. with present sense); perf. part. act. fem. nom. pl., agreeing with αἳ (a dual subject); + inf.: ’eager to’
glossary.μεσσηγὺς: μεσσηγύς — between, in the midst; adv./prep. + gen.: ’between’
glossary.μικρὸς: μικρός — small, little; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.μύκον: μυκάομαι — low, bellow; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔμυκον): ’bellowed’
glossary.νέμεσθαι: νέμομαι — graze, pasture, feed; pres. inf. mid., of purpose: ’to feed on’
glossary.νεμεσίζῃ: νεμεσίζομαι — feel resentment at, be indignant at (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. mid. -ῃ: οὐ νεμεσίζῃ ’do you not resent?’
glossary.οἰνεΐδαο: Οἰνείδης — son of Oeneus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἴχνεσκον: οἰχνέω — go, come, go about; impf. iterative 3 pl., -σκ- suffix, unaugmented: ’used to go (out)’
glossary.οἷσίν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc./neut. dat. pl., accented before an enclitic, with κοτέσσεται (+ dat.): ’with whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οὐρανὸς: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὔδει: οὖδας — ground, floor (Attic ἔδαφος); neut. dat. sg. οὔδει (also οὔδεϊ): ’on the floor’
glossary.οὔλυμπός: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. nom. sg., epic Οὔ- (= Attic Ὄλυμπος)
glossary.πέπλον: πέπλος — robe, woman’s garment; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πελάζειν: πελάζω — bring near, make approach (+ dat.); pres. inf. act., transitive: ’to bring near to’
glossary.πελειάσιν: πέλεια — dove, rock-pigeon; fem. dat. pl., epic -άσιν (= Attic -αις), after ὁμοῖαι
glossary.πελώρου: πέλωρον — monster, portent (adj. πέλωρος ’monstrous’); neut. gen. sg. πελώρου
glossary.πεπληγυῖα: πλήσσω — strike; perf. act. part. fem. nom. sg., with aorist sense: ’having struck’
glossary.περίδρομοι: περίδρομος — running round, encircling; adj. of two endings, nom. pl.
glossary.πλατέος: πλατύς — broad, wide; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with τελαμῶνος
glossary.πλῆμναι: πλήμνη — hub, nave (of a wheel); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ποιήσατο: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’made for herself’
glossary.ποικίλον: ποικίλος — intricately wrought, many-coloured, dappled; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πέπλον
glossary.πολυᾶϊξ: πολυάϊξ — darting about much, rushing again and again (πολύς + ἀΐσσω); masc. nom. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with κάματος
glossary.ποταμώ: ποταμός — river; masc. dual, acc. (object of ἷξον) with ῥέοντε: ’the two rivers’
glossary.πουλὺν: πολύς — much, vast (epic πουλύς); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠέρα: ’a great (mist)’
glossary.πρέσβα: πρέσβα (poet. fem. of πρέσβυς) — eldest, first in rank; august, revered; fem. nom./voc. sg., in apposition to a goddess’s name
glossary.προσαρηρότα: προσαραρίσκω — fit to, attach to; perf. part. act. neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἐπίσσωτρα: ’fitted on’
glossary.προφρονέως: προφρονέως — readily, willingly, eagerly; adv. of πρόφρων (-έως = Attic -όνως)
glossary.πρυλέεσσ: πρύλις (pl. πρυλέες) — foot-soldier, man fighting on foot; masc. dat. pl., elided epic -έεσσι (πρυλέεσσ’), dative of interest with ἀραρυῖαν: ’for the foot-soldiers’
glossary.πυλάων: πύλη — gate; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
glossary.σιδηρέῳ: σιδήρεος — of iron; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -έῳ (= Attic σιδηρῷ), agreeing with ἄξονι
glossary.σιμόεις: Σιμόεις — the Simois, a river of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σκάμανδρος: Σκάμανδρος — the Scamander, a river of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σκοπιῇ: σκοπιή — lookout, watching-place; fem. dat. sg.: ’on a lookout’
glossary.σμερδνή: σμερδνός — frightful, dreadful; fem. nom. sg., predicate with κεφαλή
glossary.στέντορι: Στέντωρ — Stentor, a Greek herald of enormous voice; masc. dat. sg., with εἰσαμένη
glossary.στήσασα: ἵστημι — set, make stand, bring to a stop; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having stopped’
glossary.στᾶσ: ἵστημι — set; aor. ἔστην, intrans., take one’s stand; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (στᾶσ’ = στᾶσα): ’having taken her stand’
glossary.συσὶ: σῦς — pig, boar; masc./fem. dat. pl., after ἐοικότες, with κάπροισιν: ’boars’
glossary.τέρπονται: τέρπω — delight, gladden; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’take delight, enjoy themselves’
glossary.τελαμῶνα: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τελαμῶνος: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. gen. sg. · also Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τετραφάληρον: τετραφάληρος — with four φάλοι (crest-holders or plates; exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with κυνέην
glossary.τρήρωσι: τρήρων — timorous, shy (of doves); adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., agreeing with πελειάσιν
glossary.τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): relative ’to whom’
glossary.φλόγεα: φλόγεος — flaming, fiery; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, agreeing with ὄχεα
glossary.φυλάσσω: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; pres. indic. 1 sg.: ’I guard’
glossary.χάλκε: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (χάλκε’ = χάλκεα), epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκᾶ), agreeing with ἐπίσσωτρα or κύκλα
glossary.χάλκεα: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκᾶ), agreeing with κύκλα
glossary.χαλκεοφώνῳ: χαλκεόφωνος — with a bronze voice, brazen-voiced; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with Στέντορι
glossary.χιτῶν: χιτών — tunic; masc. acc. sg., elided (χιτῶν’ = χιτῶνα)
glossary.χρυσέη: χρύσεος — golden; fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῆ)
glossary.χρυσέοισι: χρύσεος — golden; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έοισι (= Attic χρυσοῖς), agreeing with ἱμᾶσιν
glossary.χρυσείην: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κυνέην
glossary.χρύσει: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (χρύσει’ = χρύσεια), agreeing with λέπαδνα
glossary.χρύσειον: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -ειον (= Attic -οῦν), agreeing with ζυγόν
glossary.ἀγελείην: ἀγελείη — epithet of Athena, ’driver of spoil’ or ’leader of the host’ (ἄγω + λεία ’booty’, or ἀγέλη); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγητοί: ἀγητός — wondered at, admirable (ἀγάομαι); masc. nom. pl., in address with Ἀργεῖοι: ’admirable’
glossary.ἀκήριον: ἀκήριος — spiritless, faint-hearted (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is inferred); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέος
glossary.ἀλαπαδνόν: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; neut. nom. sg., predicate with σθένος
glossary.ἀμφίς: ἀμφίς — on both sides, around; adv., or postpositive prep. + acc.: ’round about’
glossary.ἀμφίφαλον: ἀμφίφαλος — with a φάλος (crest-holder) on each side, two-ridged; fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with κυνέην
glossary.ἀμφοτέρωθεν: ἀμφότερος — both; adv. with suffix -θεν: ’on both sides’
glossary.ἀνέντες: ἀνίημι — send up, let loose, let go; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having let loose’
glossary.ἀνέτειλε: ἀνατέλλω — make rise, cause to spring up; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive, augmented: ’made spring up’
glossary.ἀνακλῖναι: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, lay back, draw back; aor. inf. act.: ’to open (by drawing back)’
glossary.ἀναψύχοντα: ἀναψύχω — cool, refresh, let cool; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνακτα: ’cooling’
glossary.ἀπομόργνυ: ἀπομόργνυμι — wipe off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἀπεμόργνυ): ’wiped away, was wiping off’
glossary.ἀπώλεσε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed’
glossary.ἀραρυῖαν: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fit; perf. part. act. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κυνέην: ’fitted (for)’
glossary.ἀργύρεος: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀστερόεντος: ἀστερόεις — starry, star-spangled; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with οὐρανοῦ
glossary.ἄγρει: ἄγρει — come now! up!; epic interjection with an imper. sense (perhaps from ἀγρέω ’take’)
glossary.ἄκρῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, at the tip; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἐπ’ ἄκρῳ ’at the tip’)
glossary.ἄντυγές: ἄντυξ — rim, rail (of a chariot or shield); fem. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic εἰσι
glossary.ἄνωγον: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); past (impf. or plpf.) 1 sg. or 3 pl., unaugmented (augmented ἤνωγον): ’I bade, they bade’
glossary.ἄρῃ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic Ἄρῃ (= Attic Ἄρει), with νεμεσίζῃ: ’at Ares’
glossary.ἄφθιτος: ἄφθιτος — unfailing, imperishable, undying; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἴτυς
glossary.ἄφρονα: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τοῦτον · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κούρην: ’senseless (girl)’
glossary.ἐδείδισαν: δείδω (δείδια) — fear, be afraid; aor. 3 pl., epic -σαν built on the stem δειδ- (= ἔδεισαν): ’they feared’
glossary.ἐκπαιφάσσειν: ἐκπαιφάσσω — dart out, dash out (rare; the sense is not certain); pres. inf. act., after εἴασκον
glossary.ἐλέγχεα: ἔλεγχος — reproach, disgrace; neut. nom./voc./acc. pl., epic (Attic masc. ἔλεγχοι); in address: ’you disgraces’
glossary.ἐνδῦσα: ἐνδύω — put on, enter; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (strong aor. ἐνέδυν): ’having put on’, + acc.
glossary.ἐντέταται: ἐντείνω — stretch tight in, string; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is strung’
glossary.ἐξαποδίωμαι: ἐξαποδίεμαι (cf. δίεμαι ’chase, drive’) — drive out and away, chase out; pres. subj. mid. 1 sg. in -ωμαι after αἴ κεν, with ἐκ and ἀπό as compound preverbs; the formation is archaic
glossary.ἐξείρετο: ἐξείρομαι — ask out, inquire of (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’questioned’
glossary.ἐπίσσωτρα: ἐπίσσωτρον — tyre, rim-plate (the metal band on a wheel); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπεμαίετ: ἐπιμαίομαι — touch, reach at, lay a hand on (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεμαίετ’ = ἐπεμαίετο): ’laid on at’
glossary.ἐπιθεῖναι: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, lay over; aor. inf. act.: ’to shut (by laying over)’
glossary.ἐπιθρῴσκουσι: ἐπιθρῴσκω — leap upon, leap onward; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἐπιτάρροθος: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally (formation obscure); masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj. used as noun), predicate
glossary.ἐπιτέτραπται: ἐπιτρέπω — entrust, turn over to (+ dat.); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is entrusted’
glossary.ἐποιχομένη: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, go about, ply; go at, assail; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐστεφάνωται: στεφανόω — wreathe, encircle (στέφανος ’crown’); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wreathed round’
glossary.ἑανὸν: ἑανός — fine, soft, flowing (of cloth; sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πέπλον
glossary.ἑκὰς: ἑκάς — far, far off; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’
glossary.ἔκγονός: ἔκγονος — offspring, descendant; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι
glossary.ἔντυεν: ἐντύνω (epic ἐντύω) — make ready, harness, equip; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was making ready’
glossary.ἔπορσον: ἐπόρνυμι — rouse against, set upon; aor. imper. 2 sg. act. (ἐπ- + ὄρσον, from ὄρνυμι), + dat. of the target and acc. of the one roused: ’rouse (her) against (him)’
glossary.ἔτειρεν: τείρω — wear out, distress; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was wearing down’
glossary.ἔχευε: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (contrast unaugmented χεῦεν/χεῦον of the same verb): ’poured’
glossary.ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕκηλον: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed, in peace; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠέρα: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; masc. acc. sg., epic ἠέρα (= Attic ἀέρα)
glossary.ἠεροειδὲς: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, hazy (ἀήρ + εἶδος); neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, ’the misty-looking distance’
glossary.ἤϋσε: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ἤϋσε): ’shouted’
glossary.ἥμενος: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἰωκή: ἰωκή — onset, battle-rush, pursuit; fem. nom. sg., personified (Ἰωκή)
glossary.ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’)
glossary.ἱμᾶσιν: ἱμάς — leather strap, thong; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἱππείου: ἵππειος — of a horse, of horses; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ζυγοῦ
glossary.ἴθμαθ: ἴθμα — step, gait; neut. acc. pl., elided with aspiration before the rough breathing of ὁμοῖαι (ἴθμαθ’ = ἴθματα), of respect: ’in their gait’
glossary.ἴσχων: ἴσχω — hold, hold back; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’; with ἀνά in tmesis (ἂν … ἴσχων): ’holding up’
glossary.ἴτυς: ἴτυς — rim (of a wheel); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
glossary.ὀβριμοπάτρη: ὀβριμοπάτρη — epithet of Athena alone: ’of the mighty father’ (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀκτάκνημα: ὀκτάκνημος — eight-spoked (ὀκτώ + κνήμη ’leg’, i.e. spoke); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with κύκλα
glossary.ὀχέεσσι: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὄχοις)
glossary.ὁμοῖαι: ὅμοιος — like, similar (+ dat.); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with αἳ (a dual subject)
glossary.ὁσσάτιόν: ὁσσάτιος — as great, how great (epic, = ὅσος); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὄχεα: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. acc. pl., after ἐς: ’into the chariot’
glossary.ὑψηχέες: ὑψηχής — high-sounding, loud-sounding (ὑψι + ἠχέω); masc./fem. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
glossary.ὕπατον: ὕπατος — highest, supreme (superl. of ὕπερ); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Κρονίδην
glossary.ὠκύποδας: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
glossary.ὠμοφάγοισιν: ὠμοφάγος — eating raw flesh (ὠμός + φαγεῖν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with λείουσιν
glossary.ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.; personified Ὧραι, the Hours, keepers of the gates of heaven
glossary.ῥέοντε: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. act. masc. dual, nom./acc., agreeing with ποταμώ
glossary.αἰνῇσιν: αἰνός — dreadful, grim, terrible; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.βριθοσύνῃ: βριθοσύνη — heaviness, weight; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’under the weight’
glossary.βροτολοιγὸν: βροτολοιγός — ruinous to mortals, man-destroying (epithet of Ares); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γένευ: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic unaugmented and uncontracted (= Attic ἐγένου): ’you were born’
glossary.γιγνώσκω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise, understand; pres. 1 sg.: ’I know, I recognise’
glossary.δάμνημ: δάμνημι — subdue, tame, overpower; pres. 1 sg., epic athematic, elided (δάμνημ’ = δάμνημι; Attic δαμάζω): ’I subdue’
glossary.δίφροιο: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot (also a stool, seat); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δείδιθι: δείδω — fear, be afraid; rare perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’fear!’, + acc. of what is feared
glossary.δείσαντας: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’having feared, in fear’
glossary.δεδμήμεσθα: δάμνημι — tame, subdue; perf. pass. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we have been subdued, we are subject’
glossary.δεινὴν: δεινός — fearsome, terrible, awful; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δεκάχιλοι: δεκάχιλοι — ten thousand (δέκα + χίλιοι); numeral adj., masc. nom. pl. (Attic μύριοι)
glossary.δεύτερος: δεύτερος — second, next; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεῖξεν: δείκνυμι — show, point out, display; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -ξεν (= Attic ἔδειξε), unaugmented: ’showed’
glossary.δυσαέος: δυσαής — ill-blowing, of foul wind; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς), agreeing with ἀνέμοιο
glossary.δῦν: δύνω (= δύω) — go into, put on; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (δῦν’ = δῦνε; Attic ἔδυνε): ’put on’
glossary.εἰμὲν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
glossary.εἴας: ἐάω — allow, permit, let; impf. 2 sg., augmented (ἐ- → εἰ-): ’you allowed’
glossary.ζωννύσκετο: ζώννυμι — gird; mid. gird oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐζώννυτο): ’used to gird himself’
glossary.ζὼς: ζωός — alive, living; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic contracted ζώς (Attic ζῶν)
glossary.κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun in apposition to a person: ’an evil, a bane’ (τυκτὸν κακόν ’a fashioned evil’)
glossary.καύματος: καῦμα — burning heat, scorching; neut. gen. sg.: ’of heat’
glossary.κείνης: κεῖνος (= ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; demonstrative, fem. gen. sg. (epic for Attic ἐκείνης)
glossary.κτείνων: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’killing’
glossary.κυκόωντι: κυκάω — stir, mix; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -όωντι (= Attic κυκῶντι): ’for one stirring’
glossary.λέλασται: λανθάνω — escape notice; mid. forget (+ gen.); perf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic λέλησται): ’has forgotten’
glossary.λοῦσεν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔλουσε): ’bathed’
glossary.μέμηλεν: μέλω — be a care to (someone); perf. 3 sg. act. (pres. force), + dat. of the person: ’is a care to’
glossary.μέμνημαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember; perf. 1 sg. mid. with present sense, + gen.: ’I remember’
glossary.μίτρῃ: μίτρη — belt, belly-guard (a metal guard worn at the waist); fem. dat. sg., of means or accompaniment
glossary.μαινόμενον: μαίνομαι — rage, be mad, rave; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’raving’
glossary.μαργαίνειν: μαργαίνω — rage, be frenzied, be furious; pres. inf. act.: ’to rage’
glossary.μαχήσεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight; fut. inf. mid. dep., epic μαχήσομαι (= Attic μαχοῦμαι), + dat.: ’to fight against’
glossary.μαχόμεσθα: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. 1 pl. mid. dep., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα), + dat.: ’we fight against’
glossary.μιαιφόνος: μιαιφόνος — blood-stained, murderous (μιαίνω ’stain’ + φόνος ’slaughter’); adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.μινύριζε: μινυρίζω — whimper, moan softly; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., with μή: ’do not moan’
glossary.νέοντο: νέομαι — go, come back, return; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic, unaugmented (Attic ἔρχομαι): ’went back’
glossary.νεκάδεσσιν: νεκάς — heap of dead, corpses (collective, from νεκρός); fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
glossary.νεφέεσσιν: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic νέφεσιν)
glossary.νεφέων: νέφος — cloud; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεφῶν)
glossary.ξυνάγοντες: συνάγω (epic ξυν-) — bring together, join; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’joining, bringing together’
glossary.οἵη: οἷος — of such a kind, such as; in a simile ’as’; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πήματ: πῆμα — woe, suffering, calamity; neut. acc. pl., elided (πήματ’ = πήματα)
glossary.παιήον: Παιήων — Paieon, physician of the gods (Attic Παιάν); masc. acc. sg., elided (Παιήον’ = Παιήονα)
glossary.παρεζόμενος: παρέζομαι — sit down beside; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting beside’
glossary.παύσασαι: παύω — stop, make cease, + gen. of what is ended; aor. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’having stopped’
glossary.παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter, son; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα): ’child, daughter’ (παῖς is common gender)
glossary.περίφαντα: Πέριφας — Periphas, an Aetolian warrior; masc. acc. sg. Περίφαντα
glossary.περιτρέφεται: περιτρέφω — make solid all round, curdle, thicken; mid./pass. pres. 3 sg.: ’thickens, curdles’
glossary.προτιβάλλεαι: προτιβάλλω (epic for προσβάλλω) — throw at, assail; mid. pres. 2 sg., uncontracted -εαι (= Attic -ῃ): ’you assail, deal with’
glossary.πρῴην: πρῴην — lately, a short time ago; adv.
glossary.σέων: σεός (= σός) — your; poss. adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic σῶν), agreeing with ἐφετμέων
glossary.σπάσεν: σπάω — draw, pull; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἔσπασε): ’drew out’
glossary.στεῦτ: στεῦμαι — declare solemnly, vow, make a claim; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., elided (στεῦτ’ = στεῦτο): ’declared’
glossary.συνέπηξεν: συμπήγνυμι — fasten together, make solid, curdle; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’curdled’
glossary.σχεδίην: σχεδίος — near, close at hand; fem. acc. sg. used as an adverb, σχεδίην: ’at close quarters, hand to hand’
glossary.τέκες: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτεκες): ’you bore, you begot’
glossary.ταύτην: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’her, this one’
glossary.τετληότες: τλάω — endure, bear, suffer; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic τετληότ- (= Attic τετληκότες): ’having endured’
glossary.τυκτὸν: τυκτός — made, fashioned, wrought (verbal adj. of τεύχω); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κακόν
glossary.τυπῇσι: τυπή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.τυχών: τυγχάνω — hit the mark, happen upon, chance; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’hitting the mark, having hit’
glossary.τύψον: τύπτω — strike, hit; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’strike!’
glossary.φήγινος: φήγινος — of oak, oaken (φηγός ’oak’); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φαίνεθ: φαίνω (mid./pass.) — appear, show itself; impf. 3 sg., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (φαίνεθ’ = φαίνετο): ’appeared’
glossary.φαμένη: φημί — say, speak; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’so saying’
glossary.χαλκοῖο: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.χαρίεντα: χαρίεις — graceful, lovely; adj., neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀΐδηλος: ἀΐδηλος — destroying, baneful (or ’unseen’: sense disputed); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀάσχετον: ἀάσχετος — unrestrainable, irresistible (sense inferred, from ἀ- + ἔχω); adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος
glossary.ἀήσυλα: ἀήσυλος — lawless, reckless (sense uncertain); adj., neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.ἀλήμεναι: εἴλω — press, pack together; aor. 2 pass. inf., epic athematic -μεναι (= Attic ἁλῆναι): ’to be packed together, to crowd together’
glossary.ἀλλοπρόσαλλε: ἀλλοπρόσαλλος — changing sides, fickle, a turncoat (ἄλλος + πρός + ἄλλος); adj., masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.ἀλλοπρόσαλλον: ἀλλοπρόσαλλος — changing sides, fickle, a turncoat (ἄλλος + πρός + ἄλλος); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τοῦτον
glossary.ἀμενηνὸς: ἀμενηνός — powerless, feeble, without strength; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνέηκεν: ἀνίημι — send up, let loose, urge on; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ἀνέηκεν (= Attic ἀνῆκε), ν-movable: ’urged on’
glossary.ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνέξομαι: ἀνέχομαι — put up with, tolerate; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will put up with’
glossary.ἀναχάζομαι: ἀναχάζομαι — draw back, withdraw, retire (cf. χάζω); pres. 1 sg. mid. dep.: ’I draw back’
glossary.ἀνδροκτασιάων: ἀνδροκτασίη — man-slaying, slaughter of men; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), gen. of separation after παύω
glossary.ἀνιεῖς: ἀνίημι — let loose, let go, give free rein to; pres. 2 sg. act., epic ἀνιεῖς (= Attic ἀνίης): ’you let loose’
glossary.ἀνώγειν: ἄνωγα — order, bid, command; plup. 3 sg. with impf. sense, ν-movable (ἀνώγει + ν; = ἠνώγει): ’bade, ordered’
glossary.ἀπόρουσεν: ἀπορούω — spring away, leap off; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable (= Attic ἀπόρουσε): ’sprang away’
glossary.ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω: ’grieving’
glossary.ἀϊχθῆναι: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, spring; aor. pass. inf. with active sense (ἀϊχθῆναι): ’to dart off’
glossary.ἀὴρ: ἀήρ — mist, haze (in Homer; later ’air’); fem. nom. sg., feminine in Homer
glossary.ἄλλου: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄνδρά: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
glossary.ἄρη: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., elided (Ἄρη’ = Ἄρηα; Attic Ἄρη)
glossary.ἅζεο: ἅζομαι — shrink from, fear, revere; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid. dep., uncontracted (= Attic ἅζου); with μηδ’: ’do not shrink from’
glossary.ἐγείναο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic -ω): ’you begot’
glossary.ἐκέλευσα: κελεύω — order, bid; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I ordered’
glossary.ἐμμαπέως: ἐμμαπέως — quickly, readily, at once; adv. (formation uncertain)
glossary.ἐμμεμαυῖα: ἐμμέμαα (ἐν + μέμαα, μάω) — be eager, strive; perf. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic, present sense: ’eager’
glossary.ἐνέρτερος: ἐνέρτερος — lower, nether, further down (comparative of ἔνερθε); adj., masc. nom. sg., + gen. of comparison: ’lower than’
glossary.ἐννεάχιλοι: ἐννεάχιλοι — nine thousand (ἐννέα + χίλιοι); numeral adj., masc. nom. pl. (Attic ἐνακισχίλιοι)
glossary.ἐννεσίῃσιν: ἐννεσίη — prompting, urging, instigation; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ἐξενάριζεν: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of arms, despoil, slay; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was stripping’
glossary.ἐπέρεισε: ἐπερείδω — lean upon, press, put weight on; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’pressed home’
glossary.ἐπέτειλας: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, lay a command on, + dat. of the person; aor. 2 sg. act.: ’you enjoined’
glossary.ἐπίαχον: ἐπιάχω — shout at, cry out (ἐπί + ἰάχω); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, general in a simile: ’cry out’
glossary.ἐπειγόμενος: ἐπείγω (mid.) — press on, hasten, work fast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hastening’
glossary.ἐπιεικτὸν: ἐπιεικτός — yielding, giving way (from ἐπείκω); adj., neut. nom. sg.; with οὐκ: ’unyielding’
glossary.ἐπικεύσω: ἐπικεύθω — hide further, keep back, conceal; fut. 1 sg. · also aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel, with future sense: ’I will (not) hide’
glossary.ἐπιπείθονται: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey, be persuaded by, + dat.; pres. 3 pl. mid. dep.: ’they obey’
glossary.ἐπιτάρροθός: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally (one who runs to a cry for help); noun, masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἐρύσασ: ἐρύω — draw, drag, pull; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἐρύσασ’ = ἐρύσασα): ’having drawn’
glossary.ἐόν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐόν (= Attic ὄν): ’being, as it is’
glossary.ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
glossary.ἔβραχ: βράχω — crash, clang, roar, bellow; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔβραχ’ = ἔβραχε)
glossary.ἔδαψεν: δάπτω — tear, rend, devour; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable (= Attic ἔδαψε): ’tore’
glossary.ἔπεϊ: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔπει), of means: ’with a word’
glossary.ἔχουσιν: ἔχω — have, hold, occupy; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
glossary.ἕσσε: ἕννυμι — clothe, put clothes on; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ-: ’clothed, put on’
glossary.ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
glossary.ἰήσασθαι: ἰάομαι — heal, cure; aor. inf. mid. dep., epic ἰήσασθαι (= Attic ἰάσασθαι): ’to heal’
glossary.ἰήσατο: ἰάομαι — heal, cure; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic ἰήσατο (= Attic ἰάσατο): ’healed’
glossary.ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
glossary.ὀλοφυρόμενος: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀπὸς: ὀπός — juice, sap (of the fig-tree, used to curdle milk); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρνυμένοιο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; mid. rise, start up; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’rising’
glossary.ὀχησίου: Ὀχήσιος — Ochesius, father of Periphas; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁμιλεῖ: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, consort, mingle; pres. 3 sg. act., + dat. or μετά + dat.: ’keeps company’
glossary.ὁρῶν: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’seeing’
glossary.ὄβριμος: ὄβριμος — mighty, stout, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.ὄκνος: ὄκνος — hesitation, shrinking, reluctance; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅσσόν: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; neut. acc. sg., epic ὅσσον (= Attic ὅσον), adverbial before τε: ’as loud as’
glossary.ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, liquid, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’liquid’
glossary.ὑπήνεικαν: ὑποφέρω — carry away from under, bear off; aor. 3 pl. act., epic ὑπήνεικαν (= Attic ὑπήνεγκαν): ’carried away’
glossary.ὑπερφίαλον: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, presumptuous; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπὲκ: ὑπέκ (ὑπό + ἐκ) — out from under; prep. + gen.: ’out from under’
glossary.ὠρέξαθ: ὀρέγω — stretch out, reach, thrust; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided and aspirated (ὠρέξαθ’ = ὠρέξατο): ’reached, thrust’
glossary.ὡρμᾶτο: ὁρμάω — set in motion; mid. rush, dart, start; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’rushed on’
glossary.ὦσεν: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
glossary.ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’
glossary.ῥίγιστα: ῥίγιστος — most dreadful, most chilling (superl. of ῥίγιον ’worse’); adj., neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’the worst things’
glossary.αἰπεινήν: αἰπεινός — sheer, steep, high; fem. acc. sg., poetic by-form of αἰπύς
glossary.αἴσηπον: Αἴσηπος — Aesepus, a Trojan, son of Bucolion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl.: ’what is fitting, fitting things’
glossary.βείω: βαίνω — go, step; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic βῶ): ’I may go’
glossary.βλαφθέντε: βλάπτω — hinder, disable, entangle; aor. pass. part. dual nom. (= βλαφθέντες in the plural): ’hampered, caught’
glossary.βουκολίων: Βουκολίων — Bucolion, a son of Laomedon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βουκολίωνι: Βουκολίων — Bucolion, a son of Laomedon; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.βουλευτῇσι: βουλευτής — councillor, elder of the council; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.βὰς: βαίνω — go, step, walk; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔβην): ’having stepped, stepping’
glossary.γαστέρι: γαστήρ — belly, womb; fem. dat. sg., epic γαστέρι (= Attic γαστρί)
glossary.γεραιὰς: γεραιός — old, aged; fem. acc. pl. as a noun: ’old women’
glossary.γλαυκώπιδος: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (standing epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γούνασιν: γόνυ — knee; neut. dat. pl., epic γούνασιν (= Attic γόνασι)
glossary.δαίμοσιν: δαίμων — god, divine power; masc. dat. pl.: ’to the gods’
glossary.δαμέντες: δάμνημι — tame, subdue, overpower; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl. (ἐδάμην): ’having been subdued, overcome’
glossary.δοκέει: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖ), + dat.: ’seems (to)’
glossary.δρῆσον: Δρῆσος — Dresus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόμοιο: δόμος — house; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δύναται: δύναμαι — be able; pres. 3 sg., + inf.: ’is able’
glossary.εἰσανέβησαν: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (with κεν, past potential: ’would have gone up into’)
glossary.ζωὸν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν): ’alive’
glossary.θέων: θέω — run, speed; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’running’
glossary.θεράποντι: θεράπων — attendant, squire; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θρῄκεσσι: Θρᾷξ — Thracian; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Θραξί): ’among the Thracians’
glossary.κάρτιστον: κάρτιστος — best, mightiest; epic superlative (= Attic κράτιστος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κήδεαι: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned for (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδῃ)
glossary.καλήσιον: Καλήσιος — Calesius, an attendant of Axylus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.καταξέμεν: κατάγω — lead down; fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic κατάξειν), of purpose after a verb of giving: ’to lead down’
glossary.κατελθέμεν: κατέρχομαι — go down, come down; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic κατελθεῖν)
glossary.κειμήλια: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up (from κεῖμαι); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κληῗδι: κληΐς — bolt, bar, key; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κλείς, dat. κλειδί): ’with a key’
glossary.κοῦρον: κοῦρος — boy, son; masc. acc. sg., Ionic-epic (= Attic κόρος)
glossary.κτείνωμεν: κτείνω — kill; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., hortatory: ’let us kill’
glossary.λῆξαν: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. act., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔληξαν)
glossary.μάχεσθαί: μάχομαι — fight; pres. inf., accented before the enclitic τε: ’to fight’
glossary.μάχη: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μέγιστος: μέγας — great; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’greatest, largest’
glossary.μήστωρα: μήστωρ — deviser, planner (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχησόμεθ: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (μαχησόμεθ’ = μαχησόμεθα; Attic μαχούμεθα): ’we shall fight’
glossary.μελάνθιον: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μηκιστηϊάδης: Μηκιστηϊάδης — son of Mecisteus (patronymic, Euryalus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μιμνέτω: μίμνω — stay, wait, linger (reduplicated form of μένω); pres. imper. 3 sg. act.: ’let him linger’
glossary.μνήσασθε: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’be mindful of’
glossary.μυρικίνῳ: μυρίκινος — of tamarisk (from μυρίκη); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηῒς: Νηΐς (Attic Ναΐς) — Naiad, water-nymph, in apposition to νύμφη; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ξάνθοιο: Ξάνθος — Xanthus, the river of Troy (also Scamander); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ξυνάγουσα: συνάγω — gather, bring together; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic ξυν- (= Attic συν-): ’gathering’
glossary.οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer has only neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἰώθη: οἰόομαι — be left alone, be left solitary; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was left alone’
glossary.οἴξασα: οἴγω — open; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having opened’
glossary.πήδασον: Πήδασος — Pedasus, a Trojan, son of Bucolion; masc. acc. sg. · also Pedasus, a town on the Satnioeis; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παραστὰς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔστην): ’standing beside’
glossary.παρειπών: παρεῖπον (aor. of παραφημί) — talk over, win over with words; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having persuaded’
glossary.πεποίηται: ποιέω — make, do, prepare; perf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has been done’
glossary.πεπύθοιτ: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, find out; reduplicated aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided (πεπύθοιτ’ = πεπύθοιτο; Attic πύθοιτο): ’should learn’
glossary.περκώσιον: Περκώσιος — of Percote (a town of the Troad); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πεσέειν: πίπτω — fall; aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic πεσεῖν): ’to fall’
glossary.πιδύτην: Πιδύτης — Pidytes, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. acc. pl.: ’the most, as much as possible’
glossary.ποιμαίνων: ποιμαίνω — tend (a flock), shepherd; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’tending’
glossary.πολύκμητός: πολύκμητος — much-wrought, laboriously worked; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πρεσβύτατος: πρέσβυς — old, elder; superl. πρεσβύτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’eldest’
glossary.πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σατνιόεντος: Σατνιόεις — Satnioeis, a river of the Troad; masc. gen. sg., epic -εντος
glossary.σκότιον: σκότιος — secret, of hidden birth, illegitimate; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’in secret’
glossary.στήθεσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.στῆτ: ἵστημι — set; aor. intrans. stand; aor. imper. 2 pl., root aorist, elided (στῆτ’ = στῆτε): ’stand!’
glossary.συλήσετε: συλάω — strip off, despoil; fut. 2 pl. act.: ’you will strip’
glossary.τέκ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. act., elided, unaugmented (τέκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’bore, begot’
glossary.τεθνηῶτας: θνήσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτας): ’dead’
glossary.τειρόμενοί: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic περ: ’hard-pressed’
glossary.τευθρανίδην: Τευθρανίδης — son of Teuthras (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τεῦκρος: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek hero at Troy, half-brother of Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τηλεκλειτοί: τηλεκλειτός — far-famed, renowned; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τ’
glossary.τροχὸν: τροχός — wheel, round disc; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)
glossary.φάλαγγα: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’
glossary.φίλτατος: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’dearest’
glossary.φαίδιμα: φαίδιμος — shining, splendid (of limbs); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.φεύγοντ: φεύγω — flee, escape; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (φεύγοντ’ = φεύγοντα): ’fleeing’
glossary.φεύγοντας: φεύγω — flee, escape; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’fleeing’
glossary.φιλέεσκεν: φιλέω — love, be fond of, treat kindly; impf. iterative 3 sg., epic -εσκεν, uncontracted and unaugmented: ’used to befriend’
glossary.φοβέοντο: φοβέω — frighten; mid./pass. flee in terror; impf. 3 pl. mid., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐφοβοῦντο): ’were fleeing in panic’
glossary.φόνοιο: φόνος — murder, slaughter; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), as with verbs of ceasing: ’from slaughter’
glossary.φύγοι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., of wish: ’may he escape’
glossary.φύλακον: Φύλακος — Phylacus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φὰν: φημί — say, think; aor./impf. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔφασαν), + acc. and inf.: ’they said, thought’
glossary.χαλκήρεα: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.χαρίσαιτο: χαρίζομαι — give freely, grant as a favour; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., with κεν, potential: ’would grant’
glossary.χαριέστατος: χαρίεις — graceful, beautiful; superl. χαριέστατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’most beautiful’
glossary.χρυσός: χρυσός — gold; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀβαρβαρέη: Ἀβαρβαρέη — Abarbarea, a Naiad nymph; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.ἀγκύλον: ἀγκύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκάμαντ: Ἀκάμας — Acamas, a Thracian leader, son of Eussorus; masc. acc. sg., elided (Ἀκάμαντ’ = Ἀκάμαντα)
glossary.ἀκήδεστοι: ἀκήδεστος — uncared-for, unmourned; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀλεξήσοντα: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend, help; fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to help’
glossary.ἀλόχοισι: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); masc./fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἀναγκαίη: ἀναγκαῖος — necessary; fem. ἀναγκαίη as a noun, necessity (= ἀνάγκη); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η
glossary.ἀναλκείῃσι: ἀναλκείη — lack of strength, cowardice; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’through cowardice’
glossary.ἀνετράπετ: ἀνατρέπω — turn over, upset; aor. 3 sg. mid. (intrans.), elided (ἀνετράπετ’ = ἀνετράπετο): ’was overturned, fell backward’
glossary.ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’
glossary.ἀπόσχῃ: ἀπέχω — hold off, keep away; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κεν in a purpose clause: ’may keep off’
glossary.ἀρήσασθαι: ἀράομαι — pray (to); aor. inf. mid.: ’to pray’
glossary.ἀρίσβῃ: Ἀρίσβη — Arisbe, a town of the Troad; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀρετάονα: Ἀρετάων — Aretaon, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρηϊφίλων: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀστύαλον: Ἀστύαλος — Astyalus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτυζομένω: ἀτύζομαι — be bewildered, panic; pres. part. mid. masc. dual nom.: ’panic-struck’
glossary.ἀτυζόμενοι: ἀτύζομαι — be bewildered, panic; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’in panic’
glossary.ἀφνειοῦ: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀχιλῆά: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., Ionic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα), accented before the enclitic ποτε
glossary.ἁπάσας: ἅπας — all, quite all; fem. acc. pl.: ’all of them’
glossary.ἄβληρον: Ἄβληρος — Ableros, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄδρηστον: Ἄδρηστος — Adrastus, a Trojan taken alive; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄδραστος)
glossary.ἄξαντ: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. part. act. masc. dual nom., elided (ἄξαντ’ = ἄξαντε): ’having broken’
glossary.ἄξια: ἄξιος — worth, of equal value, worthy; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄξυλον: Ἄξυλος — Axylus, a Trojan of Arisbe; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄστύ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἄφαντοι: ἄφαντος — unseen, vanished, without trace; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐβήτην: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 dual act., root aorist (ἔβην): ’the two went’
glossary.ἐγκέκλιται: ἐγκλίνω — lean on, lay upon; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’rests on, has been laid upon’
glossary.ἐδείδιμεν: δείδω — fear; plpf. 1 pl. with impf. sense (perf. stem δεδι-), epic (= Attic ἐδέδιμεν): ’we feared’
glossary.ἐδύτην: δύω — go into, sink into; aor. 3 dual act., root aorist (ἔδυν): ’the two went into’
glossary.ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
glossary.ἐλέλιχθεν: ἐλελίζω — make whirl, wheel round; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -θεν (= Attic -θησαν): ’wheeled round, rallied’
glossary.ἐλίσσετο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; impf. 3 sg.: ’was begging’
glossary.ἐλεήσῃ: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after αἴ κε: ’if she take pity’
glossary.ἐνάρων: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from the slain (neut. pl. only); neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐξέμμεναι: ἐκ + εἰμί — be sprung from; pres. inf., epic ἐξέμμεναι (= ἐξ + ἔμμεναι; Attic ἐκ + εἶναι), one word, + gen. of source
glossary.ἐξέσπασε: ἐκσπάω — draw out, pull out; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’pulled out’
glossary.ἐξαπολοίατ: ἐξαπόλλυμι — destroy utterly; mid. perish utterly; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= -οιντο), elided, of wish: ’may they perish’
glossary.ἐξεκυλίσθη: ἐκκυλίω — roll out; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was rolled out, tumbled out’
glossary.ἐπείγει: ἐπείγω — press, drive, urge on; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιβαλλόμενος: ἐπιβάλλω — throw upon; mid. throw oneself upon, set oneself to (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐποιχόμενοι: ἐποίχομαι — go about to, go among; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going about’
glossary.ἐποτρύνητον: ἐποτρύνω — urge on; aor. subj. 2 dual act., with ἐπεί κε: ’when you two have urged on’
glossary.ἐρυκάκετε: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl. act., epic: ’hold back!’
glossary.ἐϋρρείταο: ἐϋρρείτης — fair-flowing (of a river); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐϋσσώρου: Ἐΰσσωρος — Eussorus, father of Acamas; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔλατον: Ἔλατος — Elatus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
glossary.ἔπειθε: πείθω — persuade, win over; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was persuading’
glossary.ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg. with epic -σκε(ν) suffix: ’was, used to be’
glossary.ἔτρεψεν: τρέπω — turn, change; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’turned’
glossary.ἕλενος: Ἕλενος — Helenus, a son of Priam, a seer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠκέστας: ἤκεστος (?) — of a heifer, traditionally ’untouched by the goad’ (sense not certain); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἡμετέρῃς: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ἤνις: ἤνις — yearling, a young heifer; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, + acc.: ’warded off’
glossary.ἥρω: ἥρως — hero; masc. acc. sg., elided ἥρω’ (= ἥρωα)
glossary.ἰθυνομένων: ἰθύνω — make straight, aim; mid. aim, direct oneself; pres. part. mid. gen. pl., in a genitive absolute: ’as they aimed’
glossary.ἰθύν: ἰθύς (noun) — a direct course, an undertaking, a purpose; fem. acc. sg., distinct from the homographic adverb ἰθύς ’straight’
glossary.ἰσοφαρίζειν: ἰσοφαρίζω — match, rival, be equal to (+ dat. of person); pres. inf. act.: ’to match’
glossary.ἱερευσέμεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἱερεύσειν), after a verb of promising: ’to sacrifice’
glossary.ἱεροῖο: ἱερός — holy, sacred; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἱρῆς: ἱερός — holy, sacred; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic ἱρός (= Attic ἱερᾶς)
glossary.ἴθυσε: ἰθύω — rush straight on, surge; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’rushed on’
glossary.ὀφέλτιον: Ὀφέλτιος — Opheltius, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
glossary.ὄρχαμον: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (+ gen. ’of men’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπέλυσε: ὑπολύω — loosen from beneath, unnerve; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
glossary.ὑπέρθυμοι: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, high-hearted; masc. nom./voc. pl.
glossary.ὑπαντιάσας: ὑπαντιάω — meet, come to meet; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having met’
glossary.ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., of wish after μή: ’may he not escape’
glossary.ὑπεχώρησαν: ὑποχωρέω — give way, withdraw; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’gave ground’
glossary.ὑποκυσαμένη: ὑποκύω — conceive; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having conceived’
glossary.ὑποσχέσθαι: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, vow; aor. inf. mid. (ὑπεσχόμην): ’to promise, to vow’
glossary.ὑφηνίοχος: ὑφηνίοχος — charioteer, the one who holds the reins; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὔμμι: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic encl. dat. pl. ὔμμι (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to/for you’
glossary.ὤσατο: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’thrust away from himself’
glossary.ῥυμῷ: ῥυμός — chariot pole; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰθομένοιο: αἴθω — burn, blaze; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’blazing’
glossary.αἰολίδης: Αἰολίδης — son of Aeolus; masc. nom. sg., patronymic, in apposition to Sisyphus
glossary.αἰσχυνέμεν: αἰσχύνω — shame, disgrace, dishonour; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic αἰσχύνειν): ’to disgrace’
glossary.αὐτάρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.βασιληΐδος: βασιληΐς — of a king, royal (fem. adj., gen. -ΐδος; Attic βασιλική); fem. gen. sg.: τιμῆς βασιληΐδος ’of kingly honour’
glossary.βελλεροφόντην: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βελλεροφόντης: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βελλεροφόντῃ: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. dat. sg., with δαΐφρονι: ’to Bellerophon’
glossary.βουπλῆγι: βουπλήξ — ox-goad, goad (lit. ox-striker); fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an ox-goad’
glossary.βροτῶν: βροτός — mortal; masc. gen. pl., partitive after τίς: ’of mortals’
glossary.γίγνωσκε: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγίγνωσκε): ’was recognising, came to know’
glossary.γαμβροῖο: γαμβρός — son-in-law (a kinsman by marriage); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γαμβροῦ: γαμβρός — son-in-law (a kinsman by marriage); masc. gen. sg., gen. of source after παρεδέξατο: ’from his son-in-law’
glossary.γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενεὴ: γενεή — birth, lineage, generation; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενεὴν: γενεή — generation, race, lineage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γλαῦκον: Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, son of Sisyphus and father of Bellerophon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γνῶσιν: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., ν-movable (= Attic γνῶσι): ’may know’
glossary.γράψας: γράφω — scratch, incise, write; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having inscribed’
glossary.δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δαήμεναι: δάω — learn, find out (aor. pass. ἐδάην, active sense); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic δαῆναι): ’to learn’
glossary.δειδιότα: δείδω — fear; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δεδιότα): ’frightened’
glossary.δεκάτη: δέκατος — tenth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἠώς: ’the tenth (dawn)’
glossary.διωνύσοιο: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.διώνυσος: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δρύαντος: Δρύας — Dryas, father of Lycurgus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δυστήνων: δύστηνος — wretched, ill-starred; masc. gen. pl., as a noun, possessive with παῖδες: ’of wretched men’
glossary.δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δύμεναι: δύω — go into, enter, plunge into; aor. inf. act., root aorist, epic -μεναι (= Attic δῦναι): ’to enter’
glossary.δύνηαι: δύναμαι — be able; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic δύνῃ): ’you may be able’
glossary.δύσεθ: δύω — go down, sink, plunge; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (δύσεθ’ = δύσετο): ’went down, plunged’
glossary.δώμασ: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. dat. pl., elided (δώμασ’ = δώμασι)
glossary.εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, stationed’
glossary.εὐρείης: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
glossary.ζώοντες: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντες)
glossary.θέεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
glossary.θήβῃσιν: Θῆβαι — Thebes; fem. pl., dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), after ἐν: ’at Thebes’
glossary.θεινόμεναι: θείνω — strike, beat; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.: ’being struck’
glossary.θυμοφθόρα: θυμοφθόρος — heart-destroying, deadly (sense not clear); neut. acc. pl.: ’deadly (signs)’
glossary.θύσθλα: θύσθλον — (pl.) sacred implements or offerings of the Dionysiac rite (sense not certain); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κάκτανε: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., with apocope and assimilation (κάκτανε = κατάκτανε): ’kill!’
glossary.κάλλιφ: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; aor. 3 sg. act., with apocope, assimilation and elision (κάλλιφ’ = κατέλιπε, π aspirated before a rough breathing): ’left’
glossary.κάλλός: κάλλος — beauty; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.κέρδιστος: κέρδιστος — most cunning, craftiest (superlative of κερδίων); masc. nom. sg., + partitive gen. ἀνδρῶν
glossary.καρτίστην: κάρτιστος — strongest, mightiest (epic superlative, = Attic κράτιστος); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μάχην
glossary.κατέδων: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., from epic κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίων): ’eating away’
glossary.κατέκτανε: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. act., root aorist
glossary.κατέλειπον: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; impf. 1 sg. act.: ’I left behind’
glossary.κατέπεφνε: καταπέφνω (φένω) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’killed’
glossary.κατέπεφνεν: καταπέφνω (φένω) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’killed’
glossary.κατέπηξεν: καταπήγνυμι — fix down, plant, stick fast; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’planted’
glossary.κατέρυκε: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic κατήρυκε): ’kept back, detained’
glossary.κατέχευαν: καταχέω — pour down, let fall; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -χευαν (= Attic κατέχεαν): ’let fall, dropped’
glossary.καταθνητῶν: καταθνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. gen. pl., epic by-form of θνητός: καταθνητῶν ἀνθρώπων ’of mortal men’
glossary.κλειτοί: κλειτός — famed, renowned; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic κλυτός)
glossary.κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
glossary.κρυπταδίῃ: κρυπταδίος — secret, stealthy; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ)
glossary.κτείνειν: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epexegetic: ’to kill’
glossary.κυδαλίμοισι: κυδάλιμος — glorious, renowned; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κυδιανείρῃ: κυδιάνειρα — bringing men glory, man-ennobling (of battle); fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.κόλπῳ: κόλπος — bosom, lap, fold of a garment; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κὰπ: κατά — down along, over; prep. + acc., with apocope and assimilation before π (κὰπ πεδίον = κατὰ πεδίον)
glossary.λαοδάμειαν: Λαοδάμεια — Laodamia, daughter of Bellerophon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λαοδαμείῃ: Λαοδάμεια — Laodamia, daughter of Bellerophon; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ), after παρελέξατο
glossary.λυκίην: Λυκίη — Lycia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίην (= Attic Λυκίαν), goal of motion, once with the suffix -δε: Λυκίην δέ ’to Lycia’
glossary.λυκούργου: Λυκοῦργος — Lycurgus, son of Dryas; masc. gen. sg., the contracted form (beside the uncontracted Λυκόοργος)
glossary.λυκόοργος: Λυκοῦργος — Lycurgus, son of Dryas; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted epic Λυκόοργος (= contracted Λυκοῦργος)
glossary.λύκιοι: Λύκιος — Lycian, a man of Lycia; masc. nom. pl., as a noun
glossary.μένει: μένος — force, might, fury; neut. dat. sg., with ἀντιόωσιν: ’my might’
glossary.μέσση: μέσος — middle; fem. nom. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέση): ’in the middle’
glossary.μήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, contrive, plan; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμήσατο)
glossary.μαινομένοιο: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’raving’
glossary.μαχέσσατο: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐμαχέσατο): ’fought’
glossary.μαχοίμην: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with ἂν (οὐκ ἂν … μαχοίμην): ’I would not fight’
glossary.μεγάθυμε: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μιγήμεναι: μίγνυμι — mix; pass. mingle, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic μιγῆναι): ’to lie with’
glossary.μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, nook, recess; masc. dat. sg.: ’in the recess (of)’
glossary.νυσήϊον: Νυσήϊον — Nyseion, a place sacred to Dionysus (site unknown); neut. acc. sg., adjective as noun, epic -ήϊον
glossary.ξείνισ: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest-friend; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ξείνισ’ = ξείνισε; Attic ἐξένισε)
glossary.ξείνισσε: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest-friend; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐξένισε): ’entertained’
glossary.ξεινήϊα: ξεινήϊον — gift of a guest-friend, guest-gift; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ξένια)
glossary.ξεῖνοι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. pl., predicate
glossary.οἰνεὺς: Οἰνεύς — Oeneus, king of Calydon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πάτον: πάτος — path, trodden way; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπε): ’sent, was sending’
glossary.πίνακι: πίναξ — tablet, writing-board; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παλαιός: παλαιός — old, of long standing; masc. nom. sg., predicate with ξεῖνος: ’of old’
glossary.παρεδέξατο: παραδέχομαι — receive from another, accept; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound)
glossary.πατρώϊοι: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal, hereditary; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷος)
glossary.πατρώϊός: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal, hereditary; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πατρῷος), accented before the enclitic ἐσσι
glossary.πείραθ: πεῖραρ — end, limit, boundary; neut. acc. pl., elided (πείραθ’ = πείρατα; Attic πέρατα)
glossary.πενθερῷ: πενθερός — father-in-law; masc. dat. sg.: ’to his father-in-law’
glossary.πεφνέμεν: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. inf. act., epic -έμεν: ’to kill’
glossary.πεῖθ: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg. act., elided (πεῖθ’ = πεῖθε), unaugmented: ’tried to persuade’
glossary.πομπῇ: πομπή — convoy, escort, safe conduct; fem. dat. sg.
