glossary.προίτοιο: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προίτου: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. gen. sg., possessive with γυνή
glossary.προβέβηκας: προβαίνω — step forward, advance, go beyond; perf. 2 sg. act., + gen. of comparison: ’you have gone far beyond’
glossary.προῖτ: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. voc. sg., elided (Προῖτ’ = Προῖτε), in address
glossary.προῖτον: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.προῖτος: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πτυκτῷ: πτυκτός — folded, with leaves that fold together; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πίνακι
glossary.πυμάτη: πύματος — last, outermost; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὕστατος)
glossary.πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν): ’gave’
glossary.πόρῃ: πόρω (aor. ἔπορον) — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg., with κε in a relative clause: ’may grant’
glossary.σίσυφος: Σίσυφος — Sisyphus, the cunning man of Ephyre; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σεβάσσατο: σεβάζομαι — feel awe, hold in reverence, scruple at; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐσεβάσατο), unaugmented: ’felt awe’
glossary.σεῦε: σεύω — drive, chase, put to flight; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσευε): ’chased’
glossary.σολύμοισι: Σόλυμοι — the Solymi, a people of Lycia; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), object of μαχέσσατο: ’the Solymi’
glossary.συνίτην: σύνειμι (εἶμι) — come together, meet; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic συνῄτην): ’the two met’
glossary.τάμον: τέμνω — cut, cut out, mark off; aor. 3 pl. act., root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔτεμον): ’cut out, marked off’
glossary.τέκεθ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (τέκεθ’ = τέκετο), active in sense: ’begot’
glossary.τίκτεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, unaugmented (= ἔτικτεν): ’begot’
glossary.ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with γενεῆς: ’of this’
glossary.τεθναίης: θνῄσκω — die; perf. opt. act. 2 sg. (τέθνηκα), as a wish: ’may you be dead’
glossary.τηλεθόωσα: τηλεθάω — flourish, bloom luxuriantly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., diectasis (uncontracted, stretched vowel)
glossary.τιθήνας: τιθήνη — nurse; fem. acc. pl.: ’the nurses (of Dionysus)’
glossary.τρία: τρεῖς, τρία — three; neut. acc. pl., with τέκνα
glossary.τυδέα: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τυφλὸν: τυφλός — blind; masc. acc. sg., predicate after ἔθηκε: ’blind’
glossary.τύπτε: τύπτω — strike, beat; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτυπτε): ’kept beating’
glossary.φέριστε: φέριστος — best, bravest (superlative beside φέρτερος); masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.φέροιτο: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., oblique optative in an indirect question: ’he was bringing’
glossary.φαεινόν: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζωστῆρα
glossary.φοβηθεὶς: φοβέω — frighten; pass. be afraid; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having been frightened, in fear’
glossary.φυταλιῆς: φυταλιά — orchard, planted land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ιῆς (= Attic -ιᾶς), gen. of respect after καλόν: ’fair in orchard (land)’
glossary.φύει: φύω — bring forth, make grow; (intrans.) grow, spring up; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’brings forth’ · ’grows’
glossary.φῶτας: φώς — man, warrior, mortal; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χέει: χέω — pour, shed, scatter; pres. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic χεῖ)
glossary.χίμαιρα: χίμαιρα — she-goat; fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’a goat’
glossary.χίμαιραν: Χίμαιρα — the Chimaera, a fire-breathing monster (lit. she-goat); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χαλκοκορυστήν: χαλκοκορυστής — armed in bronze, bronze-equipped; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Sarpedon
glossary.χρυσήνιος: χρυσήνιος — with golden reins; masc./fem. adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of Artemis
glossary.χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν), agreeing with δέπας
glossary.ψευσαμένη: ψεύδω — deceive; mid. speak falsely, lie; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having lied’
glossary.ἀγαθὰ: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. pl., internal accusative with φρονέοντα: ’good things’
glossary.ἀλέεινε: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun, shrink from; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + inf.: ’shrank from’
glossary.ἀλήϊον: Ἀλήϊος — Aleian, of the Aleian plain (in Cilicia, by tradition); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πεδίον
glossary.ἀλᾶτο: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., contracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἠλᾶτο): ’wandered’
glossary.ἀμαζόνας: Ἀμαζών — Amazon, one of a nation of warrior women; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμαιμακέτην: ἀμαιμάκετος — of unknown meaning, guessed ’huge’ or ’irresistible’; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the Chimaera
glossary.ἀντιανείρας: ἀντιάνειρα — man-matching (sense disputed: a match for men, fighting like men, or opposed to men); fem. acc. pl., epithet of the Amazons
glossary.ἀντιόωσιν: ἀντιάω — meet, face, come against (+ dat.); pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted with diectasis (= Attic ἀντιῶσι): ’they meet’
glossary.ἀπολήγει: ἀπολήγω — leave off, cease, come to an end; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’ends’
glossary.ἀποπνείουσα: ἀποπνέω — breathe out, blow forth; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic -πνείουσα (= Attic ἀποπνέουσα): ’breathing out’
glossary.ἀπώλετο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’perished’
glossary.ἀριστεύειν: ἀριστεύω — be the best, excel, be foremost; pres. inf. act., after ἐπέτελλεν: ’to be the best’
glossary.ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. gen. pl., of comparison after προβέβηκας: ’beyond all’
glossary.ἄντεια: Ἄντεια — Anteia, wife of Proetus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄντυξ: ἄντυξ — rim (of a shield); fem. nom. sg., in apposition to δέρμα
glossary.ἐδάμασσε: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάμασε): ’subdued’
glossary.ἐθελούσῃ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. act. fem. dat. sg., with a negative: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθελούσῃ ’to me, unwilling’)
glossary.ἐμοῖσι: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with δώμασ(ι)
glossary.ἐναιρέμεν: ἐναίρω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐναίρειν), epexegetic: ’to kill’
glossary.ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg. act. (augment inside the compound), + dat. + inf.: ’charged’
glossary.ἐπαμείψομεν: ἐπαμείβω — exchange; fut. indic. 1 pl. act. (or short-vowel aor. subj., hortative): ’we shall exchange, let us exchange’
glossary.ἐπεμήνατο: ἐπιμαίνομαι — be frenzied with desire for; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound), + inf.: ’was mad to’
glossary.ἐπιγίγνεται: ἐπιγίγνομαι — come after, come on, supervene; pres. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’comes on’
glossary.ἐπουρανίοισι: ἐπουράνιος — heavenly, dwelling in heaven; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐπουρανίοισιν: ἐπουράνιος — heavenly, dwelling in heaven; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐρέεινε: ἐρεείνω — question, ask; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’questioned’
glossary.ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἐρύξας: ἐρύκω — keep, hold back, detain; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having kept’
glossary.ἐφύρη: Ἐφύρη — Ephyre, a city of the Argive land (by tradition Corinth); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic Ἐφύρα)
glossary.ἐφύρῃ: Ἐφύρη — Ephyre, a city of the Argive land (by tradition Corinth); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Ἐφύρᾳ), after ἐν
glossary.ἔαρος: ἔαρ — spring; neut. gen. sg. (= Attic ἦρος): ’of spring’
glossary.ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
glossary.ἔθελεν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελεν): ’wished’
glossary.ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., root aorist ἔκτα
glossary.ἔμεινας: μένω — stay, remain; await, withstand; aor. 2 sg. act., + acc.: ’you withstood’
glossary.ἔτεκ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔτεκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’bore’
glossary.ἔτεκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’bore’
glossary.ἠγάθεον: ἠγάθεος — most holy, very sacred (ἠ- intensive); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with Νυσήϊον
glossary.ἠνορέην: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage, vigour; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἀνδρεία)
glossary.ἠνώγειν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; plupf. 3 sg. in -ειν, epic variant (= ἠνώγει), serving as a simple past: ’he bade’
glossary.ἠῢν: ἠΰς (= ἐΰς) — good, noble; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with γόνον
glossary.ἡμετέρην: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with γενεήν
glossary.ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἤματ’ = ἤματα), acc. of duration: ’for (twenty) days’
glossary.ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
glossary.ἰόντε: εἶμι — go; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two going’
glossary.ἱέρευσεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable
glossary.ἱππολόχοιο: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἱππόλοχον: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱππόλοχος: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴσανδρον: Ἴσανδρος — Isander, son of Bellerophon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴσανδρόν: Ἴσανδρος — Isander, son of Bellerophon; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἴσασιν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl. (pres. force), ν-movable: ’they know’
glossary.ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. dep., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἵκῃ): ’you may reach’
glossary.ἷξε: ἵκω — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg. (ἷξον): ’reached’
glossary.ὀδύσαντο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry with, hate (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic, unaugmented (= ὠδύσαντο)
glossary.ὀλέθρου: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. gen. sg., depending on πείραθ(α): ’of destruction’
glossary.ὀμφαλοέσσης: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (of a shield); fem. gen. sg., -όεσσα in the feminine, agreeing with ἀσπίδος
glossary.ὁμοκλῇ: ὁμοκλή — shout, threatening cry, rebuke; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’at the shouted rebuke’
glossary.ὑπείροχον: ὑπείροχος — outstanding, pre-eminent (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὑπέροχος): ’pre-eminent over (others)’
glossary.ὑπεδέξατο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound)
glossary.ὤπασαν: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, grant; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (ὀπάζω, aor. ὤπασα), + dat. of the recipient
glossary.ὥρη: ὥρα (Ionic ὥρη) — season, the right time of year; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ᾱ): ’the season’
glossary.ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic ᾔτει)
glossary.ῥέοντα: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’flowing’
